_meta.note: Knacks parsed from Pandora's Box (Revised) Calling and Denizen chapters (882 rows). Book (Hero p.223): knack categories are mortal | immortal only. `callingSlotCost` 1|2 is the Hero-band dot cost (PB IMMORTAL section = 2).

eligibility.callings: Array of Calling ids, or omit / callingsAny true for General Calling (PB GENERAL).
eligibility.callingsAny: If true, General Calling — PB GENERAL knack pool (any Calling).
eligibility.tier: mortal | immortal (knack category). Origin shows mortal; Hero+ shows immortal.
eligibility.callingSlotCost: Calling dots this knack spends at Hero tier: 1 (default) or 2 (PB IMMORTAL lists). Demigod+ treat all as 1 dot in the UI.

mythos_rust_and_decay.name: Rust and Decay
mythos_rust_and_decay.description: With a touch, corrode and destroy an item; Creator roll vs Size (and armor Scale if any).
mythos_rust_and_decay.mechanicalEffects: Heroic inverted Knack (MotM). Size 0 items destroyed without a roll.

mythos_raze_the_city.name: Raze the City
mythos_raze_the_city.description: Destroy a small building or monument in minutes; spend Momentum to collapse it instantly.
mythos_raze_the_city.mechanicalEffects: Immortal inverted Knack (MotM)—two Calling slots at Hero+ per standard rules.

mythos_honied_words.name: Honied Words
mythos_honied_words.description: Name a charge; Momentum directs them with +2 Enhancement while you watch (waive cost with a Bond).

mythos_puppet_show.name: Puppet Show
mythos_puppet_show.description: Command your charge’s body and mind for one action; requires Bond, lower Tier, consent per MotM sidebar.
mythos_puppet_show.mechanicalEffects: Immortal inverted Knack (MotM). Guardian Knack Skill roll.

mythos_spread_disease.name: Spread Disease
mythos_spread_disease.description: Worsen a patient’s disease Complication or spread it to nearby targets per Healer Knack Skill.

mythos_plague_bearer.name: Plague Bearer
mythos_plague_bearer.description: Spend Momentum to inflict a mythic plague on an area; extra Momentum excludes chosen people.
mythos_plague_bearer.mechanicalEffects: Immortal inverted Knack (MotM). Complication equals Healer Knack Skill.

mythos_scent_of_blood.name: Scent of Blood
mythos_scent_of_blood.description: +1 Enhancement attacking targets who already have Injury Conditions.

mythos_baying_of_the_hounds.name: Baying of the Hounds
mythos_baying_of_the_hounds.description: Momentum unleashes Mythos hunters on your prey—Complication on all actions until unconscious or you catch them.

mythos_curse_of_fragility.name: Curse of Fragility
mythos_curse_of_fragility.description: Momentum in a fight: all enemies attacking your target treat their attacks as having the Brutal tag.

mythos_pronounce_guilt.name: Pronounce Guilt
mythos_pronounce_guilt.description: Declare guilt; evidence rearranges to fit. Clash of Wills if another guilty party appears.

mythos_harsh_words.name: Harsh Words
mythos_harsh_words.description: Order a target; Momentum inflicts Complication on anything but obedience; failing to buy off causes damage.
mythos_harsh_words.mechanicalEffects: Heroic inverted Knack (MotM). Complication tied to Leader Calling rating.

mythos_raise_an_army.name: Raise an Army
mythos_raise_an_army.description: Momentum raises trivial allies—or Mythos creatures where no people exist—to fight for you.

mythos_the_gate_and_key.name: The Gate and Key
mythos_the_gate_and_key.description: Momentum opens a portal between literal doors/windows/manholes to anywhere you have visited, including Terra Incognitae.

mythos_among_the_stars.name: Among the Stars
mythos_among_the_stars.description: Become intangible star-stuff for successes in turns; matter bends around you and attacks slow.
mythos_among_the_stars.mechanicalEffects: Immortal inverted Knack (MotM). Knack Skill roll + Momentum.

mythos_sense_weakness.name: Sense Weakness
mythos_sense_weakness.description: After exchanging attacks with a foe, +1 Enhancement vs. them and +1 Defense for the fight (one foe per scene).

mythos_name_nemesis.name: Name Nemesis
mythos_name_nemesis.description: Declare a named enemy; they become Fatebound as Nemesis (replaces weaker Fatebinding at same rating).

mythos_psychic_attack.name: Psychic Attack
mythos_psychic_attack.description: Momentum + Knack Skill: victim takes increased Difficulty on mental tasks for the scene.

mythos_infinite_knowledge.name: Infinite Knowledge
mythos_infinite_knowledge.description: Ask one question—knowable answers are automatic; unknowable or hidden facts may require roll or Clash; investigations gain one Clue.

mythos_redirect.name: Redirect
mythos_redirect.description: Momentum redirects an enemy’s rage to a new target they attack instead.

mythos_exposed.name: Exposed
mythos_exposed.description: Momentum: tell a damaging lie believed by all who hear; exoneration provokes Clash of Wills.

mythos_twist_the_knife.name: Twist the Knife
mythos_twist_the_knife.description: Painful Blow stunt vs. injured enemies; +1 Difficulty to Antagonists’ actions.
mythos_twist_the_knife.mechanicalEffects: Heroic inverted Knack (MotM). See MotM for stunt cost.

mythos_pain_for_pleasure.name: Pain for Pleasure
mythos_pain_for_pleasure.description: Inflict Injury on a helpless captive to grant your Band +2 Enhancement (+3 if Taken Out).

sm_adversary_antagonistic_lessons.name: Antagonistic Lessons
sm_adversary_antagonistic_lessons.description: Whenever the results of your actions cause a target of your antagonism to fail, you may adjust their Attitude, cause them to succeed at an action you determine, or instantly create a Fatebinding with the target.
sm_adversary_antagonistic_lessons.mechanicalEffects: Whenever the results of your actions cause a target of your antagonism to fail, you may adjust their Attitude, cause them to succeed at an action you determine, or instantly create a Fatebinding with the target.

If that causes them to fail, regain the spent Momentum.

tr_general_overwhelming_presence.description: Be heard and seen clearly despite environmental Complications; your presence imposes respect.
tr_general_overwhelming_presence.mechanicalEffects: Ignore fog, noise, crowds, etc. for being perceived. Others take a Complication equal to your highest Titanic Calling to knowingly ignore or snub you; failing to buy it off knocks them prone.

tr_general_beacon_of_power.name: Beacon of Power
tr_general_beacon_of_power.description: Once per scene: one extra Innate Purview marvel this scene without counting toward your marvel limit. Once per scene. Your Innate Purview marvels can flare beyond normal limits but betray you to keen observers.
tr_general_beacon_of_power.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene: one extra Innate Purview marvel this scene without counting toward your marvel limit. Whenever you imbue or spend Legend, Hero+ characters may roll Occult + Intellect to identify you and gain +2 Enhancement to track or detect you for the scene.

tr_general_divine_armistice.name: Divine Armistice (Òrìshà / Loa)
tr_general_divine_armistice.description: Spend Momentum to cool hatred between Gods, Titans, and the Titanomachy within a Field.
tr_general_divine_armistice.mechanicalEffects: Spend 1 Momentum: Field weakens hostile attitudes about Gods/Titans/Titanomachy by 2 for the scene. Violators take +3 Complication on actions in the Field; if not bought off, observers read their actions as dishonorable or reckless (including later gossip/recordings).

tr_adv_enemy_of_my_enemy.name: Enemy of My Enemy
tr_adv_enemy_of_my_enemy.description: Sense shared grudges and read useful memories about why someone hates what you hate.
tr_adv_enemy_of_my_enemy.mechanicalEffects: You know when someone shares a negative Attitude toward a person/group you also oppose; Read Attitude reveals useful memories about that dislike. Higher Tier may hide this (Clash of Wills per PDF).

tr_adv_my_misfortune_is_your_misfortune.name: My Misfortune Is Your Misfortune
tr_adv_my_misfortune_is_your_misfortune.description: Redirect a Complication imposed on you toward the source or someone they care about.
tr_adv_my_misfortune_is_your_misfortune.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum when someone imposes a Complication on you to redirect it per PDF. First use each scene is free.

tr_adv_perfectly_symmetrical_violence.name: Perfectly Symmetrical Violence
tr_adv_perfectly_symmetrical_violence.description: Strike back immediately when someone injures you.
tr_adv_perfectly_symmetrical_violence.mechanicalEffects: When injured by a character, spend 2 Momentum to attack them immediately without a mixed action, even if you already acted this round.

tr_adv_pride_before_a_fall.name: Pride Before a Fall
tr_adv_pride_before_a_fall.description: Punish a rival’s successes with ironic failure.
tr_adv_pride_before_a_fall.mechanicalEffects: When a character you have a negative Attitude toward uses Enhancement, spend Momentum to inflict dice penalty up to your Adversary; if they fail, the failure is especially ironic or tragic. First use each scene is free.

tr_adv_a_wicked_idea.name: A Wicked Idea
tr_adv_a_wicked_idea.description: Plant a dangerous idea disguised as a joke; the target’s self-control frays.
tr_adv_a_wicked_idea.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to suggest a malicious course as “just a joke.” Next good opportunity, target takes +2 Complication on all actions for the scene from distraction. Higher Tier resists with Clash (Manipulation + Legend vs Composure + Legend).

tr_adv_fever_ridden_bogovi.name: Fever-Ridden (Bogovi)
tr_adv_fever_ridden_bogovi.description: Possess another as a spiritual disease, riding their senses.
tr_adv_fever_ridden_bogovi.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to become an infectious cloud and inhabit someone at Short range; share senses; once per scene influence them (+2 Enhancement if unaware). Healing diseases exorcises you; otherwise Integrity + Stamina successes accumulate to force you out. Same Tier+ resists infection with Clash of Wills.

tr_adv_wrath_is_sustenance_kuh.name: Wrath Is Sustenance (K’uh)
tr_adv_wrath_is_sustenance_kuh.description: Feed on enmity; leverage hatred in contests.
tr_adv_wrath_is_sustenance_kuh.mechanicalEffects: Reduce penalties from fatigue, hunger, and similar needs by your highest negative Attitude. Add Adversary as Enhancement to contested rolls against characters toward whom you have a negative Attitude.

tr_adv_my_best_enemy.name: My Best Enemy
tr_adv_my_best_enemy.description: Hold extra temporary Fatebindings fueled by rivalry.
tr_adv_my_best_enemy.mechanicalEffects: You may hold extra temporary Fatebindings up to your Adversary rating beyond normal limits; these cap at Strength 3. Same Tier+ resists with Clash of Wills. Duration follows Fatebinding rules (see Scion: Hero).

tr_adv_ruin_your_life_netjer.name: Ruin Your Life (Netjer)
tr_adv_ruin_your_life_netjer.description: Steal an enemy’s identity to destroy their reputation.
tr_adv_ruin_your_life_netjer.mechanicalEffects: Gain Enhancement equal to their negative Attitude toward you to impersonate them; includes stunts Not a Trace (1s) and The Wrong Trace Entirely (3s) per PDF.

tr_adv_that_venom_deception_palas.name: That Venom, Deception (Pālas)
tr_adv_that_venom_deception_palas.description: Spread irresistible gossip that compels believers to repeat it.
tr_adv_that_venom_deception_palas.mechanicalEffects: Spend 1 Momentum: +2 Enhancement to spread gossip about someone; believers must pass it on. Same Tier+ resists with Clash. Free vs trivial subjects or those who already dislike you; first use each scene is free.

tr_dest_it_all_ends_in_silence.name: It All Ends in Silence
tr_dest_it_all_ends_in_silence.description: Spend Momentum: Field grants +1 Enhancement to Stealth. Create a sound-suppressing Field favoring stealth and muffling foes.
tr_dest_it_all_ends_in_silence.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum: Field grants +1 Enhancement to Stealth; noisy actions take +3 Complication; if not bought off, speech cannot carry beyond Short range for the scene.

tr_dest_not_a_trace.name: Not a Trace (Destroyer)
tr_dest_not_a_trace.description: Erase forensic and electronic evidence of your presence after each scene.
tr_dest_not_a_trace.mechanicalEffects: At scene end, destroy fingerprints, DNA, and recordings of your presence; witnesses still remember you normally.

tr_dest_sever_the_ties.name: Sever the Ties
tr_dest_sever_the_ties.description: Undermine loyalties harder when you Shift Attitude to tear bonds apart.
tr_dest_sever_the_ties.mechanicalEffects: When using Shift Attitude to undermine loyalty or affection, spend Momentum to shift one extra step; if reduced to 0 or less, rebuilding that attitude this season is +2 difficulty. First use each scene is free.

tr_dest_what_you_fear_losing.name: What You Fear Losing
tr_dest_what_you_fear_losing.description: Read what a victim cannot bear to lose and leverage it in threats.
tr_dest_what_you_fear_losing.mechanicalEffects: On Read Attitude, intuit something in the scene they fear to lose; +2 Enhancement to threats endangering it; they cannot apply their negative Attitude toward you against those threats.

tr_dest_juracans_dance_zem.name: Juracán’s Dance (Zemí)
tr_dest_juracans_dance_zem.description: Channel destruction through performance and revolutionary art.
tr_dest_juracans_dance_zem.mechanicalEffects: +2 Enhancement to encourage destructive or revolutionary behavior through art or performance, or to stoke outrage/violence. Those who embrace the mission gain +1 Enhancement on attacks against your chosen target.

tr_dest_jotuns_armory_aesir.name: Jötun’s Armory (Æsir)
tr_dest_jotuns_armory_aesir.description: Reflexively arm yourself with improvised oversized weapons from scenery.
tr_dest_jotuns_armory_aesir.mechanicalEffects: Break trivial scenery for Heavy Melee weapons (Bashing or Lethal + one of Brutal, Pushing, Reach, Stun). With Size Scale access, weapons scale slightly above your size as per PDF.

tr_dest_swallow_the_moon_balahala.name: Swallow the Moon (Bahala)
tr_dest_swallow_the_moon_balahala.description: Diminish a Purview’s grip on the scene by devouring its symbolic power.
tr_dest_swallow_the_moon_balahala.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum, choose a Purview: for the scene, Complications and Enhancements tied to it drop by 2; extra Inflict Damage stunt purchases vs examples of it. Purview wielders may contest with Clash (Legend + Might vs Legend + Stamina).

tr_dest_evil_eye_tuatha.name: The Evil Eye (Tuatha)
tr_dest_evil_eye_tuatha.description: Your locked gaze becomes a lethal, vision-warping curse.
tr_dest_evil_eye_tuatha.mechanicalEffects: When another locks eyes with you, roll Integrity + Presence attack with Piercing and Lethal; for the scene they take +2 Complication on vision-based actions against you or risk Injury.
tr_dest_evil_eye_tuatha.source: TItans_Rising_(Final_Download).pdf — Destroyer Knacks (Immortal, Tuatha Dé Danann)

tr_dest_embrace_the_end_yazata.name: Embrace the End (Yazata)
tr_dest_embrace_the_end_yazata.description: Your attacks carry decay—wounds fester and years catch up.
tr_dest_embrace_the_end_yazata.mechanicalEffects: On attacks, access stunts Festering Wound (1s) and Decay of Age (3s) per PDF (healing slowed; physical Attribute penalty until Injuries heal).

tr_mon_stinging_stink_manitou.name: Stinging Stink (Manitou)
tr_mon_stinging_stink_manitou.description: Action: Noxious Condition on everyone within Short. Release a musk cloud that marks everyone nearby with stench and social peril.
tr_mon_stinging_stink_manitou.mechanicalEffects: Action: Noxious Condition on everyone within Short; hours to scrub; +2 Complication on social influence to avoid offense and on Stealth to avoid trails for the scene.

tr_mon_no_close_ups_please.name: No Close-ups, Please
tr_mon_no_close_ups_please.description: Your face refuses to be remembered—only the fear sticks.
tr_mon_no_close_ups_please.mechanicalEffects: +2 difficulty to remember or describe you after the scene; trivial characters cannot unless you deliberately terrified them (then they remember but cannot describe).

tr_mon_debts_paid_in_blood_teotl.name: Debts Paid in Blood (Teōtl)
tr_mon_debts_paid_in_blood_teotl.description: Hunt anyone indebted to you across distance with predatory certainty.
tr_mon_debts_paid_in_blood_teotl.mechanicalEffects: Always know distance, direction, and shortest path to debtors. They take Complication equal to your Monster Calling to evade, defraud, or refuse repayment; if not bought off, messy Injury and you sense their intent at any range.

tr_mon_face_of_fear.name: The Face of Fear
tr_mon_face_of_fear.description: Embody a target’s primal fear to terrify them worse than anyone else.
tr_mon_face_of_fear.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to learn a primal fear and shapeshift into a monstrous embodiment: +1 Enhancement to terrify generally, +3 against that target. First use each scene and vs trivial targets are free.

tr_mon_evolving_threat.name: Evolving Threat
tr_mon_evolving_threat.description: Each turn you adapt armor or natural weapons against what hurt you.
tr_mon_evolving_threat.mechanicalEffects: Start of your turn: gain Resistant vs last turn’s damage type or add a 1-point tag to a Natural weapon; bank points across turns for pricier tags, up to Monster dots total new tags; all slough at scene end.

tr_mon_lifeblood_buffet.name: Lifeblood Buffet
tr_mon_lifeblood_buffet.description: A concealed natural weapon feeds on blood to mend your wounds.
tr_mon_lifeblood_buffet.mechanicalEffects: Close attack (Natural, Melee, Lethal, Concealable). When you buy Inflict Damage, spend Momentum to heal Bruised/Injured; with Critical Stunt, heal Maimed. Trivial victims only heal Bruised.

tr_mon_monsters_in_the_mirror.name: Monsters in the Mirror
tr_mon_monsters_in_the_mirror.description: Spend Momentum to inflict Monstrous Urges (see Saints & Monsters or Titanomachy for the Condition). Infect others with Monstrous Urges that risk collateral harm.
tr_mon_monsters_in_the_mirror.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to inflict Monstrous Urges (see Saints & Monsters or Titanomachy for the Condition). Same Tier+ resists with Clash of Wills.

tr_mon_skulking_horror.name: Skulking Horror
tr_mon_skulking_horror.description: While concealed from all observers, move to any location you can see within Long range without traversing intervening space. While hidden and your position unknown, slip across Long range without crossing the space between.
tr_mon_skulking_horror.mechanicalEffects: While concealed from all observers, move to any location you can see within Long range without traversing intervening space.

tr_mon_sacrificial_spawn_tengri.name: Sacrificial Spawn (Tengri)
tr_mon_sacrificial_spawn_tengri.description: Sacrifice a body part to birth a short-lived titanspawn.
tr_mon_sacrificial_spawn_tengri.mechanicalEffects: Harmlessly remove a limb/eye/etc. and transform it into a Creature for the scene with rating 2 + Complication you took from the loss (max 3).

tr_prime_bending_the_world.name: Bending the World
tr_prime_bending_the_world.description: Act at Close range through wind, plants, and other natural extensions.
tr_prime_bending_the_world.mechanicalEffects: Take Close actions at distance via natural phenomena using normal pools, but Attribute dice cannot exceed Primeval. +1 Complication at Medium, +2 at Long; if not bought off, actions are slow or clumsy.

tr_prime_the_old_ways_nemetondevos.name: The Old Ways (Nemetondevos)
tr_prime_the_old_ways_nemetondevos.description: Punish reliance on complex tools; return craft to raw elements.
tr_prime_the_old_ways_nemetondevos.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum: inflict Complication equal to Primeval on actions using complex tools (guns, phones, etc.). If not bought off, item is destroyed at action’s end. First use and vs trivial are free.

tr_prime_none_grasp_the_wind.name: None Grasp the Wind
tr_prime_none_grasp_the_wind.description: Slip bonds and barriers that would hold a mortal body.
tr_prime_none_grasp_the_wind.mechanicalEffects: +2 Enhancement to resist physical restraint including Clashes of Wills. Spend Momentum to pass through a barrier that is not airtight.

tr_prime_world_is_my_partner.name: The World Is My Partner
tr_prime_world_is_my_partner.description: A bond with your Purview refreshes each session to bank successes like a normal Bond.
tr_prime_world_is_my_partner.mechanicalEffects: Bond resets to Primeval rating each session; spend/bank successes on actions that dramatically affirm your commitment to that Purview’s themes.

tr_prime_world_provides.name: The World Provides
tr_prime_world_provides.description: Shape simple mundane materials for crafting without special supplies.
tr_prime_world_provides.mechanicalEffects: Action: create simple mundane objects from stone, wood, iron, or similar common materials, replacing mundane supply needs for crafting projects this scene.

tr_prime_caldera_overflows_atua.name: The Caldera Overflows (Atua)
tr_prime_caldera_overflows_atua.description: When you are injured, your Purview lashes out as hazardous terrain.
tr_prime_caldera_overflows_atua.mechanicalEffects: When you suffer an Injury, spread dangerous terrain out to Medium based on an outpouring of one of your Purviews. Others take Complication on next action based on Injury severity; spend Momentum to raise severity caps per PDF.

tr_prime_implacable_as_winter.name: Implacable as Winter
tr_prime_implacable_as_winter.description: Once per scene reset one attitude to 0 or reduce an atmosphere’s influence on you by Primeval. For the rest of the scene, plays on your ambitions/desires take +2 Complication; if not bought off, the manipulator risks Injury as elements lash out. Once per scene, shut down emotional leverage against you.
tr_prime_implacable_as_winter.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene reset one attitude to 0 or reduce an atmosphere’s influence on you by Primeval. For the rest of the scene, plays on your ambitions/desires take +2 Complication; if not bought off, the manipulator risks Injury as elements lash out.

tr_prime_single_minded_disaster_kami.name: Single-Minded Disaster (Kami)
tr_prime_single_minded_disaster_kami.description: Declare your intent for the scene and barrel through opposition—at a cost.
tr_prime_single_minded_disaster_kami.mechanicalEffects: Loudly declare your immediate scene goal: gain Primeval Enhancement to resist dissuasion or impediments to that goal only. You take a Complication of the same rating when you do anything else; if not bought off, Injury as your nature rebels.

tr_prime_bodys_trove_theoi.name: The Body’s Trove (Theoi)
tr_prime_bodys_trove_theoi.description: Hide tools and willing passengers inside your Titanic body.
tr_prime_bodys_trove_theoi.mechanicalEffects: Absorb up to Primeval rating in objects or willing characters of roughly your size; they leave hints detectable with difficulty 3 Occult + Intellect; extracting takes an action.

tr_tyr_compliance_is_rewarded.name: Compliance Is Rewarded
tr_tyr_compliance_is_rewarded.description: Spend 1 Momentum to resolve a Condition on someone who recognizes you as superior. Heal a subordinate’s Condition, then punish future defiance.
tr_tyr_compliance_is_rewarded.mechanicalEffects: Spend 1 Momentum to resolve a Condition on someone who recognizes you as superior; next defiance inflicts Complication equal to Tyrant dots or the Condition returns with Injury if not bought off. Higher-Tier sources require Clash of Wills (Legend + Presence).

tr_tyr_impossible_quest_tuatha.name: An Impossible Quest (Plant Dôn)
tr_tyr_impossible_quest_tuatha.description: Goad someone into a brutal task with a tempting reward.
tr_tyr_impossible_quest_tuatha.mechanicalEffects: Encourage Behavior to push someone into a difficult task: +2 Enhancement; they cannot leverage negative Attitude toward you while a reasonable reward is offered. If they succeed, you must pay the reward and suffer Complication equal to Tyrant until you do.
tr_tyr_impossible_quest_tuatha.source: TItans_Rising_(Final_Download).pdf — Tyrant Knacks (Heroic, Tuatha Dé Danann)

tr_tyr_greasing_the_palm_shen.name: Greasing the Palm (Shén)
tr_tyr_greasing_the_palm_shen.description: Intuit the perfect bribe for an official and lock in their complicity.
tr_tyr_greasing_the_palm_shen.mechanicalEffects: Spend 1 Momentum to learn the perfect bribe; if paid, their attitude toward you improves by 1 and they take Tyrant Complication to betray you for the rest of the story; if not bought off, superiors learn of the bribe. First use each scene and vs trivial are free.

tr_tyr_the_last_word.name: The Last Word
tr_tyr_the_last_word.description: End a debate or topic for the rest of the scene.
tr_tyr_the_last_word.mechanicalEffects: Spend 1 Momentum to forbid a topic from resurfacing this scene. Same Tier+ resists with Clash (Legend + Composure vs Legend + Presence).

tr_tyr_whom_do_you_serve.name: Whom Do You Serve?
tr_tyr_whom_do_you_serve.description: Map a character’s loyalties, chains of command, and attitudes.
tr_tyr_whom_do_you_serve.mechanicalEffects: Spend 1 Momentum to intuit rough loyalties, superiors, and attitudes—including off-screen figures you later recognize. First use each scene and vs trivial are free.

tr_tyr_shatter_tablets_anunna.name: Shatter Tablets, Seize Crowns (Annunaki)
tr_tyr_shatter_tablets_anunna.description: Claim honors, offices, or possessions from a rival you defeat in an agreed contest.
tr_tyr_shatter_tablets_anunna.mechanicalEffects: Upon winning an agreed contest, claim one honor/position/possession; until surrendered, target suffers Tyrant Complication on related actions; gossip sours attitudes if Complications go unpaid.

tr_tyr_dwelling_in_darkness_apu.name: Dwelling in Darkness (Apu)
tr_tyr_dwelling_in_darkness_apu.description: Consecrate a dark stronghold and snap back to it when plans collapse.
tr_tyr_dwelling_in_darkness_apu.mechanicalEffects: Spend 1 Momentum when injured or foiled to teleport yourself, Bandmates, and up to Tyrant willing others to your consecrated stronghold; journeys toward it take half time. Re-consecrate with a night-long ritual.

tr_tyr_obvious_superiority_deva.name: Obvious Superiority (Devá)
tr_tyr_obvious_superiority_deva.description: Reject authority that is not your own with overwhelming disdain.
tr_tyr_obvious_superiority_deva.mechanicalEffects: +2 Enhancement to resist influence compelling submission or recognizing others’ status. Once per scene when resisting such an effect, impose Complication equal to Tyrant on the source’s next influence action; if not bought off, observers read their influence as pathetic or unhinged.

tr_tyr_auspices_of_attar_ilhm.name: Auspices of Attar (Ilhm)
tr_tyr_auspices_of_attar_ilhm.description: Rally trivial mortals as fanatic Heavy Followers for one battle.
tr_tyr_auspices_of_attar_ilhm.mechanicalEffects: Action: trivial characters become Heavy Followers with extra Tags equal to Tyrant; they arrive instantly or by next scene; they serve one battle/scene then fade to stardust memorials.

tr_tyr_survey_the_empire.name: Survey the Empire
tr_tyr_survey_the_empire.description: Read the morale and needs of those sworn or subject to you.
tr_tyr_survey_the_empire.mechanicalEffects: Leadership + Cunning action: sense morale/disposition/needs of loyalists below your Tier; gain Leadership Scale 1 to influence them; spend 1 Momentum to fully inhabit one chosen follower’s senses for the scene.

automachy_the_builder.name: The Builder
automachy_the_builder.description: You are highly adept at building and customizing your vehicles in a way that visually supports the overall concept intended. Storytelling, displaying the theme, and focusing the main idea of your story with your modifications come easy. You gain +1 Enhancement to rolls for building or modifying vehicles.
automachy_the_builder.mechanicalEffects: You are highly adept at building and customizing your vehicles in a way that visually supports the overall concept intended. Storytelling, displaying the theme, and focusing the main idea of your story with your modifications come easy. You gain +1 Enhancement to rolls for building or modifying vehicles.

automachy_the_pitcher.name: The Pitcher
automachy_the_pitcher.description: Vehicular aerodynamics come more easily to you. You can work out how to throw a vehicle with ease with as little damage as possible. You may spend Momentum to double successes on any Skill rolls for throwing vehicles.
automachy_the_pitcher.mechanicalEffects: Vehicular aerodynamics come more easily to you. You can work out how to throw a vehicle with ease with as little damage as possible. You may spend Momentum to double successes on any Skill rolls for throwing vehicles.

automachy_the_wall.name: The Wall
automachy_the_wall.description: You understand a car’s momentum and can plan what is needed to slow a vehicle down. Everything from hand placement, the distance required to slow a car, and which body position to use with each type of vehicle come quickly to you. Gain 1 Momentum on any successful rolls when stopping a vehicle.
automachy_the_wall.mechanicalEffects: You understand a car’s momentum and can plan what is needed to slow a vehicle down. Everything from hand placement, the distance required to slow a car, and which body position to use with each type of vehicle come quickly to you. Gain 1 Momentum on any successful rolls when stopping a vehicle.

automachy_the_ballista.name: The Ballista
automachy_the_ballista.description: When you throw a vehicle for both distances, you can remove 1 Complication from the challenge. You may spend Momentum to double successes on any Skill rolls for throwing vehicles.
automachy_the_ballista.mechanicalEffects: When you throw a vehicle for both distances, you can remove 1 Complication from the challenge. You may spend Momentum to double successes on any Skill rolls for throwing vehicles.

automachy_the_fortification.name: The Fortification
automachy_the_fortification.description: Your reputation precedes you, and your personality is so outgoing it can stop a moving vehicle. You add half your Legend, rounded up, in Enhancement to rolls to stop a moving vehicle.
automachy_the_fortification.mechanicalEffects: Your reputation precedes you, and your personality is so outgoing it can stop a moving vehicle. You add half your Legend, rounded up, in Enhancement to rolls to stop a moving vehicle.

automachy_the_visionary.name: The Visionary
automachy_the_visionary.description: Your Skill at storytelling via the medium of vehicular modification has gained masterwork levels. You gain +2 Enhancement to rolls with building or modifying vehicles.
automachy_the_visionary.mechanicalEffects: Your Skill at storytelling via the medium of vehicular modification has gained masterwork levels. You gain +2 Enhancement to rolls with building or modifying vehicles.

architect_machines_of_loving_grace.name: Machines Of Loving Grace
architect_machines_of_loving_grace.description: When it comes to their grand design, no detail is too small for an Architect’s notice, no action too far removed from them to be altered. By imbuing Legend when you interact with an individual, you can ensure that a single action or event takes place at a specified time and loca - tion, such as a certain switch being…
architect_machines_of_loving_grace.mechanicalEffects: When it comes to their grand design, no detail is too small for an Architect’s notice, no action too far removed from them to be altered. By imbuing Legend when you interact with an individual, you can ensure that a single action or event takes place at a specified time and loca - tion, such as a certain switch being flipped at a particular time. You may operate a number of individuals away from your desired effect equal to your Legend Trait; at Legend 1, you could ensure action by another person by talking to them, while at Legend 3, you could have that person interact with someone who interacts with your actual target. This is not mind control, but mere engineering of happenstance and happy (or unhappy) accidents on the part of mortals. The Storyguide is the ultimate arbiter of what is possible with this Knack, and how long the “set - up” will take, but generally speaking each step removed from the Architect should require a minimum of 1 hour.

architect_this_must_be_the_place.name: This Must Be The Place
architect_this_must_be_the_place.description: During their travels, Architects come across places they know play an important role in their design. Once per session, the Architect can spend 1 Momentum to declare an area (no larger than a single mid-size build - ing) to be sacred ground. For the duration of the session, the Architect and those with a positive…
architect_this_must_be_the_place.mechanicalEffects: During their travels, Architects come across places they know play an important role in their design. Once per session, the Architect can spend 1 Momentum to declare an area (no larger than a single mid-size build - ing) to be sacred ground. For the duration of the session, the Architect and those with a positive Attitude toward them suffer no Complications while in the sanctified area, and anyone opposing the Architect’s design suffers a +3 Complication. If not bought off, their efforts are stymied as little things go wrong, all artfully arranged by the Ar - chitect ahead of time. By spending a point of Legend, the site becomes a shrine and has the effect permanently.

creator_capture_the_moment.name: Capture The Moment
creator_capture_the_moment.description: When you describe a scene you have experienced through a creative medium (visual art, dance, music, poetry, etc.), the result is so evocative that it lets others investigate that scene as if they were there. A character who was not present for the scene can make an investigation roll to gather clues, attempt to read…
creator_capture_the_moment.mechanicalEffects: When you describe a scene you have experienced through a creative medium (visual art, dance, music, poetry, etc.), the result is so evocative that it lets others investigate that scene as if they were there. A character who was not present for the scene can make an investigation roll to gather clues, attempt to read the Attitude of a Storyguide character who was there, or use any information-gathering Knack that would normally require them to be in the location.

creator_corrupted_creation.name: Corrupted Creation
creator_corrupted_creation.description: Your knowledge of creation allows you to break down constructed objects. By touching an object you can degrade its quality. Spend 1 Momentum to gain Enhancement equal to your Creator dots to turn objects into raw material. For each Injury Condition you receive from a weapon, you can spend 1 Momentum to weaken the…
creator_corrupted_creation.mechanicalEffects: Your knowledge of creation allows you to break down constructed objects. By touching an object you can degrade its quality. Spend 1 Momentum to gain Enhancement equal to your Creator dots to turn objects into raw material. For each Injury Condition you receive from a weapon, you can spend 1 Momentum to weaken the weapon, causing it to lose 1 weapon tag. A mundane weapon can lose up to your Creator dots in tags. Relics lose half your Creator dots (rounded up). The Storyguide decides which weapon tag is lost. Mundane weapons are destroyed if reduced to zero tags, while Relics can never drop below 1. Regaining the weapon’s tags follows Making Repairs rules (Scion: Origin, p. 77).

creator_flawlessly_platonic_ideal.name: Flawlessly Platonic Ideal
creator_flawlessly_platonic_ideal.description: When you work to improve an object, you make it as flawless as possible. When creating an object using this Knack, you may ignore 1 point of Flaws. In combat, you can upgrade light cover to heavy cover by making a Knack Skill roll. If materials are available, you may also spend Momen - tum and use an action to…
creator_flawlessly_platonic_ideal.mechanicalEffects: When you work to improve an object, you make it as flawless as possible. When creating an object using this Knack, you may ignore 1 point of Flaws. In combat, you can upgrade light cover to heavy cover by making a Knack Skill roll. If materials are available, you may also spend Momen - tum and use an action to transform items that would not normally be protective (stacks of newspaper, empty cardboard boxes, curtains, etc.) into light cover.

creator_hidden_armor.name: Hidden Armor
creator_hidden_armor.description: You lift your shirt to reveal a finely wrought iron plate. Spend 1 Momentum to reduce the damage of a lost Show -
creator_hidden_armor.mechanicalEffects: You lift your shirt to reveal a finely wrought iron plate. Spend 1 Momentum to reduce the damage of a lost Show -

creator_infinitely_sharable.name: Infinitely Sharable
creator_infinitely_sharable.description: When you release a song, video, or other significantly creative piece of media, you can name a specific audience you want to see it, such as “our fans,” “the people of Seattle,” or “Eileen Bran.” Fate ensures that it’s seen by a significant part of that audience within no more than a day — if Eileen’s stuck in one of…
creator_infinitely_sharable.mechanicalEffects: When you release a song, video, or other significantly creative piece of media, you can name a specific audience you want to see it, such as “our fans,” “the people of Seattle,” or “Eileen Bran.” Fate ensures that it’s seen by a significant part of that audience within no more than a day — if Eileen’s stuck in one of those particularly inconvenient Underworlds without internet access, she’ll still hear about it from a freshly dead shade.

creator_innate_toolkit.name: Innate Toolkit
creator_innate_toolkit.description: You are always able to work your craft, regardless of whether or not you have the appropriate tools available. When you use your bare hands to build or create something that would otherwise require special equipment, you suffer no penalty or any kind of Injury. For example: If you were to pound your bare fist against…
creator_innate_toolkit.mechanicalEffects: You are always able to work your craft, regardless of whether or not you have the appropriate tools available. When you use your bare hands to build or create something that would otherwise require special equipment, you suffer no penalty or any kind of Injury. For example: If you were to pound your bare fist against a railroad spike like a hammer or plunge your exposed fingers into a heated forge, you would not break bones or suffer more than cosmetic burns.

creator_parts_of_a_whole.name: Parts Of A Whole
creator_parts_of_a_whole.description: By handling an object constructed by someone of the same Tier or lower, you can determine the base components needed to reconstruct it. This doesn’t require a roll, only a few moments of study. If used on a naturally occurring substance, you know it wasn’t manufactured, but the base components are still revealed. You…
creator_parts_of_a_whole.mechanicalEffects: By handling an object constructed by someone of the same Tier or lower, you can determine the base components needed to reconstruct it. This doesn’t require a roll, only a few moments of study. If used on a naturally occurring substance, you know it wasn’t manufactured, but the base components are still revealed. You understand this information however you would interpret it best — be it in actual parts, chemical compounds, or classical elements. Attempts to recreate or copy an object studied this way receive 2 Enhancements.

creator_perfection_of_form.name: Perfection Of Form
creator_perfection_of_form.description: Whatever tool you work with cannot be destroyed during use if it’s physical in nature. This applies to a black - smith’s forge, a chef’s oven, and even a soldier’s sword: When they are wielded in their intended craft, only a being of a higher Tier may break them. Characters of the same Tier may attempt to do so but…
creator_perfection_of_form.mechanicalEffects: Whatever tool you work with cannot be destroyed during use if it’s physical in nature. This applies to a black - smith’s forge, a chef’s oven, and even a soldier’s sword: When they are wielded in their intended craft, only a being of a higher Tier may break them. Characters of the same Tier may attempt to do so but suffer a Difficulty increase equal to the wielder’s Legend.

creator_perfect_rendition.name: Perfect Rendition
creator_perfect_rendition.description: You are a master artist, able to illustrate or recreate an image of a person, place, or object you have seen with photo-perfect clarity, allowing you to flawlessly identify suspects, create detailed maps, or forge signatures. You do this without needing to roll and can recreate these things in scant instances. If…
creator_perfect_rendition.mechanicalEffects: You are a master artist, able to illustrate or recreate an image of a person, place, or object you have seen with photo-perfect clarity, allowing you to flawlessly identify suspects, create detailed maps, or forge signatures. You do this without needing to roll and can recreate these things in scant instances. If something you observed has been obscured by a supernatural power, make a Clash of Wills.

creator_reverse_engineer.name: Reverse Engineer
creator_reverse_engineer.description: When you take apart an object, you instantly gain an understanding of how to rebuild it or create new versions.
creator_reverse_engineer.mechanicalEffects: When you take apart an object, you instantly gain an understanding of how to rebuild it or create new versions.

creator_rust_and_decay.name: Rust And Decay
creator_rust_and_decay.description: With a touch, you can corrode and destroy any item. Make a Creator Skill roll and apply successes to making the item decay. The item is broken or destroyed if the successes equal its Size. If the item has a defensive Scale or armor that increases its Scale against Force, then you must match that additional Scale in…
creator_rust_and_decay.mechanicalEffects: With a touch, you can corrode and destroy any item. Make a Creator Skill roll and apply successes to making the item decay. The item is broken or destroyed if the successes equal its Size. If the item has a defensive Scale or armor that increases its Scale against Force, then you must match that additional Scale in successes. Size 0 items are destroyed in - stantly without a roll.

creator_sundering.name: Sundering
creator_sundering.description: When unmaking something, be it in a workshop or the heat of battle, you may apply the same action to every similar item within short range. Similar items would encompass, for example, all Kevlar vests, all handguns, or all cell phones. By spending a Momentum, you may exclude some of the targets, such as “my friend’s…
creator_sundering.mechanicalEffects: When unmaking something, be it in a workshop or the heat of battle, you may apply the same action to every similar item within short range. Similar items would encompass, for example, all Kevlar vests, all handguns, or all cell phones. By spending a Momentum, you may exclude some of the targets, such as “my friend’s phone.” In combat, this Knack enhances the Sunder stunt.

creator_tastes_of_might_and_genius.name: Tastes Of Might And Genius
creator_tastes_of_might_and_genius.description: Whenever a character eats food you’ve prepared or drinks you’ve brewed, you may choose a broad type of action such as “physical exertion” or “investigating a mystery.” Until the end of the session, the character may gain Enhance - ment 3 to one roll for that type of action. You may choose to provide different benefits…
creator_tastes_of_might_and_genius.mechanicalEffects: Whenever a character eats food you’ve prepared or drinks you’ve brewed, you may choose a broad type of action such as “physical exertion” or “investigating a mystery.” Until the end of the session, the character may gain Enhance - ment 3 to one roll for that type of action. You may choose to provide different benefits to different characters eating the same meal. A character may not benefit from this Knack more than once a scene.

creator_tastes_of_sorrow_and_joy.name: Tastes Of Sorrow And Joy
creator_tastes_of_sorrow_and_joy.description: When you create food or drink, you may choose an Attitude. Characters without a related or opposed Attitude who consume your creations gain the Attitude you choose at 2, while those with a similar Attitude increase it by 1. Charac - ters with an opposed Attitude may either decrease its value by 1 or gain a negative 1…
creator_tastes_of_sorrow_and_joy.mechanicalEffects: When you create food or drink, you may choose an Attitude. Characters without a related or opposed Attitude who consume your creations gain the Attitude you choose at 2, while those with a similar Attitude increase it by 1. Charac - ters with an opposed Attitude may either decrease its value by 1 or gain a negative 1 Point Attitude toward your cooking, as they choose.

creator_the_unlimited_quartermaster.name: The Unlimited Quartermaster
creator_the_unlimited_quartermaster.description: You never need to roll to acquire mundane crafting sup - plies, as you always know where and how to find them. Unless the item is exceedingly rare (or being blocked from access by a rival), you get what you need with little complication — this does not make materials cost less or arrive any faster should they need to…
creator_the_unlimited_quartermaster.mechanicalEffects: You never need to roll to acquire mundane crafting sup - plies, as you always know where and how to find them. Unless the item is exceedingly rare (or being blocked from access by a rival), you get what you need with little complication — this does not make materials cost less or arrive any faster should they need to be transported to you. If someone or something is preventing you from acquiring materials, make a Clash of Wills.

creator_we_go_all_night.name: We Go All Night
creator_we_go_all_night.description: When working on a creative project, you can work without ceasing for a number of days equal to your Creator Knack Skill. After this period, you must rest for a day before resuming your work.
creator_we_go_all_night.mechanicalEffects: When working on a creative project, you can work without ceasing for a number of days equal to your Creator Knack Skill. After this period, you must rest for a day before resuming your work.

creator_wireless_interface.name: Wireless Interface
creator_wireless_interface.description: Electronic devices respond without you needing to touch them. They must be powered on and functional, but you can use a number of devices in the same Field as you equal to your Knack Skill with your hands free. If you try to do other things while communing with technology, you must make a mixed action roll.
creator_wireless_interface.mechanicalEffects: Electronic devices respond without you needing to touch them. They must be powered on and functional, but you can use a number of devices in the same Field as you equal to your Knack Skill with your hands free. If you try to do other things while communing with technology, you must make a mixed action roll.

creator_abiding_forges.name: Abiding Forges
creator_abiding_forges.description: When committed to a creative project and refusing to disrupt it due to a violent confrontation, lower tier char - acters cannot attack you; equal or higher-tier characters suffer your Legend in increased Difficulty. Using this in truly life-threatening conditions may count as a Milestone for a crafting project you…
creator_abiding_forges.mechanicalEffects: When committed to a creative project and refusing to disrupt it due to a violent confrontation, lower tier char - acters cannot attack you; equal or higher-tier characters suffer your Legend in increased Difficulty. Using this in truly life-threatening conditions may count as a Milestone for a crafting project you work on once per session.

creator_afternoon_of_fortnights.name: Afternoon Of Fortnights
creator_afternoon_of_fortnights.description: When you begin a creative project, spend Momentum and make a Knack Skill roll. For each success earned on this roll you decrease the amount of time required to work on the project by one unit. This is measured in either units of dramatic time (a project that would take a whole session can be downgraded to a scene) or…
creator_afternoon_of_fortnights.mechanicalEffects: When you begin a creative project, spend Momentum and make a Knack Skill roll. For each success earned on this roll you decrease the amount of time required to work on the project by one unit. This is measured in either units of dramatic time (a project that would take a whole session can be downgraded to a scene) or in in-game units of time (years become months, months become weeks, etc.) whichever is more appropriate for the game’s approach.

creator_diwatas_hospitality.name: Diwata’S Hospitality
creator_diwatas_hospitality.description: Balahala-Specific You provide for your family, your guests, and yourself in abundance. You can always produce mundane goods or equipment with a moment’s notice with gifts and guidance from your ancestors. Additionally, once per session, you may use a marvel without cost to create magical or raw elemental material as…
creator_diwatas_hospitality.mechanicalEffects: Balahala-Specific You provide for your family, your guests, and yourself in abundance. You can always produce mundane goods or equipment with a moment’s notice with gifts and guidance from your ancestors. Additionally, once per session, you may use a marvel without cost to create magical or raw elemental material as desired, the natural world offering treasures for your use.

creator_durant_works.name: Durant Works
creator_durant_works.description: Neither time nor mortal acts may harm your creations, and they’ll also give the Immortal a run for their money. Imbue Legend for durability or size Scale when making a creation preternaturally durable and lasting. Beyond the benefits of a high defensive force Scale, such things are immune to the ravages of time or…
creator_durant_works.mechanicalEffects: Neither time nor mortal acts may harm your creations, and they’ll also give the Immortal a run for their money. Imbue Legend for durability or size Scale when making a creation preternaturally durable and lasting. Beyond the benefits of a high defensive force Scale, such things are immune to the ravages of time or environment not wielded against them by supernatural powers.

creator_eternitys_atelier.name: Eternity’S Atelier
creator_eternitys_atelier.description: Your place of work becomes a font of wonders, for you and whatever lucky students you allow. Imbue Legend to consecrate a workspace; the procedural projects of those who work there benefit from additional Scale of any applicable type. This may create a Realm Condition that reduces the cost for Artistry, Forge, or…
creator_eternitys_atelier.mechanicalEffects: Your place of work becomes a font of wonders, for you and whatever lucky students you allow. Imbue Legend to consecrate a workspace; the procedural projects of those who work there benefit from additional Scale of any applicable type. This may create a Realm Condition that reduces the cost for Artistry, Forge, or Prosperity Divine Rule actions taken through it by 1.

creator_lifted_from_dust.name: Lifted From Dust
creator_lifted_from_dust.description: When you work on a creative project that would cover a massive Scale (planning a city or designing a civilization), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
creator_lifted_from_dust.mechanicalEffects: When you work on a creative project that would cover a massive Scale (planning a city or designing a civilization), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

creator_proven_provenance.name: Proven Provenance
creator_proven_provenance.description: Make a Creator Skill roll when trying to identify a significant object, artifact, or relic. Spend your successes one-forone to answer the following questions: What’s its purpose? What powers or abilities does it possess? Who made it and why? How did its current owner gain it? Any successes past four may be spent to…
creator_proven_provenance.mechanicalEffects: Make a Creator Skill roll when trying to identify a significant object, artifact, or relic. Spend your successes one-forone to answer the following questions: What’s its purpose? What powers or abilities does it possess? Who made it and why? How did its current owner gain it? Any successes past four may be spent to ask freely chosen questions.

creator_raise_the_pillars_of_the_earth.name: Raise The Pillars Of The Earth
creator_raise_the_pillars_of_the_earth.description: Make a Creator Skill roll. With any successes, you create a small building, structure, or monument in a matter of minutes, which grows from nothing but rocks and dirt. To raise a creation in a scant instant, spend Momentum.
creator_raise_the_pillars_of_the_earth.mechanicalEffects: Make a Creator Skill roll. With any successes, you create a small building, structure, or monument in a matter of minutes, which grows from nothing but rocks and dirt. To raise a creation in a scant instant, spend Momentum.

creator_raze_the_city.name: Raze The City
creator_raze_the_city.description: Make a Creator Skill roll. With any successes, you can destroy a small building, structure, or monument in a matter of minutes, as they crumble to rubble and dust. To raze a building in an instant, spend a Momentum.
creator_raze_the_city.mechanicalEffects: Make a Creator Skill roll. With any successes, you can destroy a small building, structure, or monument in a matter of minutes, as they crumble to rubble and dust. To raze a building in an instant, spend a Momentum.

creator_rhapsodic_whirlwind.name: Rhapsodic Whirlwind
creator_rhapsodic_whirlwind.description: You are an elemental force of creation and works of art and artifice pour from you like a deluge. When taking a crafting Procedural action, you may spend 1 Momentum to immediately fulfill a Milestone once per episode. When creating Realm Conditions through this Calling, gain an ad - ditional point of effect.
creator_rhapsodic_whirlwind.mechanicalEffects: You are an elemental force of creation and works of art and artifice pour from you like a deluge. When taking a crafting Procedural action, you may spend 1 Momentum to immediately fulfill a Milestone once per episode. When creating Realm Conditions through this Calling, gain an ad - ditional point of effect.

creator_spread_of_ages.name: Spread Of Ages
creator_spread_of_ages.description: Make a Creator Skill roll when trying to provide suste - nance for a large number of people. On a success, you may increase the Scale of how many people your ingredients can feed. Characters who partake of such a meal together heal any Bruised Conditions they have once per session. If you use this ability to feed the…
creator_spread_of_ages.mechanicalEffects: Make a Creator Skill roll when trying to provide suste - nance for a large number of people. On a success, you may increase the Scale of how many people your ingredients can feed. Characters who partake of such a meal together heal any Bruised Conditions they have once per session. If you use this ability to feed the starving or needy, you may recover 1 Legend once per session.

creator_taste_of_power.name: Taste Of Power
creator_taste_of_power.description: You may imbue Legend for the session when creating food or brewing drink. A character who consumes such potent brew or provender recovers 1 Legend. Multiple uses of this Knack are required to benefit multiple characters. A character may not benefit from this more than once a scene.
creator_taste_of_power.mechanicalEffects: You may imbue Legend for the session when creating food or brewing drink. A character who consumes such potent brew or provender recovers 1 Legend. Multiple uses of this Knack are required to benefit multiple characters. A character may not benefit from this more than once a scene.

creator_touch_of_the_muses.name: Touch Of The Muses
creator_touch_of_the_muses.description: When working on an artistic project, double the suc - cesses earned on each roll made by an artistic partner. You have the option to spend Momentum and lend this benefit to yourself.
creator_touch_of_the_muses.mechanicalEffects: When working on an artistic project, double the suc - cesses earned on each roll made by an artistic partner. You have the option to spend Momentum and lend this benefit to yourself.

creator_molded_from_clay.name: Molded From Clay
creator_molded_from_clay.description: You are able to make a living being from inanimate matter. Creating an animal or plant requires a crafting roll at Tier 3, with an additional Milestone for each dot of Birthright Creature you are constructing. Giving the being human intelligence pushes the project up to Tier 4. In either case, they become Fatebound to…
creator_molded_from_clay.mechanicalEffects: You are able to make a living being from inanimate matter. Creating an animal or plant requires a crafting roll at Tier 3, with an additional Milestone for each dot of Birthright Creature you are constructing. Giving the being human intelligence pushes the project up to Tier 4. In either case, they become Fatebound to you or someone you’ve created it for, with an archetype of your choosing and a strength equal to your dots in Creator. For one additional Milestone, you can make enough individuals to start a community of this new species (though only one of them is Fatebound).

creator_mythic_feast.name: Mythic Feast
creator_mythic_feast.description: Prepare a meal before battle. Spend a scene breaking bread with your bandmates, any of their creatures or followers, and up to (your Legend) other allies. Everyone partaking feels powerful and nourished, gaining an extra level of Soft Armor for the rest of the session.
creator_mythic_feast.mechanicalEffects: Prepare a meal before battle. Spend a scene breaking bread with your bandmates, any of their creatures or followers, and up to (your Legend) other allies. Everyone partaking feels powerful and nourished, gaining an extra level of Soft Armor for the rest of the session.

creator_redefine_the_world.name: Redefine The World
creator_redefine_the_world.description: The World is whatever you say it is. Imbue for Scale to reshape the geography of an area or alter its natural phenomena (moving a mountain, slowing a hurricane).
creator_redefine_the_world.mechanicalEffects: The World is whatever you say it is. Imbue for Scale to reshape the geography of an area or alter its natural phenomena (moving a mountain, slowing a hurricane).

creator_talecrafter.name: Talecrafter
creator_talecrafter.description: A ballad that captures the hearts of a nation. An epic poem that shows the World who the real hero was. A meme that makes a public figure a laughingstock. Imbue for Scale to spread a story (true or false) through your art.
creator_talecrafter.mechanicalEffects: A ballad that captures the hearts of a nation. An epic poem that shows the World who the real hero was. A meme that makes a public figure a laughingstock. Imbue for Scale to spread a story (true or false) through your art.

creator_the_birth_of_legends.name: The Birth Of Legends
creator_the_birth_of_legends.description: If a new being is brought into creation (newborn human, a new species Molded from Clay, etc.), you may permanently bestow upon them access to any Knack, or to any Boon from a Purview that you have access to yourself. Using multiple times on the same subject requires a point of momentum for each Knack or Boon after the…
creator_the_birth_of_legends.mechanicalEffects: If a new being is brought into creation (newborn human, a new species Molded from Clay, etc.), you may permanently bestow upon them access to any Knack, or to any Boon from a Purview that you have access to yourself. Using multiple times on the same subject requires a point of momentum for each Knack or Boon after the first.

creator_teotl_specific_the_new_fire.name: Teotl-Specific: The New Fire
creator_teotl_specific_the_new_fire.description: At the end of the 52year cycle, all flames must be extinguished, and a new fire rekindled five days later. You have access to a fire that has been burning since the last such cycle and can use it as part of a complex crafting action. Doing so gives the item you craft a +1 Enhancement to all rolls.
creator_teotl_specific_the_new_fire.mechanicalEffects: At the end of the 52year cycle, all flames must be extinguished, and a new fire rekindled five days later. You have access to a fire that has been burning since the last such cycle and can use it as part of a complex crafting action. Doing so gives the item you craft a +1 Enhancement to all rolls.

covenant_all_knowing_idol.name: All-Knowing Idol
covenant_all_knowing_idol.description: Who your chosen people are is a matter of public record as far as you are concerned. Make a Knack Skill roll. For each success, ask the Storyguide one of the following questions about one of your chosen people, which must be answered honestly: Where is their home? What can I do to help them? What secret could they…
covenant_all_knowing_idol.mechanicalEffects: Who your chosen people are is a matter of public record as far as you are concerned. Make a Knack Skill roll. For each success, ask the Storyguide one of the following questions about one of your chosen people, which must be answered honestly: Where is their home? What can I do to help them? What secret could they confess to me? What could they do for me? Who or what threatens them? This Knack is only available to Demigods at the fourth and fifth dot of the Covenant Birthright.

covenant_ear_to_the_streets.name: Ear To The Streets
covenant_ear_to_the_streets.description: You have a sixth sense for threats to your people. The Storyguide should give you warnings in the form of ominous portents before a threat manifests, giving you enough time to potentially intervene. Spend 1 Momentum to double suc - cesses on a roll to notice or pinpoint such a threat.
covenant_ear_to_the_streets.mechanicalEffects: You have a sixth sense for threats to your people. The Storyguide should give you warnings in the form of ominous portents before a threat manifests, giving you enough time to potentially intervene. Spend 1 Momentum to double suc - cesses on a roll to notice or pinpoint such a threat.

covenant_exiled_on_main_street.name: Exiled On Main Street
covenant_exiled_on_main_street.description: You may curse transgressors in your chosen community. For the exile, reverse the Birthright’s Enhancement benefits, treating it as an equivalent Complication rating. Failure to buy it off means the target’s actions are perceived as hostile to the community. What constitutes a transgression is left for the character to…
covenant_exiled_on_main_street.mechanicalEffects: You may curse transgressors in your chosen community. For the exile, reverse the Birthright’s Enhancement benefits, treating it as an equivalent Complication rating. Failure to buy it off means the target’s actions are perceived as hostile to the community. What constitutes a transgression is left for the character to define; any covenant members who protest should’ve read the fine print This Knack is only available to Demigods at the fourth and fifth dot of the Covenant Birthright.

covenant_civic_paragon.name: Civic Paragon
covenant_civic_paragon.description: When you take an action to which this Birthright’s En - hancement applies, imbue Legend rather than spending it to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
covenant_civic_paragon.mechanicalEffects: When you take an action to which this Birthright’s En - hancement applies, imbue Legend rather than spending it to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

covenant_divine_posting.name: Divine Posting
covenant_divine_posting.description: You may communicate directly with your chosen people. Once per session, you may spend a Momentum to convey a message that will be heard by anyone you wish to speak with in your covenant. Your qualities and those of your people determine the medium. Whether via clouds, billboards, or dreams, the message is…
covenant_divine_posting.mechanicalEffects: You may communicate directly with your chosen people. Once per session, you may spend a Momentum to convey a message that will be heard by anyone you wish to speak with in your covenant. Your qualities and those of your people determine the medium. Whether via clouds, billboards, or dreams, the message is unquestionably sent by you. This Knack is only available to Demigods at the fourth and fifth dot of the Covenant Birthright.

druid_druids_kit.name: Druid’S Kit
druid_druids_kit.description: This knack functions identically to the Heroic Healer Knack “Doctor’s Kit” ( Scion: Origin , p. 227), but rather than modern medical equipment, you heal with herbs you’ve collected in the wild. The stunts are likewise identical, but represent the following, respectively: Rare Herbs (1s), Poultice (2s), and Ritual…
druid_druids_kit.mechanicalEffects: This knack functions identically to the Heroic Healer Knack “Doctor’s Kit” ( Scion: Origin , p. 227), but rather than modern medical equipment, you heal with herbs you’ve collected in the wild. The stunts are likewise identical, but represent the following, respectively: Rare Herbs (1s), Poultice (2s), and Ritual Tincture (4s).

druid_keeper_of_knowledge.name: Keeper Of Knowledge
druid_keeper_of_knowledge.description: Gain access to one of the following Mortal Sage Knacks (Scion: Origin, p. 111): Blockade of Reason, Palace of Memory, or Presence of Magic.
druid_keeper_of_knowledge.mechanicalEffects: Gain access to one of the following Mortal Sage Knacks (Scion: Origin, p. 111): Blockade of Reason, Palace of Memory, or Presence of Magic.

druid_the_wheel_of_the_year.name: The Wheel Of The Year
druid_the_wheel_of_the_year.description: At the start of a complex action representing a longterm project, you can glean the auspices of the dates or times you’ll be working from the calendar and take advantage of Fate’s favor or mitigate its hindrances. Reflexively roll your Knack Skill and spend the successes as Enhancements across any rolls during the…
druid_the_wheel_of_the_year.mechanicalEffects: At the start of a complex action representing a longterm project, you can glean the auspices of the dates or times you’ll be working from the calendar and take advantage of Fate’s favor or mitigate its hindrances. Reflexively roll your Knack Skill and spend the successes as Enhancements across any rolls during the complex action, to a maximum of three per roll.

druid_aoifes_curse.name: Aoife’S Curse
druid_aoifes_curse.description: By successfully striking a foe of lower tier with a hazel wand, you transform them into a beast of your choice, as in the Metamorphosis Boon “Transfigure” ( Scion: Hero , p. 270). This transformation is a Condition that resolves upon a future event you name that must be either guaranteed to occur within the arc, such…
druid_aoifes_curse.mechanicalEffects: By successfully striking a foe of lower tier with a hazel wand, you transform them into a beast of your choice, as in the Metamorphosis Boon “Transfigure” ( Scion: Hero , p. 270). This transformation is a Condition that resolves upon a future event you name that must be either guaranteed to occur within the arc, such as “when next the moon is full,” or something the target can make happen themselves, such as “when you give back what you stole.” The successful attack isn’t required against trivial targets. If you know the Geasa Boon “Lay Geis” ( Scion: Hero, p. 271), you may forgo the attack and the Momentum cost to use this Knack in conjunction, bestowing both Conditions in the same action. However, resolving one Condition immediately ends the other, and you still must proclaim the event that will end the curse.

druid_bé_chuille_and_diananns_army.name: Bé Chuille And Dianann’S Army
druid_bé_chuille_and_diananns_army.description: Like the druid sisters of the Tuatha Dé Danann, you can use the World itself to create the illusion of a great army. Leaves and grass (or desert sands or crashing waves) appear as whatever type of warriors you choose. Anyone of lower tier automatically sees legions of formidable foes, while it requires an opposed…
druid_bé_chuille_and_diananns_army.mechanicalEffects: Like the druid sisters of the Tuatha Dé Danann, you can use the World itself to create the illusion of a great army. Leaves and grass (or desert sands or crashing waves) appear as whatever type of warriors you choose. Anyone of lower tier automatically sees legions of formidable foes, while it requires an opposed Knack Skill roll to affect those of the same tier or higher. Even those who successfully see through the illusion face a higher difficulty to convince anyone else of the ruse: +1 Difficulty if you’re a Hero, +2 at Demigod, and +3 at God.

druid_cathbads_calendar.name: Cathbad’S Calendar
druid_cathbads_calendar.description: Once per episode, you can make a prediction based on the calendar’s arcane complexities. Make a Knack Skill roll and ask the Storyguide the following: “If allowed to happen, what upcoming event will have the direst consequences?” This roll comes with a unique stunt: Each success spent al - lows an additional yes/no…
druid_cathbads_calendar.mechanicalEffects: Once per episode, you can make a prediction based on the calendar’s arcane complexities. Make a Knack Skill roll and ask the Storyguide the following: “If allowed to happen, what upcoming event will have the direst consequences?” This roll comes with a unique stunt: Each success spent al - lows an additional yes/no question about the named event to learn specific ramifications and other details.

auraOfGreatness.name: Aura Of Greatness
auraOfGreatness.description: Something about the pre-Visitation Scion affects the people around them. They can be radically inspirational, the perfect confidant, or horrifically scary, depending on their origins and demeanor. Choose one Social Skill (Leadership, Empathy, or Persuasion), and the Scion may add Enhancement 2 as a bonus to that type…
auraOfGreatness.mechanicalEffects: Something about the pre-Visitation Scion affects the people around them. They can be radically inspirational, the perfect confidant, or horrifically scary, depending on their origins and demeanor. Choose one Social Skill (Leadership, Empathy, or Persuasion), and the Scion may add Enhancement 2 as a bonus to that type of roll once per session, reflecting their Godly heritage.
auraOfGreatness.source: Scion_Origin_(Revised_Download).pdf — Mortal General Calling Knacks; also SCION_Pandoras_Box_(Revised_Download).pdf p.25 (General Knacks)

bornToBeKings.name: Born To Be Kings
bornToBeKings.description: Scions are masters at enforcing their will upon the World, if it means serving their parents diligently. The first time each scene that the character would add points to the Momentum pool, they instead add 2.

desperateEntreaty.name: Desperate Entreaty
desperateEntreaty.description: The Gods may seem more distant, but they have not forgotten their Scions. The armor does not negate the initial damage received, cannot…
desperateEntreaty.mechanicalEffects: The Gods may seem more distant, but they have not forgotten their Scions. Once per session, after receiving an Injury of any severity, you make a plea to the Gods for help, and they answer by granting hard armor (2 boxes) for the remainder of the session. The armor does not negate the initial damage received, cannot be repaired, and cannot be used if the character already has hard or soft armor.

exemplarOfTheCalling.name: Exemplar Of The Calling
exemplarOfTheCalling.description: This Knack allows you to temporarily alter your Legend to resonate with one of your Callings at the expense of all others. The following changes occur when this Knack is activated: Your Calling associated with this Knack is set to 5 and all other more dots in Knacks alongside this one, for a total of 10, but they must…
exemplarOfTheCalling.mechanicalEffects: This Knack allows you to temporarily alter your Legend to resonate with one of your Callings at the expense of all others. The following changes occur when this Knack is activated: Your Calling associated with this Knack is set to 5 and all other more dots in Knacks alongside this one, for a total of 10, but they must be from the chosen Calling — no Universal, Path, or other Knacks. If your Legendary Title doesn’t reflect the Calling, Fate grants you a new one. Should you perform an Adoption Deed while this Knack is active, you may claim the title permanently. This can be done once per any given Call - ing. Attempts to perform anything that would be an Adoption Deed for a neglected Calling receive increased Difficulty equal to half of your Legend. The effects of this Knack last until the end of the Session in which it is activated. Characters who have not yet received their Visitation may not learn this Knack.

iAmHere.name: I Am Here
iAmHere.description: Once per scene, you may unveil your full power to gain +2 Enhancement on a social roll to impress, threaten, intimidate, or overwhelm others. All characters in the scene who can sense the supernatural automatically intuit your Titanic nature, Legend rating, and pantheon. Trivial characters flee or freeze.

leaveItAllOutThere.name: Leave It All Out There
leaveItAllOutThere.description: You gain +2 Enhancement to Shift Atmosphere actions while performing and can spend 1 Momentum to automat - ically reset the Atmosphere to 0 before the roll, setting the mood for the entire room despite previous vibes.
leaveItAllOutThere.mechanicalEffects: You gain +2 Enhancement to Shift Atmosphere actions while performing and can spend 1 Momentum to automat - ically reset the Atmosphere to 0 before the roll, setting the mood for the entire room despite previous vibes.

monstersUnited.name: Monsters United
monstersUnited.description: Once per session, you may roll your Knack Skill to commune with the collective wisdom of their pantheon’s Titans. You may ask one of the following questions, plus another for each success: What here is Titanic in nature, or could be swayed to Titanic service? What would [a specific Titan] wish for me to do here? Who…
monstersUnited.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, you may roll your Knack Skill to commune with the collective wisdom of their pantheon’s Titans. You may ask one of the following questions, plus another for each success: What here is Titanic in nature, or could be swayed to Titanic service? What would [a specific Titan] wish for me to do here? Who here hates or fears the Titans? How can I curry favor with my progenitor at this moment? You gain +2 Enhancement to a roll of your choice when you act on these answers during the same scene.

overwhelmingPresence.name: Overwhelming Presence
overwhelmingPresence.description: When you wish, you can be heard and seen clearly despite any environmental Complications such as fog, low light, crowds, or noise. Characters suffer a Complication equal to your highest Titanic Calling to knowingly ignore or snub you; failing to buy it off knocks them prone with the sheer force of your presence.

scentTheDivine.name: Scent The Divine
scentTheDivine.description: Having a touch of divinity, the Scion has an innate sense of anything divine near him. With a sniff or a knowing listen, he can detect another Scion of a particular pantheon.

somebodysWatchingMe.name: Somebody’S Watching Me
somebodysWatchingMe.description: A Scion’s Godly parent has eyes and ears everywhere, and even if they don’t Visit their child, they’re often ready to lend a hand to aid their child in need. During a scene where the Scion would be in danger, their parent sends in reinforcements, usually resulting in either two Mooks or one Professional to fight on their side. These allies leave at the end of the scene, however.
somebodysWatchingMe.source: Scion_Origin_(Revised_Download).pdf — Mortal General Calling Knacks; also SCION_Pandoras_Box_(Revised_Download).pdf p.26 (General Knacks)

beaconOfPower.name: Beacon Of Power
beaconOfPower.description: Your power is overwhelming but difficult to conceal. Once per scene, you may perform a marvel with your Innate Purview that doesn’t count as your marvel for the scene. Whenever you imbue or spend Legend, characters at the Hero Tier or higher can immediately make an Occult + In - tellect roll to identify your nature…
beaconOfPower.mechanicalEffects: Your power is overwhelming but difficult to conceal. Once per scene, you may perform a marvel with your Innate Purview that doesn’t count as your marvel for the scene. Whenever you imbue or spend Legend, characters at the Hero Tier or higher can immediately make an Occult + In - tellect roll to identify your nature and pantheon and gain +2 Enhancement to track, detect, or identify you for the rest of the scene.

divineArmistice.name: Divine Armistice
divineArmistice.description: Òrìshàand Loa-Specific Spend 1 Momentum to create a Field that weakens negative attitudes about Gods, Titans, and the Titanomachy by 2 for the scene. Characters who violate this peace suffer a +3 Complication on all actions within the Field; unless bought off, their actions are perceived by observers as needless,…
divineArmistice.mechanicalEffects: Òrìshàand Loa-Specific Spend 1 Momentum to create a Field that weakens negative attitudes about Gods, Titans, and the Titanomachy by 2 for the scene. Characters who violate this peace suffer a +3 Complication on all actions within the Field; unless bought off, their actions are perceived by observers as needless, dishonorable, or reckless — an impression that extends to retellings, recordings, gossip, and more.

guardian_a_bulwark.name: A Bulwark
guardian_a_bulwark.description: When a friendly character in your range band would suffer an injury condition, you may expend health levels from Heavy Armor you’re wearing to prevent the injury. If all damage is prevented this way, all other effects of the attack are also negated.
