guardian_a_fortress.name: A Fortress
guardian_a_fortress.description: At the start of a combat scene, roll your Knack Skill with 1 Enhancement. Gain the following Stunts which you may spend the resulting successes on, each time you successfully Defend (e.g. an attack targeting you does not hit). Get Out of Here (1s): A target you are protecting immediately makes the Disengage action.…
guardian_a_fortress.mechanicalEffects: At the start of a combat scene, roll your Knack Skill with 1 Enhancement. Gain the following Stunts which you may spend the resulting successes on, each time you successfully Defend (e.g. an attack targeting you does not hit). Get Out of Here (1s): A target you are protecting immediately makes the Disengage action. Second Wind (2s): Heal a Bruised Injury you have taken, including Injuries sustained by your Armor. My Turn (1s): Make one additional attack action against an opponent that attacked your charge this round.

guardian_a_promise.name: A Promise
guardian_a_promise.description: You make a promise to someone you consider yourself a Guardian over, and it is infused with Fate. This promise becomes an additional Deed. While this Deed is unfulfilled, you receive the benefit of 9-again on any rolls made towards the fulfillment of the promise. However, on rolls for tasks not devoted to this Deed,…
guardian_a_promise.mechanicalEffects: You make a promise to someone you consider yourself a Guardian over, and it is infused with Fate. This promise becomes an additional Deed. While this Deed is unfulfilled, you receive the benefit of 9-again on any rolls made towards the fulfillment of the promise. However, on rolls for tasks not devoted to this Deed, you lose the ability to reroll 10s. Characters should take care when swearing such a promise, as it lasts until fulfilled. Not even the death of the target or the Scion releases the promise, it merely makes it far harder to fulfill. A character can break their promise at any time. Doing so, however, grants them the Oathbreaker Condition: Oathbreaker (Persistent): You broke a sworn vow, staining your honor and your Legend. So long as this Condition persists, reduce the Attitude other characters feel towards you by 2. Add Momentum to the pool whenever you fail a roll due to this Condition. Resolution: Resolving this Condition requires an act of penance equal to the oath which was broken.

guardian_a_refuge.name: A Refuge
guardian_a_refuge.description: You’re always able to find a place to keep someone safe, if only temporarily. It takes (13 − Legend) hours to set up a safe refuge. This can be shortened with the proper Stunt. Make a Knack Skill roll with Enhancements equal to your Guardian Calling and spend them on the following Stunts: Right around the corner (3s):…
guardian_a_refuge.mechanicalEffects: You’re always able to find a place to keep someone safe, if only temporarily. It takes (13 − Legend) hours to set up a safe refuge. This can be shortened with the proper Stunt. Make a Knack Skill roll with Enhancements equal to your Guardian Calling and spend them on the following Stunts: Right around the corner (3s): The refuge is close and can be found within the next scene. Y ou’ll be safe a while (1+s): Each success spent on this Stunt allows the refuge to remain safe for 24 hours. No one will find you (1+s): Each success spent on this Stunt increases the Difficulty of others’ attempts to locate the refuge by one.

guardian_a_watch.name: A Watch
guardian_a_watch.description: As long as you are watching over your charge, you re - ceive Enhancement equal to half your Legend on any rolls to avoid being swayed or distracted. This includes attempts to seduce, intimidate, or even deceive the character, be they mundane or magical.

guardian_a_purpose.name: A Purpose
guardian_a_purpose.description: Dedicate yourself to an ideal of your choosing (fight for love and justice, defend the weak, save the World from invasion). When you take action to defend this ideal, gain +1 Enhancement to all applicable rolls and to any Stunts you may have gained from Knacks.

guardian_a_sentinel.name: A Sentinel
guardian_a_sentinel.description: Choose a person or group of trivial targets to be your charge. When you guard your charge, you both gain +1 Defense so long as you stay in the same range band. You also gain +1 Enhancement to rolls to keep track of or defend your charge.
guardian_a_sentinel.mechanicalEffects: Choose a person or group of trivial targets to be your charge. When you guard your charge, you both gain +1 Defense so long as you stay in the same range band. You also gain +1 Enhancement to rolls to keep track of or defend your charge.

guardian_a_talisman.name: A Talisman
guardian_a_talisman.description: Bless an object (usually belonging to someone you wish to protect, but not required) and make a Knack Skill roll. If any successes are achieved, it then grants the bearer 2 Enhancement to rolls made to defend or protect against a particular person, thing, or situation as defined at the time of blessing. If you are…

If you are making a talisman for your charge, this happens automatically without needing to roll.

guardian_a_vanguard.name: A Vanguard
guardian_a_vanguard.description: At the start of a combat scene, roll your Knack Skill with 1 Enhancement. You may spend those successes at any point during the scene to protect characters in your range band as if you had made the complicate action (Scion: Origin, p. 118).
guardian_a_vanguard.mechanicalEffects: At the start of a combat scene, roll your Knack Skill with 1 Enhancement. You may spend those successes at any point during the scene to protect characters in your range band as if you had made the complicate action (Scion: Origin, p. 118).

guardian_a_vigil.name: A Vigil
guardian_a_vigil.description: When you stand guard over a person, place, or thing, you do not need to eat or sleep so long as your vigil persists. This benefit extends so long as the protected target remains within your sight. You may do other things — talk, interact, move around, etc. — but must devote most of your time to keeping your vigil. You…
guardian_a_vigil.mechanicalEffects: When you stand guard over a person, place, or thing, you do not need to eat or sleep so long as your vigil persists. This benefit extends so long as the protected target remains within your sight. You may do other things — talk, interact, move around, etc. — but must devote most of your time to keeping your vigil. You may only keep vigil over one thing at a time.

guardian_a_warning.name: A Warning
guardian_a_warning.description: You sense the presence of danger before it emerges. Spend Momentum and double the successes on any roll to detect ambushes or to discern whether a person means harm. If you are protecting your charge, you do not need to pay the cost.
guardian_a_warning.mechanicalEffects: You sense the presence of danger before it emerges. Spend Momentum and double the successes on any roll to detect ambushes or to discern whether a person means harm. If you are protecting your charge, you do not need to pay the cost.

guardian_aggravated_defender.name: Aggravated Defender
guardian_aggravated_defender.description: Sometimes you need to make it very clear someone’s under your protection. Spend 1 Momentum. Your attacks gain the Aggravated and Messy tags when defending your declared charge for the duration of combat. You gain +2 Enhancement to intimidation rolls against any who have witnessed your brutal display of force until the…
guardian_aggravated_defender.mechanicalEffects: Sometimes you need to make it very clear someone’s under your protection. Spend 1 Momentum. Your attacks gain the Aggravated and Messy tags when defending your declared charge for the duration of combat. You gain +2 Enhancement to intimidation rolls against any who have witnessed your brutal display of force until the end of the scene. If your attacks already have the Aggravated and Messy tags, increase the level of your Bond with your ward by 1.

guardian_ear_to_the_ground.name: Ear To The Ground
guardian_ear_to_the_ground.description: You automatically know when someone is trying to slander you, your Bandmates, or anyone you have a Bond to, and add your Guardian dots as Enhancement to rolls to disprove their claims, clear the air, or identify the source.
guardian_ear_to_the_ground.mechanicalEffects: You automatically know when someone is trying to slander you, your Bandmates, or anyone you have a Bond to, and add your Guardian dots as Enhancement to rolls to disprove their claims, clear the air, or identify the source.

guardian_escape_route.name: Escape Route
guardian_escape_route.description: Sometimes, it’s better to take your charge somewhere else. While escorting your charge away from danger, make a Knack Skill roll. On any success, you instinctively know the safest way out and bypass any ordinary locks along the way. Your charge must remain within short range of you throughout, and you cannot pause to…
guardian_escape_route.mechanicalEffects: Sometimes, it’s better to take your charge somewhere else. While escorting your charge away from danger, make a Knack Skill roll. On any success, you instinctively know the safest way out and bypass any ordinary locks along the way. Your charge must remain within short range of you throughout, and you cannot pause to do anything along the way. If there is no way out that would not result in a threat to your charge, you know the route that leads you to that obstacle and gain 1 Enhancement on any actions you take to protect them at that point.

guardian_honied_words.name: Honied Words
guardian_honied_words.description: Choose a person to be your charge. Spend a Momentum and give them a direction or suggestion. When they act on that direction, they gain +2 Enhancement to do so as long as you are watching. If you have a Bond with the person, you can forgo the cost.
guardian_honied_words.mechanicalEffects: Choose a person to be your charge. Spend a Momentum and give them a direction or suggestion. When they act on that direction, they gain +2 Enhancement to do so as long as you are watching. If you have a Bond with the person, you can forgo the cost.

guardian_the_hearth_warden.name: The Hearth Warden
guardian_the_hearth_warden.description: When you declare a place as your charge, your presence grants Enhancement 1 to those working on tasks for its protection or wellbeing. You are instantly aware if anyone works to sabotage or suborn your charge, forcing a Clash of Wills with anyone hiding such with supernatural powers.

guardian_a_juggernaut.name: A Juggernaut

guardian_adamant_admonishment.name: Adamant Admonishment
guardian_adamant_admonishment.description: Pālas-Specific Upholding your sacred duty to protect the living, you exhort the violent and the aggressive to cease. So long as you continue lecturing and none take hostile actions…
guardian_adamant_admonishment.mechanicalEffects: Pālas-Specific Upholding your sacred duty to protect the living, you exhort the violent and the aggressive to cease. Once per scene when confronting a violent foe, spend your action explaining the flaws in their behavior and how they might act rightly. So long as you continue lecturing and none take hostile actions against them, they must listen nonviolently. Even if they succeed at a Clash of Wills to attempt a violent action, you may reflexively make a social action or an attack targeting them, imbuing Legend for power Scale. If you succeed, their violent action immediately fails in addition to the regular consequences of your action. You may spend Momentum to use this Knack a second time in a scene.

guardian_by_your_side.name: By Your Side
guardian_by_your_side.description: Spend a point of Momentum to move to be next to someone you are protecting in an instant, regardless of the distance between you. You receive an innate warning whenever this Knack would come into play. If you are protecting your charge, you do not need to pay the cost.
guardian_by_your_side.mechanicalEffects: Spend a point of Momentum to move to be next to someone you are protecting in an instant, regardless of the distance between you. You receive an innate warning whenever this Knack would come into play. If you are protecting your charge, you do not need to pay the cost.

guardian_eternal_guardian.name: Eternal Guardian
guardian_eternal_guardian.description: When you protect a person, place, or thing that can be measured with Scale (standing guard at the entrance of your pantheon’s afterlife, keeping a watchful eye on a city all night), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

guardian_living_pillar.name: Living Pillar
guardian_living_pillar.description: When you protect someone else with your body, you are immune to environmental hazards: The flames of a burning building do not scorch you, a landslide does not crush you, water cannot drown you, and so on. As long as you keep your target close (within arm’s reach), they benefit from the same immunity, but still need…
guardian_living_pillar.mechanicalEffects: When you protect someone else with your body, you are immune to environmental hazards: The flames of a burning building do not scorch you, a landslide does not crush you, water cannot drown you, and so on. As long as you keep your target close (within arm’s reach), they benefit from the same immunity, but still need to eat, sleep, etc., so it’s best to leave a hazardous area as quickly as possible. If you have Elemental Immunity transformed, you may instead spend 2 Momentum to apply this immunity to your protected target without them needing to be near you.

guardian_puppet_show.name: Puppet Show
guardian_puppet_show.description: You take command of your charge’s body and mind, directing her actions and guiding her thoughts. Roll your Guardian Knack Skill. Success allows you to direct your charge to take a single action. You dictate how she takes the action, and even if she speaks or talks while taking the ac - tion. You must be able to see…
guardian_puppet_show.mechanicalEffects: You take command of your charge’s body and mind, directing her actions and guiding her thoughts. Roll your Guardian Knack Skill. Success allows you to direct your charge to take a single action. You dictate how she takes the action, and even if she speaks or talks while taking the ac - tion. You must be able to see your charge to use this Knack, though you do not have to verbalize or speak the command out loud. This Knack does not work unless you have a Bond to the target, and they are a lower Tier than you.

guardian_the_fastness.name: The Fastness
guardian_the_fastness.description: Your sanctuaries and sigils are always under your pro - tection, no matter the distance. This may create a Realm Condition that…

Imbue Legend to consecrate a place of safety or static symbol of your protection; those who seek shelter there benefit from additional defensive Scale when fighting to protect themselves. This may create a Realm Condition that reduces the cost for Earth, Epic Stamina, or Epic Strength Divine Rule actions taken through it by 1.

guardian_the_heart.name: The Heart
guardian_the_heart.description: Peoples and nations respond to your call to action. When rallying large numbers of people in defense of their home, loved ones, or another shared bond, imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending it, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

guardian_the_threshold.name: The Threshold
guardian_the_threshold.description: When you declare a place as your charge, you are always aware when someone attempts to enter or harm it. As long as you are unvanquished, lower tier characters simply fail without your permission. Equal or higher-tier characters may attempt a Clash of Wills to force their way in without otherwise defeating you.

As long as you are unvanquished, lower tier characters simply fail without your permission. Equal or higher-tier characters may attempt a Clash of Wills to force their way in without otherwise defeating you.

guardian_the_return.name: The Return
guardian_the_return.description: When you declare a place as your charge, you may spend Momentum to access it for a scene and then return to your previous location, no matter the distance. You may spend an additional Momentum to bring your Band or another small group with you. You are always aware if your charge or its inhabitants are endangered,…
guardian_the_return.mechanicalEffects: When you declare a place as your charge, you may spend Momentum to access it for a scene and then return to your previous location, no matter the distance. You may spend an additional Momentum to bring your Band or another small group with you. You are always aware if your charge or its inhabitants are endangered, which removes the cost to access it.

guardian_the_watchtower.name: The Watchtower
guardian_the_watchtower.description: To approach you is to be known. Enemies never benefit from attempts to ambush you, your charge, or any characters in your immediate presence that are under your protection. Attempts to escape your notice in Divine Rule play require an additional point of effect, even if using a subtle method.
guardian_the_watchtower.mechanicalEffects: To approach you is to be known. Enemies never benefit from attempts to ambush you, your charge, or any characters in your immediate presence that are under your protection. Attempts to escape your notice in Divine Rule play require an additional point of effect, even if using a subtle method.

guardian_they_cannot_be_touched.name: They Cannot Be Touched
guardian_they_cannot_be_touched.description: Spend a point of Momentum and designate one person to be immune to all source of damage until the end of the session. This only applies if the character is someone you have a Bond with, or is of a lower Tier. If a target does not need to be protected (such as your best friend, the Warrior-Calling Scion), this Knack…
guardian_they_cannot_be_touched.mechanicalEffects: Spend a point of Momentum and designate one person to be immune to all source of damage until the end of the session. This only applies if the character is someone you have a Bond with, or is of a lower Tier. If a target does not need to be protected (such as your best friend, the Warrior-Calling Scion), this Knack does not apply.

guardian_alarm_beacon.name: Alarm Beacon
guardian_alarm_beacon.description: When attempting to warn masses about an imminent danger (an approaching Titanspawn, climate change, Ragnarök), you may spend one momentum to Imbue for Scale.
guardian_alarm_beacon.mechanicalEffects: When attempting to warn masses about an imminent danger (an approaching Titanspawn, climate change, Ragnarök), you may spend one momentum to Imbue for Scale.

guardian_champion_of_the_community.name: Champion Of The Community
guardian_champion_of_the_community.description: Spend one Momentum. For a scene, you may declare everyone in one local community as your charge for the purposes of relevant Guardian Knacks.
guardian_champion_of_the_community.mechanicalEffects: Spend one Momentum. For a scene, you may declare everyone in one local community as your charge for the purposes of relevant Guardian Knacks.

guardian_divine_layup.name: Divine Layup
guardian_divine_layup.description: Once per session, you may Imbue to lend Scale to a single action made by your charge to defend themself. This does not stack with any other supernatural sources of Scale they might have.
guardian_divine_layup.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, you may Imbue to lend Scale to a single action made by your charge to defend themself. This does not stack with any other supernatural sources of Scale they might have.

guardian_just_do_what_i_do.name: Just Do What I Do
guardian_just_do_what_i_do.description: For one scene per session, you may give your charge access to a Knack you possess. Their use of it counts against your maximum number of simultaneous Knacks active, and any Momentum or Legend is spent from your total.
guardian_just_do_what_i_do.mechanicalEffects: For one scene per session, you may give your charge access to a Knack you possess. Their use of it counts against your maximum number of simultaneous Knacks active, and any Momentum or Legend is spent from your total.

guardian_rescue_mission.name: Rescue Mission
guardian_rescue_mission.description: Once per scene, Imbue for Scale when saving some - one who is imprisoned or hopelessly lost in a way that no mortal could ever escape (kidnapped by a god, trapped in a labyrinth, dead and rotting in the Underworld).
guardian_rescue_mission.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, Imbue for Scale when saving some - one who is imprisoned or hopelessly lost in a way that no mortal could ever escape (kidnapped by a god, trapped in a labyrinth, dead and rotting in the Underworld).

guardian_dev_specific_matsyas_promise.name: Dev -Specific: Matsya’S Promise
guardian_dev_specific_matsyas_promise.description: You declare your charge to be under your dharmic protection. You may Imbue for Scale to protect your charge, or to give Scale to their actions to avoid harm. This does not benefit rolls to attack, even in self-defense, nor does it stack with other magical sources of Scale. If they have a Legend rating, they may, one…
guardian_dev_specific_matsyas_promise.mechanicalEffects: You declare your charge to be under your dharmic protection. You may Imbue for Scale to protect your charge, or to give Scale to their actions to avoid harm. This does not benefit rolls to attack, even in self-defense, nor does it stack with other magical sources of Scale. If they have a Legend rating, they may, one time ever, do the same to repay you, after which they are no longer your charge.

guardian_kami_specific_the_greater_kami.name: Kami-Specific: The Greater Kami
guardian_kami_specific_the_greater_kami.description: Young, weak kami are loath to harm you. Spend a point of Momentum; for the remainder of the scene any mundane weapons newer than 100 years are at +2 Diffi - culty to injure you or your charge.
guardian_kami_specific_the_greater_kami.mechanicalEffects: Young, weak kami are loath to harm you. Spend a point of Momentum; for the remainder of the scene any mundane weapons newer than 100 years are at +2 Diffi - culty to injure you or your charge.

healer_combat_medic.name: Combat Medic
healer_combat_medic.description: When you tend to an ally’s wounds in the heat of battle, once per turn remove any +1 Bruised Injury they may be suffering — including damage sustained to armor — without needing to roll. You may not make Mixed actions when uti - lizing this Knack.
healer_combat_medic.mechanicalEffects: When you tend to an ally’s wounds in the heat of battle, once per turn remove any +1 Bruised Injury they may be suffering — including damage sustained to armor — without needing to roll. You may not make Mixed actions when uti - lizing this Knack.

healer_damage_conversion.name: Damage Conversion
healer_damage_conversion.description: When you administer medical attention to a patient or yourself as an action, convert any Injuries to one lower; Maimed becomes Injured, Injured becomes Bruised, and Bruised Injuries heal completely.
healer_damage_conversion.mechanicalEffects: When you administer medical attention to a patient or yourself as an action, convert any Injuries to one lower; Maimed becomes Injured, Injured becomes Bruised, and Bruised Injuries heal completely.

healer_doctors_kit.name: Doctor’S Kit
healer_doctors_kit.description: At the start of a combat scene, roll your Knack Skill. Spend the resulting successes on the following Stunts whenever a bandmate or allied character in the same range band as you takes an Injury: Ice Pack (1s): Remove a Bruised Injury, including those sustained by armor. Swift Bandaging (2s): Remove an Injured Injury.…
healer_doctors_kit.mechanicalEffects: At the start of a combat scene, roll your Knack Skill. Spend the resulting successes on the following Stunts whenever a bandmate or allied character in the same range band as you takes an Injury: Ice Pack (1s): Remove a Bruised Injury, including those sustained by armor. Swift Bandaging (2s): Remove an Injured Injury. Emergency Operation (4s): Remove a Maimed Injury until the end of the scene.

healer_dream_interpretation.name: Dream Interpretation
healer_dream_interpretation.description: When you take a few minutes to talk with a patient about their recent dreams, they reveal their hidden troubles. Ask the Storyguide a question from those listed below, then make a Knack Skill roll and select a further option for each success. You may choose the same ones more than once if applicable: What negative…
healer_dream_interpretation.mechanicalEffects: When you take a few minutes to talk with a patient about their recent dreams, they reveal their hidden troubles. Ask the Storyguide a question from those listed below, then make a Knack Skill roll and select a further option for each success. You may choose the same ones more than once if applicable: What negative Condition is affecting them? Who or what are they most afraid of? Does any supernatural being intend to harm them? For the remainder of the episode, you gain 2 Enhance - ment on any rolls to heal applicable threats you have identified.

healer_herbarium_rex.name: Herbarium Rex
healer_herbarium_rex.description: You cultivate a collection of medical plants from the World and beyond. Make a Knack Skill roll the first time you encounter a disease or poison. If you succeed, you pos - sess a cure which will instantly cure or suppress mundane maladies, and grant you your Healer rating in Enhancement to treat supernatural ills. To…
healer_herbarium_rex.mechanicalEffects: You cultivate a collection of medical plants from the World and beyond. Make a Knack Skill roll the first time you encounter a disease or poison. If you succeed, you pos - sess a cure which will instantly cure or suppress mundane maladies, and grant you your Healer rating in Enhancement to treat supernatural ills. To treat additional individuals or cases, you may have to acquire more medical supplies. If you fail, you still know how and where to find them.

healer_holistic_empowerment.name: Holistic Empowerment
healer_holistic_empowerment.description: Treating the entire body as a system to be purified and em - powered, you may grant exceptional health and wellness to your - self or an ally. At the beginning of a scene or when rolling Initiative, designate a target within close range to be empowered. Make a Knack Skill roll and spend successes on the following…
healer_holistic_empowerment.mechanicalEffects: Treating the entire body as a system to be purified and em - powered, you may grant exceptional health and wellness to your - self or an ally. At the beginning of a scene or when rolling Initiative, designate a target within close range to be empowered. Make a Knack Skill roll and spend successes on the following stunts: Sound of Mind (1-2s): For 1 success, the target gains 9-again this scene for rolls using Mental Arena attributes. For 2 successes, the target gains 8-again instead. Strong of Limb (1-2s): For 1 success, the target gains 9-again this scene for rolls using Physical Arena attributes. For 2 successes, the target gains 8-again instead. Clear of Heart (1-2s): For 1 success, the target gains 9-again this scene for rolls using Social Arena attributes. For 2 successes, the target gains 8-again instead.

healer_immunization_booster.name: Immunization Booster
healer_immunization_booster.description: Designate up to your Knack Skill in targets to be under your care. While under your protection, they get +2 En - hancement to all rolls to resist disease and poison, and to recover from Injuries. Storyguide characters you protect in this way are automatically protected — that is, the Storyguide does not need to make…
healer_immunization_booster.mechanicalEffects: Designate up to your Knack Skill in targets to be under your care. While under your protection, they get +2 En - hancement to all rolls to resist disease and poison, and to recover from Injuries. Storyguide characters you protect in this way are automatically protected — that is, the Storyguide does not need to make rolls when they would be affected by disease or poison.

healer_immediate_intervention.name: Immediate Intervention
healer_immediate_intervention.description: The first time a character suffers an Injury Condition in a scene, you may immediately heal it. You may heal additional characters by spending Momentum for each, but no character may benefit from this Knack more than once a scene.
healer_immediate_intervention.mechanicalEffects: The first time a character suffers an Injury Condition in a scene, you may immediately heal it. You may heal additional characters by spending Momentum for each, but no character may benefit from this Knack more than once a scene.

healer_instant_diagnosis.name: Instant Diagnosis
healer_instant_diagnosis.description: When you spend time interacting with an ailing target, you diagnose what is wrong with them, as well as any other pertinent medical information. In the event that you are di - agnosing a patient suffering from a supernatural disease, this may require a Knack Skill roll, which is opposed by whomever afflicted the…
healer_instant_diagnosis.mechanicalEffects: When you spend time interacting with an ailing target, you diagnose what is wrong with them, as well as any other pertinent medical information. In the event that you are di - agnosing a patient suffering from a supernatural disease, this may require a Knack Skill roll, which is opposed by whomever afflicted the victim.

healer_lay_down_your_troubles.name: Lay Down Your Troubles
healer_lay_down_your_troubles.description: When you perform for someone, you gain access to the following stunt: Catharsis (3s): After your performance, the target re - solves emotional Conditions with total Complications or difficulty penalties equal to your Healer rating. This can also affect curses from characters of your Tier or below; against those of…
healer_lay_down_your_troubles.mechanicalEffects: When you perform for someone, you gain access to the following stunt: Catharsis (3s): After your performance, the target re - solves emotional Conditions with total Complications or difficulty penalties equal to your Healer rating. This can also affect curses from characters of your Tier or below; against those of higher Tiers, you instead cause the curse to recede for the scene.

healer_medically_induced.name: Medically Induced
healer_medically_induced.description: With a Standard Action, you may place an individual into a state of suspended animation. If the individual isn’t already Taken Out, they must be willing to enter the state. This state is maintained indefinitely, but this requires that a Scion with this Knack tend to the individual one day per year. Rather than…
healer_medically_induced.mechanicalEffects: With a Standard Action, you may place an individual into a state of suspended animation. If the individual isn’t already Taken Out, they must be willing to enter the state. This state is maintained indefinitely, but this requires that a Scion with this Knack tend to the individual one day per year. Rather than waiting, a character of equal or greater Tier to the character who used this Knack may rouse someone from their coma with the Medicine skill. While in this coma, an individual is immune to age and disease and doesn’t require food, water, or air. They may heal normally. As an additional perk, you receive a +1 Enhancement to treat anyone who is unconscious, sleeping, or suffering from any form of sleep disorder.

healer_protect_doc.name: Protect Doc
healer_protect_doc.description: In conflicts all over the World, medical professionals rush in to give aid to the wounded. During an action scene, make a Knack Skill roll. If you succeed, an SGC of the Storyguide’s choice makes your safety their priority while you’re render - ing medical aid. The character defends you until they lose a number of…
healer_protect_doc.mechanicalEffects: In conflicts all over the World, medical professionals rush in to give aid to the wounded. During an action scene, make a Knack Skill roll. If you succeed, an SGC of the Storyguide’s choice makes your safety their priority while you’re render - ing medical aid. The character defends you until they lose a number of Health boxes equal to your successes rolled +1. If you take an offensive action, you can disengage and spend 1 Momentum to use this Knack a second time in the same scene.

healer_spread_disease.name: Spread Disease
healer_spread_disease.description: When dealing with a patient who has a disease, you can increase the Complication from the disease by a number of points equal to your Knack Skill, or you may designate a number of nearby targets equal to your Knack Skill who also contract the disease at the original Complication rating.
healer_spread_disease.mechanicalEffects: When dealing with a patient who has a disease, you can increase the Complication from the disease by a number of points equal to your Knack Skill, or you may designate a number of nearby targets equal to your Knack Skill who also contract the disease at the original Complication rating.

healer_surgeon_with_the_hands_of_god.name: Surgeon With The Hands Of God
healer_surgeon_with_the_hands_of_god.description: Halve the time you need to undertake any kind of medical procedure (such as surgery). You never face any increased difficulty to treat a critically ill or injured patient.
healer_surgeon_with_the_hands_of_god.mechanicalEffects: Halve the time you need to undertake any kind of medical procedure (such as surgery). You never face any increased difficulty to treat a critically ill or injured patient.

healer_the_bare_minimum.name: The Bare Minimum
healer_the_bare_minimum.description: You are always able to safely tend to someone’s wounds, even if you have no sanitary medical tools available. Even if all you have are twigs and dirt, you’ll be able to perform surgery at no increased difficulty and at no risk to your patient.
healer_the_bare_minimum.mechanicalEffects: You are always able to safely tend to someone’s wounds, even if you have no sanitary medical tools available. Even if all you have are twigs and dirt, you’ll be able to perform surgery at no increased difficulty and at no risk to your patient.

healer_with_a_glance.name: With A Glance
healer_with_a_glance.description: When you spend time interacting with an ailing target, you diagnose what is wrong with him, as well as any other pertinent medical information. In the event that you are di - agnosing a patient suffering from a supernatural disease, this may require a Knack Skill roll, which is opposed by whomever afflicted the victim.
healer_with_a_glance.mechanicalEffects: When you spend time interacting with an ailing target, you diagnose what is wrong with him, as well as any other pertinent medical information. In the event that you are di - agnosing a patient suffering from a supernatural disease, this may require a Knack Skill roll, which is opposed by whomever afflicted the victim.

healer_breath_of_life.name: Breath Of Life
healer_breath_of_life.description: If you touch a target within three minutes of their death, you can spend a point of Legend and bring them back to life with all Injuries filled. Any longer than three minutes and the target cannot be revived.
healer_breath_of_life.mechanicalEffects: If you touch a target within three minutes of their death, you can spend a point of Legend and bring them back to life with all Injuries filled. Any longer than three minutes and the target cannot be revived.

healer_complete_medical_history.name: Complete Medical History
healer_complete_medical_history.description: You can tell how old someone was when they took their first steps from the way they waltz. Spend Momentum when examining someone at a close distance. You know their entire medical history, down to minute, specific details, and may gain Enhancement equal to your Healer rank for one action targeting them by taking…
healer_complete_medical_history.mechanicalEffects: You can tell how old someone was when they took their first steps from the way they waltz. Spend Momentum when examining someone at a close distance. You know their entire medical history, down to minute, specific details, and may gain Enhancement equal to your Healer rank for one action targeting them by taking advantage of your incredibly intimate knowledge. Supernatural disguises or similar deception must defeat you on a Clash of Wills to avoid your scrutiny.

healer_excision.name: Excision
healer_excision.description: You cut out illness, root and branch. When you successfully treat someone for a specific disease or condition, you may spend Momentum to perfectly treat anyone else suffering from the same malady for the rest of the episode. When solving problems with this Calling in Divine Rule, gain an additional point of effect.
healer_excision.mechanicalEffects: You cut out illness, root and branch. When you successfully treat someone for a specific disease or condition, you may spend Momentum to perfectly treat anyone else suffering from the same malady for the rest of the episode. When solving problems with this Calling in Divine Rule, gain an additional point of effect.

healer_herbarium_imperator.name: Herbarium Imperator
healer_herbarium_imperator.description: You cultivate medical plants and substances of singular quality. Once per session, you may use your superlative stock to make a Knack Skill roll. On a success, do any of the following, extra successes allowing you to affect the same target with different effects. Instantly cure a target of all mundane diseases,…
healer_herbarium_imperator.mechanicalEffects: You cultivate medical plants and substances of singular quality. Once per session, you may use your superlative stock to make a Knack Skill roll. On a success, do any of the following, extra successes allowing you to affect the same target with different effects. Instantly cure a target of all mundane diseases, poisons, and ailments. Instantly cure a target of one supernatural disease, poison, or curse. Instantly cure a target of any number of -0 or -1 injuries, or a single more serious wound. You may spend momentum to use this power addi - tional times, but never for the same effect, in a single session.

healer_immortal_instruction.name: Immortal Instruction
healer_immortal_instruction.description: When you task someone else to provide care to a patient in your absence, they treat patients as if you were providing care, including from any other relevant Knacks. You may empower up to your Knack Skill in assistants this way.
healer_immortal_instruction.mechanicalEffects: When you task someone else to provide care to a patient in your absence, they treat patients as if you were providing care, including from any other relevant Knacks. You may empower up to your Knack Skill in assistants this way.

healer_internal_refinery.name: Internal Refinery
healer_internal_refinery.description: When exposed to a poison or disease, make a Knack Skill roll. A success instantly cures yourself. By spending a point of Momentum, you then also generate one dose of a cure or antidote, which you can secrete and administer to another person.
healer_internal_refinery.mechanicalEffects: When exposed to a poison or disease, make a Knack Skill roll. A success instantly cures yourself. By spending a point of Momentum, you then also generate one dose of a cure or antidote, which you can secrete and administer to another person.

healer_living_ends.name: Living Ends
healer_living_ends.description: Designate a target to be under extreme care. While un - der your care, they can take an additional number of −2 injuries equal to your Healer rating and cannot be killed save by the direct efforts of higher-tier characters than you. When they heal, they may treat −2 injuries as −1 injuries.
healer_living_ends.mechanicalEffects: Designate a target to be under extreme care. While un - der your care, they can take an additional number of −2 injuries equal to your Healer rating and cannot be killed save by the direct efforts of higher-tier characters than you. When they heal, they may treat −2 injuries as −1 injuries.

healer_operating_theater.name: Operating Theater
healer_operating_theater.description: You establish a place of healing and wellness, from which recovery and knowledge of life and death flow. Imbue Legend to consecrate a place of healing and medicine; those practicing medicine there benefit from additional scope Scale when treating large numbers of patients. If there’s a common source of injury or…
healer_operating_theater.mechanicalEffects: You establish a place of healing and wellness, from which recovery and knowledge of life and death flow. Imbue Legend to consecrate a place of healing and medicine; those practicing medicine there benefit from additional scope Scale when treating large numbers of patients. If there’s a common source of injury or illness among the patients, you automatically recognize this and gain the same Scale when attempting to determine the root cause. This may create a Realm Condition that reduces the cost for Death, Fertility, or Health Divine Rule actions taken through it by 1.

healer_panacea.name: Panacea
healer_panacea.description: When you work to cure a disease or fight an illness on a large Scale (curing cancer, stopping a God-driven plague), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
healer_panacea.mechanicalEffects: When you work to cure a disease or fight an illness on a large Scale (curing cancer, stopping a God-driven plague), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

healer_plague_bearer.name: Plague Bearer
healer_plague_bearer.description: Spend a Momentum to inflict a mythic plague upon an area, affecting everyone within it. The disease’s Complica - tion is equal to your Healer Knack Skill. You can spend an additional Momentum to exclude specific people from the plague’s effect. The disease is not supernatural in nature and can be cured through normal…
healer_plague_bearer.mechanicalEffects: Spend a Momentum to inflict a mythic plague upon an area, affecting everyone within it. The disease’s Complica - tion is equal to your Healer Knack Skill. You can spend an additional Momentum to exclude specific people from the plague’s effect. The disease is not supernatural in nature and can be cured through normal means.

healer_reconstruction.name: Reconstruction
healer_reconstruction.description: Once per day, make a Knack Skill roll. If any successes are achieved, remove any one Condition a target may face that is not necessarily an illness or ailment. Examples include ending a character’s blindness, restoring a limb with a perfect prosthetic, and ending paralysis or PTSD. You may cure additional ailments by…
healer_reconstruction.mechanicalEffects: Once per day, make a Knack Skill roll. If any successes are achieved, remove any one Condition a target may face that is not necessarily an illness or ailment. Examples include ending a character’s blindness, restoring a limb with a perfect prosthetic, and ending paralysis or PTSD. You may cure additional ailments by spending 1 Momentum each. As an additional effect, which does not cost Momentum, at the beginning of the session you have the option to reassign your Attribute dots in any order as long as they remain within the same original categories. You cannot move Resistance dots into Power dots, for example. TIME, A SCALPEL Your Procedural rolls always have the following Stunts available. Ongoing Care (variable): Spend successes equal to the penalty of an Injury affecting a character you are treating to immediately heal that injury. Healing Presence (1): The target gains your Healer rat - ing in Enhancement for any rolls to recover from or resist disease and poison

healer_cleanse_the_land.name: Cleanse The Land
healer_cleanse_the_land.description: You are able to heal the environment itself, out to Long Range. You fix damage to structures or flora and remove any pollutants or contagions found in the area or its wildlife. This can also be used to add or remove up to three points of Enhancements or Complications to the field. Supernatural blights require a Clash…
healer_cleanse_the_land.mechanicalEffects: You are able to heal the environment itself, out to Long Range. You fix damage to structures or flora and remove any pollutants or contagions found in the area or its wildlife. This can also be used to add or remove up to three points of Enhancements or Complications to the field. Supernatural blights require a Clash of Wills.

healer_disaster_relief.name: Disaster Relief
healer_disaster_relief.description: Imbue for Scale when attempting to halt the loss of life after a massive violent event, such as a battle or a natural disaster.
healer_disaster_relief.mechanicalEffects: Imbue for Scale when attempting to halt the loss of life after a massive violent event, such as a battle or a natural disaster.

healer_healer_of_souls.name: Healer Of Souls
healer_healer_of_souls.description: Imbue for Scale when attempting to heal the hearts of an entire group or culture. This might mean setting aside past prejudices, or moving forward after a national tragedy, or inspiring the hope needed to survive an ongoing crisis.
healer_healer_of_souls.mechanicalEffects: Imbue for Scale when attempting to heal the hearts of an entire group or culture. This might mean setting aside past prejudices, or moving forward after a national tragedy, or inspiring the hope needed to survive an ongoing crisis.

healer_remember_them.name: Remember Them
healer_remember_them.description: With a touch, you are able to restore anyone’s lost memories, from dementia patients to Underworld Shades. The permanence of this effect is up to you. Memories specifically stolen or occluded require a Clash of Wills.
healer_remember_them.mechanicalEffects: With a touch, you are able to restore anyone’s lost memories, from dementia patients to Underworld Shades. The permanence of this effect is up to you. Memories specifically stolen or occluded require a Clash of Wills.

healer_that_which_was_broken.name: That Which Was Broken
healer_that_which_was_broken.description: If you are rebuilding something that was once de - stroyed, you may add your Healer dots as an Enhance - ment to all rolls in the complex crafting action.
healer_that_which_was_broken.mechanicalEffects: If you are rebuilding something that was once de - stroyed, you may add your Healer dots as an Enhance - ment to all rolls in the complex crafting action.

herald_his_masters_voice.name: His Master’S Voice
herald_his_masters_voice.description: Once per session, add your Presence score and your focus’ Legend score to a limited Enhancement pool. This pool can be applied to any roll made on behalf of the focus for the remainder of the session.
herald_his_masters_voice.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, add your Presence score and your focus’ Legend score to a limited Enhancement pool. This pool can be applied to any roll made on behalf of the focus for the remainder of the session.

herald_marked_with_myrrh.name: Marked With Myrrh
herald_marked_with_myrrh.description: Once per session, you can spend a Momentum point to anoint your focus as is appropriate to your context (oils, ghee, ashes, etc.) through a ritual that should take a scene to accomplish. Once the ritual is complete, the marked character is granted spiritual armor with the Soft 1 and Innocuous tags for the rest of the…
herald_marked_with_myrrh.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, you can spend a Momentum point to anoint your focus as is appropriate to your context (oils, ghee, ashes, etc.) through a ritual that should take a scene to accomplish. Once the ritual is complete, the marked character is granted spiritual armor with the Soft 1 and Innocuous tags for the rest of the session.

herald_private_caller.name: Private Caller
herald_private_caller.description: Despite all the speeches and sermons, there’s always at least one person that, if convinced, can bring their entire community into line. Spend 1 Momentum to gain perfect knowledge of how to bypass any security or other obstacles between yourself and your target, and gain +2 Enhancement on any rolls to do so. This…
herald_private_caller.mechanicalEffects: Despite all the speeches and sermons, there’s always at least one person that, if convinced, can bring their entire community into line. Spend 1 Momentum to gain perfect knowledge of how to bypass any security or other obstacles between yourself and your target, and gain +2 Enhancement on any rolls to do so. This Knack’s effects end once you’re in your target’s presence.

hunter_apex_predator.name: Apex Predator
hunter_apex_predator.description: When a target of lower Tier who you have been pursu - ing attacks you or otherwise attempts to hunt you in return, increase the difficulty of all Stunts they apply against you by 1. If this target is your quarry, increase it by an additional +1.
hunter_apex_predator.mechanicalEffects: When a target of lower Tier who you have been pursu - ing attacks you or otherwise attempts to hunt you in return, increase the difficulty of all Stunts they apply against you by 1. If this target is your quarry, increase it by an additional +1.

hunter_eyes_in_the_blinds.name: Eyes In The Blinds
hunter_eyes_in_the_blinds.description: Spend Momentum to invest a fraction of your power into a small token (a coin, a figurine, dice, an arrowhead, etc.). Place this token anywhere in a Field you are aware of, and for as long as it remains in place you have the power to ob - serve the goings-on in the Field as if you were present. This lasts for the…
hunter_eyes_in_the_blinds.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to invest a fraction of your power into a small token (a coin, a figurine, dice, an arrowhead, etc.). Place this token anywhere in a Field you are aware of, and for as long as it remains in place you have the power to ob - serve the goings-on in the Field as if you were present. This lasts for the duration of a day in-game time, or for a session of play, whichever is longer. You do not have to deliver the token yourself and may send an ally or animal companion to deliver it instead. If the token is destroyed or otherwise removed from the Field, the effect ends. The Difficulty to notice the token is equal to your Hunter Calling dots.

hunter_harry.name: Harry
hunter_harry.description: While you’re hunting someone, they cannot rest. Your constant harrying leads to small mistakes and growing weakness throughout the hunt. Anyone you pursue loses the ability to re-roll 10s on any dice rolls they make.
hunter_harry.mechanicalEffects: While you’re hunting someone, they cannot rest. Your constant harrying leads to small mistakes and growing weakness throughout the hunt. Anyone you pursue loses the ability to re-roll 10s on any dice rolls they make.

hunter_preternatural_senses.name: Preternatural Senses
hunter_preternatural_senses.description: As a master of the hunt, a Scion with this Knack is never caught unaware. So long as you’re hunting something, you may take the 8-Again quality on any perception rolls you make, including for Clash of Wills attempts to pierce mys - tical concealment.
hunter_preternatural_senses.mechanicalEffects: As a master of the hunt, a Scion with this Knack is never caught unaware. So long as you’re hunting something, you may take the 8-Again quality on any perception rolls you make, including for Clash of Wills attempts to pierce mys - tical concealment.

hunter_internal_compass.name: Internal Compass
hunter_internal_compass.description: You always know your precise direction — whether that be navigating while on foot or driving a car or working your way out of a petty God’s labyrinthine prison. You do not ever have to roll to navigate somewhere, or to find your way out of being lost. If you are entrapped in a magical maze, make a Clash of Wills with…
hunter_internal_compass.mechanicalEffects: You always know your precise direction — whether that be navigating while on foot or driving a car or working your way out of a petty God’s labyrinthine prison. You do not ever have to roll to navigate somewhere, or to find your way out of being lost. If you are entrapped in a magical maze, make a Clash of Wills with 2 Enhancement.

hunter_just_in_time_healing.name: Just In Time Healing
hunter_just_in_time_healing.description: You slap on a bandage before the wound even starts bleeding. When someone you can reach with a reflexive
hunter_just_in_time_healing.mechanicalEffects: You slap on a bandage before the wound even starts bleeding. When someone you can reach with a reflexive

hunter_keen_eyed_predator.name: Keen-Eyed Predator
hunter_keen_eyed_predator.description: When you enter a Field, you extend your senses to de - termine what might await you. Ask one question from the following list for free. You may roll your Knack Skill and spend one success per additional question. The Storyguide must answer these questions honestly: What kinds of haz - ards (such as terrain) are…
hunter_keen_eyed_predator.mechanicalEffects: When you enter a Field, you extend your senses to de - termine what might await you. Ask one question from the following list for free. You may roll your Knack Skill and spend one success per additional question. The Storyguide must answer these questions honestly: What kinds of haz - ards (such as terrain) are present? Where is the nearest exit? Where is the safest way in? How many hostile enemies are present? Who (or what) is the biggest threat?

hunter_most_dangerous_prey.name: Most Dangerous Prey
hunter_most_dangerous_prey.description: Choose an enemy to be your quarry. When you pursue your quarry, gain +1 Enhancement to all rolls made against the target (including attack rolls) until the end of the session or until you catch them, whichever comes first. You gain access to the following Stunts, which may be applied to any attack action made against…
hunter_most_dangerous_prey.mechanicalEffects: Choose an enemy to be your quarry. When you pursue your quarry, gain +1 Enhancement to all rolls made against the target (including attack rolls) until the end of the session or until you catch them, whichever comes first. You gain access to the following Stunts, which may be applied to any attack action made against your quarry: Stalk (1s): After resolving your attack, spend a success to take an additional Move action. Snare (any successes above Defense): You trap the tar - get in place. They may not make Move, Rush, or Disengage actions. To end the effect, the target must make Athletics + Dexterity rolls vs. your Knack Skill until they succeed or until you choose to end it, whichever comes first.

hunter_nose_for_deals.name: Nose For Deals
hunter_nose_for_deals.description: When you search for a good or service — whether that’s authentic Ethiopian cuisine, new Victoria-brand sneakers, or an ophthalmologist with cyclops-related experience — the Storyguide will offer you your choice of the quickest, easiest, or safest route to get it. You gain +2 Enhancement to overcome obstacles along…
hunter_nose_for_deals.mechanicalEffects: When you search for a good or service — whether that’s authentic Ethiopian cuisine, new Victoria-brand sneakers, or an ophthalmologist with cyclops-related experience — the Storyguide will offer you your choice of the quickest, easiest, or safest route to get it. You gain +2 Enhancement to overcome obstacles along that route.

hunter_no_safety.name: No Safety
hunter_no_safety.description: At the beginning of an action scene in your hunting ground, you may define a field as dangerous terrain with a Complication rating of your Hunter rating. During a Chase there, you may create a Complication 2 Hazard to inflict on your opponents once per scene.
hunter_no_safety.mechanicalEffects: At the beginning of an action scene in your hunting ground, you may define a field as dangerous terrain with a Complication rating of your Hunter rating. During a Chase there, you may create a Complication 2 Hazard to inflict on your opponents once per scene.

hunter_no_shelter.name: No Shelter
hunter_no_shelter.description: Enemies in your hunting ground treat all cover as though it was expendable, and you gain Enhancement 1 for any chases there. Your quarry cannot gain the benefits of cover in your hunting ground, and you gain Enhancement 2 for any chases against them.
hunter_no_shelter.mechanicalEffects: Enemies in your hunting ground treat all cover as though it was expendable, and you gain Enhancement 1 for any chases there. Your quarry cannot gain the benefits of cover in your hunting ground, and you gain Enhancement 2 for any chases against them.

hunter_predators_senses.name: Predator’S Senses
hunter_predators_senses.description: Attuning your consciousness to the greatest hunters of the animal kingdom allows you to tap into their senses. Be it an eagle’s eyesight, a horned owl’s hearing, or a shark’s sense of smell, you can turn on this Knack at will while pursuing your quarry, gaining 3 Enhancement to a chosen sense. With a Knack Skill roll…
hunter_predators_senses.mechanicalEffects: Attuning your consciousness to the greatest hunters of the animal kingdom allows you to tap into their senses. Be it an eagle’s eyesight, a horned owl’s hearing, or a shark’s sense of smell, you can turn on this Knack at will while pursuing your quarry, gaining 3 Enhancement to a chosen sense. With a Knack Skill roll you can increase the number of senses ac - tive at one time. If you encounter a bright light, loud noise, or any other sudden assault to the senses, make a Survival + Composure roll (difficulty 1) to avoid being startled and gaining the Stunned Condition.

hunter_predatory_grin.name: Predatory Grin
hunter_predatory_grin.description: Like a hungry wolf, you fill your prey with dread, causing them to blunder into error after error. At the start of a Show-
hunter_predatory_grin.mechanicalEffects: Like a hungry wolf, you fill your prey with dread, causing them to blunder into error after error. At the start of a Show-

hunter_query_the_quarry.name: Query The Quarry
hunter_query_the_quarry.description: A Hunter with this Knack is keenly aware of what plane of existence their chosen quarry is currently on, whether an Overworld, Underworld, the World, a Terra Incognita, or an even stranger place. This information updates in real time, so if a Hunter’s quarry flees from Asgard to Jotunheim, they know instantly.…
hunter_query_the_quarry.mechanicalEffects: A Hunter with this Knack is keenly aware of what plane of existence their chosen quarry is currently on, whether an Overworld, Underworld, the World, a Terra Incognita, or an even stranger place. This information updates in real time, so if a Hunter’s quarry flees from Asgard to Jotunheim, they know instantly. Additionally, the Hunter receives +1 Enhancement on any action to move between realms, even if they have no current quarry. If they do, this bonus stacks with the Enhancement from Most Dangerous Prey.

hunter_scent_of_blood.name: Scent Of Blood
hunter_scent_of_blood.description: You can smell the blood in the water, and it drives you towards your goal. Gain +1 Enhancement on attacks made against targets that have one or more Injury Conditions.
hunter_scent_of_blood.mechanicalEffects: You can smell the blood in the water, and it drives you towards your goal. Gain +1 Enhancement on attacks made against targets that have one or more Injury Conditions.

hunter_silence_in_the_woods.name: Silence In The Woods
hunter_silence_in_the_woods.description: When pursuing a target, you make no noise at all, add - ing +2 Enhancement to avoid detection based on hearing/ sound (including things that can perceive vibrations without specifically hearing) and to set up ambushes. This Enhancement applies before you roll. Recording equipment is also unable to pick up your sound.
hunter_silence_in_the_woods.mechanicalEffects: When pursuing a target, you make no noise at all, add - ing +2 Enhancement to avoid detection based on hearing/ sound (including things that can perceive vibrations without specifically hearing) and to set up ambushes. This Enhancement applies before you roll. Recording equipment is also unable to pick up your sound.

hunter_the_hunter_hunted.name: The Hunter Hunted
hunter_the_hunter_hunted.description: You know how to think like prey as well as predator. When you are the target of an ambush (Scion: Origin, pp.118119), add an Enhancement equal to your dots in Hunter to your dice pool before rolling. When launching an ambush of your own, you gain the same Enhancement for the Surprise stunt, but applied after the roll…
hunter_the_hunter_hunted.mechanicalEffects: You know how to think like prey as well as predator. When you are the target of an ambush (Scion: Origin, pp.118119), add an Enhancement equal to your dots in Hunter to your dice pool before rolling. When launching an ambush of your own, you gain the same Enhancement for the Surprise stunt, but applied after the roll instead of before.

hunter_worrying_hound.name: Worrying Hound
hunter_worrying_hound.description: While pursuing a target, you do not face any increase in difficulty to track down your target, even if they were to take flight, hide in a body of water, or attempt to disappear into the back alleys of a crowded city. You always have some idea of where your target has gone, and gain +1 Enhancement to keep up with him…
hunter_worrying_hound.mechanicalEffects: While pursuing a target, you do not face any increase in difficulty to track down your target, even if they were to take flight, hide in a body of water, or attempt to disappear into the back alleys of a crowded city. You always have some idea of where your target has gone, and gain +1 Enhancement to keep up with him and to apply any Stunts you may have access to from Hunter Knacks. When you hunt your quarry, add another +1 Enhancement.

hunter_always_there.name: Always There
hunter_always_there.description: Anyone of a lower Tier cannot escape you. You always find them and can always track them down no matter how far they go.
hunter_always_there.mechanicalEffects: Anyone of a lower Tier cannot escape you. You always find them and can always track them down no matter how far they go.

hunter_baying_of_the_hounds.name: Baying Of The Hounds
hunter_baying_of_the_hounds.description: Spend a Momentum to set the hounds loose on your prey. These are not literal hounds, but creatures of the Mythos that harry your enemy, corralling them for you to collect later. Your target suffers a Complication equal to your Knack Skill on all actions, taking an Injury Condition as a consequence for not buying it…
hunter_baying_of_the_hounds.mechanicalEffects: Spend a Momentum to set the hounds loose on your prey. These are not literal hounds, but creatures of the Mythos that harry your enemy, corralling them for you to collect later. Your target suffers a Complication equal to your Knack Skill on all actions, taking an Injury Condition as a consequence for not buying it off as the hounds chase them. The hounds do not stop bothering the person until they fall unconscious, or you catch up to your prey.

hunter_between_disasters.name: Between Disasters
hunter_between_disasters.description: Zemí-Specific No pathway between islands, across the World, or be - yond its borders surprises you. When you engage in long term travel, you’re always aware of any potential hazards or dangers along your path and gain an Enhancement equal to your Calling rating to avoid them. In Action-Adventure gameplay, reduce any…
hunter_between_disasters.mechanicalEffects: Zemí-Specific No pathway between islands, across the World, or be - yond its borders surprises you. When you engage in long term travel, you’re always aware of any potential hazards or dangers along your path and gain an Enhancement equal to your Calling rating to avoid them. In Action-Adventure gameplay, reduce any damage from dangerous terrain or damaging fields by your Calling rating to a minimum of zero.

hunter_catching_thoughts.name: Catching Thoughts
hunter_catching_thoughts.description: Your Procedural Investigation actions gain your Hunter rating in Enhancement for use in the Extra Clue and Q&A Stunts; when purchasing those stunts, you may always ask questions about individuals involved, determining a person’s motivation from the depth of their footprints or their par - ticular skills from their…
hunter_catching_thoughts.mechanicalEffects: Your Procedural Investigation actions gain your Hunter rating in Enhancement for use in the Extra Clue and Q&A Stunts; when purchasing those stunts, you may always ask questions about individuals involved, determining a person’s motivation from the depth of their footprints or their par - ticular skills from their dirty dishes. You act with additional Scale when investigating your quarry.

hunter_fell_the_mountain.name: Fell The Mountain
hunter_fell_the_mountain.description: The bigger they are… When hunting enormous or in - credibly durable targets such as enormous monsters, giants, or similar prey, you may spend Momentum to discover their weakest point. For the rest of the episode, reduce the cost of the Inflict Injury and Critical Stunts against targets with Size Scale or Segments, and…
hunter_fell_the_mountain.mechanicalEffects: The bigger they are… When hunting enormous or in - credibly durable targets such as enormous monsters, giants, or similar prey, you may spend Momentum to discover their weakest point. For the rest of the episode, reduce the cost of the Inflict Injury and Critical Stunts against targets with Size Scale or Segments, and of resolving Goliath milestones by 2. When using Direct Assault through this calling in Di - vine Rule, gain an additional point of effect.

hunter_hackles_rise.name: Hackles Rise
hunter_hackles_rise.description: One predator can’t slip by another. You always know if someone else has taken life; whether it was animal, human, monster, or divine being; and whether it was out of need, in the flash of passion, or in cold blood. Magical attempts to deceive you or avoid this power must defeat you in a Clash of Wills.
hunter_hackles_rise.mechanicalEffects: One predator can’t slip by another. You always know if someone else has taken life; whether it was animal, human, monster, or divine being; and whether it was out of need, in the flash of passion, or in cold blood. Magical attempts to deceive you or avoid this power must defeat you in a Clash of Wills.

hunter_no_escape.name: No Escape
hunter_no_escape.description: At the beginning of an action scene, you may define a Field in your hunting ground as difficult terrain which af - fects only your enemies at a Difficulty equal to your rating in Hunter. Your quarry treats the entirety of your hunting ground as such difficult terrain. During a chase there, you benefit from an…
hunter_no_escape.mechanicalEffects: At the beginning of an action scene, you may define a Field in your hunting ground as difficult terrain which af - fects only your enemies at a Difficulty equal to your rating in Hunter. Your quarry treats the entirety of your hunting ground as such difficult terrain. During a chase there, you benefit from an additional point of speed Scale.

hunter_no_hiding.name: No Hiding
hunter_no_hiding.description: You can focus on one of your hunting grounds, becom - ing perfectly aware of everything going on there for a scene, no matter where you are. Lower tier characters cannot conceal their presence or any activities from you, while equal or higher-tier characters must succeed on a Clash of Wills to successfully hide from…
hunter_no_hiding.mechanicalEffects: You can focus on one of your hunting grounds, becom - ing perfectly aware of everything going on there for a scene, no matter where you are. Lower tier characters cannot conceal their presence or any activities from you, while equal or higher-tier characters must succeed on a Clash of Wills to successfully hide from you.

hunter_perfect_camouflage.name: Perfect Camouflage
hunter_perfect_camouflage.description: You blend in seamlessly with your surroundings, granting +3 Enhancement to avoid notice by the person you are pur - suing, which applies before you roll. Targets of a lower Tier simply cannot spot you. Gain access to the following Stunt: Vanish (successes equal to the target’s Composure): After re - solving an attack,…
hunter_perfect_camouflage.mechanicalEffects: You blend in seamlessly with your surroundings, granting +3 Enhancement to avoid notice by the person you are pur - suing, which applies before you roll. Targets of a lower Tier simply cannot spot you. Gain access to the following Stunt: Vanish (successes equal to the target’s Composure): After re - solving an attack, you vanish from the target’s line of sight. They may not target you with any action until the start of your next turn.

hunter_pursuit_predator.name: Pursuit Predator
hunter_pursuit_predator.description: While on the hunt, you don’t need to eat, drink, or sleep; suppress the effects of related Conditions until you succeed or abandon your pursuit. You gain your Hunter rating in Enhancement for attempts to exhaust or otherwise outlast your quarry.
hunter_pursuit_predator.mechanicalEffects: While on the hunt, you don’t need to eat, drink, or sleep; suppress the effects of related Conditions until you succeed or abandon your pursuit. You gain your Hunter rating in Enhancement for attempts to exhaust or otherwise outlast your quarry.

hunter_relentless.name: Relentless
hunter_relentless.description: When you pursue or hunt a target on a massive Scale or of great Size (chasing your target across dimensions, hunting a mountain-sized titanspawn), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
hunter_relentless.mechanicalEffects: When you pursue or hunt a target on a massive Scale or of great Size (chasing your target across dimensions, hunting a mountain-sized titanspawn), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

hunter_send_the_pack.name: Send The Pack
hunter_send_the_pack.description: Make a Knack Skill roll. On a success, designate a target that you can see with unaided sight. Friendly characters you designate up to your Legend can pursue them without ceasing and at no increased difficulty.
hunter_send_the_pack.mechanicalEffects: Make a Knack Skill roll. On a success, designate a target that you can see with unaided sight. Friendly characters you designate up to your Legend can pursue them without ceasing and at no increased difficulty.

hunter_wild_expanses.name: Wild Expanses
hunter_wild_expanses.description: A lodge, hunting ground, or untrammeled stretch of wilderness is enough for you to feed a people. Imbue Legend to consecrate a hunting ground or attendant area dedicated to the hunt. Those hunting there benefit from additional applicable Scale when attempting to obtain rare or bountiful resources. This may create a…
hunter_wild_expanses.mechanicalEffects: A lodge, hunting ground, or untrammeled stretch of wilderness is enough for you to feed a people. Imbue Legend to consecrate a hunting ground or attendant area dedicated to the hunt. Those hunting there benefit from additional applicable Scale when attempting to obtain rare or bountiful resources. This may create a Realm Condition that reduces the cost for Beasts, Moon, or Wilds Divine Rule actions taken through it by 1.

hunter_crying_wolf.name: Crying Wolf
hunter_crying_wolf.description: You quarry cannot get help, because no one believes they’re being hunted. Once per scene, you may Imbue for Scale to terrorize them out of credibility or to convince their allies that they are in no real danger.
hunter_crying_wolf.mechanicalEffects: You quarry cannot get help, because no one believes they’re being hunted. Once per scene, you may Imbue for Scale to terrorize them out of credibility or to convince their allies that they are in no real danger.

hunter_oubliette.name: Oubliette
hunter_oubliette.description: Once you have caught your quarry, spend one mo - mentum to trap them. The field around them transforms into a cage or labyrinth of your design. Beings of lower Tier are trapped, while others must attempt a Clash of Wills to escape. You may enter or exit at will.
hunter_oubliette.mechanicalEffects: Once you have caught your quarry, spend one mo - mentum to trap them. The field around them transforms into a cage or labyrinth of your design. Beings of lower Tier are trapped, while others must attempt a Clash of Wills to escape. You may enter or exit at will.

hunter_the_wrong_place.name: The Wrong Place
hunter_the_wrong_place.description: Imbue for Scale when attempting to find something that was lost to history (a forgotten relic, an ancient secret, or a single, centuries-old soul bound in the vast expanses of an Underworld).
hunter_the_wrong_place.mechanicalEffects: Imbue for Scale when attempting to find something that was lost to history (a forgotten relic, an ancient secret, or a single, centuries-old soul bound in the vast expanses of an Underworld).

hunter_to_extinction.name: To Extinction
hunter_to_extinction.description: You may declare any organized group of foes as your quarry for the purposes of relevant Knacks. If you have the Knack “Always There”, and the targets are of lower Tier, you may immediately jump to the scene of catching the last one.
hunter_to_extinction.mechanicalEffects: You may declare any organized group of foes as your quarry for the purposes of relevant Knacks. If you have the Knack “Always There”, and the targets are of lower Tier, you may immediately jump to the scene of catching the last one.

hunter_trophy_room.name: Trophy Room
hunter_trophy_room.description: You’ve caught beasts across the globe. You may, at will, produce a trophy of your off-screen exploits: any item that could reasonably have been harvested from the body of any mundane animal, common Denizen, or a monster of lower Tier. Further, once per session you can use such a trophy to grant your dots in the Hunter…
hunter_trophy_room.mechanicalEffects: You’ve caught beasts across the globe. You may, at will, produce a trophy of your off-screen exploits: any item that could reasonably have been harvested from the body of any mundane animal, common Denizen, or a monster of lower Tier. Further, once per session you can use such a trophy to grant your dots in the Hunter Calling as an Enhancement, either to an intimidation roll or a crafting roll utilizing the item in question.

hunter_manitou_specific_hunting_party.name: Manitou-Specific: Hunting Party
hunter_manitou_specific_hunting_party.description: When you lead a hunt for a specific species of ani - mal or Titanspawn, you may use your dots in the Hunter Calling as an enhancement to all rolls toward finding the location of the creatures.
hunter_manitou_specific_hunting_party.mechanicalEffects: When you lead a hunt for a specific species of ani - mal or Titanspawn, you may use your dots in the Hunter Calling as an enhancement to all rolls toward finding the location of the creatures.

judge_curse_of_fragility.name: Curse Of Fragility
judge_curse_of_fragility.description: Pick a target in a combat situation and spend a Mo - mentum. For the rest of the fight, all enemies attacking your target are considered to have the Brutal tag.
judge_curse_of_fragility.mechanicalEffects: Pick a target in a combat situation and spend a Mo - mentum. For the rest of the fight, all enemies attacking your target are considered to have the Brutal tag.

judge_divine_truths.name: Divine Truths
judge_divine_truths.description: By speaking plain and true, you empower what you say. Whenever you speak truly, you may add Enhancement equal to your Knack Skill to any Intrigue rolls to persuade or in - form. At the Storyguide’s discretion, this Knack may fail to function when the character’s words are untrue — even if she believes them.
judge_divine_truths.mechanicalEffects: By speaking plain and true, you empower what you say. Whenever you speak truly, you may add Enhancement equal to your Knack Skill to any Intrigue rolls to persuade or in - form. At the Storyguide’s discretion, this Knack may fail to function when the character’s words are untrue — even if she believes them.

judge_eye_for_an_eye.name: Eye For An Eye
judge_eye_for_an_eye.description: When you suffer an Injury, spend Momentum and inflict the same Injury on the target that attacked you. The target must have attacked you directly; you cannot reflect attacks that targeted someone else. If the target does not have the ability to take a similar Injury (having your arm bitten by a giant snake, for…
judge_eye_for_an_eye.mechanicalEffects: When you suffer an Injury, spend Momentum and inflict the same Injury on the target that attacked you. The target must have attacked you directly; you cannot reflect attacks that targeted someone else. If the target does not have the ability to take a similar Injury (having your arm bitten by a giant snake, for example), inflict an Injury of similar severity instead, such as a festering, envenomed bite mark. This also applies to Critical Hits inflicted.

judge_final_judgement.name: Final Judgement
judge_final_judgement.description: People of the World trust in your ability to resolve conflicts fairly and without bias. When asked to mediate, with a successful Knack Skill roll all parties involved accept and abide by your decision. While the parties involved accept your judgement, this Knack does not prevent those on the losing side of the…
judge_final_judgement.mechanicalEffects: People of the World trust in your ability to resolve conflicts fairly and without bias. When asked to mediate, with a successful Knack Skill roll all parties involved accept and abide by your decision. While the parties involved accept your judgement, this Knack does not prevent those on the losing side of the argument from harboring ill will toward you for siding against them. HANG ‘EM HIGH You condemn your foe, preparing to bring down righ - teous justice. Spend 1 Momentum to declare a character “Wanted,” imposing +1 Difficulty to all actions involving law enforcement, including possess.

judge_honor_in_duty.name: Honor In Duty
judge_honor_in_duty.description: When you work to uphold the law, justice, or order for a higher power, whether as an agent of mortal society, divine right, or stranger authority, those attempting to directly interfere with your investigations or litigation suffer your Judge rating in Complication: Censured: Any unresolved Complication is reduced…
judge_honor_in_duty.mechanicalEffects: When you work to uphold the law, justice, or order for a higher power, whether as an agent of mortal society, divine right, or stranger authority, those attempting to directly interfere with your investigations or litigation suffer your Judge rating in Complication: Censured: Any unresolved Complication is reduced from their Defense and the Diffi - culty for you to make investigation or intrigue rolls against them for the rest of the scene.

judge_indisputable_analysis.name: Indisputable Analysis
judge_indisputable_analysis.description: You spend a moment observing the scene you wish to analyze, and the player makes a Knack Skill roll.
