You then apply the successes on this roll as Enhancement to all rolls made to analyze and investigate the incident for the rest of the scene. These successes apply before you roll.
judge_indisputable_analysis.mechanicalEffects: You spend a moment observing the scene you wish to analyze, and the player makes a Knack Skill roll. You then apply the successes on this roll as Enhancement to all rolls made to analyze and investigate the incident for the rest of the scene. These successes apply before you roll.

judge_lie_detector.name: Lie Detector
judge_lie_detector.description: Anyone of a Tier lower than you must overcome Com - plication 2, “Under Scrutiny” when lying to you; failure or inability to buy off this Complication results in a confession from the target. Spend Momentum, and they simply cannot lie to you at all. The Storyguide should also notify you when a lie has been told,…
judge_lie_detector.mechanicalEffects: Anyone of a Tier lower than you must overcome Com - plication 2, “Under Scrutiny” when lying to you; failure or inability to buy off this Complication results in a confession from the target. Spend Momentum, and they simply cannot lie to you at all. The Storyguide should also notify you when a lie has been told, though it does not automatically reveal the truth, but also reveals nebulous truth, such as “he has been convinced this is true” — which should always be a means for characters to pursue the person who manipulated the target in the first place.

judge_lift_the_veil.name: Lift The Veil
judge_lift_the_veil.description: Lift the Veil allows you to see through disguises. By taking a moment’s concentration, you may see through any illusions or shapeshifting intended to deceive. Against a character of a higher Tier, this requires a Clash of Wills.
judge_lift_the_veil.mechanicalEffects: Lift the Veil allows you to see through disguises. By taking a moment’s concentration, you may see through any illusions or shapeshifting intended to deceive. Against a character of a higher Tier, this requires a Clash of Wills.

judge_no_innocents_were_harmed.name: No Innocents Were Harmed
judge_no_innocents_were_harmed.description: Whether they mete out justice with fists, bullets, or hurricanes, a truly just Scion seeks to spare those undeserving of their wrath. Before engaging in an act of violence, you may spend a Momentum to declare your target and make a Knack Skill roll. Each Success on this roll increases the Scale of violence which you…
judge_no_innocents_were_harmed.mechanicalEffects: Whether they mete out justice with fists, bullets, or hurricanes, a truly just Scion seeks to spare those undeserving of their wrath. Before engaging in an act of violence, you may spend a Momentum to declare your target and make a Knack Skill roll. Each Success on this roll increases the Scale of violence which you can engage in without harming anyone who is truly innocent, starting at Scale 0. Example: A Scion of Maudjee-Kawiss seeks to punish the Titan Cult which has infiltrated a hospital. Using No Innocents Were Harmed, they roll 3 successes. The Scion is free to unleash devastation up to Scale 2 and be certain innocents will not be harmed. OBJECTION! You mark a target, and anyone targeting them with an action gains +1 Enhancement to all rolls. This bonus applies before you roll. Gain access to the following Stunt, which you may apply to any of your attack actions: Terrify (any successes above Defense): After applying this Stunt, the target must make a Clash of Wills roll. On a failure, they must flee the fight or suffer +2 Difficulty to attack rolls until the fight is over.

judge_on_the_case.name: On The Case
judge_on_the_case.description: When you investigate an event or scene, you are cas - ing. While casing, gain +1 Enhancement to rolls to discern motives and search for clues, which applies before you roll. Casing lasts until the end of the session.
judge_on_the_case.mechanicalEffects: When you investigate an event or scene, you are cas - ing. While casing, gain +1 Enhancement to rolls to discern motives and search for clues, which applies before you roll. Casing lasts until the end of the session.

judge_proper_penance.name: Proper Penance
judge_proper_penance.description: When a character confesses a wronging or failure to you, you may proscribe a course of action for them to atone or set things to right. Roll your Knack skill; your successes make a pool of Enhancement they may spend on rolls to follow your instructions for the rest of the session. If they choose to actively defy your…
judge_proper_penance.mechanicalEffects: When a character confesses a wronging or failure to you, you may proscribe a course of action for them to atone or set things to right. Roll your Knack skill; your successes make a pool of Enhancement they may spend on rolls to follow your instructions for the rest of the session. If they choose to actively defy your judgment, they suffer +1 Difficulty on all their actions for the rest of the session instead.

judge_quick_study.name: Quick Study
judge_quick_study.description: You sweep your eyes over a crime scene and collects clue almost immediately. Halve the time you would need to perform an investigation. Quarter it if you are also casing.
judge_quick_study.mechanicalEffects: You sweep your eyes over a crime scene and collects clue almost immediately. Halve the time you would need to perform an investigation. Quarter it if you are also casing.

judge_read_the_room.name: Read The Room
judge_read_the_room.description: When you observe a crowd or audience, you can ask the Storyguide for two options of how you could win them over. If you do one or the other, they automatically improve their Attitude toward you by 2 steps, and you intuit a useful clue about what else they want from you, what it would take to get them to do something,…
judge_read_the_room.mechanicalEffects: When you observe a crowd or audience, you can ask the Storyguide for two options of how you could win them over. If you do one or the other, they automatically improve their Attitude toward you by 2 steps, and you intuit a useful clue about what else they want from you, what it would take to get them to do something, or some other piece of useful information about the group; if you act on it, you gain +1 Enhancement.

judge_reveal_evidence.name: Reveal Evidence
judge_reveal_evidence.description: At the beginning of an investigation, make a Knack Skill roll and apply the results to either of these Stunts: Surprise Witness (1-3s): A witness to events comes for - ward with information that wouldn’t otherwise be available, like someone who saw a ghost pass through a wall without leaving traces or who confirms the…
judge_reveal_evidence.mechanicalEffects: At the beginning of an investigation, make a Knack Skill roll and apply the results to either of these Stunts: Surprise Witness (1-3s): A witness to events comes for - ward with information that wouldn’t otherwise be available, like someone who saw a ghost pass through a wall without leaving traces or who confirms the apparent suspect was elsewhere at the time. If you take the new information into account, gain an Enhancement on your next investigation roll equal to the successes spent. Process of Elimination (2s): If you have multiple poten - tial suspects in the investigation, the Storyguide must let you know one of them (if any) that can be eliminated from your options. You can buy this Stunt multiple times.

judge_the_truth_arises.name: The Truth Arises
judge_the_truth_arises.description: When you engage in conversation (or other such inter - action) with an alleged perpetrator of a crime, make a Knack Skill roll. On a success, if the target is guilty, he will leak a piece of information that connects him to his crime. Before expending effort on using this Knack, let the Storyguide know, and she should…
judge_the_truth_arises.mechanicalEffects: When you engage in conversation (or other such inter - action) with an alleged perpetrator of a crime, make a Knack Skill roll. On a success, if the target is guilty, he will leak a piece of information that connects him to his crime. Before expending effort on using this Knack, let the Storyguide know, and she should tell you if the target does not have any valuable information to leak — which in itself can be helpful in an investigation.

judge_a_house_of_law.name: A House Of Law
judge_a_house_of_law.description: Your chambers or places of judgement are beacons of light and order across the land. Imbue Legend to consecrate a courthouse, hall of judgement, law library, or similar place of jurisprudence. Those attempting investigative actions (in Procedural scenes or otherwise) to determine the truth within its walls benefit…
judge_a_house_of_law.mechanicalEffects: Your chambers or places of judgement are beacons of light and order across the land. Imbue Legend to consecrate a courthouse, hall of judgement, law library, or similar place of jurisprudence. Those attempting investigative actions (in Procedural scenes or otherwise) to determine the truth within its walls benefit from additional Scale. This may create a Realm Condition that reduces the cost for Fortune, Order, or Sun Divine Rule actions taken through it by 1.

judge_bound_by_oath.name: Bound By Oath
judge_bound_by_oath.description: When someone swears an oath to you to perform a task of your choosing, you bind it with your choice of swearing ceremony. As long as they work towards the sworn oath, they gain +1 Enhancement to all rolls until the task is complete. This bonus applies before the roll. If the target breaks your oath, the next roll they…
judge_bound_by_oath.mechanicalEffects: When someone swears an oath to you to perform a task of your choosing, you bind it with your choice of swearing ceremony. As long as they work towards the sworn oath, they gain +1 Enhancement to all rolls until the task is complete. This bonus applies before the roll. If the target breaks your oath, the next roll they would make botches automatically.

judge_i_am_the_law.name: I Am The Law
judge_i_am_the_law.description: When you reshape laws or challenge the structure of society on a wide Scale (rewriting a country’s constitution, smashing the patriarchy), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
judge_i_am_the_law.mechanicalEffects: When you reshape laws or challenge the structure of society on a wide Scale (rewriting a country’s constitution, smashing the patriarchy), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

judge_interlinking_roots.name: Interlinking Roots
judge_interlinking_roots.description: Ilhm-Specific You trace relations and relationships through the com - munity, determining where the people have come from and how they’ve come together. You can tell two individuals’ relationships, from familial to friendly, formal to intimate, at a glance, including any Bonds, Attitudes, or supernatural effects…
judge_interlinking_roots.mechanicalEffects: Ilhm-Specific You trace relations and relationships through the com - munity, determining where the people have come from and how they’ve come together. You can tell two individuals’ relationships, from familial to friendly, formal to intimate, at a glance, including any Bonds, Attitudes, or supernatural effects connecting them. If supernaturally concealed from you, you may gain +2 Enhancement on any Clash of Wills to discover that information.

judge_pardon_and_parole.name: Pardon And Parole
judge_pardon_and_parole.description: When a character offers recompense for their deeds in good faith to you and promises to amend their behavior, you may grant them pardon. As long as they keep the promises they make to you, the World recognizes their changed nature and prevents further persecution from any who acknowl - edge your judgement or who are…
judge_pardon_and_parole.mechanicalEffects: When a character offers recompense for their deeds in good faith to you and promises to amend their behavior, you may grant them pardon. As long as they keep the promises they make to you, the World recognizes their changed nature and prevents further persecution from any who acknowl - edge your judgement or who are lower Tier characters. This may include avoiding legal consequences, removing negative Attitudes towards them, and allowing relevant Fatebindings to resolve peacefully (such as a Nemesis becoming a Balm). If they break their word to you or return to their perfidious ways, this effect ends, and you immediately know.

judge_pronounce_guilt.name: Pronounce Guilt
judge_pronounce_guilt.description: You declare a target is guilty of a crime, and it becomes true. The target need not actually be guilty or even associated with the crime, but the moment you declare their guilt, all the evidence lines up. If another guilty party is brought for - ward, it provokes a Clash of Wills.
judge_pronounce_guilt.mechanicalEffects: You declare a target is guilty of a crime, and it becomes true. The target need not actually be guilty or even associated with the crime, but the moment you declare their guilt, all the evidence lines up. If another guilty party is brought for - ward, it provokes a Clash of Wills.

judge_righteous_petitions.name: Righteous Petitions
judge_righteous_petitions.description: You may provide supernatural aid or supply to a char - acter embarking on a quest, an errand for a higher power, or in pursuit of a worthy Ideal. Pick a Birthright of value up to your Judge rating; they gain access to it until they succeed at or abandon their goal, or the end of the arc. You may have no more benefits…
judge_righteous_petitions.mechanicalEffects: You may provide supernatural aid or supply to a char - acter embarking on a quest, an errand for a higher power, or in pursuit of a worthy Ideal. Pick a Birthright of value up to your Judge rating; they gain access to it until they succeed at or abandon their goal, or the end of the arc. You may have no more benefits present in play than your Legend at any one time.

judge_terror_of_the_guilty.name: Terror Of The Guilty
judge_terror_of_the_guilty.description: Anyone guilty of a wrongdoing of your choosing who is of lower Tier than you cannot bear to be in your presence and will flee in panic and terror or break down weeping and confessing. The wrongdoing must be something abhorrent to your personal ethics and/or morality, or applicable to the laws of your place of origin.…
judge_terror_of_the_guilty.mechanicalEffects: Anyone guilty of a wrongdoing of your choosing who is of lower Tier than you cannot bear to be in your presence and will flee in panic and terror or break down weeping and confessing. The wrongdoing must be something abhorrent to your personal ethics and/or morality, or applicable to the laws of your place of origin. To apply this to anyone of the same Tier or higher, spend Momentum and win a Clash of Wills.

judge_the_pain_of_dishonesty.name: The Pain Of Dishonesty
judge_the_pain_of_dishonesty.description: Spend Momentum and anyone who lies directly to you suffers a +1 Injury Condition. You choose whether or not to inflict the damage or Condition, automatically alerting you of the lie (though it does not reveal the truth). You also know the severity of the lie and therefore can choose not to harm someone who is lying to…
judge_the_pain_of_dishonesty.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum and anyone who lies directly to you suffers a +1 Injury Condition. You choose whether or not to inflict the damage or Condition, automatically alerting you of the lie (though it does not reveal the truth). You also know the severity of the lie and therefore can choose not to harm someone who is lying to preserve someone’s feelings as opposed to lying to obstruct a criminal investigation. If the target is another player’s character with whom you have Bond, the Bond lessens by 1 unless the character chooses to reveal the truth.

judge_the_price_of_perfidy.name: The Price Of Perfidy
judge_the_price_of_perfidy.description: Characters who have seriously breached the law or their honor suffer distraction and shame in your presence, suffering Complication: Censured: Any unresolved Complication is reduced from their Defense and the Difficulty for you to make investigation or intrigue rolls against them for their actions equal to your Judge…
judge_the_price_of_perfidy.mechanicalEffects: Characters who have seriously breached the law or their honor suffer distraction and shame in your presence, suffering Complication: Censured: Any unresolved Complication is reduced from their Defense and the Difficulty for you to make investigation or intrigue rolls against them for their actions equal to your Judge rating once per scene. Characters who have lied, committed petty crimes, or broken simple promises suffer if they erred in the same scene, while those who have committed serious crimes, broken oaths, or com - mitted dire betrayal suffer unless they’ve somehow atoned for their deeds.

judge_the_stench_of_betrayal.name: The Stench Of Betrayal
judge_the_stench_of_betrayal.description: You are always aware when someone in your presence holds a negative or inappropriate Attitude toward a superior, ally, or subordinate. You automatically know the Attitude in question for lower Tier characters, and gain your Judge rating in Enhancement for attempts to try and discover it for other characters through…
judge_the_stench_of_betrayal.mechanicalEffects: You are always aware when someone in your presence holds a negative or inappropriate Attitude toward a superior, ally, or subordinate. You automatically know the Attitude in question for lower Tier characters, and gain your Judge rating in Enhancement for attempts to try and discover it for other characters through intrigue actions.

judge_universal_inspection.name: Universal Inspection
judge_universal_inspection.description: You can find dust motes hidden amongst thistle if it will reveal the truth. When performing an investigation or search on an enormous Scale, such as finding a lost ring hidden in a crow’s nest within a city or a smudged footprint in a muddied factory field, imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending it, to invoke…
judge_universal_inspection.mechanicalEffects: You can find dust motes hidden amongst thistle if it will reveal the truth. When performing an investigation or search on an enormous Scale, such as finding a lost ring hidden in a crow’s nest within a city or a smudged footprint in a muddied factory field, imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending it, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

judge_voice_of_law.name: Voice Of Law
judge_voice_of_law.description: Spend Momentum and name an action you wish to out - law for the scene. Characters attempting to disobey it must always roll, even if it would normally be an unrolled action (i.e., “No one may open that door!”). Attempts to disobey suffer your Legend in additional Difficulty, and those who succeed at disobeying suffer…
judge_voice_of_law.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum and name an action you wish to out - law for the scene. Characters attempting to disobey it must always roll, even if it would normally be an unrolled action (i.e., “No one may open that door!”). Attempts to disobey suffer your Legend in additional Difficulty, and those who succeed at disobeying suffer Complication: Censured: Any unresolved Complication is reduced from their Defense and the Difficulty for you to make investigation or intrigue rolls against them for their actions equal to your Judge rating once per scene.

judge_divine_mercy.name: Divine Mercy
judge_divine_mercy.description: When someone has been unfairly punished or given an excessive sentence, you may Imbue for Scale to release them. This may involve sundering chains, burning a slave labor camp to the ground, or pulling someone out of a tormenting afterlife (to place them in a more benevolent Underworld realm; this Knack alone cannot…
judge_divine_mercy.mechanicalEffects: When someone has been unfairly punished or given an excessive sentence, you may Imbue for Scale to release them. This may involve sundering chains, burning a slave labor camp to the ground, or pulling someone out of a tormenting afterlife (to place them in a more benevolent Underworld realm; this Knack alone cannot undo a death sentence). Doing so is seen as a lawful act in the eyes of any Boons or Knacks that make that distinction.

judge_inescapable_judgement.name: Inescapable Judgement
judge_inescapable_judgement.description: Imbue for Scale when punishing the guilty on a massive scope (capturing every member of an international criminal enterprise, guillotining a cruel aristocracy, binding a Titan).
judge_inescapable_judgement.mechanicalEffects: Imbue for Scale when punishing the guilty on a massive scope (capturing every member of an international criminal enterprise, guillotining a cruel aristocracy, binding a Titan).

judge_name_the_executioner.name: Name The Executioner
judge_name_the_executioner.description: If you declare someone guilty of a transgression, you may proclaim a single ally as the executioner of their punishment. Once per session, you may Imbue for Scale to modify a single roll made by the executioner to punish the transgressor. This does not stack with any other su - pernatural sources of Scale.
judge_name_the_executioner.mechanicalEffects: If you declare someone guilty of a transgression, you may proclaim a single ally as the executioner of their punishment. Once per session, you may Imbue for Scale to modify a single roll made by the executioner to punish the transgressor. This does not stack with any other su - pernatural sources of Scale.

judge_oathbinder.name: Oathbinder
judge_oathbinder.description: You can sanctify oaths with the force of your divinity. Any character of a lower Tier attempting to break such an oath cannot do so, and others must make a Clash of Wills against you. You know immediately if such an oath is successfully broken.
judge_oathbinder.mechanicalEffects: You can sanctify oaths with the force of your divinity. Any character of a lower Tier attempting to break such an oath cannot do so, and others must make a Clash of Wills against you. You know immediately if such an oath is successfully broken.

judge_the_good_and_bad_places.name: The Good And Bad Places
judge_the_good_and_bad_places.description: Whenever you or your bandmates take the life of any being of Lower Tier, you may declare the Underworld to which that Shade is sent. Beings of equal or greater Tier require a Clash of Wills. The Shade must still undergo any necessary afterlife trials, and the ruler of that realm has final say over the soul’s specific…
judge_the_good_and_bad_places.mechanicalEffects: Whenever you or your bandmates take the life of any being of Lower Tier, you may declare the Underworld to which that Shade is sent. Beings of equal or greater Tier require a Clash of Wills. The Shade must still undergo any necessary afterlife trials, and the ruler of that realm has final say over the soul’s specific placement, but they will take your judgement into ac - count. If they vehemently disagree with your assessment, they will likely let you know out of professional courtesy.

judge_netjer_specific_read_the_ib.name: Netjer-Specific: Read The Ib
judge_netjer_specific_read_the_ib.description: The heart is the record of all deeds, good or ill. By simply looking at any being of Lower Tier, you literally see their beating heart in their chest, and can assess their most severe, recent unjust act. Beings of equal or greater Tier require one Momentum and a Clash of Wills.
judge_netjer_specific_read_the_ib.mechanicalEffects: The heart is the record of all deeds, good or ill. By simply looking at any being of Lower Tier, you literally see their beating heart in their chest, and can assess their most severe, recent unjust act. Beings of equal or greater Tier require one Momentum and a Clash of Wills.

judge_sh_n_specific_the_proper_forms.name: Sh N-Specific: The Proper Forms
judge_sh_n_specific_the_proper_forms.description: You can instantly sense whether someone has acted without following proper bureaucratic procedures (such as driving without a license or leaving Diyu without the permission of the royal judges). If they are of lower Tier, you can command them to immediately make steps to rectify this error.
judge_sh_n_specific_the_proper_forms.mechanicalEffects: You can instantly sense whether someone has acted without following proper bureaucratic procedures (such as driving without a license or leaving Diyu without the permission of the royal judges). If they are of lower Tier, you can command them to immediately make steps to rectify this error.

knight_companion_and_confidant.name: Companion And Confidant
knight_companion_and_confidant.description: When you and another character form a bond, if you confess your Passion and explain how it may hinder your mutual goals, increase the resulting Bond by 1. If such a bond ends or is destroyed, gain Momentum.
knight_companion_and_confidant.mechanicalEffects: When you and another character form a bond, if you confess your Passion and explain how it may hinder your mutual goals, increase the resulting Bond by 1. If such a bond ends or is destroyed, gain Momentum.

knight_guiding_voice.name: Guiding Voice
knight_guiding_voice.description: Make a Knack skill roll when trying to inspire others to your Ideal once per scene. You may spend those suc - cesses to give who heed your words and try to live up to your expectations a pool of 1 Enhancement per success spent, which they may apply once per roll, until the pool is depleted or the scene ends.
knight_guiding_voice.mechanicalEffects: Make a Knack skill roll when trying to inspire others to your Ideal once per scene. You may spend those suc - cesses to give who heed your words and try to live up to your expectations a pool of 1 Enhancement per success spent, which they may apply once per roll, until the pool is depleted or the scene ends.

knight_noble_struggle.name: Noble Struggle
knight_noble_struggle.description: When you fail a roll, you may spend Momentum and describe how your Passion’s follies or your struggle to contain them caused your failure. If you do, nonhostile characters present gain or increase a positive attitude toward you, and those who already possess one gain 1 Enhancement on their next roll.
knight_noble_struggle.mechanicalEffects: When you fail a roll, you may spend Momentum and describe how your Passion’s follies or your struggle to contain them caused your failure. If you do, nonhostile characters present gain or increase a positive attitude toward you, and those who already possess one gain 1 Enhancement on their next roll.

knight_purpose_driven.name: Purpose Driven
knight_purpose_driven.description: Spend Momentum when pursuing a quest or similar task. You become aware of immediate obstacles or Com - plications you will face, and potential consequences for continuing. When opposed by those obstacles or Complications, gain 1 Enhancement on rolls to overcome them.
knight_purpose_driven.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum when pursuing a quest or similar task. You become aware of immediate obstacles or Com - plications you will face, and potential consequences for continuing. When opposed by those obstacles or Complications, gain 1 Enhancement on rolls to overcome them.

knight_righteous_sword.name: Righteous Sword
knight_righteous_sword.description: Choose one weapon to be your favored weapon. Add an additional weapon tag point to it. When you wield it in pursuit of your Ideal, gain an additional tag point for the scene. You may change your favored weapon between sessions. Negative cost tags cannot be purchased with this Knack.
knight_righteous_sword.mechanicalEffects: Choose one weapon to be your favored weapon. Add an additional weapon tag point to it. When you wield it in pursuit of your Ideal, gain an additional tag point for the scene. You may change your favored weapon between sessions. Negative cost tags cannot be purchased with this Knack.

knight_shield_cohort.name: Shield Cohort
knight_shield_cohort.description: When fighting side-by-side with an ally, you both gain 1 Defense.
knight_shield_cohort.mechanicalEffects: When fighting side-by-side with an ally, you both gain 1 Defense.

knight_shining_armor.name: Shining Armor
knight_shining_armor.description: Your personal armor gains the Resistant tag of your choice. You may spend Momentum to change which Resistant tag it possesses. If forced into combat without your armor, gain Momentum.
knight_shining_armor.mechanicalEffects: Your personal armor gains the Resistant tag of your choice. You may spend Momentum to change which Resistant tag it possesses. If forced into combat without your armor, gain Momentum.

knight_true_valor.name: True Valor
knight_true_valor.description: Spend Momentum when attacking a worthy opponent of equal or greater Tier. Reduce the success cost of all non-Inflict Injury Stunts by 1 against them for the rest of the scene, to a minimum of 1. If you demonstrate your Ideal in attacking or opposing them, also decrease their Defense.
knight_true_valor.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum when attacking a worthy opponent of equal or greater Tier. Reduce the success cost of all non-Inflict Injury Stunts by 1 against them for the rest of the scene, to a minimum of 1. If you demonstrate your Ideal in attacking or opposing them, also decrease their Defense.

knight_trusty_steed.name: Trusty Steed
knight_trusty_steed.description: Your steed, whether it be warhorse, exotic beast from Terra Incognita, or fighter plane, is always considered socially appropriate to be present, and you can always access it with no more than an intervening scene in even the direst straits. It gains your Defense value if yours is lower, and cannot be killed or…
knight_trusty_steed.mechanicalEffects: Your steed, whether it be warhorse, exotic beast from Terra Incognita, or fighter plane, is always considered socially appropriate to be present, and you can always access it with no more than an intervening scene in even the direst straits. It gains your Defense value if yours is lower, and cannot be killed or destroyed as long as you live. You may change your chosen steed at the end of an arc.

knight_unyielding_fervor.name: Unyielding Fervor
knight_unyielding_fervor.description: Spend Momentum. For the scene, you may ignore Injury Complications. If you are in the grips of your Passion, in - crease the Difficulty of Inflict Injury Stunts against you by 1.
knight_unyielding_fervor.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum. For the scene, you may ignore Injury Complications. If you are in the grips of your Passion, in - crease the Difficulty of Inflict Injury Stunts against you by 1.

knight_flower_of_chivalry.name: Flower Of Chivalry
knight_flower_of_chivalry.description: Characters in your presence gain your Legend in Enhancement to rolls to create positive attitudes toward you or atmospheres for the scene. If you are in the pursuit of your Ideal, characters gain one Scale for attempts to encourage belief in that Ideal or to encourage behavior intended to fulfill or exemplify it.
knight_flower_of_chivalry.mechanicalEffects: Characters in your presence gain your Legend in Enhancement to rolls to create positive attitudes toward you or atmospheres for the scene. If you are in the pursuit of your Ideal, characters gain one Scale for attempts to encourage belief in that Ideal or to encourage behavior intended to fulfill or exemplify it.

knight_full_harness.name: Full Harness
knight_full_harness.description: When you ride any sort of mount whatsoever into battle, specifically including any sort of animal, mechanical conveyance, or magical war machine, gain the following benefits: Your mount benefits from all protective measures and abilities you possess in addition to their own. Your mount cannot be Taken Out until you…
knight_full_harness.mechanicalEffects: When you ride any sort of mount whatsoever into battle, specifically including any sort of animal, mechanical conveyance, or magical war machine, gain the following benefits: Your mount benefits from all protective measures and abilities you possess in addition to their own. Your mount cannot be Taken Out until you are as long as you are in the same zone. You can maintain reflexive control of your mount as long as you’re within short range, and may call it to you as a complex action from further away.

knight_unflinching_virtue.name: Unflinching Virtue
knight_unflinching_virtue.description: Spend Momentum. For the scene, enemies cannot purchase the Knockdown/Trip, Shove, Throw or similar Stunts that force you to move, and other powers that would move you against your will must defeat you in a Clash of Wills. If you’re actively pursuing your Ideal, enemies can - not buy the Critical or Critical Hit Stunts…
knight_unflinching_virtue.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum. For the scene, enemies cannot purchase the Knockdown/Trip, Shove, Throw or similar Stunts that force you to move, and other powers that would move you against your will must defeat you in a Clash of Wills. If you’re actively pursuing your Ideal, enemies can - not buy the Critical or Critical Hit Stunts against you.

knight_unrestrained_might.name: Unrestrained Might
knight_unrestrained_might.description: Once per scene, you may make an attack that reduc - es your opponent’s Defense, and the cost of the Shove, Sunder, and Knock Down Stunts by your Legend, to a minimum of 1. If you are in the grips of your Passion, also reduce the cost of Critical/Critical Hit.
knight_unrestrained_might.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, you may make an attack that reduc - es your opponent’s Defense, and the cost of the Shove, Sunder, and Knock Down Stunts by your Legend, to a minimum of 1. If you are in the grips of your Passion, also reduce the cost of Critical/Critical Hit.

knight_worldly_vices.name: Worldly Vices
knight_worldly_vices.description: Once per session, describe how your struggles with your Passion or failing prey to it has given you access to wealth, power, or forbidden knowledge; this qualifies as a completed Milestone for an appropriate Procedural action.
knight_worldly_vices.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, describe how your struggles with your Passion or failing prey to it has given you access to wealth, power, or forbidden knowledge; this qualifies as a completed Milestone for an appropriate Procedural action.

leader_call_to_adventure.name: Call To Adventure
leader_call_to_adventure.description: No matter how skilled and daring, a Leader without followers is alone. This Knack allows you to call forth willing followers to assist you should you find yourself alone (here defined as without any Followers). At the start of a Scene, make a Knack Skill roll. These successes can be spent to purchase temporary dots of…
leader_call_to_adventure.mechanicalEffects: No matter how skilled and daring, a Leader without followers is alone. This Knack allows you to call forth willing followers to assist you should you find yourself alone (here defined as without any Followers). At the start of a Scene, make a Knack Skill roll. These successes can be spent to purchase temporary dots of the Followers Birthright at 2 successes per dot. These Followers disperse at the end of the scene in which they were conjured. Players and Storyguides should work together to select Followers that make sense for the situation.

leader_captain_of_industry.name: Captain Of Industry
leader_captain_of_industry.description: When you take charge of a group, roll Knack Skill. For every two successes rolled, reduce the difficulty of all actions taken by the group you command by 1. You can inspire a number of people equal to your Leadership + 1, or can spend a point of Momentum to apply this to a much larger group, giving the action a Scale.…
leader_captain_of_industry.mechanicalEffects: When you take charge of a group, roll Knack Skill. For every two successes rolled, reduce the difficulty of all actions taken by the group you command by 1. You can inspire a number of people equal to your Leadership + 1, or can spend a point of Momentum to apply this to a much larger group, giving the action a Scale. The decrease in difficulty does not apply to you, though while you are inspiring others, you gain 2 Enhancement to apply to Social rolls involving leadership, and any Stunts you may have gained from Knacks.

leader_cloak_of_dread.name: Cloak Of Dread
leader_cloak_of_dread.description: You project an aura of menace that terrifies and intimi - dates anyone who would dare cross you. Spend Momentum and double your successes on any Knack Skill rolls to intimidate targets. Enemies of a lesser Tier and extras simply will not attack you.
leader_cloak_of_dread.mechanicalEffects: You project an aura of menace that terrifies and intimi - dates anyone who would dare cross you. Spend Momentum and double your successes on any Knack Skill rolls to intimidate targets. Enemies of a lesser Tier and extras simply will not attack you.

leader_good_listener.name: Good Listener
leader_good_listener.description: When you make casual conversation with an SGC, that character will reveal information or an important detail that the Leader is looking for, if they know it. Before using this ability, tell the Storyguide what you’re seeking; if the SGC doesn’t know it, you immediately become aware that the character isn’t relevant to…
leader_good_listener.mechanicalEffects: When you make casual conversation with an SGC, that character will reveal information or an important detail that the Leader is looking for, if they know it. Before using this ability, tell the Storyguide what you’re seeking; if the SGC doesn’t know it, you immediately become aware that the character isn’t relevant to your quest. Even the most recal - citrant of characters eventually opens up and reveals a clue — this power requires no roll.

leader_grand_entrance.name: Grand Entrance
leader_grand_entrance.description: When you make a first impression, roll your Knack Skill. On a success, the target remembers you favorably, granting you +1 Enhancement to all Social rolls made towards them until the end of the session.
leader_grand_entrance.mechanicalEffects: When you make a first impression, roll your Knack Skill. On a success, the target remembers you favorably, granting you +1 Enhancement to all Social rolls made towards them until the end of the session.

leader_group_effort.name: Group Effort
leader_group_effort.description: Your orders create a tapestry of violence. When you lead
leader_group_effort.mechanicalEffects: Your orders create a tapestry of violence. When you lead

leader_harsh_words.name: Harsh Words
leader_harsh_words.description: Your orders are more than just an impulse; they are a compunction with a threat of punishment if not followed. Give an order to a target and spend a Momentum. They suf - fer a Complication equal to your Leader Calling rating to do anything other than what you ordered. If they fail to buy it off, they take a damage.
leader_harsh_words.mechanicalEffects: Your orders are more than just an impulse; they are a compunction with a threat of punishment if not followed. Give an order to a target and spend a Momentum. They suf - fer a Complication equal to your Leader Calling rating to do anything other than what you ordered. If they fail to buy it off, they take a damage.

leader_inspirational_aura.name: Inspirational Aura
leader_inspirational_aura.description: When you take charge of a group, roll Knack Skill. For every two successes rolled, reduce the Difficulty of all actions taken by the group you command by 1. You can in - spire a number of people equal to her Leadership + Leader Calling or can spend a point of Momentum to apply this to a much larger group, multiplying…
leader_inspirational_aura.mechanicalEffects: When you take charge of a group, roll Knack Skill. For every two successes rolled, reduce the Difficulty of all actions taken by the group you command by 1. You can in - spire a number of people equal to her Leadership + Leader Calling or can spend a point of Momentum to apply this to a much larger group, multiplying that number by 10 for each Momentum spent. The decrease in difficulty does not apply to you, though while you are inspiring others, you gain 2 Enhancement to apply to social rolls involving leadership, and any Stunts you may have gained from Knacks.

leader_inspiring_ichor.name: Inspiring Ichor
leader_inspiring_ichor.description: When leading troops in battle, you can inspire them to further heights through risking your own health. Any time you receive an Injury Condition, any followers within Medium Range receive Enhancement to their next action equal to the severity of the injury. Bruised provides 1 Enhancement, Injured 2 Enhancements, and…
leader_inspiring_ichor.mechanicalEffects: When leading troops in battle, you can inspire them to further heights through risking your own health. Any time you receive an Injury Condition, any followers within Medium Range receive Enhancement to their next action equal to the severity of the injury. Bruised provides 1 Enhancement, Injured 2 Enhancements, and Maimed 4. Being Taken Out provides no inspiration to your followers. Despite the name, the character need not actually visibly bleed.

leader_lead_by_example.name: Lead By Example
leader_lead_by_example.description: Whenever you lead a group of Storyguide Characters in an activity, be it an actual hunt, a military exercise, an elaborate dance routine, or a marathon coding session, you inspire your subordinates to success. Make a Knack Skill roll with 1 Enhancement and spend successes on the following stunts. These successes may…
leader_lead_by_example.mechanicalEffects: Whenever you lead a group of Storyguide Characters in an activity, be it an actual hunt, a military exercise, an elaborate dance routine, or a marathon coding session, you inspire your subordinates to success. Make a Knack Skill roll with 1 Enhancement and spend successes on the following stunts. These successes may be spent throughout the task you are leading. Each stunt may be purchased multiple times. Follow my lead! (2s): Any Follower who can view an action you undertake receives an Enhancement equal to half your successes to attempting the same action. Victory Together (1s): Any Follower may gain the 9-again rule for their next action to complete the task.

leader_lighthouse_of_society.name: Lighthouse Of Society
leader_lighthouse_of_society.description: In a tense, heated, or chaotic situation, you stand as a beacon of certain leadership. Your presence is a bulwark against fear and panic. As long as a crowd has not been frightened directly by magical means, you can get a group of people to act calm and do as you ask (such as evacuating a dangerous area) in an orderly…
leader_lighthouse_of_society.mechanicalEffects: In a tense, heated, or chaotic situation, you stand as a beacon of certain leadership. Your presence is a bulwark against fear and panic. As long as a crowd has not been frightened directly by magical means, you can get a group of people to act calm and do as you ask (such as evacuating a dangerous area) in an orderly fashion without needing to roll. A supernatural situation requires a Clash of Wills. For example, if an enemy Scion of Eris sows panic into a crowd of mortals so they’ll bolt and trample each other, a roll would be made against her. If Poseidon creates a tidal wave that happens to scare people because natural disasters are terri - fying, a roll would not be made against him.

leader_muster.name: Muster
leader_muster.description: Spend Momentum to instantly call aid to your side. A Professional or group of Minions (Scion: Origin p. 143) with appropriate skills for the tasks at hand arrive for the dura - tion of the scene. Such characters either come from your existing allies and allegiances or from the call of Fate. In the case of combat,…
leader_muster.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to instantly call aid to your side. A Professional or group of Minions (Scion: Origin p. 143) with appropriate skills for the tasks at hand arrive for the dura - tion of the scene. Such characters either come from your existing allies and allegiances or from the call of Fate. In the case of combat, treat the Minion group as a 4 health Swarm (Scion: Hero p. 288).

leader_noble_bearing.name: Noble Bearing
leader_noble_bearing.description: Unless you try and hide your true nature, characters who meet you will always understand you to be an important person and figure of leadership. Trivial characters will grant you deference and assume you have rightful authority auto - matically, while others gain a 2-point Attitude toward you of their choice:…
leader_noble_bearing.mechanicalEffects: Unless you try and hide your true nature, characters who meet you will always understand you to be an important person and figure of leadership. Trivial characters will grant you deference and assume you have rightful authority auto - matically, while others gain a 2-point Attitude toward you of their choice: “Respect” if positive and “Defiance” if negative. You know which they choose.

leader_one_among_many.name: One Among Many
leader_one_among_many.description: You know that others are more willing to follow you if you find common ground with them. The first time you meet a Storyguide character in an arc, roll your Knack Skill. The Storyguide must answer one of the following questions about that character, plus one more for every additional success: Are they acting under…
leader_one_among_many.mechanicalEffects: You know that others are more willing to follow you if you find common ground with them. The first time you meet a Storyguide character in an arc, roll your Knack Skill. The Storyguide must answer one of the following questions about that character, plus one more for every additional success: Are they acting under orders from someone else? Do they have authority over anyone else in the scene? How afraid are they of consequences if they fail at their current ambition? What is their immediate ambition for the scene? What value or virtue do they try to follow most?

leader_perfect_poise.name: Perfect Poise
leader_perfect_poise.description: You cannot be shaken by panic or fear unless it is from another supernatural source — in which case, you gain 2 Enhancement to resist it (such as making Clash of Wills rolls) that applies before you roll. You also gain 1 Enhancement to all Social rolls involving grace, poise, or composure, and to keep a “poker face.”…
leader_perfect_poise.mechanicalEffects: You cannot be shaken by panic or fear unless it is from another supernatural source — in which case, you gain 2 Enhancement to resist it (such as making Clash of Wills rolls) that applies before you roll. You also gain 1 Enhancement to all Social rolls involving grace, poise, or composure, and to keep a “poker face.” This also applies before you roll.

leader_pied_piper.name: Pied Piper
leader_pied_piper.description: Your art is captivating, and while you continue to per - form, speak, or otherwise engage an audience, they’ll follow you as long as it’s relatively safe to do so. You can spend 1 Momentum to lead them into danger, but other Legendary characters can resist with a Clash of Wills, pitting their Knack Skill + Calling…
leader_pied_piper.mechanicalEffects: Your art is captivating, and while you continue to per - form, speak, or otherwise engage an audience, they’ll follow you as long as it’s relatively safe to do so. You can spend 1 Momentum to lead them into danger, but other Legendary characters can resist with a Clash of Wills, pitting their Knack Skill + Calling Rating against your Knack Skill + Calling Rating. This can also be purchased as a Tyrant Knack.

leader_theyre_with_me.name: They’Re With Me
leader_theyre_with_me.description: Your entourage is a part of your Legend, and they ac - company you regardless. When you possess this Knack, characters of your Tier or lower cannot prevent your com - panions from accompanying you, regardless of rules or decorum. This Knack can protect up to one individual per dot in Legend or Leader Calling,…
leader_theyre_with_me.mechanicalEffects: Your entourage is a part of your Legend, and they ac - company you regardless. When you possess this Knack, characters of your Tier or lower cannot prevent your com - panions from accompanying you, regardless of rules or decorum. This Knack can protect up to one individual per dot in Legend or Leader Calling, whichever is higher. Unlike many Leader Knacks, this ability is explicitly able to be extended to Bandmates.

leader_abiding_presence.name: Abiding Presence
leader_abiding_presence.description: You imbue those who follow you with your ethos and passion, and they follow your design even when you are absent or otherwise unable to lead. Your followers and any - one who attempts to act on your behalf in good faith always knows what you’d want done in that situation, and you may act remotely through them for…
leader_abiding_presence.mechanicalEffects: You imbue those who follow you with your ethos and passion, and they follow your design even when you are absent or otherwise unable to lead. Your followers and any - one who attempts to act on your behalf in good faith always knows what you’d want done in that situation, and you may act remotely through them for Procedural actions, using your die pools and powers even if you aren’t there. You pay any relevant cost for powers or abilities used.

leader_amid_the_intrigues.name: Amid The Intrigues
leader_amid_the_intrigues.description: K’uh-Specific Both those K’uh engaged in internal machinations and those who consider themselves above it possess a keen awareness of the shifting alliances and loyalties of their kin. You are always aware when a character in a scene has a positive or negative Attitude towards you, and you gain that Attitude’s value…
leader_amid_the_intrigues.mechanicalEffects: K’uh-Specific Both those K’uh engaged in internal machinations and those who consider themselves above it possess a keen awareness of the shifting alliances and loyalties of their kin. You are always aware when a character in a scene has a positive or negative Attitude towards you, and you gain that Attitude’s value to any Stunts to create Enhancement, Complication, or Difficulty for them. Imbue Legend when leading or opposing a character with at least 3 Attitude to - wards you on a massive Scale, such as leading an army to aid them or burying them beneath a mountain.

leader_corporate_restructuring.name: Corporate Restructuring
leader_corporate_restructuring.description: Boardrooms are battlefields. Spend 1 Momentum to convince a corporation, organization, or cult to fire a mem - ber of their leadership and replace them with another member of the leadership team of your choosing. The Scale of the organization you can affect equals your Leader dots plus the number of successes on a…
leader_corporate_restructuring.mechanicalEffects: Boardrooms are battlefields. Spend 1 Momentum to convince a corporation, organization, or cult to fire a mem - ber of their leadership and replace them with another member of the leadership team of your choosing. The Scale of the organization you can affect equals your Leader dots plus the number of successes on a Knack Skill roll. If the leader in question is supernatural, they contest Legend + Resolve vs. your Legend + Manipulation.

leader_fearless_presence.name: Fearless Presence
leader_fearless_presence.description: As long as they can see you, your followers of lesser Tier are fearless and do not panic or flee. They will walk into the Underworld or plunge into a Titanic monster’s mouth or face down a wrathful storm brewed up by a petulant god so long as you lead them.
leader_fearless_presence.mechanicalEffects: As long as they can see you, your followers of lesser Tier are fearless and do not panic or flee. They will walk into the Underworld or plunge into a Titanic monster’s mouth or face down a wrathful storm brewed up by a petulant god so long as you lead them.

leader_grand_enterprise.name: Grand Enterprise
leader_grand_enterprise.description: You may always count the “aid of willing followers and loyal allies” as a Milestone for Procedural actions.
leader_grand_enterprise.mechanicalEffects: You may always count the “aid of willing followers and loyal allies” as a Milestone for Procedural actions.

leader_largess.name: Largess
leader_largess.description: Once per session, make a Knack roll when giving gifts or supplies to others. On a success, you can provide any mun - dane material goods or services that are locally possible, no matter how unlikely. Additional successes may be spent onefor-one to provide otherwise impossible mundane goods (a war horse on a sailing…
leader_largess.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, make a Knack roll when giving gifts or supplies to others. On a success, you can provide any mun - dane material goods or services that are locally possible, no matter how unlikely. Additional successes may be spent onefor-one to provide otherwise impossible mundane goods (a war horse on a sailing ship; a main battle tank in a grocery store), or temporary Birthright dots, lasting until the end of the session.

leader_loyal_ranks.name: Loyal Ranks
leader_loyal_ranks.description: Spend Momentum and make a Knack roll to call upon great aid. Over the course of no longer than a scene, Followers arrive in force. Treat the assembled host as a Foe (Scion: Hero p. 286) on your side, with the Swarm quality and base 4 health; spend successes from your roll to add additional health, or Heroic-tier…
leader_loyal_ranks.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum and make a Knack roll to call upon great aid. Over the course of no longer than a scene, Followers arrive in force. Treat the assembled host as a Foe (Scion: Hero p. 286) on your side, with the Swarm quality and base 4 health; spend successes from your roll to add additional health, or Heroic-tier qualities (Scion: Origin p. 146).

leader_halls_of_power.name: Halls Of Power
leader_halls_of_power.description: Whether fortress war-room, distinguished dining table, or intimate back room, where you speak, your words echo. Imbue Legend to consecrate a board room, a private study, a public square, or another place you lead from. Those spurring their followers to great deeds within its bounds benefit from additional leadership…
leader_halls_of_power.mechanicalEffects: Whether fortress war-room, distinguished dining table, or intimate back room, where you speak, your words echo. Imbue Legend to consecrate a board room, a private study, a public square, or another place you lead from. Those spurring their followers to great deeds within its bounds benefit from additional leadership Scale. This may create a Realm Condition that reduces the cost for Passion, Sky, or War Di - vine Rule actions taken through it by 1.

leader_invulnerable_master.name: Invulnerable Master
leader_invulnerable_master.description: While leading followers loyal to you (Storyguide charac - ters, not bandmates), you can spend Momentum and shrug off a −1 Bruised injury or a −2 Injured injury when they’re suffered.
leader_invulnerable_master.mechanicalEffects: While leading followers loyal to you (Storyguide charac - ters, not bandmates), you can spend Momentum and shrug off a −1 Bruised injury or a −2 Injured injury when they’re suffered.

leader_masterful_efficiency.name: Masterful Efficiency
leader_masterful_efficiency.description: When you lead people in a task, make a Knack Skill roll. They increase in Scale by 1 for every success achieved, up to half your Legend rating, for one action (which may be part of an extended task, though not combat). A team of five people can build a skyscraper, or a small band of warriors can hold a chokepoint…
leader_masterful_efficiency.mechanicalEffects: When you lead people in a task, make a Knack Skill roll. They increase in Scale by 1 for every success achieved, up to half your Legend rating, for one action (which may be part of an extended task, though not combat). A team of five people can build a skyscraper, or a small band of warriors can hold a chokepoint against an entire army, etc. You may spend Momentum for the task to increase Scale one for one above the number of successes achieved, again to a maximum of half your Legend rating. NOT TODAY, FRIENDS When you command others or stir the hearts of many on a huge Scale (commanding an entire army, calling a whole city to your aid), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

leader_raise_an_army.name: Raise An Army
leader_raise_an_army.description: Your command sways people to follow you, even those who barely know you. Spend a Momentum to raise an army of trivial targets which come to your call and fight by your side. No matter where you are, people will come to fight for you, and if you are in a place without people, creatures of the Mythos come in their stead.
leader_raise_an_army.mechanicalEffects: Your command sways people to follow you, even those who barely know you. Spend a Momentum to raise an army of trivial targets which come to your call and fight by your side. No matter where you are, people will come to fight for you, and if you are in a place without people, creatures of the Mythos come in their stead.

leader_the_voice_through_the_storm.name: The Voice Through The Storm
leader_the_voice_through_the_storm.description: When following your orders, your Followers may ignore up to your Leader rating in points of increased Difficulty or Com - plication. Spend momentum to apply this to your band or other worthy allies who are following your instruction for a scene.
leader_the_voice_through_the_storm.mechanicalEffects: When following your orders, your Followers may ignore up to your Leader rating in points of increased Difficulty or Com - plication. Spend momentum to apply this to your band or other worthy allies who are following your instruction for a scene.

leader_unmistakable_dynamism.name: Unmistakable Dynamism
leader_unmistakable_dynamism.description: Even your fiercest enemies cannot discount you as a fig - ure of authority and importance. Beings of lesser Tier can’t help but treat you with respect, no matter their nature. Those of equal or greater Tier must choose to treat with you as an honored presence, even your enemies, and suffer from +2 Difficulty for any…
leader_unmistakable_dynamism.mechanicalEffects: Even your fiercest enemies cannot discount you as a fig - ure of authority and importance. Beings of lesser Tier can’t help but treat you with respect, no matter their nature. Those of equal or greater Tier must choose to treat with you as an honored presence, even your enemies, and suffer from +2 Difficulty for any actions opposing or targeting you in a scene until they acknowledge your august presence formally (which takes an action in combat). When using divine opposition with this Calling in Divine Rule, gain an additional point of effect.

leader_be_the_example.name: Be The Example
leader_be_the_example.description: You lead by showing others how it’s done. Once per scene, when you are taking action with the specific pur - pose of inspiring others or setting an example, you may Imbue for Scale. The Scale applies to the action itself, though extra successes can be spent on Stunts to rally those who follow you. This could mean…
leader_be_the_example.mechanicalEffects: You lead by showing others how it’s done. Once per scene, when you are taking action with the specific pur - pose of inspiring others or setting an example, you may Imbue for Scale. The Scale applies to the action itself, though extra successes can be spent on Stunts to rally those who follow you. This could mean taking the first swing against an army of rakshasas, or refusing to give in to temptation when the sirens are calling your name.

leader_living_will.name: Living Will
leader_living_will.description: Even if you should fall, your followers fight on. If you are Taken Out in a fight, you may continue to roll to lead your followers, with all of your normal knacks and enhancements to do so, until they too are Taken Out.
leader_living_will.mechanicalEffects: Even if you should fall, your followers fight on. If you are Taken Out in a fight, you may continue to roll to lead your followers, with all of your normal knacks and enhancements to do so, until they too are Taken Out.

leader_power_grab.name: Power Grab
leader_power_grab.description: Your rise to power will be legendary. Once per scene, Imbue for Scale when attempting to usurp someone’s leadership role. This can be through direct force, charis - ma, or even assassination.
leader_power_grab.mechanicalEffects: Your rise to power will be legendary. Once per scene, Imbue for Scale when attempting to usurp someone’s leadership role. This can be through direct force, charis - ma, or even assassination.

leader_signature_crew.name: Signature Crew
leader_signature_crew.description: At the beginning of the session, choose a group of Birthright Followers to be your favored compatriots. These followers gain an additional Follower tag for each dot of the Leader Calling you have. This affects the Followers capabilities, but doesn’t change the actual makeup of the group. For instance, your three…
leader_signature_crew.mechanicalEffects: At the beginning of the session, choose a group of Birthright Followers to be your favored compatriots. These followers gain an additional Follower tag for each dot of the Leader Calling you have. This affects the Followers capabilities, but doesn’t change the actual makeup of the group. For instance, your three kitsune backup singers can control a crowd as if they had the Mob tag, without actually increasing in number. “TO ME!” You can get a crowd of people to heed your call at a moment’s notice. Once per session, you may make a Knack Skill roll to call forth a group to aid you in the following scene. This group acts as your Followers, as per the Birthright, with a ranking equal to your successes (to a maximum five dots, with relevant tags of your choice). The group disbands after the scene ends.

liminal_always_a_backdoor.name: Always A Backdoor
liminal_always_a_backdoor.description: With this Knack, you are impossible to fully defend against. No matter how unlikely, difficult, or dangerous, you can always find a possible means of entry or escape. This doesn’t mean you automatically manage to get in, but you find some method you could theoretically succeed at, given enough time and perhaps luck.
liminal_always_a_backdoor.mechanicalEffects: With this Knack, you are impossible to fully defend against. No matter how unlikely, difficult, or dangerous, you can always find a possible means of entry or escape. This doesn’t mean you automatically manage to get in, but you find some method you could theoretically succeed at, given enough time and perhaps luck.

liminal_anonymous_wandering.name: Anonymous Wandering
liminal_anonymous_wandering.description: You’re a vagabond, free as the wind. So long as you don’t sleep in the same place twice — whether crashing with different friends or traveling from town to town — you and your companions get +2 Enhancement to avoid pursuers, and mundane authorities can’t track you down at all without supernatural help. Even mystical…
liminal_anonymous_wandering.mechanicalEffects: You’re a vagabond, free as the wind. So long as you don’t sleep in the same place twice — whether crashing with different friends or traveling from town to town — you and your companions get +2 Enhancement to avoid pursuers, and mundane authorities can’t track you down at all without supernatural help. Even mystical scrying struggles, suffering a level 2 Complication; if not bought off, all results are from (your Legend) days ago.

liminal_beyond_memory.name: Beyond Memory
liminal_beyond_memory.description: You bend the boundaries of cognition, fading from memory after an interaction. Anyone trying to describe you or recall the details of your interaction must make an Oc - cult + Composure roll at Difficulty 2 to remember anything at all, with a 1-point Complication. If they fail to meet this Complication, your identity…
liminal_beyond_memory.mechanicalEffects: You bend the boundaries of cognition, fading from memory after an interaction. Anyone trying to describe you or recall the details of your interaction must make an Oc - cult + Composure roll at Difficulty 2 to remember anything at all, with a 1-point Complication. If they fail to meet this Complication, your identity is safe, though the details of their interaction are not. If this is magically contested, make a Clash of Wills. You may spend Momentum and double successes on any Liminal Skill rolls to avoid passive detec - tion, notice, or stealth otherwise; this does not work against active searching.
liminal_beyond_memory.source: Scion_Origin_(Revised_Download).pdf — Mortal Liminal Knacks; also SCION_Pandoras_Box_(Revised_Download).pdf p.44 (Liminal Knacks)

liminal_closed_door_policy.name: Closed-Door Policy
liminal_closed_door_policy.description: You can use this Knack to make an entrance to a loca - tion unable to be found. Anyone of an equal or lower Tier cannot locate the entrance. Doors blend into walls and forest paths seem to fade into overgrowth. This effect is automatic against anyone two Tiers beneath you. For a character of equal Tier or one lower,…
liminal_closed_door_policy.mechanicalEffects: You can use this Knack to make an entrance to a loca - tion unable to be found. Anyone of an equal or lower Tier cannot locate the entrance. Doors blend into walls and forest paths seem to fade into overgrowth. This effect is automatic against anyone two Tiers beneath you. For a character of equal Tier or one lower, they must succeed in a Clash of Wills. You gain +2 Enhancements to the Clash of Wills. The Size of an entrance which can be concealed can be no greater than half the Scion’s Legend, rounded up. A nascent Hero can hide a door or window, but only a powerful God could hide a valley which leads to a Terra Incognita. A character can simultaneously hide a number of entrances equal to their dots in the Liminal Calling.

liminal_complete_privacy.name: Complete Privacy
liminal_complete_privacy.description: By reinforcing the importance of your personal bound - aries, any interactions you take cannot be listened in on, your lips cannot be read, your phone can’t be tapped, etc. by use of mundane means. Add +2 difficulty to attempts to tail you. This protects only against covert attempts to invade your privacy and offers…
liminal_complete_privacy.mechanicalEffects: By reinforcing the importance of your personal bound - aries, any interactions you take cannot be listened in on, your lips cannot be read, your phone can’t be tapped, etc. by use of mundane means. Add +2 difficulty to attempts to tail you. This protects only against covert attempts to invade your privacy and offers no protection against airport security going through your luggage or rivals breaking into your apartment.
liminal_complete_privacy.source: Scion_Origin_(Revised_Download).pdf — Mortal Liminal Knacks; also SCION_Pandoras_Box_(Revised_Download).pdf p.44 (Liminal Knacks)

liminal_experienced_traveler.name: Experienced Traveler
liminal_experienced_traveler.description: When you travel to a new place, no matter how remote, you quickly pick up the social mores and behaviors, along with enough of the language to get by. Add +1 Enhancement to any applicable rolls to blend into the culture, if the Sto - ryguide feels a need to call for a roll at all. This bonus applies before you roll.…
liminal_experienced_traveler.mechanicalEffects: When you travel to a new place, no matter how remote, you quickly pick up the social mores and behaviors, along with enough of the language to get by. Add +1 Enhancement to any applicable rolls to blend into the culture, if the Sto - ryguide feels a need to call for a roll at all. This bonus applies before you roll. Additionally, when you attend a social ritual (such as a wedding or a funeral or a birthday party) you al - ways know exactly the right social mores to follow, and how to appropriately dress. Even if you were not invited, you will not read as out of place.
liminal_experienced_traveler.source: Scion_Origin_(Revised_Download).pdf — Mortal Liminal Knacks; also SCION_Pandoras_Box_(Revised_Download).pdf p.44 (Liminal Knacks)

liminal_familiar_kind_of_face.name: Familiar Kind Of Face
liminal_familiar_kind_of_face.description: Unless you choose to suppress it, your presence feels familiar to all who encounter you. Trivial characters will treat you as an old, fond friend, while other characters meeting you for the first time develop a positive Attitude 2 of “Pleasantly familiar.”
liminal_familiar_kind_of_face.mechanicalEffects: Unless you choose to suppress it, your presence feels familiar to all who encounter you. Trivial characters will treat you as an old, fond friend, while other characters meeting you for the first time develop a positive Attitude 2 of “Pleasantly familiar.”

liminal_feel_the_rush.name: Feel The Rush
liminal_feel_the_rush.description: Distance is trivial for you, and you move effortlessly between places. In a chase scene, reduce any terrain related Complications by 1. Once per scene when you make a disen - gage or rush action against a lower-Tier target, they cannot contest the action. In addition, when you spend 1 Momentum you can disengage, rush,…
liminal_feel_the_rush.mechanicalEffects: Distance is trivial for you, and you move effortlessly between places. In a chase scene, reduce any terrain related Complications by 1. Once per scene when you make a disen - gage or rush action against a lower-Tier target, they cannot contest the action. In addition, when you spend 1 Momentum you can disengage, rush, or utilize cover as a reflexive action.

liminal_flatlander.name: Flatlander
liminal_flatlander.description: When you make a close combat, thrown, or ranged at - tack, you gain access and 1 Enhancement to apply any of the following Stunts to your action, in addition to the default set: Glimpse the Other Side (any successes above Defense): Make a Clash of Wills. If the target fails, they are removed from reality (leaving play…
liminal_flatlander.mechanicalEffects: When you make a close combat, thrown, or ranged at - tack, you gain access and 1 Enhancement to apply any of the following Stunts to your action, in addition to the default set: Glimpse the Other Side (any successes above Defense): Make a Clash of Wills. If the target fails, they are removed from reality (leaving play entirely) until the start of their next turn. They roll initiative as normal and reappear where they were standing on their action. An opponent removed from reality in this way cannot be targeted by any actions until they reappear. Stutter Time (any successes above Defense): You force the target of your attack to suffer a penalty to their Initiative equal to the successes you spend on this Stunt. This pushes a fast opponent further down the initiative roster. If you are targeting an opponent who has already gone, they take this penalty at the start of the next turn. Bend Space (any successes above Defense): Reduce the target’s Range by 1 for each success spent on this Stunt, to a minimum of Close, which lasts until the end of the target’s next action.
liminal_flatlander.source: Scion_Origin_(Revised_Download).pdf — Mortal Liminal Knacks; also SCION_Pandoras_Box_(Revised_Download).pdf p.45 (Liminal Knacks)

liminal_locked_room_mystery.name: Locked-Room Mystery
liminal_locked_room_mystery.description: Being able to make an exit is just as important as gaining access. When you leave a room, you can choose to have the door (or window, or whatever exit you use) close and lock behind you from the other side. If you spend Momentum, you can choose to have all exits from the room lock in the same way.
liminal_locked_room_mystery.mechanicalEffects: Being able to make an exit is just as important as gaining access. When you leave a room, you can choose to have the door (or window, or whatever exit you use) close and lock behind you from the other side. If you spend Momentum, you can choose to have all exits from the room lock in the same way.

liminal_mirage_step.name: Mirage Step
liminal_mirage_step.description: You step through the shimmering heat, emerging else - where. Once per scene, as a reflexive action, spend 1 Mo - mentum to reposition yourself elsewhere in the scene. You

liminal_neither_the_minute_nor_the_hour.name: Neither The Minute Nor The Hour
liminal_neither_the_minute_nor_the_hour.description: You make a prediction about the details of your target’s inevitable death (which does not have to be true) and make an opposed Knack Skill roll. If successful, the target suffers a +1 Difficulty to all actions for the rest of the scene.
liminal_neither_the_minute_nor_the_hour.mechanicalEffects: You make a prediction about the details of your target’s inevitable death (which does not have to be true) and make an opposed Knack Skill roll. If successful, the target suffers a +1 Difficulty to all actions for the rest of the scene.
liminal_neither_the_minute_nor_the_hour.source: Scion_Origin_(Revised_Download).pdf — Mortal Liminal Knacks; also SCION_Pandoras_Box_(Revised_Download).pdf p.45 (Liminal Knacks)

liminal_never_there.name: Never There
liminal_never_there.description: In any scene where you haven’t harmed anyone, you may simply leave. You weren’t there, and any evidence that you were quickly disappears. Trivial and lower Tier characters cannot prevent you from leaving, while equal or higher-Tier characters must succeed at a Clash of Wills if they haven’t already clapped you in…
liminal_never_there.mechanicalEffects: In any scene where you haven’t harmed anyone, you may simply leave. You weren’t there, and any evidence that you were quickly disappears. Trivial and lower Tier characters cannot prevent you from leaving, while equal or higher-Tier characters must succeed at a Clash of Wills if they haven’t already clapped you in chains, magically paralyzed you, or similarly restrained when you use this power.

liminal_the_gate_and_key.name: The Gate And Key
liminal_the_gate_and_key.description: You may spend a Momentum to open a portal from one location to another as long as it is through a literal portal (a door, window, manhole, etc.) to anywhere else of your choosing, including Terra Incognitae. You must have visited the location you are moving to for the portal to work.
liminal_the_gate_and_key.mechanicalEffects: You may spend a Momentum to open a portal from one location to another as long as it is through a literal portal (a door, window, manhole, etc.) to anywhere else of your choosing, including Terra Incognitae. You must have visited the location you are moving to for the portal to work.

liminal_unerring_delivery.name: Unerring Delivery
liminal_unerring_delivery.description: Send a message via another person — a stranger you choose on the street, a spirit or ghost of your pantheon, etc. — to someone in an instant, which can be done even if you are not present in the World, or somewhere else where a simple text or email might not reach.
liminal_unerring_delivery.mechanicalEffects: Send a message via another person — a stranger you choose on the street, a spirit or ghost of your pantheon, etc. — to someone in an instant, which can be done even if you are not present in the World, or somewhere else where a simple text or email might not reach.
liminal_unerring_delivery.source: Scion_Origin_(Revised_Download).pdf — Mortal Liminal Knacks; also SCION_Pandoras_Box_(Revised_Download).pdf p.45 (Liminal Knacks)

liminal_unobtrusive_visitor.name: Unobtrusive Visitor
liminal_unobtrusive_visitor.description: When you would observe or infiltrate a location where you do not belong, spend a Momentum and blur the line between what is expected and unexpected. You take on the aspect of someone unassuming and invisible: a janitor, gar - dener, housekeeper, etc. So long as you collect information or remain an observer and do not…
liminal_unobtrusive_visitor.mechanicalEffects: When you would observe or infiltrate a location where you do not belong, spend a Momentum and blur the line between what is expected and unexpected. You take on the aspect of someone unassuming and invisible: a janitor, gar - dener, housekeeper, etc. So long as you collect information or remain an observer and do not take hostile action, anyone in the same Field as you overlooks your presence. This lasts until you take violent action, or until you leave the Field, whichever comes first.
liminal_unobtrusive_visitor.source: Scion_Origin_(Revised_Download).pdf — Mortal Liminal Knacks; also SCION_Pandoras_Box_(Revised_Download).pdf p.45 (Liminal Knacks)

liminal_always_there.name: Always There
liminal_always_there.description: Characters who wish to speak to you can do so from anywhere. You are always aware when a character wishes to speak to you, and know what they wish to convey. Spend Momentum to instantly appear at their side, as long as you’re within the same realm. You are also aware of any divine or other interference if it prevents…
liminal_always_there.mechanicalEffects: Characters who wish to speak to you can do so from anywhere. You are always aware when a character wishes to speak to you, and know what they wish to convey. Spend Momentum to instantly appear at their side, as long as you’re within the same realm. You are also aware of any divine or other interference if it prevents someone from reaching you.

liminal_among_the_stars.name: Among The Stars
liminal_among_the_stars.description: Roll your Knack Skill and spend a Momentum. For a number of turns equal to successes, take on the form of star stuff, adopting the bleak void of space and the pinpricks of light from distant stars. In doing so, you become intangible, but extremely dense. Matter bends around you, allowing you to pass through the…
liminal_among_the_stars.mechanicalEffects: Roll your Knack Skill and spend a Momentum. For a number of turns equal to successes, take on the form of star stuff, adopting the bleak void of space and the pinpricks of light from distant stars. In doing so, you become intangible, but extremely dense. Matter bends around you, allowing you to pass through the smallest of crack or shore up the largest of spaces. Weapon attacks bend away from you, metal wraps around the density of your shape, and attackers find their fists slowed to nothing as they enter your radius. When the effect ends, your body reverts to normal, but the matter you twisted remains as you moved it.

liminal_enforcing_the_boundary.name: Enforcing The Boundary
liminal_enforcing_the_boundary.description: Make a Knack Skill roll — on a success, create a barrier of force that protects you and all allies within short range of you. It moves with you, but you may not take the Rush or Disengage actions. The force field lasts until the end of a fight scene, until you are Taken Out, or until you choose to end the effect —…
liminal_enforcing_the_boundary.mechanicalEffects: Make a Knack Skill roll — on a success, create a barrier of force that protects you and all allies within short range of you. It moves with you, but you may not take the Rush or Disengage actions. The force field lasts until the end of a fight scene, until you are Taken Out, or until you choose to end the effect — whichever comes first.
