While enforcing this boundary, characters under its protection may not be targeted by attacks by weapons or abilities with the Firearms or Arcing tags. It adds your Legend in Enhancement to any rolls you make to resist the Rush action. This applies before you roll.

liminal_everybodys_trail.name: Everybody’S Trail
liminal_everybodys_trail.description: Your peregrinations blaze paths between peoples and worlds. Your refusal to be limited to any one context pro - vides a path and template for those that would follow you. Imbue Legend to consecrate a path, literal or figurative, be - tween any two places or away from any single place. Those that follow the path…
liminal_everybodys_trail.mechanicalEffects: Your peregrinations blaze paths between peoples and worlds. Your refusal to be limited to any one context pro - vides a path and template for those that would follow you. Imbue Legend to consecrate a path, literal or figurative, be - tween any two places or away from any single place. Those that follow the path benefit from additional appropriate Scale to overcome obstacles for following it to its conclusion. This may create a Realm Condition that reduces the cost for Darkness, Journey, or Stars Divine Rule actions taken through it by 1.

liminal_future_history_self.name: Future History Self
liminal_future_history_self.description: You can shift between ages at will, though without other magic Fate may still claim you when you’ve reached the end of your natural span. Once per scene, gain 2 Enhancement for a roll aided by becoming a younger or older self; if you become younger, you may spend Momentum to remove an Injury condition; if you become…
liminal_future_history_self.mechanicalEffects: You can shift between ages at will, though without other magic Fate may still claim you when you’ve reached the end of your natural span. Once per scene, gain 2 Enhancement for a roll aided by becoming a younger or older self; if you become younger, you may spend Momentum to remove an Injury condition; if you become older, you may raise or lower an Attitude you hold by 1.

liminal_lapse.name: Lapse
liminal_lapse.description: Spend Momentum to cease existing for up to a scene. Lower-tier characters cannot recall you existed, other characters must use supernatural means and a Clash of Will if they wish to affect you at all, pulling you back into existence if they defeat you. At any point before the duration runs out, you may choose to…
liminal_lapse.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to cease existing for up to a scene. Lower-tier characters cannot recall you existed, other characters must use supernatural means and a Clash of Will if they wish to affect you at all, pulling you back into existence if they defeat you. At any point before the duration runs out, you may choose to return to existence anywhere within Long range. In combat, this allows you to immediately take your action if you haven’t yet for a turn, and you gain your Legend in Enhancement to your first action.

liminal_nobodys_path.name: Nobody’S Path
liminal_nobodys_path.description: Where you say there is no path, only fools attempt travel. When sealing off a travel route on an epic Scale, such as the border between two nations or a well-trod pathway between worlds, imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending it, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
liminal_nobodys_path.mechanicalEffects: Where you say there is no path, only fools attempt travel. When sealing off a travel route on an epic Scale, such as the border between two nations or a well-trod pathway between worlds, imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending it, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

liminal_pierce_the_veil.name: Pierce The Veil
liminal_pierce_the_veil.description: When you cross boundaries on an epic Scale (descend - ing into the afterlife on foot, driving your way across the globe), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
liminal_pierce_the_veil.mechanicalEffects: When you cross boundaries on an epic Scale (descend - ing into the afterlife on foot, driving your way across the globe), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

liminal_step_sideways.name: Step Sideways
liminal_step_sideways.description: When you take a Move action, cross the distance instantly. This movement ignores hazardous and difficult terrain and crosses distance where there may not be a safe place to walk — such as across a chasm. So long as you can see your destination and it is within a distance you can Move, you appear there unharmed. This…
liminal_step_sideways.mechanicalEffects: When you take a Move action, cross the distance instantly. This movement ignores hazardous and difficult terrain and crosses distance where there may not be a safe place to walk — such as across a chasm. So long as you can see your destination and it is within a distance you can Move, you appear there unharmed. This may only be used to augment the reflexive Move action, and does not apply to Rush or Disengage.

liminal_the_long_road_to_anywhere.name: The Long Road To Anywhere
liminal_the_long_road_to_anywhere.description: You make an extended journey without stopping but must rest upon arrival. When you arrive, you can ask hospi - tality of anyone of a lower Tier than you, and if they refuse you have the option to make the target suffer +2 Difficulty to all actions until you choose to remove the penalty.
liminal_the_long_road_to_anywhere.mechanicalEffects: You make an extended journey without stopping but must rest upon arrival. When you arrive, you can ask hospi - tality of anyone of a lower Tier than you, and if they refuse you have the option to make the target suffer +2 Difficulty to all actions until you choose to remove the penalty.

liminal_timewise_presence.name: Timewise Presence
liminal_timewise_presence.description: Spend Momentum and roll Knack Skill to retroactively insert yourself into a target’s past. On a success, against trivial or lower tier targets, you can make material changes to their circumstances, changing declaring a facts about them for each success as you explain how your presence altered their major life events.…
liminal_timewise_presence.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum and roll Knack Skill to retroactively insert yourself into a target’s past. On a success, against trivial or lower tier targets, you can make material changes to their circumstances, changing declaring a facts about them for each success as you explain how your presence altered their major life events. Against targets of equal or higher-ti - er, you can instead spend successes to perform the Q&A Investigation stunt as you rifle through their past.

liminal_universal_conductor.name: Universal Conductor
liminal_universal_conductor.description: You help folks set off on their own, marking needful paths across the face of the World. When you help someone embark on a meaningful and important journey, you may give them your blessing. Characters of lower Tier are pro - tected from any harm or serious inconvenience short of a character defeating you in a Clash of…
liminal_universal_conductor.mechanicalEffects: You help folks set off on their own, marking needful paths across the face of the World. When you help someone embark on a meaningful and important journey, you may give them your blessing. Characters of lower Tier are pro - tected from any harm or serious inconvenience short of a character defeating you in a Clash of Wills, while characters of the same or higher Tier benefit from your Liminal rating in Enhancement to overcome any travel related problems or dangers. When performing Procedural tasks, you may describe how a character you helped undertake a journey changed the World in a way that aids your project, counting that as a completed Milestone once per Procedural action.

liminal_divine_mediator.name: Divine Mediator
liminal_divine_mediator.description: As an outsider, you are able to see both sides of even the bitterest feuds. When you enter an antagonis - tic conversation, even beings who have made war since the creation of the cosmos start to see from the others’ perspective. When you do this, Imbue for Scale to bring those conflicts to peaceful resolution.
liminal_divine_mediator.mechanicalEffects: As an outsider, you are able to see both sides of even the bitterest feuds. When you enter an antagonis - tic conversation, even beings who have made war since the creation of the cosmos start to see from the others’ perspective. When you do this, Imbue for Scale to bring those conflicts to peaceful resolution.

liminal_outsiders_immunity.name: Outsider’S Immunity
liminal_outsiders_immunity.description: You may ignore local laws or customs when abroad. Relatively universal laws, like “don’t murder people” will still apply, but the unique rules of specific foreign coun - tries, terrae incognitae, or Underworlds just don’t apply to you. Boons or Knacks involving the law do not see these actions as criminal, nor can a…
liminal_outsiders_immunity.mechanicalEffects: You may ignore local laws or customs when abroad. Relatively universal laws, like “don’t murder people” will still apply, but the unique rules of specific foreign coun - tries, terrae incognitae, or Underworlds just don’t apply to you. Boons or Knacks involving the law do not see these actions as criminal, nor can a being of Lower Tier hassle you about them.

liminal_rise_from_your_grave.name: Rise From Your Grave
liminal_rise_from_your_grave.description: Once per story, you can choose to be killed in com - bat, returning from the grave unharmed at a dramatically appropriate moment (usually within the same session, but the choice is yours). Your current longterm Deed is considered “unfinished business,” and all rolls toward finishing it gain a +1 Enhancement.
liminal_rise_from_your_grave.mechanicalEffects: Once per story, you can choose to be killed in com - bat, returning from the grave unharmed at a dramatically appropriate moment (usually within the same session, but the choice is yours). Your current longterm Deed is considered “unfinished business,” and all rolls toward finishing it gain a +1 Enhancement.

liminal_the_watcher_of_the_road.name: The Watcher Of The Road
liminal_the_watcher_of_the_road.description: You may declare one route (a road, a doorway, a magical portal, a sea route between two cities) to be under your watch. Wherever you are, you automatically know everything and everyone passing through: their name, their cargo, what they do along the way. Magical or divine disguises require a Clash of Wills to see…
liminal_the_watcher_of_the_road.mechanicalEffects: You may declare one route (a road, a doorway, a magical portal, a sea route between two cities) to be under your watch. Wherever you are, you automatically know everything and everyone passing through: their name, their cargo, what they do along the way. Magical or divine disguises require a Clash of Wills to see through.

liminal_trailblaze.name: Trailblaze
liminal_trailblaze.description: Imbue for Scale when creating a path, doorway, or passage that others can cross. This might be a road that leads to another realm, a literal door through an impenetrable wall, or a gate big enough for a Titan.
liminal_trailblaze.mechanicalEffects: Imbue for Scale when creating a path, doorway, or passage that others can cross. This might be a road that leads to another realm, a literal door through an impenetrable wall, or a gate big enough for a Titan.

lover_all_your_favorites.name: All Your Favorites
lover_all_your_favorites.description: You can immediately recognize some of a character’s favorite things when meeting them or hearing about them from those who know them — favorite bands, films, candies, color, and so on. When you capitalize on this to connect with or bribe them, you gain a +2 Enhancement. If you have any opportunity to prepare your…
lover_all_your_favorites.mechanicalEffects: You can immediately recognize some of a character’s favorite things when meeting them or hearing about them from those who know them — favorite bands, films, candies, color, and so on. When you capitalize on this to connect with or bribe them, you gain a +2 Enhancement. If you have any opportunity to prepare your surroundings to suit their taste, whether finding the perfect café or putting on the right mu - sic, you treat its Atmosphere bonus as +1 higher than normal with them.

lover_beyond_words.name: Beyond Words
lover_beyond_words.description: You and characters who have strong devoted, intimate, or romantic relationships can convey thoughts instantly with a glance or a meaningful sigh. Others cannot eavesdrop on such communication unless they share similar bonds with both of you. Gain Enhancement 2 when working on Procedural actions with such characters.…
lover_beyond_words.mechanicalEffects: You and characters who have strong devoted, intimate, or romantic relationships can convey thoughts instantly with a glance or a meaningful sigh. Others cannot eavesdrop on such communication unless they share similar bonds with both of you. Gain Enhancement 2 when working on Procedural actions with such characters. DON’T YOU REMEMBER ME? With this Knack you may construct a memory of an old friendship with a character you have just met. Make a Knack Skill roll with 1 Enhancement and apply these successes as a Bond of Friendship (Scion: Origin, p. 79) which lasts for the remainder of the session. You may accept a Fatebinding with the Storyguide Character to apply a Feat of Scale to the roll rather than the 1 Enhancement. If you do, the Fatebinding Role will always be Rival.

lover_fluid_appeal.name: Fluid Appeal
lover_fluid_appeal.description: When interacting with someone, gain knowledge of whatever floats their boat. At any subsequent interaction, you can shift your features to be more appealing, adding +2 Enhancement to any persuasive social action including but not limited to seduction. This bonus applies before the roll is made. Note that this does not…
lover_fluid_appeal.mechanicalEffects: When interacting with someone, gain knowledge of whatever floats their boat. At any subsequent interaction, you can shift your features to be more appealing, adding +2 Enhancement to any persuasive social action including but not limited to seduction. This bonus applies before the roll is made. Note that this does not conceal your identity in any way.

lover_heart_turned_cold.name: Heart Turned Cold
lover_heart_turned_cold.description: Make a Knack Skill roll. If successful, you make a target’s attitude towards one character more negative, shifting it by an amount equal to your Lover dots for one scene. At the end of the scene, the target’s attitude reverts back to its previous value. However, anyone they hurt or upset while under the effects of…
lover_heart_turned_cold.mechanicalEffects: Make a Knack Skill roll. If successful, you make a target’s attitude towards one character more negative, shifting it by an amount equal to your Lover dots for one scene. At the end of the scene, the target’s attitude reverts back to its previous value. However, anyone they hurt or upset while under the effects of this Knack are still upset with the target, and any damage to the target’s attitude or bond with those characters remains until they’ve put in the work to repair the damage.

lover_heartbreak.name: Heartbreak
lover_heartbreak.description: With but a few words, you can shatter a bond between two Storyguide Characters. These characters must be of a lower Tier. Make a Knack Skill roll. On a success, any Bond between Storyguide Characters of a lower Tier is severed.
lover_heartbreak.mechanicalEffects: With but a few words, you can shatter a bond between two Storyguide Characters. These characters must be of a lower Tier. Make a Knack Skill roll. On a success, any Bond between Storyguide Characters of a lower Tier is severed.

lover_highest_regard.name: Highest Regard
lover_highest_regard.description: Once per scene, you may dedicate a Heroic action to an absent character you have a strong devoted, intimate, or ro - mantic relationship with. If you succeed, you gain your Lover rating in Enhancement to the roll, while if you gain Compli - cation 2 “Pining” for the rest of the scene. If “Pining” is unresolved for a…
lover_highest_regard.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, you may dedicate a Heroic action to an absent character you have a strong devoted, intimate, or ro - mantic relationship with. If you succeed, you gain your Lover rating in Enhancement to the roll, while if you gain Compli - cation 2 “Pining” for the rest of the scene. If “Pining” is unresolved for a roll, you must spend your next action lamenting your failures (which may be part of a mixed action).

lover_i_am_a_fire.name: I Am A Fire
lover_i_am_a_fire.description: You stoke the affection one person has towards another — including yourself — which impels them towards a rela - tionship. If it is between two Storyguide characters, work with the Storyguide to determine how their suddenly pas - sionate relationship takes shape. If the target is one of your bandmates, this Knack does…
lover_i_am_a_fire.mechanicalEffects: You stoke the affection one person has towards another — including yourself — which impels them towards a rela - tionship. If it is between two Storyguide characters, work with the Storyguide to determine how their suddenly pas - sionate relationship takes shape. If the target is one of your bandmates, this Knack does not work unless you obtain permission from the character’s player. If the target is yourself, you gain +1 Enhancement to all Social rolls involving your partner of choice until the end of the session.

lover_jump_on_the_grenade.name: Jump On The Grenade
lover_jump_on_the_grenade.description: When a fellow warrior with whom you have a Bond of Camaraderie would be injured in combat, you may instead take the blow for them as long as you’re in the same Field. You suffer from the same wound, as though you were the intended target. If this was an area of effect that would have wounded you anyway, you suffer two…
lover_jump_on_the_grenade.mechanicalEffects: When a fellow warrior with whom you have a Bond of Camaraderie would be injured in combat, you may instead take the blow for them as long as you’re in the same Field. You suffer from the same wound, as though you were the intended target. If this was an area of effect that would have wounded you anyway, you suffer two Injuries.

lover_lovers_intuition.name: Lover’S Intuition
lover_lovers_intuition.description: When touching another character, which may be as brief as a handshake, you gain an understanding of your target’s romantic life. Ask one question from the following list for free. You may roll your Knack Skill and spend one success per additional question. Who or what does the character love? Who is the character…
lover_lovers_intuition.mechanicalEffects: When touching another character, which may be as brief as a handshake, you gain an understanding of your target’s romantic life. Ask one question from the following list for free. You may roll your Knack Skill and spend one success per additional question. Who or what does the character love? Who is the character romantically involved with? Who is the character close to? Who would the character like to be romantically involved with? This may be used on your bandmates with consent from the player.

lover_not_a_fighter.name: Not A Fighter
lover_not_a_fighter.description: When you are engaged in a fight, as long as you do not make attacks, enemies will not target you directly with their attacks. Additionally, gain +1 Enhancement to disengage and withdrawal rolls. You must also have a partner or Followers present for this effect to apply.
lover_not_a_fighter.mechanicalEffects: When you are engaged in a fight, as long as you do not make attacks, enemies will not target you directly with their attacks. Additionally, gain +1 Enhancement to disengage and withdrawal rolls. You must also have a partner or Followers present for this effect to apply.

lover_on_your_side.name: On Your Side
lover_on_your_side.description: When you make a teamwork action with a person with whom you have a devoted, intimate, or romantic relation - ship, add your Lover dots in Enhancement to spend on Stunts including any you may have gained from Knacks.
lover_on_your_side.mechanicalEffects: When you make a teamwork action with a person with whom you have a devoted, intimate, or romantic relation - ship, add your Lover dots in Enhancement to spend on Stunts including any you may have gained from Knacks.

lover_perfect_partner.name: Perfect Partner
lover_perfect_partner.description: You know how to work perfectly in sync with someone, down to the timed beats of their hearts. Double the usual benefit you would provide from any teamwork rolls.
lover_perfect_partner.mechanicalEffects: You know how to work perfectly in sync with someone, down to the timed beats of their hearts. Double the usual benefit you would provide from any teamwork rolls.

lover_revitalizing_kiss.name: Revitalizing Kiss
lover_revitalizing_kiss.description: You kiss a fallen loved one, snatching them from death. As a simple or mixed action, spend 1 Momentum to remove the Taken Out Injury Condition from someone you love.
lover_revitalizing_kiss.mechanicalEffects: You kiss a fallen loved one, snatching them from death. As a simple or mixed action, spend 1 Momentum to remove the Taken Out Injury Condition from someone you love.

lover_sense_weakness.name: Sense Weakness
lover_sense_weakness.description: After you have made an attack, or someone has attacked you, you may analyze them for a weakness. Gain a +1 En - hancement on attacks against them and a +1 to Defense until the fight is over. Only one enemy can be analyzed this way per scene.
lover_sense_weakness.mechanicalEffects: After you have made an attack, or someone has attacked you, you may analyze them for a weakness. Gain a +1 En - hancement on attacks against them and a +1 to Defense until the fight is over. Only one enemy can be analyzed this way per scene.

lover_soothing_presence.name: Soothing Presence
lover_soothing_presence.description: When you enter an initial social encounter, reduce Attitude by 1. For any other interaction in which you attempt to get someone else to relax, calm down, or be welcoming, you have 1 Enhancement to all applicable rolls and to apply to any Stunts you may have gained from Knacks.
lover_soothing_presence.mechanicalEffects: When you enter an initial social encounter, reduce Attitude by 1. For any other interaction in which you attempt to get someone else to relax, calm down, or be welcoming, you have 1 Enhancement to all applicable rolls and to apply to any Stunts you may have gained from Knacks.

lover_this_is_for_you.name: This Is For You
lover_this_is_for_you.description: Once per scene, when you dedicate an action to some - one with whom you have an emotional connection (positive or negative), you gain access to the following Stunts: Show Off (1-2s): For the duration of the scene, shift the target’s Attitude toward you in a direction of your choice by an amount equal to the number of…
lover_this_is_for_you.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, when you dedicate an action to some - one with whom you have an emotional connection (positive or negative), you gain access to the following Stunts: Show Off (1-2s): For the duration of the scene, shift the target’s Attitude toward you in a direction of your choice by an amount equal to the number of successes spent. Camaraderie (1-3s): Regain a number of Bond dice with the target equal to the number of successes spent. You cannot use this Stunt more than once per session on the same target.

lover_a_place_of_joy.name: A Place Of Joy
lover_a_place_of_joy.description: Kitchen table, royal garret, artist’s studio, petal-strewn bower — wherever you stir emotions, the eddies carry others along. Imbue Legend to consecrate a place of emotion and fellowship. Anyone attempting to convey heartfelt emotion to allies or others they care about in your Place of Joy ben - efits from one…
lover_a_place_of_joy.mechanicalEffects: Kitchen table, royal garret, artist’s studio, petal-strewn bower — wherever you stir emotions, the eddies carry others along. Imbue Legend to consecrate a place of emotion and fellowship. Anyone attempting to convey heartfelt emotion to allies or others they care about in your Place of Joy ben - efits from one additional Scale. This may create a Realm Condition that reduces the cost for Beauty, Passion, or Water Divine Rule actions taken through it by 1.

lover_center_of_attention.name: Center Of Attention
lover_center_of_attention.description: You’re where the people want to be. You are a centrifuge of social attention, automatically pulling anyone of lesser Tier than you into your social wake. If you are at a party and need to meet someone of political or social importance, they are there. If you need the attention of supernaturally pow - erful…
lover_center_of_attention.mechanicalEffects: You’re where the people want to be. You are a centrifuge of social attention, automatically pulling anyone of lesser Tier than you into your social wake. If you are at a party and need to meet someone of political or social importance, they are there. If you need the attention of supernaturally pow - erful individuals, spend Momentum instead. At Storyguide discretion, you may need to make a Knack Skill roll to attract the attention of the Gods themselves — and this may not always work out the way you’d like it to.

lover_for_my_honor.name: For My Honor
lover_for_my_honor.description: When a character fights or strives on your behalf and you give them your blessing, they ignore any Injury Conditions they possess and up to your Lover Rating in points of Complication or increased Difficulty. If they would be Taken Out, you may spend Momentum to postpone the effects until the end of the scene. FOR…
lover_for_my_honor.mechanicalEffects: When a character fights or strives on your behalf and you give them your blessing, they ignore any Injury Conditions they possess and up to your Lover Rating in points of Complication or increased Difficulty. If they would be Taken Out, you may spend Momentum to postpone the effects until the end of the scene. FOR YOU, I WILL Regain 1 point of spent Legend when you perform an impressive feat that positively impacts a character whom you love (which expressly includes the platonic bond of close friendship) — this can be a Storyguide character or a bandmate, but the feat must be suitably impressive depend - ing on the target. What impresses an ordinary mortal is not the same as what impresses a Demigod.

lover_hearts_aflame.name: Hearts Aflame
lover_hearts_aflame.description: When you inspire passion or promote relationships on an epic Scale (inspiring an audience of millions, changing a cul - ture’s attitudes on consent), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
lover_hearts_aflame.mechanicalEffects: When you inspire passion or promote relationships on an epic Scale (inspiring an audience of millions, changing a cul - ture’s attitudes on consent), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

lover_hearts_inferno.name: Heart’S Inferno
lover_hearts_inferno.description: Spend Momentum. All atmospheres and attitudes of characters present increase by 1 until the end of the scene; those further reinforced through influence retain their increased rating afterward, while others return to their original rating.
lover_hearts_inferno.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum. All atmospheres and attitudes of characters present increase by 1 until the end of the scene; those further reinforced through influence retain their increased rating afterward, while others return to their original rating.

lover_hearts_in_sync.name: Hearts In Sync
lover_hearts_in_sync.description: Those who you love and are loved by can support each other in ways most can only dream of. Once per episode, you and a character with mutual positive Attitudes may lend each other a Knack. The lender loses access to it for the duration, but the borrower doesn’t require any of the prerequisites and may use the lender’s…
lover_hearts_in_sync.mechanicalEffects: Those who you love and are loved by can support each other in ways most can only dream of. Once per episode, you and a character with mutual positive Attitudes may lend each other a Knack. The lender loses access to it for the duration, but the borrower doesn’t require any of the prerequisites and may use the lender’s Calling rating in place of their own.

lover_impossible_allure.name: Impossible Allure
lover_impossible_allure.description: Your arrival seizes attention like little else and rarely lets it go. When you enter a scene, you may spend Momentum. Most trivial characters bend over backwards to meet your every need, and even those opposed to you are hopelessly awestruck without outside intervention. Non-trivial char - acters must choose to be…
lover_impossible_allure.mechanicalEffects: Your arrival seizes attention like little else and rarely lets it go. When you enter a scene, you may spend Momentum. Most trivial characters bend over backwards to meet your every need, and even those opposed to you are hopelessly awestruck without outside intervention. Non-trivial char - acters must choose to be awed, improving their Attitude to - wards you by +3, or distracted, which imposes a +3 Difficulty to their first actions in the scene, as well as all subsequent actions that target or directly oppose you.

lover_i_will_be_with_you_again.name: I Will Be With You Again
lover_i_will_be_with_you_again.description: Spend Momentum. No matter how far or how distant, you may travel to reach a character you have a strong devoted, intimate, or romantic relationship with. If you could reach them within a year, it takes a day; if within a day, a scene; if within a scene, instantly. Only characters with equal or greater tier may attempt…
lover_i_will_be_with_you_again.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum. No matter how far or how distant, you may travel to reach a character you have a strong devoted, intimate, or romantic relationship with. If you could reach them within a year, it takes a day; if within a day, a scene; if within a scene, instantly. Only characters with equal or greater tier may attempt to stop you, and you gain your Lover rating in Enhancement on the resulting Clash of Wills. If you or they are suffering an injury Condition, ignore the cost to use this Knack.

lover_lovers_oath.name: Lover’S Oath
lover_lovers_oath.description: You and a consenting partner enter into an agreement to bind yourselves together forever as lovers. Both parties spend a point of Legend (if applicable). From that moment on, it takes only a moment’s concentration to know the location and general state (emotional wellbeing, health, etc.) of your partner. You have the…
lover_lovers_oath.mechanicalEffects: You and a consenting partner enter into an agreement to bind yourselves together forever as lovers. Both parties spend a point of Legend (if applicable). From that moment on, it takes only a moment’s concentration to know the location and general state (emotional wellbeing, health, etc.) of your partner. You have the option to accept Injuries for the other, and can imbue points of Legend for each other’s abilities (assuming your part - ner has a pool of Legend to pull from). This is a pact that binds you together by Fate, and while it does not necessarily have to be made out of romantic love, ill fortune befalls those who mistreat their partner whom they have sworn an oath to before the Gods.

lover_name_nemesis.name: Name Nemesis
lover_name_nemesis.description: Select a target and declare them as your named enemy. While so named, the person is immediately Fatebound to the Scion as a Nemesis. If the target is already Fatebound to another Scion, this replaces that Fate completely at the same rating.
lover_name_nemesis.mechanicalEffects: Select a target and declare them as your named enemy. While so named, the person is immediately Fatebound to the Scion as a Nemesis. If the target is already Fatebound to another Scion, this replaces that Fate completely at the same rating.

lover_pull_down_the_moon.name: Pull Down The Moon
lover_pull_down_the_moon.description: Once per session, you may swear to perform a Heroic action for a strong devoted, intimate, or romantic relation - ship with. You gain +1 Scale for that action, and if successful regain Legend. If you fail, you suffer Complication 2 “Pin - ing” (above) for the rest of the scene.
lover_pull_down_the_moon.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, you may swear to perform a Heroic action for a strong devoted, intimate, or romantic relation - ship with. You gain +1 Scale for that action, and if successful regain Legend. If you fail, you suffer Complication 2 “Pin - ing” (above) for the rest of the scene.

lover_lasso_the_moon.name: Lasso The Moon
lover_lasso_the_moon.description: Once per scene, you may Imbue for Scale on a single roll toward seizing an impossible-to-acquire object (a star, a philosophical concept, a god’s personal relic) for the purpose of gifting it to a loved one.
lover_lasso_the_moon.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, you may Imbue for Scale on a single roll toward seizing an impossible-to-acquire object (a star, a philosophical concept, a god’s personal relic) for the purpose of gifting it to a loved one.

lover_matchmaker.name: Matchmaker
lover_matchmaker.description: You see the roots of potential love and you can twist fate to make that love blossom. Once per scene, you are able to Fatebind two characters of a lower Tier to each other as Paramours, at a strength equal to your dots of the Lover Calling. This cannot be used on other player char - acters, and does not alter the…
lover_matchmaker.mechanicalEffects: You see the roots of potential love and you can twist fate to make that love blossom. Once per scene, you are able to Fatebind two characters of a lower Tier to each other as Paramours, at a strength equal to your dots of the Lover Calling. This cannot be used on other player char - acters, and does not alter the subjects’ free will. While you, the player, are changing the narrative of their story, in the World the characters discover or admit a feeling that was always there.

lover_no_mountain_high_enough.name: No Mountain High Enough
lover_no_mountain_high_enough.description: Once per scene, you may Imbue for Scale to over - come obstacles that physically prevent you from being near your love. This can include a combat action, but only if the fight is solely about whether or not you can pass through to reach your love.
lover_no_mountain_high_enough.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, you may Imbue for Scale to over - come obstacles that physically prevent you from being near your love. This can include a combat action, but only if the fight is solely about whether or not you can pass through to reach your love.

lover_romantic_reckoning.name: Romantic Reckoning
lover_romantic_reckoning.description: You are a divine avenger for the broken hearted. Once per scene, Imbue for Scale when getting revenge for a romantic betrayal. The victim could be yourself, a friend, a bandmate, or a total stranger.
lover_romantic_reckoning.mechanicalEffects: You are a divine avenger for the broken hearted. Once per scene, Imbue for Scale when getting revenge for a romantic betrayal. The victim could be yourself, a friend, a bandmate, or a total stranger.

lover_token_of_affection.name: Token Of Affection
lover_token_of_affection.description: You give your loved one a small, wearable object as a token of your love. So long as they wear it, you can reflexively see what they are doing, no matter how far, and are automatically alerted should they come into danger. This is explained to them when the gift is given, and they can take it off for privacy at any…
lover_token_of_affection.mechanicalEffects: You give your loved one a small, wearable object as a token of your love. So long as they wear it, you can reflexively see what they are doing, no matter how far, and are automatically alerted should they come into danger. This is explained to them when the gift is given, and they can take it off for privacy at any time. Should they come into danger, you may, once per session, cast a Marvel at no cost to protect them, regardless of distance.

miracleworker_greatest_show_on_earth.name: Greatest Show On Earth
miracleworker_greatest_show_on_earth.description: You have a particular flair for showy miracles, which tends to get you lots of attention. When attempting to in - fluence anyone who has seen one of your marvels at least once, gain +2 Enhancement. If you’ve used a marvel in their presence within the scene, gain +3 Enhancement instead.
miracleworker_greatest_show_on_earth.mechanicalEffects: You have a particular flair for showy miracles, which tends to get you lots of attention. When attempting to in - fluence anyone who has seen one of your marvels at least once, gain +2 Enhancement. If you’ve used a marvel in their presence within the scene, gain +3 Enhancement instead.

miracleworker_the_sincerest_form_of_flat.name: The Sincerest Form Of Flattery
miracleworker_the_sincerest_form_of_flat.description: Miracleworkers manipulate the stuff of Fate rather than the inner workings of Purviews themselves, meaning that to them one marvel is much like another. If you wit - ness another character create a marvel, for the remainder of the session you can create the same marvel, even if you don’t possess the Purview used.
miracleworker_the_sincerest_form_of_flat.mechanicalEffects: Miracleworkers manipulate the stuff of Fate rather than the inner workings of Purviews themselves, meaning that to them one marvel is much like another. If you wit - ness another character create a marvel, for the remainder of the session you can create the same marvel, even if you don’t possess the Purview used.

miracleworker_when_you_believe.name: When You Believe
miracleworker_when_you_believe.description: Miracles aren’t always a thing of faith in the World, but faith certainly doesn’t hurt. When you have the Sword of Damocles Condition, all your Integrity and Persuasion rolls not only don’t suffer from the Complication, but gain half the Complication (round up) as a standing Enhancement to those rolls. When the Sword…
miracleworker_when_you_believe.mechanicalEffects: Miracles aren’t always a thing of faith in the World, but faith certainly doesn’t hurt. When you have the Sword of Damocles Condition, all your Integrity and Persuasion rolls not only don’t suffer from the Complication, but gain half the Complication (round up) as a standing Enhancement to those rolls. When the Sword of Damocles causes your marvels to go awry, they never do so in a way that would lower the Attitude of onlookers (which, in the absence of other easy targets, may mean it targets you more directly).

oracle_empathy_for_the_seer.name: Empathy For The Seer
oracle_empathy_for_the_seer.description: Once per scene, you can, upon achieving physical contact or locking eyes with another character, wordlessly provide information that the character was previously not privy to. This often takes the form of visions or sud - den, numinous intuitions. If you spend a Momentum point when you do so, the character gets access…
oracle_empathy_for_the_seer.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, you can, upon achieving physical contact or locking eyes with another character, wordlessly provide information that the character was previously not privy to. This often takes the form of visions or sud - den, numinous intuitions. If you spend a Momentum point when you do so, the character gets access to your skill specialties for the scene.

oracle_show_me.name: Show Me
oracle_show_me.description: The vision of an Oracle is incomparable, sometimes resolving actions moment to moment. Once per session, spend Momentum to effectively “rewind” time — what transpired before was merely a perfectly clear vision of the immediate future. The amount of Momentum required varies accord - ing to the amount of time rewound a…
oracle_show_me.mechanicalEffects: The vision of an Oracle is incomparable, sometimes resolving actions moment to moment. Once per session, spend Momentum to effectively “rewind” time — what transpired before was merely a perfectly clear vision of the immediate future. The amount of Momentum required varies accord - ing to the amount of time rewound a single turn costs 1 Momentum, a full round 2, and an entire scene might cost anywhere up to 5 Momentum, which should represent about an hour’s time.

oracle_visions_of_what_went_before.name: Visions Of What Went Before
oracle_visions_of_what_went_before.description: An Oracle’s vision isn’t always locked to the future, for Fate carries a memory of has come before. You can recall events from the past, slipping into a trance as history plays out before your eyes in real time. You may spend Momentum to “scrub” around in time looking for critical moments; each Momentum spent allows…
oracle_visions_of_what_went_before.mechanicalEffects: An Oracle’s vision isn’t always locked to the future, for Fate carries a memory of has come before. You can recall events from the past, slipping into a trance as history plays out before your eyes in real time. You may spend Momentum to “scrub” around in time looking for critical moments; each Momentum spent allows you to identify a moment and search for it. For example, you might say, “show me when the fight starts.” If no moment in the scene matches your query, no Momentum is spent.

outsider_exceptions_that_prove.name: Exceptions That Prove
outsider_exceptions_that_prove.description: When interacting or entering a Field with a Complica - tion on it, once per scene, spend Momentum and ignore that Complication. If you are alone (not within line of sight to another character, separated by impassable barriers, etc.) do not spend Momentum. I CAN’T, YOU SAY Once per session, you may reroll a failed…
outsider_exceptions_that_prove.mechanicalEffects: When interacting or entering a Field with a Complica - tion on it, once per scene, spend Momentum and ignore that Complication. If you are alone (not within line of sight to another character, separated by impassable barriers, etc.) do not spend Momentum. I CAN’T, YOU SAY Once per session, you may reroll a failed roll. You gain a +1 Enhancement to the roll if that failure was a botch. If another character advised against that course of action or said you would fail, gain +2 Enhancement.

outsider_loveable_rebel.name: Loveable Rebel
outsider_loveable_rebel.description: Once per session, when you break a social norm which would normally shock or appall those around you, witnesses view your actions as daring and brave. For the duration of the scene your antics do not cause SGCs’ attitude toward you to decrease. Spend 1 Momentum to gain +1 attitude with any onlookers with a positive or…
outsider_loveable_rebel.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, when you break a social norm which would normally shock or appall those around you, witnesses view your actions as daring and brave. For the duration of the scene your antics do not cause SGCs’ attitude toward you to decrease. Spend 1 Momentum to gain +1 attitude with any onlookers with a positive or neutral attitude toward you. Those with a negative attitude remain unswayed, but their attempts to convince others your behavior is uncouth suffer +2 difficulty.

outsider_lovable_scamp.name: Lovable Scamp
outsider_lovable_scamp.description: When an action you took would cause a character’s attitude to drop, make a Knack Roll. Each success on that roll negates one level of Attitude reduction. With additional successes, the target gains a +1 Complication, which applies to any future Intrigue action targeting your character. Until they buy the Complication…
outsider_lovable_scamp.mechanicalEffects: When an action you took would cause a character’s attitude to drop, make a Knack Roll. Each success on that roll negates one level of Attitude reduction. With additional successes, the target gains a +1 Complication, which applies to any future Intrigue action targeting your character. Until they buy the Complication off, no action you take can lower their Attitude toward you.

outsider_master_of_interference.name: Master Of Interference
outsider_master_of_interference.description: Once per session, when you compel another character’s Fatebound Storyguide character, you gain one Legend and that character gains two points of Legend instead of one.
outsider_master_of_interference.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, when you compel another character’s Fatebound Storyguide character, you gain one Legend and that character gains two points of Legend instead of one.

outsider_narrow_trolling.name: Narrow Trolling
outsider_narrow_trolling.description: When you cause a character’s Attitude to drop, it only drops for you, and the character’s Attitudes toward the rest of your Band raises.
outsider_narrow_trolling.mechanicalEffects: When you cause a character’s Attitude to drop, it only drops for you, and the character’s Attitudes toward the rest of your Band raises.

outsider_petard_hoister.name: Petard Hoister
outsider_petard_hoister.description: When you uncover an otherwise secret plot, you gain a +2 Enhancement when interacting with the plotter or the effects of the plot as it’s set into motion. This effect ends once a day in game time has passed from the Enhancement’s first use or if anyone else outside the plot becomes aware of it.
outsider_petard_hoister.mechanicalEffects: When you uncover an otherwise secret plot, you gain a +2 Enhancement when interacting with the plotter or the effects of the plot as it’s set into motion. This effect ends once a day in game time has passed from the Enhancement’s first use or if anyone else outside the plot becomes aware of it.

outsider_theres_no_i_in_team.name: There’S No I In Team
outsider_theres_no_i_in_team.description: When a target tries to affect multiple people in an effect that includes you, spend Momentum to exclude yourself from the effect.
outsider_theres_no_i_in_team.mechanicalEffects: When a target tries to affect multiple people in an effect that includes you, spend Momentum to exclude yourself from the effect.

outsider_with_friends_like_these.name: With Friends Like These
outsider_with_friends_like_these.description: When a Scion, God, or Legendary Creature of your pantheon tries to engage with you socially, you can spend Momentum and make a Knack roll. On a success, the target gains a +2 Complication which applies to any Procedural or Intrigue roll involving you. If not bought off, you will be drawn into the target’s scheme,…
outsider_with_friends_like_these.mechanicalEffects: When a Scion, God, or Legendary Creature of your pantheon tries to engage with you socially, you can spend Momentum and make a Knack roll. On a success, the target gains a +2 Complication which applies to any Procedural or Intrigue roll involving you. If not bought off, you will be drawn into the target’s scheme, taking some of the credit (or blame) and bringing notice to their plot.

outsider_black_sheep.name: Black Sheep
outsider_black_sheep.description: When another character uses Scent the Divine or a similar ability, you present as a member of any pantheon you wish other than your own.
outsider_black_sheep.mechanicalEffects: When another character uses Scent the Divine or a similar ability, you present as a member of any pantheon you wish other than your own.

outsider_fate_twister.name: Fate Twister
outsider_fate_twister.description: When interacting with a Fatebound character, make a Knack Skill roll. If you roll a number of successes equal to or greater than the Fatebinding’s Strength, their Fatebound condition becomes Jinx for the session. This Knack cannot be used on a Fatebound character with the Imperiled, Nemesis, Rival, or Traitor…
outsider_fate_twister.mechanicalEffects: When interacting with a Fatebound character, make a Knack Skill roll. If you roll a number of successes equal to or greater than the Fatebinding’s Strength, their Fatebound condition becomes Jinx for the session. This Knack cannot be used on a Fatebound character with the Imperiled, Nemesis, Rival, or Traitor conditions.

outsider_friendly_face.name: Friendly Face
outsider_friendly_face.description: Once per session, you may declare yourself an ally, companion, or otherwise connected with an individual, and sever that individual’s tie to a group or Path they possess. You must openly act on their behalf or otherwise prove your ties in order to do so. This effect lasts for the remainder of the session.
outsider_friendly_face.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, you may declare yourself an ally, companion, or otherwise connected with an individual, and sever that individual’s tie to a group or Path they possess. You must openly act on their behalf or otherwise prove your ties in order to do so. This effect lasts for the remainder of the session.

outsider_im_looking_in.name: I’m Looking In
outsider_im_looking_in.description: Your view from the outside of a group lets you analyze and understand their behavior objectively, giving you +1 Enhancement on Read Attitude actions. Once per scene make a Knack Skill roll. If successful, each success grants one En - hancement which can be used on any intrigue actions for the rest of the scene. You…
outsider_im_looking_in.mechanicalEffects: Your view from the outside of a group lets you analyze and understand their behavior objectively, giving you +1 Enhancement on Read Attitude actions. Once per scene make a Knack Skill roll. If successful, each success grants one En - hancement which can be used on any intrigue actions for the rest of the scene. You can imbue rather than spend Legend to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

outsider_nowhere_man.name: Nowhere Man
outsider_nowhere_man.description: Efforts to find or track you automatically fail unless supplemented by some form of magic (a Knack, sorcery, etc.), in which case they suffer from a +3 Complication that, if not bought off, warns you that you’re being followed.
outsider_nowhere_man.mechanicalEffects: Efforts to find or track you automatically fail unless supplemented by some form of magic (a Knack, sorcery, etc.), in which case they suffer from a +3 Complication that, if not bought off, warns you that you’re being followed.

outsider_outside_looking_in.name: Outside Looking In
outsider_outside_looking_in.description: While you are outside of a building or room, you can spend Momentum to see and hear as if you were within said room or building, provided someone you know is within it. These senses last for one scene, or until you relinquish it, and you cannot see or hear normally for the duration.
outsider_outside_looking_in.mechanicalEffects: While you are outside of a building or room, you can spend Momentum to see and hear as if you were within said room or building, provided someone you know is within it. These senses last for one scene, or until you relinquish it, and you cannot see or hear normally for the duration.

prophets_let_me_get_that_for_you.name: Let Me Get That For You
prophets_let_me_get_that_for_you.description: Prophets can be shields against catastrophes and beacons of love and care, warning against Fate’s obstacles and hazards. Once per session, you can remove all Com - plications from a roll for yourself or another character. In addition, you gain the following Defensive Stunt: Come Prepared (varies): You may expend…
prophets_let_me_get_that_for_you.mechanicalEffects: Prophets can be shields against catastrophes and beacons of love and care, warning against Fate’s obstacles and hazards. Once per session, you can remove all Com - plications from a roll for yourself or another character. In addition, you gain the following Defensive Stunt: Come Prepared (varies): You may expend successes on your Full Defense Roll to negate Complications suf - fered by yourself or other characters on a one-for-one basis, representing your foreknowledge of such dangers.

prophets_this_is_not_the_way.name: This Is Not The Way
prophets_this_is_not_the_way.description: Sometimes, a person loses their way, but you’re par - ticularly adept at finding their path again. When you ad - vise another character, you may grant Enhancement and Complication equal to that character’s Attitude toward you (positive or negative!). The Enhancement applies to any action in keeping with your advice,…
prophets_this_is_not_the_way.mechanicalEffects: Sometimes, a person loses their way, but you’re par - ticularly adept at finding their path again. When you ad - vise another character, you may grant Enhancement and Complication equal to that character’s Attitude toward you (positive or negative!). The Enhancement applies to any action in keeping with your advice, while the Compli - cation applies to actions that would work against it. If not bought off, despite the character’s success, Fate arranges for reminders in the form of strange happenstance, odd encounters, and others repeating your advice to the character unprompted. This effect lasts until the end of the session, and may only be used on a given character once per arc.

prophets_youre_going_to_regret_this.name: You’Re Going To Regret This
prophets_youre_going_to_regret_this.description: Without realizing it, one wrong choice can lead to catastrophic consequences. When you declare that an action taken by a character will have terrible and unforeseeable results, you may spend Momentum. At any time later in the session or even in future sessions, you may impose Complications on the character equal to…
prophets_youre_going_to_regret_this.mechanicalEffects: Without realizing it, one wrong choice can lead to catastrophic consequences. When you declare that an action taken by a character will have terrible and unforeseeable results, you may spend Momentum. At any time later in the session or even in future sessions, you may impose Complications on the character equal to Momentum points spent to power the cursed prophecy.

psychopomp_companion_of_the_grave.name: Companion Of The Grave
psychopomp_companion_of_the_grave.description: Ghosts and shades will not target you with attacks so long as you do not attack them. In addition, you have 2 En - hancement on any rolls to placate or calm such spirits.
psychopomp_companion_of_the_grave.mechanicalEffects: Ghosts and shades will not target you with attacks so long as you do not attack them. In addition, you have 2 En - hancement on any rolls to placate or calm such spirits.

psychopomp_cracking_the_egg.name: Cracking The Egg
psychopomp_cracking_the_egg.description: When the Psychopomp performs an impressive feat which either creates a state change for someone else, or positively encourages him to undertake that state change, regain one point of spend Legend. In the performing of that feat, if the Psychopomp has used a gift of prophecy or communication on the subject in the past,…
psychopomp_cracking_the_egg.mechanicalEffects: When the Psychopomp performs an impressive feat which either creates a state change for someone else, or positively encourages him to undertake that state change, regain one point of spend Legend. In the performing of that feat, if the Psychopomp has used a gift of prophecy or communication on the subject in the past, gain +1 Enhancement.

psychopomp_crossroads_wisdom.name: Crossroads Wisdom
psychopomp_crossroads_wisdom.description: You are always aware of the direction and distance to the nearest Axis Mundi, gate, Touchstone, or sacred place associated with your pantheon.
psychopomp_crossroads_wisdom.mechanicalEffects: You are always aware of the direction and distance to the nearest Axis Mundi, gate, Touchstone, or sacred place associated with your pantheon.

psychopomp_dead_man_walking.name: Dead Man Walking
psychopomp_dead_man_walking.description: You invoke the Underworld, forcing a foe to witness their own death. Once per scene, spend 1 Momentum to impose the Frightened Condition on a character. While Frightened, they must take mixed actions, with the other pool being Integrity + Composure (or an equivalent) until they succeed at the mixed action.
psychopomp_dead_man_walking.mechanicalEffects: You invoke the Underworld, forcing a foe to witness their own death. Once per scene, spend 1 Momentum to impose the Frightened Condition on a character. While Frightened, they must take mixed actions, with the other pool being Integrity + Composure (or an equivalent) until they succeed at the mixed action.

psychopomp_eye_for_portents.name: Eye For Portents
psychopomp_eye_for_portents.description: You recognize subtle divine warnings when you are in danger. Upon entering combat, roll your Knack Skill to cre - ate a pool of Enhancements; as a reflexive action, you can then allocate any or all Enhancements from that pool to any defensive action you or your allies take. You may spend 1 Momentum to use this Knack a…
psychopomp_eye_for_portents.mechanicalEffects: You recognize subtle divine warnings when you are in danger. Upon entering combat, roll your Knack Skill to cre - ate a pool of Enhancements; as a reflexive action, you can then allocate any or all Enhancements from that pool to any defensive action you or your allies take. You may spend 1 Momentum to use this Knack a second time in a combat, but no more than that.

psychopomp_keeper_of_the_keys.name: Keeper Of The Keys
psychopomp_keeper_of_the_keys.description: You can bypass mundane locks on doors, gates, and similar barriers automatically. You may make a Clash of Wills to pass supernatural locks, unless they have been put in place by a being two or more Tiers above you. This Knack does not apply to computer passwords unless they open some form of physical door.
psychopomp_keeper_of_the_keys.mechanicalEffects: You can bypass mundane locks on doors, gates, and similar barriers automatically. You may make a Clash of Wills to pass supernatural locks, unless they have been put in place by a being two or more Tiers above you. This Knack does not apply to computer passwords unless they open some form of physical door.

psychopomp_marked_out_by_god.name: Marked Out By God
psychopomp_marked_out_by_god.description: Prophets and psychopomps enjoy special protection from fate, and many cultures consider it deeply unlucky to knowingly and deliberately harm someone with the gift of prophecy. As long as the Psychopomp takes no aggressive actions in a fight, enemies will not target her with their at - tacks. In addition, gain +1…
psychopomp_marked_out_by_god.mechanicalEffects: Prophets and psychopomps enjoy special protection from fate, and many cultures consider it deeply unlucky to knowingly and deliberately harm someone with the gift of prophecy. As long as the Psychopomp takes no aggressive actions in a fight, enemies will not target her with their at - tacks. In addition, gain +1 Enhancement to rolls to escape, disengage, or withdraw from fights.

psychopomp_on_the_sound_of_water.name: On The Sound Of Water
psychopomp_on_the_sound_of_water.description: By meditating upon the sound of water in motion, trains, highway sounds, jet engines, or any other travel noises, the Psychopomp receives visions of important events upcoming, either for herself or a subject she knows by name. While she might be able to describe a subject she doesn’t know by name, this does not allow…
psychopomp_on_the_sound_of_water.mechanicalEffects: By meditating upon the sound of water in motion, trains, highway sounds, jet engines, or any other travel noises, the Psychopomp receives visions of important events upcoming, either for herself or a subject she knows by name. While she might be able to describe a subject she doesn’t know by name, this does not allow enough precision for this prophetic work — she must know at least a name by which the subject is commonly addressed. An online handle, pseudonym, nom de guerre, or nom de plume, however, may work, with one exception: any name the subject has discarded and no longer uses will not work. If she only knows her subject’s deadname or maiden name? No dice. Upon a successful Knack roll, the player may ask the Storyguide a number of yes or no ques - tions equal to successes. The Storyguide may answer ‘maybe’ or ‘it’s impossible to answer that’ for questions which don’t have a clear-cut answer, or which rely upon player actions.

psychopomp_quickest_route.name: Quickest Route
psychopomp_quickest_route.description: When engaged in a Chase that requires multiple mile - stones to complete, you may spend 1 Momentum to apply threshold successes from one milestone to your roll to complete the next one.
psychopomp_quickest_route.mechanicalEffects: When engaged in a Chase that requires multiple mile - stones to complete, you may spend 1 Momentum to apply threshold successes from one milestone to your roll to complete the next one.

psychopomp_secondary_messenger.name: Secondary Messenger
psychopomp_secondary_messenger.description: The Psychopomp may make a Knack Skill roll to pass a message along via unconventional means: a bird tears bits of a newspaper to make its nest and drops them in the path of the intended recipient; a newscaster reads out an announce - ment that they don’t understand when the intended recipient happens to be actively…
psychopomp_secondary_messenger.mechanicalEffects: The Psychopomp may make a Knack Skill roll to pass a message along via unconventional means: a bird tears bits of a newspaper to make its nest and drops them in the path of the intended recipient; a newscaster reads out an announce - ment that they don’t understand when the intended recipient happens to be actively watching. However the message gets to the recipient, the Psychopomp’s encoding makes it understood. The recipient simply knows that the message is meant for them, who it comes from, and what it means. Sometimes you can’t just send a text message and you have to encode it in the patterns of leaves blowing down the street.

psychopomp_swift_footed.name: Swift-Footed
psychopomp_swift_footed.description: When you make an uncontested Disengage action, you may choose to move two range bands instead of one. If it is contested, you have 2 Enhancement on your attempt but only move one range band.
psychopomp_swift_footed.mechanicalEffects: When you make an uncontested Disengage action, you may choose to move two range bands instead of one. If it is contested, you have 2 Enhancement on your attempt but only move one range band.

psychopomp_tending_the_egg.name: Tending The Egg
psychopomp_tending_the_egg.description: Making an opposed Knack roll (not everyone wants to hear about their future, just ask Cassandra), the Psychopomp makes a prediction about the subject’s next state change. Example state changes include gaining or losing a job; en - tering into a new alliance, significant friendship, or romantic relationship; coming out…
psychopomp_tending_the_egg.mechanicalEffects: Making an opposed Knack roll (not everyone wants to hear about their future, just ask Cassandra), the Psychopomp makes a prediction about the subject’s next state change. Example state changes include gaining or losing a job; en - tering into a new alliance, significant friendship, or romantic relationship; coming out of the closet; making an important discovery about her family, or other significant life change, good or bad, subject to the Storyguide’s final ruling. When the state change occurs, the subject gains +1 Enhancement for the rest of the scene, as the Psychopomp’s actions buoy her forward on the winds of Fate. This Enhancement occurs whether positive or negative state change takes place—even if he doesn’t want to know who fathered him, Luke still might get lucky and catch his knees on a radio antenna and dangle there until help arrives, rather than plummeting to his death.

psychopomp_the_longest_road.name: The Longest Road
psychopomp_the_longest_road.description: A Psychopomp may, by making a mark on a door or a wall made of multiple parts (brick walls work, concrete walls don’t), step through to the nearest road to the closest Un - derworld. This doesn’t guarantee that the Psychopomp will reach a route leading to a familiar Underworld. The mark remains on the wall after the…
psychopomp_the_longest_road.mechanicalEffects: A Psychopomp may, by making a mark on a door or a wall made of multiple parts (brick walls work, concrete walls don’t), step through to the nearest road to the closest Un - derworld. This doesn’t guarantee that the Psychopomp will reach a route leading to a familiar Underworld. The mark remains on the wall after the Psychopomp passes through until someone removes said mark or it naturally wears away. This may provide a means for others to track the movement of the Psychopomp.

psychopomp_the_road_less_traveled.name: The Road Less Traveled
psychopomp_the_road_less_traveled.description: The Psychopomp does not need a map or navigation device in order to know which direction is the right way to go, no matter what Realm he finds himself traveling through, regardless of whether or not he’s ever been there before. When attempting to discern the specific rules or regulations of a Realm or country he’s…
psychopomp_the_road_less_traveled.mechanicalEffects: The Psychopomp does not need a map or navigation device in order to know which direction is the right way to go, no matter what Realm he finds himself traveling through, regardless of whether or not he’s ever been there before. When attempting to discern the specific rules or regulations of a Realm or country he’s never been in before, in order to continue his travels, he gains a +1 Enhancement.

psychopomp_the_ties_of_prophecy.name: The Ties Of Prophecy
psychopomp_the_ties_of_prophecy.description: When you make a teamwork action with someone on whom you have used a gift of prophecy or communication in the past (all Psychopomp Knacks count), add your Psy - chopomp dots in Enhancement to spend on Stunts. This includes any you may have gained from Knacks. Your ability to predict what your subject will do, due to…
psychopomp_the_ties_of_prophecy.mechanicalEffects: When you make a teamwork action with someone on whom you have used a gift of prophecy or communication in the past (all Psychopomp Knacks count), add your Psy - chopomp dots in Enhancement to spend on Stunts. This includes any you may have gained from Knacks. Your ability to predict what your subject will do, due to past prophetic dalliances, makes it easier for you to work with someone.

psychopomp_this_isnt_everything_you_are.name: This Isn’T Everything You Are
psychopomp_this_isnt_everything_you_are.description: Given the Psychopomp’s connection to quests and Or - phic Journeys, she may solemnize someone else’s quest or journey. When the Psychopomp seeks to help the subject break free from a rut or achieve something different with his life, this Knack has maximum effect. For every action the subject takes which represents a…
psychopomp_this_isnt_everything_you_are.mechanicalEffects: Given the Psychopomp’s connection to quests and Or - phic Journeys, she may solemnize someone else’s quest or journey. When the Psychopomp seeks to help the subject break free from a rut or achieve something different with his life, this Knack has maximum effect. For every action the subject takes which represents a direct attempt to complete his quest, he receives a +1 Enhancement, +2 if his actions represent a dramatic departure from his previous life. The Storyguide makes the final decision on what represents a ‘dramatic departure.’ The Psychopomp may invoke this Knack upon herself.

psychopomp_travelers_guide.name: Traveler’S Guide
psychopomp_travelers_guide.description: When you enter an Otherworld, you become aware of its nature and possible dangers. Ask one question from the following list for free. You may make a Knack Skill roll and ask one additional question per success. The Storyguide must your answer questions truthfully: What kind of hazards (such as terrain) are present?…
psychopomp_travelers_guide.mechanicalEffects: When you enter an Otherworld, you become aware of its nature and possible dangers. Ask one question from the following list for free. You may make a Knack Skill roll and ask one additional question per success. The Storyguide must your answer questions truthfully: What kind of hazards (such as terrain) are present? Who is the ruling authority, if anyone? What or who is the most dangerous threat to me? What is the most important custom to know? How far away is my destination? What do I have to do in order to leave, if anything?

psychopomp_when_in_rome.name: When In Rome
psychopomp_when_in_rome.description: When traveling in a land which is not his own, the Psy - chopomp must act as though he belongs there in order to pass leaving few ripples in his wake. Add +1 Enhancement to any attempts to blend into a culture not your own (if the Storyteller feels the need to even call for a roll). This bonus applies before you roll.…
psychopomp_when_in_rome.mechanicalEffects: When traveling in a land which is not his own, the Psy - chopomp must act as though he belongs there in order to pass leaving few ripples in his wake. Add +1 Enhancement to any attempts to blend into a culture not your own (if the Storyteller feels the need to even call for a roll). This bonus applies before you roll. This applies to circumstances as farflung as attempting to slip unnoticed through the Markets on the Moon or as mundane as trying to fit in on the streets of South Philly instead of sounding like you grew up in the Bronx. Locals can sniff out the outsider, though Psychopomps make that much more difficult: his continued contact with the world of the dead and the collective unconscious means that he reflexively knows how to never flub social rituals. If she’s never attended a Seder before, she still knows the order and not to drink from Elijah’s cup, and whether or not they’ve ever gone to a modern prom, they know how to dress.

psychopomp_within_the_caul.name: Within The Caul
psychopomp_within_the_caul.description: Pulling the interstitial state of being, second nature to psychopomps, around herself like a cloak, she disguises herself from view and memory. This permits her to much more easily keep herself from prying eyes as she goes about her business guiding people to strange places and hidden realms, and souls to their final…
psychopomp_within_the_caul.mechanicalEffects: Pulling the interstitial state of being, second nature to psychopomps, around herself like a cloak, she disguises herself from view and memory. This permits her to much more easily keep herself from prying eyes as she goes about her business guiding people to strange places and hidden realms, and souls to their final rest.”. All the better to keep herself from prying eyes as she goes about her business guiding people to strange places and hidden realms, and souls to their final rest. Those attempting to see or remember the psychopomp make an Oc - cult + Composure roll with a difficulty 2, with a 1-point Com - plication. Those failing to meet this Complication cannot recall the psychopomp’s identity. The opponent remembers details of the interaction, just who they interacted with. A Clash of Wills is required if the opponent magically contests this Knack. The psychopomp may also spend Momentum in order to double successes on any rolls to avoid notice or move stealthily.

psychopomp_adaptable_traveler.name: Adaptable Traveler
psychopomp_adaptable_traveler.description: When you enter a Realm, you may use that Realm’s Motif (see Scion: Demigod ) for your Marvels and Boons instead of your own. Once per session, you can use a Marvel associated with that Realm for free.
psychopomp_adaptable_traveler.mechanicalEffects: When you enter a Realm, you may use that Realm’s Motif (see Scion: Demigod ) for your Marvels and Boons instead of your own. Once per session, you can use a Marvel associated with that Realm for free.

psychopomp_be_not_afraid.name: Be Not Afraid
psychopomp_be_not_afraid.description: Once per scene, when you reveal your Omen by spend - ing Legend or Momentum, you may reflexively make a Knack Skill roll and apply one or more of the following Stunts: Heed Me (variable): Add your successes to your next roll to intimidate or command beings of a lower Tier, with 2 Enhancement. I Come in Peace (1s): If…
psychopomp_be_not_afraid.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, when you reveal your Omen by spend - ing Legend or Momentum, you may reflexively make a Knack Skill roll and apply one or more of the following Stunts: Heed Me (variable): Add your successes to your next roll to intimidate or command beings of a lower Tier, with 2 Enhancement. I Come in Peace (1s): If you or your allies have not already attacked in this scene, enemies will not attack you directly. Mantle of Authority (2s): You display the Omen of your divine parent as well as your own. Gain 1 Defense for the duration of the scene.

psychopomp_cracking_the_worlds_shell.name: Cracking The World’S Shell
psychopomp_cracking_the_worlds_shell.description: When the Psychopomp creates or inspires state change on an impressive Scale — speaking a prophecy which affects a na - tion rather than an individual, predicting an Odyssey rather than a quick trip home by boat — imbue a point of Legend, instead of spending, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
psychopomp_cracking_the_worlds_shell.mechanicalEffects: When the Psychopomp creates or inspires state change on an impressive Scale — speaking a prophecy which affects a na - tion rather than an individual, predicting an Odyssey rather than a quick trip home by boat — imbue a point of Legend, instead of spending, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

psychopomp_herald_of_the_gods.name: Herald Of The Gods
psychopomp_herald_of_the_gods.description: When you declare that you are acting on divine orders (whether true or not), trivial targets will not impede you from passing them. Against other beings, you may make a Knack Skill roll: on a success, they have 2 Difficulty on any attempts to halt your progress for the rest of the scene.
psychopomp_herald_of_the_gods.mechanicalEffects: When you declare that you are acting on divine orders (whether true or not), trivial targets will not impede you from passing them. Against other beings, you may make a Knack Skill roll: on a success, they have 2 Difficulty on any attempts to halt your progress for the rest of the scene.

psychopomp_humble_offering.name: Humble Offering
psychopomp_humble_offering.description: You know how to persuade the Gods that even token sacrifices are worthy of response when given with genuine respect. You may benefit from minor sacrifices one extra time per arc at Legend 1-4, twice more at Legend 5-8, and three times more at Legend 9-12
psychopomp_humble_offering.mechanicalEffects: You know how to persuade the Gods that even token sacrifices are worthy of response when given with genuine respect. You may benefit from minor sacrifices one extra time per arc at Legend 1-4, twice more at Legend 5-8, and three times more at Legend 9-12

psychopomp_invisible_messenger.name: Invisible Messenger
psychopomp_invisible_messenger.description: When delivering a message on someone else’s behalf, you (along with your mount or vehicle) are completely hidden from mundane detection from your starting point to your destination. If you stop along the way, you become visible until you continue your journey. Passing supernatural observers unnoticed requires a Clash…
psychopomp_invisible_messenger.mechanicalEffects: When delivering a message on someone else’s behalf, you (along with your mount or vehicle) are completely hidden from mundane detection from your starting point to your destination. If you stop along the way, you become visible until you continue your journey. Passing supernatural observers unnoticed requires a Clash of Wills.

psychopomp_in_the_service_of_fate.name: In The Service Of Fate
psychopomp_in_the_service_of_fate.description: When on official business, little stops a Psychopomp from traveling quickly to his destination. If he carries a spe - cific message or is under a geas or quest (as per This Is/Isn’t Everything You Are), he may travel without food or rest and always knows the quickest route to his destination. He may collapse from…
psychopomp_in_the_service_of_fate.mechanicalEffects: When on official business, little stops a Psychopomp from traveling quickly to his destination. If he carries a spe - cific message or is under a geas or quest (as per This Is/Isn’t Everything You Are), he may travel without food or rest and always knows the quickest route to his destination. He may collapse from exhaustion after he has delivered his message, but until he gets there, his feet may bleed and his stomach may growl, but he doesn’t need to stop.

psychopomp_katabasis.name: Katabasis
psychopomp_katabasis.description: Once per session, you may touch a corpse that has died within the past day and use it as a gate to enter the Under - world where that corpse’s spirit has gone. If you spend 1 Momentum, your allies may travel with you, up to a maximum number equal to your Legend. MANANNÁN’S GENEROSITY Tuatha Dé Danann specific: Once…
psychopomp_katabasis.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, you may touch a corpse that has died within the past day and use it as a gate to enter the Under - world where that corpse’s spirit has gone. If you spend 1 Momentum, your allies may travel with you, up to a maximum number equal to your Legend. MANANNÁN’S GENEROSITY Tuatha Dé Danann specific: Once per session, you may use an Equipment Marvel to summon a vehicle large enough to transport you and your allies with no Legend cost.

psychopomp_may_the_road_rise_up.name: May The Road Rise Up
psychopomp_may_the_road_rise_up.description: So long as you are following a marked route, you and your allies ignore difficult terrain and any Complications that arise from environmental conditions (heavy rain, fog, blizzards).
psychopomp_may_the_road_rise_up.mechanicalEffects: So long as you are following a marked route, you and your allies ignore difficult terrain and any Complications that arise from environmental conditions (heavy rain, fog, blizzards).

psychopomp_opening_the_way.name: Opening The Way
psychopomp_opening_the_way.description: With a successful Knack roll and the expenditure of a point of Legend, the Psychopomp may create or close a per - manent entrance into a Realm from anywhere else. This may permit her to make a door from Hel to Olympus or close a doorway which another Psychopomp opened between her apartment and the Markets of the Moon.…
psychopomp_opening_the_way.mechanicalEffects: With a successful Knack roll and the expenditure of a point of Legend, the Psychopomp may create or close a per - manent entrance into a Realm from anywhere else. This may permit her to make a door from Hel to Olympus or close a doorway which another Psychopomp opened between her apartment and the Markets of the Moon. If someone immediately closes the doorway she created, she does not regain her point of Legend. The Psychopomp must specify which Realm the portal leads to when purchasing this Knack. This Knack can be purchased. multiple times with multiple destinations

psychopomp_otherworldly_echoes.name: Otherworldly Echoes
