psychopomp_otherworldly_echoes.description: The Psychopomp imbues her presence with an un - nerving, ethereal quality which makes her subtly terrifying. When she invokes this eerie aura, anyone attempting to at - tack, coerce, intimidate, or browbeat the Psychopomp must first succeed in a Clash of Wills. If her opponent fails, he may justify it to himself that…
psychopomp_otherworldly_echoes.mechanicalEffects: The Psychopomp imbues her presence with an un - nerving, ethereal quality which makes her subtly terrifying. When she invokes this eerie aura, anyone attempting to at - tack, coerce, intimidate, or browbeat the Psychopomp must first succeed in a Clash of Wills. If her opponent fails, he may justify it to himself that he dares not cross someone so obviously marked by the Underworld, she may be a little creeped out, or some other emotional response — this power does not dictate how the opponent feels about realizing that he dares not attack someone so clearly set apart by the Gods.

psychopomp_spirit_parade.name: Spirit Parade
psychopomp_spirit_parade.description: Spend Momentum to surround yourself with fleeting images of shades and ghosts that add 2 Complication to attempts to hit you. You gain 2 Defense against all attacks that target you specifically until an attacker overcomes the Complication
psychopomp_spirit_parade.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to surround yourself with fleeting images of shades and ghosts that add 2 Complication to attempts to hit you. You gain 2 Defense against all attacks that target you specifically until an attacker overcomes the Complication

psychopomp_the_truth_the_dead_know.name: The Truth The Dead Know
psychopomp_the_truth_the_dead_know.description: No illusion or lie deceives someone who has walked among the dead. The Psychopomp has stood naked before her own soul, who can lie to her now? Attempts to deceive the Psycho - pomp gain +2 Difficulty. She may also see through supernatural illusions or powers of deception with a Clash of Wills.
psychopomp_the_truth_the_dead_know.mechanicalEffects: No illusion or lie deceives someone who has walked among the dead. The Psychopomp has stood naked before her own soul, who can lie to her now? Attempts to deceive the Psycho - pomp gain +2 Difficulty. She may also see through supernatural illusions or powers of deception with a Clash of Wills.

psychopomp_the_song_of_orpheus.name: The Song Of Orpheus
psychopomp_the_song_of_orpheus.description: When you take an established route into a Realm, Underworld or Overworld, crossing boundaries on an epic Scale, imbue a point of Legend instead of spending it, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale. The Song of Orpheus does not include using The Longest Road or any other supernatural means to immediately…
psychopomp_the_song_of_orpheus.mechanicalEffects: When you take an established route into a Realm, Underworld or Overworld, crossing boundaries on an epic Scale, imbue a point of Legend instead of spending it, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale. The Song of Orpheus does not include using The Longest Road or any other supernatural means to immediately cross the bound - ary between the lands of the living and the dead.

psychopomp_this_is_everything_you_are.name: This Is Everything You Are
psychopomp_this_is_everything_you_are.description: A Psychopomp at her most powerful may not only gift someone with the means to break free from the shackles of his mundane life, but lay a geas upon him to do so. Unlike This Isn’t Everything You Are, the quests assigned under This Is Everything You Are comes with the occasional nudge from Fate to stay on track. As…
psychopomp_this_is_everything_you_are.mechanicalEffects: A Psychopomp at her most powerful may not only gift someone with the means to break free from the shackles of his mundane life, but lay a geas upon him to do so. Unlike This Isn’t Everything You Are, the quests assigned under This Is Everything You Are comes with the occasional nudge from Fate to stay on track. As with the Heroic Knack, these quests have greatest effectiveness when the Psychopomp seeks to help the subject break free from a rut or achieve something different with his life. For every action that the subject takes which represents a direct attempt to complete his quest, he receives a +1 Enhancement, +2 if this represents a dramatic departure from his previous life. Actions which directly re - sist the quest taken by the subject suffer a +1 Complication. The Storyguide makes the final decision on what represents a ‘dramatic departure,’ or which actions go directly against the spirit of the quest or geas. A Clash of Wills is required to lay these quests upon unwilling subjects. The Psychopomp may invoke this Knack upon herself.

psychopomp_touchstone_key.name: Touchstone Key
psychopomp_touchstone_key.description: As a complex action requiring two milestones to com - plete, you can create a temporary Touchstone to take you to another Touchstone that you know. Both milestones require a Knack Skill roll: the first to create a symbol representing your destination and the second to activate it. You can only have one Touchstone…
psychopomp_touchstone_key.mechanicalEffects: As a complex action requiring two milestones to com - plete, you can create a temporary Touchstone to take you to another Touchstone that you know. Both milestones require a Knack Skill roll: the first to create a symbol representing your destination and the second to activate it. You can only have one Touchstone symbol ready at a time, and must touch it and spend 1 Momentum to activate it.

psychopomp_trail_of_stones.name: Trail Of Stones
psychopomp_trail_of_stones.description: You guide a known ally in the same Realm to your location through a series of portents, such as an animal as - sociated with your pantheon or a constant breeze pointing in your direction. Make a Knack Skill roll: on a success, the recipient can follow your guidance to your exact location; on a failure, they can reach…
psychopomp_trail_of_stones.mechanicalEffects: You guide a known ally in the same Realm to your location through a series of portents, such as an animal as - sociated with your pantheon or a constant breeze pointing in your direction. Make a Knack Skill roll: on a success, the recipient can follow your guidance to your exact location; on a failure, they can reach the general area. This Knack does not increase the speed of travel, nor does it protect against any obstacles along the way. It does not compel the target of the message to follow, but you will know if they ignore it.

psychopomp_visit_from_beyond.name: Visit From Beyond
psychopomp_visit_from_beyond.description: Touch a character and spend 1 Momentum to summon a ghost or shade from their past for a short period of time. It’s unsettling for those experienced with the supernatural, and downright terrifying for everyone else. Trivial characters are overwhelmed by emotion at the sight of their deceased loved ones; others gain a…
psychopomp_visit_from_beyond.mechanicalEffects: Touch a character and spend 1 Momentum to summon a ghost or shade from their past for a short period of time. It’s unsettling for those experienced with the supernatural, and downright terrifying for everyone else. Trivial characters are overwhelmed by emotion at the sight of their deceased loved ones; others gain a Complication equal to half your Psychopomp dots rounded down. If the Complication is not bought off, the presence of the dead gives them +1 difficulty.

psychopomp_wayfinder.name: Wayfinder
psychopomp_wayfinder.description: When crossing long distances to reach a known destination (as opposed to wandering or exploring), you may imbue Legend instead of spending it to invoke a Feat of Scale based on your Legendary Titles.
psychopomp_wayfinder.mechanicalEffects: When crossing long distances to reach a known destination (as opposed to wandering or exploring), you may imbue Legend instead of spending it to invoke a Feat of Scale based on your Legendary Titles.

psychopomp_xolotls_tunnel.name: Xolotl’S Tunnel
psychopomp_xolotls_tunnel.description: Teōtl-specific: Once per session, you may create a Twist of Fate to discover an escape from your current location without having to invoke a Path. Make a Knack Skill roll to determine how convenient it is: one success is enough for something to crawl through, while five successes reveal a secret passage that takes you…
psychopomp_xolotls_tunnel.mechanicalEffects: Teōtl-specific: Once per session, you may create a Twist of Fate to discover an escape from your current location without having to invoke a Path. Make a Knack Skill roll to determine how convenient it is: one success is enough for something to crawl through, while five successes reveal a secret passage that takes you to your destination

sage_as_i_have_foreseen.name: As I Have Foreseen
sage_as_i_have_foreseen.description: At the beginning of a scene, you may activate this Knack to make a Knack Skill roll. Set this roll aside. You may replace a roll that is made during the scene — either your own, an - other player’s, or a Storyguide Character’s of equal or lower Tier — with the results of this dice roll.
sage_as_i_have_foreseen.mechanicalEffects: At the beginning of a scene, you may activate this Knack to make a Knack Skill roll. Set this roll aside. You may replace a roll that is made during the scene — either your own, an - other player’s, or a Storyguide Character’s of equal or lower Tier — with the results of this dice roll.

sage_bestiary_and_atlas.name: Bestiary And Atlas
sage_bestiary_and_atlas.description: When you encounter a supernatural creature or mag - ical place for the first time, roll Knack Skill. You may ask a question per success, and may ask questions multiple times as applicable. Questions without answers (i.e., “it’s not dan - gerous”) do not count against your total. Any successes past 4 may be spent to…
sage_bestiary_and_atlas.mechanicalEffects: When you encounter a supernatural creature or mag - ical place for the first time, roll Knack Skill. You may ask a question per success, and may ask questions multiple times as applicable. Questions without answers (i.e., “it’s not dan - gerous”) do not count against your total. Any successes past 4 may be spent to ask freely chosen questions. The Storyteller must answer these questions honestly. What’s its origin? What makes it dangerous? What power or ability does it possess? Who controls it?

sage_blockade_of_reason.name: Blockade Of Reason
sage_blockade_of_reason.description: You readily deflate the arguments of hucksters and con men with a sharp application of reason, or blunt denial (usually calling out the person for what they are trying to do). Targets of lower Tier cannot trick, coerce, swindle, or con you, and any supernatural attempts to do so trigger a Clash of Wills. You add 2…
sage_blockade_of_reason.mechanicalEffects: You readily deflate the arguments of hucksters and con men with a sharp application of reason, or blunt denial (usually calling out the person for what they are trying to do). Targets of lower Tier cannot trick, coerce, swindle, or con you, and any supernatural attempts to do so trigger a Clash of Wills. You add 2 Enhancement to the Clash of Wills roll.
sage_blockade_of_reason.source: Scion_Origin_(Revised_Download).pdf — Mortal Sage Knacks; also SCION_Pandoras_Box_(Revised_Download).pdf p.56 (Sage Knacks)

sage_calculated_angles.name: Calculated Angles
sage_calculated_angles.description: Your mind works out the mathematics of ricochets with ease. When you use a ranged weapon, it gains either the Arcing or Returning tag. If the weapon already has the Returning tag, it can hit a different second target on its way back to you, treating it as an attack with the same number of successes as the initial one.
sage_calculated_angles.mechanicalEffects: Your mind works out the mathematics of ricochets with ease. When you use a ranged weapon, it gains either the Arcing or Returning tag. If the weapon already has the Returning tag, it can hit a different second target on its way back to you, treating it as an attack with the same number of successes as the initial one.

sage_flawless_logic.name: Flawless Logic
sage_flawless_logic.description: Your wisdom and reasoning are unparalleled. You gain Enhancement equal to half your Sage dots (rounded up) when you verbally explain a subject or use logic to influence someone. You can increase the difficulty for other characters to counter, oppose, or dispute what you’re saying. After the first use of this Knack in…
sage_flawless_logic.mechanicalEffects: Your wisdom and reasoning are unparalleled. You gain Enhancement equal to half your Sage dots (rounded up) when you verbally explain a subject or use logic to influence someone. You can increase the difficulty for other characters to counter, oppose, or dispute what you’re saying. After the first use of this Knack in a scene, subsequent uses require spending 1 Momentum.

sage_ive_been_everywhere.name: I’ve Been Everywhere
sage_ive_been_everywhere.description: When you’re heading to a new location with its own vibe, whether a different town or another neighborhood in a large city, you can ask the Storyteller one of the following questions and get a useful answer. How can we best fit in or stand out? What’s an opportunity to make a good impression? What’s something we should…
sage_ive_been_everywhere.mechanicalEffects: When you’re heading to a new location with its own vibe, whether a different town or another neighborhood in a large city, you can ask the Storyteller one of the following questions and get a useful answer. How can we best fit in or stand out? What’s an opportunity to make a good impression? What’s something we should be on the lookout for there? When you leverage this information, it provides +1 Enhancement to relevant rolls.

sage_library_and_epistle.name: Library And Epistle
sage_library_and_epistle.description: Once per session when you are unable to answer a question or fail a roll to gain insight into the unknown, you may declare your library possesses a source of knowledge or that you know a scholar who can answer the question upon consultation. If you spend Momentum, they are easily at hand; otherwise, it may take you up…
sage_library_and_epistle.mechanicalEffects: Once per session when you are unable to answer a question or fail a roll to gain insight into the unknown, you may declare your library possesses a source of knowledge or that you know a scholar who can answer the question upon consultation. If you spend Momentum, they are easily at hand; otherwise, it may take you up to a scene to recover the information from them.

sage_master_of_the_world.name: Master Of The World
sage_master_of_the_world.description: While inside a Field, you may define up to three points of Enhancements or Complications (or a combination of each) that are readily apparent to your perceptions (which may be enhanced by other abilities) but not obvious to other observers. They must conform to the Features of the Field, however — it makes sense for a…
sage_master_of_the_world.mechanicalEffects: While inside a Field, you may define up to three points of Enhancements or Complications (or a combination of each) that are readily apparent to your perceptions (which may be enhanced by other abilities) but not obvious to other observers. They must conform to the Features of the Field, however — it makes sense for a shotgun to be behind the bar, but not a rocket launcher. The hardwood floors of a burning building could be expected to be weak, but the flames can’t be cold. Only three total Enhancements or Complications can be applied to a Field at a time, regardless of how many Scions possess this ability.

sage_master_strategist.name: Master Strategist
sage_master_strategist.description: With this Knack activated you are always prepared for a near-infinite array of possibilities. When rolling Initiative, you receive the benefit of 8-again.
sage_master_strategist.mechanicalEffects: With this Knack activated you are always prepared for a near-infinite array of possibilities. When rolling Initiative, you receive the benefit of 8-again.

sage_office_hours.name: Office Hours
sage_office_hours.description: When someone approaches you with a problem that you can solve, they gain +1 Enhancement to resolve it themselves if you work them through a solution. If you can’t solve it, you gain the same bonus to all rolls to solve it on your own. These bonuses apply before rolls are made. Spend Momentum to impel a Storyguide…
sage_office_hours.mechanicalEffects: When someone approaches you with a problem that you can solve, they gain +1 Enhancement to resolve it themselves if you work them through a solution. If you can’t solve it, you gain the same bonus to all rolls to solve it on your own. These bonuses apply before rolls are made. Spend Momentum to impel a Storyguide Character to come to you with a problem in need of solving.

sage_omniglot_translation.name: Omniglot Translation
sage_omniglot_translation.description: When you converse in or read a foreign language, your communication is flawless, without a trace of an accent. You can turn out translations in your native language in a matter of minutes without needing to roll. If you are translating mystical runes or the handwriting of Gods, you still do so swiftly, but must make a…
sage_omniglot_translation.mechanicalEffects: When you converse in or read a foreign language, your communication is flawless, without a trace of an accent. You can turn out translations in your native language in a matter of minutes without needing to roll. If you are translating mystical runes or the handwriting of Gods, you still do so swiftly, but must make a Knack Skill roll.

sage_palace_of_memory.name: Palace Of Memory
sage_palace_of_memory.description: When you recall past events that you have experienced or studied, you are able to recall the details flawlessly, never missing out on any clues or dropping the ball on any details you might remember. This allows the player to bypass the need to roll to remember salient details or facts, and also to declare a narrative…
sage_palace_of_memory.mechanicalEffects: When you recall past events that you have experienced or studied, you are able to recall the details flawlessly, never missing out on any clues or dropping the ball on any details you might remember. This allows the player to bypass the need to roll to remember salient details or facts, and also to declare a narrative advantage she may have remembered without needing to invoke her Path. If you missed a Proce - dural Clue in a prior scene, you may attempt to rediscover it.
sage_palace_of_memory.source: Scion_Origin_(Revised_Download).pdf — Mortal Sage Knacks; also SCION_Pandoras_Box_(Revised_Download).pdf p.57 (Sage Knacks)

sage_presence_of_magic.name: Presence Of Magic
sage_presence_of_magic.description: You always know when you are near an object or place of true magical or sacred power. How this manifests is up to you. Ask the Storyguide if an object is magical or sacred, and she must tell you honestly “yes” or “no.” This bypasses the need to make any kind of Occult roll to identify a place or object of magical or…
sage_presence_of_magic.mechanicalEffects: You always know when you are near an object or place of true magical or sacred power. How this manifests is up to you. Ask the Storyguide if an object is magical or sacred, and she must tell you honestly “yes” or “no.” This bypasses the need to make any kind of Occult roll to identify a place or object of magical or sacred power.
sage_presence_of_magic.source: Scion_Origin_(Revised_Download).pdf — Mortal Sage Knacks; also SCION_Pandoras_Box_(Revised_Download).pdf p.57 (Sage Knacks)

sage_psychic_attack.name: Psychic Attack
sage_psychic_attack.description: You impart your vast stores of knowledge to someone else, overwhelming them. Spend a Momentum to roll your Knack Skill. Success an increased Difficulty equal to successes rolled on your victim’s actions that require mental capacity, such as studying, researching, or even communicating.
sage_psychic_attack.mechanicalEffects: You impart your vast stores of knowledge to someone else, overwhelming them. Spend a Momentum to roll your Knack Skill. Success an increased Difficulty equal to successes rolled on your victim’s actions that require mental capacity, such as studying, researching, or even communicating.

sage_showdown_scholar.name: Showdown Scholar
sage_showdown_scholar.description: You’ve studied the angles and your foes, giving you the upper hand. Make a Knack roll. For every 2 successes, you learn the pool names and values of one character in scene.
sage_showdown_scholar.mechanicalEffects: You’ve studied the angles and your foes, giving you the upper hand. Make a Knack roll. For every 2 successes, you learn the pool names and values of one character in scene.

sage_speed_reading.name: Speed Reading
sage_speed_reading.description: When you read materials for your research, you do so at lightning speed, devouring thick tomes in a matter of min - utes and flipping through electronic documents in the blink of an eye. Halve the time you need to do any kind of academic research. Once a scene you may establish that you’ve read up on a subject and…
sage_speed_reading.mechanicalEffects: When you read materials for your research, you do so at lightning speed, devouring thick tomes in a matter of min - utes and flipping through electronic documents in the blink of an eye. Halve the time you need to do any kind of academic research. Once a scene you may establish that you’ve read up on a subject and gain 1 Enhancement to the next applicable roll. This bonus applies before the roll.

sage_what_manner_of_beast.name: What Manner Of Beast
sage_what_manner_of_beast.description: When exposed to an animal, God, Denizen, or other type of being new to you, you’re driven by a need to under - stand what it is. You receive one Enhancement to any rolls to determine the nature of the beast. This Enhancement applies before the roll.
sage_what_manner_of_beast.mechanicalEffects: When exposed to an animal, God, Denizen, or other type of being new to you, you’re driven by a need to under - stand what it is. You receive one Enhancement to any rolls to determine the nature of the beast. This Enhancement applies before the roll.

sage_where_power_rests.name: Where Power Rests
sage_where_power_rests.description: You’re adept at finding sources of power in the World, particularly those that have long been undisturbed. When seeking something of mystic might — including anything with a Legend Score — you receive 1 Enhancement before the roll. You then receive an additional Enhancement after the roll for each century the person…
sage_where_power_rests.mechanicalEffects: You’re adept at finding sources of power in the World, particularly those that have long been undisturbed. When seeking something of mystic might — including anything with a Legend Score — you receive 1 Enhancement before the roll. You then receive an additional Enhancement after the roll for each century the person or object has been undisturbed.

sage_cipher.name: Cipher
sage_cipher.description: You are never stumped by any codes or encryptions set in place by a character of a lower Tier. When you converse in or read a foreign language, your communication is flawless, without a trace of an accent. You can turn out translations in your native language in a matter of minutes without needing to roll. If you are…
sage_cipher.mechanicalEffects: You are never stumped by any codes or encryptions set in place by a character of a lower Tier. When you converse in or read a foreign language, your communication is flawless, without a trace of an accent. You can turn out translations in your native language in a matter of minutes without needing to roll. If you are translating mystical runes or the handwriting of gods, you still do so swiftly, but must make a Knack Skill roll. When you create your own encryption, it also cannot be resolved by anyone of a lower Tier. You add your half your Legend, round up, in Enhancement to rolls to prevent decryption by your peers and those of higher Tiers. This bonus applies before you roll.

sage_eternal_genius.name: Eternal Genius
sage_eternal_genius.description: When you unravel a mystery or tackle a complex, scholarly problem on a massive Scale (untangling the secrets of quantum physics, solving a trickster God’s cipher), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your Leg - endary Title as a Feat of Scale.
sage_eternal_genius.mechanicalEffects: When you unravel a mystery or tackle a complex, scholarly problem on a massive Scale (untangling the secrets of quantum physics, solving a trickster God’s cipher), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your Leg - endary Title as a Feat of Scale.

sage_eternal_lectern.name: Eternal Lectern
sage_eternal_lectern.description: The spaces you teach others in cannot help but convey knowledge to the curious. Imbue Legend to consecrate a classroom or other place of learning. Attempts to teach epically complex concepts or across impossibly distant con - ceptual gulfs there benefit from additional appropriate Scale. This may create a Realm…
sage_eternal_lectern.mechanicalEffects: The spaces you teach others in cannot help but convey knowledge to the curious. Imbue Legend to consecrate a classroom or other place of learning. Attempts to teach epically complex concepts or across impossibly distant con - ceptual gulfs there benefit from additional appropriate Scale. This may create a Realm Condition that reduces the cost for Fire, Order, or Stars Divine Rule actions taken through it by 1.

sage_immortal_mastermind.name: Immortal Mastermind
sage_immortal_mastermind.description: When you make a plan of action and direct others to fol - low, it grants them 1 Enhancement to all actions. Anyone who doesn’t follow your plan gains +1 Difficulty to all actions. Bandmates are not under any obligation to follow your every word, but do gain the benefit if they opt to participate. When dealing with an…
sage_immortal_mastermind.mechanicalEffects: When you make a plan of action and direct others to fol - low, it grants them 1 Enhancement to all actions. Anyone who doesn’t follow your plan gains +1 Difficulty to all actions. Bandmates are not under any obligation to follow your every word, but do gain the benefit if they opt to participate. When dealing with an enemy, you are free to create a plan in order to bait your opposition into suffering the Difficulty — just as planned.

sage_infinite_knowledge.name: Infinite Knowledge
sage_infinite_knowledge.description: You know the truth of the cosmos, the stars, and every - thing in between. You can reach through your vast knowl - edge to find the answer to one question. If it is a knowable thing, your character automatically knows the answer; if it is unknowable, she instead can roll her Sage Skill and know the answer on a…
sage_infinite_knowledge.mechanicalEffects: You know the truth of the cosmos, the stars, and every - thing in between. You can reach through your vast knowl - edge to find the answer to one question. If it is a knowable thing, your character automatically knows the answer; if it is unknowable, she instead can roll her Sage Skill and know the answer on a success. If the information is purposefully hidden, it provokes a Clash of Wills. If this is part of an investigation, the character gains a single Clue.

sage_invisible_kingdoms.name: Invisible Kingdoms
sage_invisible_kingdoms.description: Once per session, you may reveal a place of power and mystery within the World, whether a marvel of nature or a place touching a specific Otherworld, working with the Sto - ryguide to define it. A number of characters equal to your Sage rating may regain one Legend by resting there for a scene.
sage_invisible_kingdoms.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, you may reveal a place of power and mystery within the World, whether a marvel of nature or a place touching a specific Otherworld, working with the Sto - ryguide to define it. A number of characters equal to your Sage rating may regain one Legend by resting there for a scene.

sage_maps_beyond_the_world.name: Maps Beyond The World
sage_maps_beyond_the_world.description: Worlds beyond the World are known to you, and you may ruminate deeply on the secrets therein. Once you’ve stayed in an Otherworldly location for at least a session of play or a day of narrative time, you may make a Knack Skill roll to ask questions about its nature or events transpiring there — such as “why do the…
sage_maps_beyond_the_world.mechanicalEffects: Worlds beyond the World are known to you, and you may ruminate deeply on the secrets therein. Once you’ve stayed in an Otherworldly location for at least a session of play or a day of narrative time, you may make a Knack Skill roll to ask questions about its nature or events transpiring there — such as “why do the fire giants hate the Theoi visi - tors?” or “what has polluted the river of heaven?” — and get true, useful answers for each success. In Divine Rule play, you may spend these successes to learn information about Realm Conditions, including who created them and what their ongoing effects on the realm might be.

sage_overworld_knowledge.name: Overworld Knowledge
sage_overworld_knowledge.description: Once per scene, make a Knack Skill roll. For each success, ask a question of the Storyguide relevant to the events transpiring — something you would know or have studied — and receive a truthful and applicable answer. For example, “What stratagem is the enemy general using?” or “What are Kane Taoka’s true mo - tives?”…
sage_overworld_knowledge.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, make a Knack Skill roll. For each success, ask a question of the Storyguide relevant to the events transpiring — something you would know or have studied — and receive a truthful and applicable answer. For example, “What stratagem is the enemy general using?” or “What are Kane Taoka’s true mo - tives?” If you have remaining unasked questions, spend Momentum to roll over the remaining questions into the following scene.

sage_personal_alexandria.name: Personal Alexandria
sage_personal_alexandria.description: When able to consult your collection of books and per - sonal notes, you gain Enhancement 2 for attempts to answer questions, engage in Investigation, or further knowledge of the World. Once per session, access to your collection may count as a Milestone for a Procedural action.
sage_personal_alexandria.mechanicalEffects: When able to consult your collection of books and per - sonal notes, you gain Enhancement 2 for attempts to answer questions, engage in Investigation, or further knowledge of the World. Once per session, access to your collection may count as a Milestone for a Procedural action.

sage_scent_of_sorcery.name: Scent Of Sorcery
sage_scent_of_sorcery.description: When exposed to or made aware of a supernatural effect, spend Momentum to know its origin and purpose. Equal or higher-tier characters may attempt to hide their identities through a Clash of Wills; regain your Momentum if you fail.
sage_scent_of_sorcery.mechanicalEffects: When exposed to or made aware of a supernatural effect, spend Momentum to know its origin and purpose. Equal or higher-tier characters may attempt to hide their identities through a Clash of Wills; regain your Momentum if you fail.

sage_transcendent_mastery_of_works.name: Transcendent Mastery Of Works
sage_transcendent_mastery_of_works.description: Your understanding of all things under the sun and many things above it allows you to guide long term projects with unmatched ability. You may automatically complete one Milestone per Procedural scene, even if you lack any requisite Skills or equipment.
sage_transcendent_mastery_of_works.mechanicalEffects: Your understanding of all things under the sun and many things above it allows you to guide long term projects with unmatched ability. You may automatically complete one Milestone per Procedural scene, even if you lack any requisite Skills or equipment.

sage_a_consult.name: A Consult
sage_a_consult.description: Even if you don’t know the answer, you know who does. When trying to find information, you gain an innate sense of who can help you, and you may Imbue for Scale to reach them and/or implore their aid. DON’T YOU KNOW WHO THIS IS? You word is trusted, and when you extol someone’s accomplishments, people listen. Once per…
sage_a_consult.mechanicalEffects: Even if you don’t know the answer, you know who does. When trying to find information, you gain an innate sense of who can help you, and you may Imbue for Scale to reach them and/or implore their aid. DON’T YOU KNOW WHO THIS IS? You word is trusted, and when you extol someone’s accomplishments, people listen. Once per session, you many Imbue for Scale to enhance a social roll made by an ally. This requires you to briefly glorify them by praising one of their past Deeds. This does not stack with any other supernatural sources of Scale. “FALSE!” Imbue for Scale when stamping out a widespread falsehood, a common misconception, or a massive illusion.

sage_i_know_your_bane.name: I Know Your Bane
sage_i_know_your_bane.description: You wield knowledge like a weapon. Once per ses - sion, this knowledge can give you a lead to begin a com - plex investigation action to find a creature’s supernatural bane. Whenever they take an injury condition from that source, they also take an additional condition of the same severity. This can apply to a…
sage_i_know_your_bane.mechanicalEffects: You wield knowledge like a weapon. Once per ses - sion, this knowledge can give you a lead to begin a com - plex investigation action to find a creature’s supernatural bane. Whenever they take an injury condition from that source, they also take an additional condition of the same severity. This can apply to a specific opponent or an entire race of denizens. In the case of the latter, the bane should be significantly harder to come by (and require more Milestones to uncover): a rare plant that is poisonous to satyrs, or a unique sword that burns away an oni’s flesh.

sage_loremaster.name: Loremaster
sage_loremaster.description: You immediately know the Legendary Titles of any - one you meet. Further, by spending a point of Momentum, you may use your dots in the Sage Calling as an Enhancement to any social roll against them that evokes one of those Titles. If their identity is disguised in any way, this requires a Clash of Wills.
sage_loremaster.mechanicalEffects: You immediately know the Legendary Titles of any - one you meet. Further, by spending a point of Momentum, you may use your dots in the Sage Calling as an Enhancement to any social roll against them that evokes one of those Titles. If their identity is disguised in any way, this requires a Clash of Wills.

saint_blood_of_the_valiant.name: Blood Of The Valiant
saint_blood_of_the_valiant.description: Prerequisite: From Hell’s Heart When someone would suffer an Injury Condition and is within Close range of you, you may take the Injury Condition instead. If you or they have the Virtuous Condition, their next action gains Enhancement equal to your Virtue rating. If this causes a Maimed or worse Injury Condition and…
saint_blood_of_the_valiant.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: From Hell’s Heart When someone would suffer an Injury Condition and is within Close range of you, you may take the Injury Condition instead. If you or they have the Virtuous Condition, their next action gains Enhancement equal to your Virtue rating. If this causes a Maimed or worse Injury Condition and you were not already Virtuous, you become Virtuous in the Virtue of your choice.

saint_castigate.name: Castigate
saint_castigate.description: Prerequisite: Virtuous Might When you witness someone acting against one of your Virtues, you get Enhancement on your next action that would harm them this scene, physically or otherwise. This Enhancement is equal to your Virtue rating. IF I CAN DO IT, SO CAN YOU You show humanity what they are capable of by your very…
saint_castigate.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: Virtuous Might When you witness someone acting against one of your Virtues, you get Enhancement on your next action that would harm them this scene, physically or otherwise. This Enhancement is equal to your Virtue rating. IF I CAN DO IT, SO CAN YOU You show humanity what they are capable of by your very existence. Once per session, when you succeed at an effort to overcome an obstacle, such as climbing a cliff, solving a maze or breaking through a blockade, you can bring up to your successes in other characters with you, granting them automatic success at the same deed. This does not count as spending those successes on a stunt. Characters Fatebound to you and trivial targets do not count against that limit.

saint_implacable_sacrifice.name: Implacable Sacrifice
saint_implacable_sacrifice.description: When you become Taken Out, you may perform a single action before it takes effect. You gain Enhancement to this action equal to your Virtue rating or the Enhancement of the attack that made you get Taken Out, whichever is greater. Once per session, you may choose to end the Virtuous Con - dition and return to the…
saint_implacable_sacrifice.mechanicalEffects: When you become Taken Out, you may perform a single action before it takes effect. You gain Enhancement to this action equal to your Virtue rating or the Enhancement of the attack that made you get Taken Out, whichever is greater. Once per session, you may choose to end the Virtuous Con - dition and return to the center of the Virtue track to use this when you gain any Injury Condition rather than Taken Out.

saint_it_is_not_in_heaven.name: It Is Not In Heaven
saint_it_is_not_in_heaven.description: You act with Virtue, and you demand that the powerful live up to their Virtue as well. Once per session, when you are arguing or fighting with someone and they spend Tension or Legend, you may clearly stand against them. They get Complication 3 to their next attempt to argue with or fight with you. If this is not…
saint_it_is_not_in_heaven.mechanicalEffects: You act with Virtue, and you demand that the powerful live up to their Virtue as well. Once per session, when you are arguing or fighting with someone and they spend Tension or Legend, you may clearly stand against them. They get Complication 3 to their next attempt to argue with or fight with you. If this is not bought off, every Storyguide Character nearby not directly involved in the conflict believes they are in the wrong, no matter what, and cannot be convinced otherwise for the rest of the scene.

saint_miracle.name: Miracle
saint_miracle.description: Once per session, a Saint can perform a Twist of Fate that’s not tied to their Path. This can be anything from healing the sick masses to bringing a newly dead person back to life from being mostly-dead. This may border on the super - natural, though it’s rarely anything explicit; the dead man’s heart starts beating…
saint_miracle.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, a Saint can perform a Twist of Fate that’s not tied to their Path. This can be anything from healing the sick masses to bringing a newly dead person back to life from being mostly-dead. This may border on the super - natural, though it’s rarely anything explicit; the dead man’s heart starts beating again, while the sufferers of plague feel their coughs recede over the course of a scene.

saint_my_cause_sustains_me.name: My Cause Sustains Me
saint_my_cause_sustains_me.description: Prerequisite: Stainless While you have the Virtuous Condition, you do not need to eat, drink, or sleep. You may choose to end the Virtuous Condi - tion immediately and return to the center of the Virtue track to ignore the effects of a single Injury Condition for the rest of the scene. If you do, once the scene ends,…
saint_my_cause_sustains_me.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: Stainless While you have the Virtuous Condition, you do not need to eat, drink, or sleep. You may choose to end the Virtuous Condi - tion immediately and return to the center of the Virtue track to ignore the effects of a single Injury Condition for the rest of the scene. If you do, once the scene ends, you must rest for a full day.

saint_renunciation.name: Renunciation
saint_renunciation.description: Prerequisite: Miracle Your strength of will ensures that even the divine hesi - tates in the force of your Virtue. When you are targeted by a divine Marvel or other effect that costs Legend or Tension, you may choose to end the Virtuous Condition and return to the center of the Virtue track to cause a Clash of Wills…
saint_renunciation.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: Miracle Your strength of will ensures that even the divine hesi - tates in the force of your Virtue. When you are targeted by a divine Marvel or other effect that costs Legend or Tension, you may choose to end the Virtuous Condition and return to the center of the Virtue track to cause a Clash of Wills against the effect’s source. If you succeed, the effect does nothing to you. If you fail, the roll generates Momentum like a normal failed roll.

saint_stainless.name: Stainless
saint_stainless.description: While you have the Virtuous Condition, it is impossi - ble for anything to make you act against your Virtues, even divine powers seizing control of your body directly. When someone attempts to do so, you may choose to pass your Virtuous Condition to them. If you do, you return to the center of the Virtue track and…
saint_stainless.mechanicalEffects: While you have the Virtuous Condition, it is impossi - ble for anything to make you act against your Virtues, even divine powers seizing control of your body directly. When someone attempts to do so, you may choose to pass your Virtuous Condition to them. If you do, you return to the center of the Virtue track and lose the Condition yourself. Even if they have different Virtues than you, their new Condition is identical to the one you had.

saint_the_divine_eye.name: The Divine Eye
saint_the_divine_eye.description: Prerequisite: If I Can Do It, So Can Y ou You always know the Virtues that most influence anyone you meet, even if they do not actually have a Virtue track. You get Enhancement equal to your Virtue rating on all Social rolls that align with or encourage these Virtues when dealing with them. If you have the same…
saint_the_divine_eye.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: If I Can Do It, So Can Y ou You always know the Virtues that most influence anyone you meet, even if they do not actually have a Virtue track. You get Enhancement equal to your Virtue rating on all Social rolls that align with or encourage these Virtues when dealing with them. If you have the same Virtues as they do, this Enhancement applies before rolling.

saint_voice_of_the_mob.name: Voice Of The Mob
saint_voice_of_the_mob.description: Prerequisite: It Is Not in Heaven While you have the Virtuous Condition, any action that would stop you from being able to speak suffers Complica - tion 3 which, if not bought off, causes all human Storyguide Characters present to become angry at whoever silenced you. While you do not have the Virtuous Condition, any…
saint_voice_of_the_mob.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: It Is Not in Heaven While you have the Virtuous Condition, any action that would stop you from being able to speak suffers Complica - tion 3 which, if not bought off, causes all human Storyguide Characters present to become angry at whoever silenced you. While you do not have the Virtuous Condition, any ac - tion trying to track you or your whereabouts suffers Complication 3 which, if not bought off, gets the tracker into trouble with a local human organization.

saint_virtuous_might.name: Virtuous Might
saint_virtuous_might.description: Once per session, a Saint may cancel out Scale equal to their position on the Virtue track (maximum 3, minimum 1) for the scene on a single target. This can be anything from stopping a speeding truck from killing them (Scale 2 to 0) to slapping a God like they would any other mortal (cancelling the God’s defensive…
saint_virtuous_might.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, a Saint may cancel out Scale equal to their position on the Virtue track (maximum 3, minimum 1) for the scene on a single target. This can be anything from stopping a speeding truck from killing them (Scale 2 to 0) to slapping a God like they would any other mortal (cancelling the God’s defensive Scale). Despite the name, this applies to any expression of Scale, including social and mental.

saint_beyond_the_ninth_wave.name: Beyond The Ninth Wave
saint_beyond_the_ninth_wave.description: Prerequisite: My Cause Sustains Me While you have the Virtuous Condition, you ignore the Scale of anything that would physically harm you. A tank shell is like a rifle bullet, a divinely charged fist like a normal punch from a master fighter. You can still be harmed, but Scale does not provide extra successes. Once…
saint_beyond_the_ninth_wave.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: My Cause Sustains Me While you have the Virtuous Condition, you ignore the Scale of anything that would physically harm you. A tank shell is like a rifle bullet, a divinely charged fist like a normal punch from a master fighter. You can still be harmed, but Scale does not provide extra successes. Once per session, you may end the Virtuous Condition immediately and return to the center of the Virtue track to negate a single attack entirely — it doesn’t affect you or anyone else in any way.

saint_heavens_will.name: Heaven’S Will
saint_heavens_will.description: Prerequisite: Castigate While you are Virtuous, you ignore the defensive Scale of anything you attack. You can cut through tank armor like it was Kevlar, fistfight a God or wrestle a giant. Once per session, you may end the Virtuous Condition immediately and return to the center of the track to ignore all immunities…
saint_heavens_will.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: Castigate While you are Virtuous, you ignore the defensive Scale of anything you attack. You can cut through tank armor like it was Kevlar, fistfight a God or wrestle a giant. Once per session, you may end the Virtuous Condition immediately and return to the center of the track to ignore all immunities to damage for a single attack.

saint_martyr.name: Martyr
saint_martyr.description: Prerequisite: Blood of the Valiant Your Virtue shines brightest at your worst moments. While you are Virtuous, when you are Taken Out, you may choose: any trivial targets or foes of lesser Tier than you immediately stop fighting and stare in awe for the rest of the scene or until attacked, whichever comes first, or…
saint_martyr.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: Blood of the Valiant Your Virtue shines brightest at your worst moments. While you are Virtuous, when you are Taken Out, you may choose: any trivial targets or foes of lesser Tier than you immediately stop fighting and stare in awe for the rest of the scene or until attacked, whichever comes first, or all of your allies gain Enhancement equal to your Virtue rating to any attack against the foe that caused you to become Taken Out for the rest of the scene. Once per session, you may immediately end the Virtuous Condition and return to the center of the Virtue track to gain this benefit when you take any Injury condition rather than when you are Taken Out.

saint_passion_play.name: Passion Play
saint_passion_play.description: The strength of your dedication and passion is con - tagious. Everyone in your presence who has a Virtue track moves twice as far on the Virtue track as they normally would whenever they move along the Virtue Track. Whenever someone in your presence becomes Virtuous, gain Momentum.
saint_passion_play.mechanicalEffects: The strength of your dedication and passion is con - tagious. Everyone in your presence who has a Virtue track moves twice as far on the Virtue track as they normally would whenever they move along the Virtue Track. Whenever someone in your presence becomes Virtuous, gain Momentum.

saint_svabhava.name: Svabhava
saint_svabhava.description: Prerequisite: The Divine Eye While you are Virtuous, anything you say which is true is obviously true to everyone hearing it - no one can doubt you when you say something that is true. Whenever you witness someone take an action resonating with one of your Virtues, you may immediately end your Virtuous Condition and…
saint_svabhava.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: The Divine Eye While you are Virtuous, anything you say which is true is obviously true to everyone hearing it - no one can doubt you when you say something that is true. Whenever you witness someone take an action resonating with one of your Virtues, you may immediately end your Virtuous Condition and return to the center of the Virtue track to reinforce the basic truth of their actions, reducing the total Complication they suffer on the action by 3.

saint_the_deserved_gift.name: The Deserved Gift
saint_the_deserved_gift.description: Prerequisite: Renunciation Once per session, you may call on your Virtues for a greater miracle. Select another character. They gain the Blessed Virtue Condition toward one of your Virtues of your choice.
saint_the_deserved_gift.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: Renunciation Once per session, you may call on your Virtues for a greater miracle. Select another character. They gain the Blessed Virtue Condition toward one of your Virtues of your choice.

saint_we_are_greater.name: We Are Greater
saint_we_are_greater.description: Prerequisite: Voice of the Mob While you are Virtuous, anyone that follows you who would normally be considered a trivial target does not count as one for any effect that might harm them. In addition, they are entirely fearless. Once per session, you may immediately end the Virtuous Condition and return to the center…
saint_we_are_greater.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: Voice of the Mob While you are Virtuous, anyone that follows you who would normally be considered a trivial target does not count as one for any effect that might harm them. In addition, they are entirely fearless. Once per session, you may immediately end the Virtuous Condition and return to the center of the Virtue track to temporarily turn a crowd of normal mortals into a temporary Followers birthright for the rest of the scene. They have dots equal to your Saint Calling rating but must have one of the Group or Mob tags.

shepherd_a_friend_to_all.name: A Friend To All
shepherd_a_friend_to_all.description: You and your Ward may have additional Fatebinding Conditions over the limit set by Legend, equal to the difference in tier between you and your Ward.
shepherd_a_friend_to_all.mechanicalEffects: You and your Ward may have additional Fatebinding Conditions over the limit set by Legend, equal to the difference in tier between you and your Ward.

shepherd_aim_for_my_mark.name: Aim For My Mark
shepherd_aim_for_my_mark.description: You gain access to the following stunts, which may be used in close and ranged combat: Weak Point (1s): On his next attack, your Ward may purchase the Critical stunt at a discount equal to the differ - ence between you in Tiers (i.e., if he is a mortal and you are a Hero, it costs 3s; if you were a Demigod, it would…
shepherd_aim_for_my_mark.mechanicalEffects: You gain access to the following stunts, which may be used in close and ranged combat: Weak Point (1s): On his next attack, your Ward may purchase the Critical stunt at a discount equal to the differ - ence between you in Tiers (i.e., if he is a mortal and you are a Hero, it costs 3s; if you were a Demigod, it would cost 2s). Find the Opening (2s): The opponent’s Soft Armor doesn’t apply to your Ward’s next attack.

shepherd_and_my_shield.name: And My Shield
shepherd_and_my_shield.description: When you take a Full Defense action and your Ward is within short range, he also doubles his Defense pool.
shepherd_and_my_shield.mechanicalEffects: When you take a Full Defense action and your Ward is within short range, he also doubles his Defense pool.

shepherd_in_the_nick_of_time.name: In The Nick Of Time
shepherd_in_the_nick_of_time.description: If your Ward is attacked within your line of sight, you can spend Momentum to instantly move to him.
shepherd_in_the_nick_of_time.mechanicalEffects: If your Ward is attacked within your line of sight, you can spend Momentum to instantly move to him.

shepherd_leading_by_example.name: Leading By Example
shepherd_leading_by_example.description: When your Ward gains a Complication, you may choose to suffer its consequences, and may overcome the Complication with any roll, even unrelated ones. If you successfully overcome the Complication, your Ward gains Enhancement on their next action equal to the Complication’s rating; you gain half that, round up.
shepherd_leading_by_example.mechanicalEffects: When your Ward gains a Complication, you may choose to suffer its consequences, and may overcome the Complication with any roll, even unrelated ones. If you successfully overcome the Complication, your Ward gains Enhancement on their next action equal to the Complication’s rating; you gain half that, round up.

shepherd_matchmaker.name: Matchmaker
shepherd_matchmaker.description: Instead of using your once per session ability to acquire a new Fatebinding, another consenting player or a Sto - ryguide character may use that ability instead.
shepherd_matchmaker.mechanicalEffects: Instead of using your once per session ability to acquire a new Fatebinding, another consenting player or a Sto - ryguide character may use that ability instead.

shepherd_taught_you_everything_i_know.name: Taught You Everything I Know
shepherd_taught_you_everything_i_know.description: Once per session, when you spend a scene training your Ward, make a Shepherd Skill roll and note your successes. For the remainder of the session, you may spend these suc - cesses for any of the following effects, once per turn, so long as they mirror an aspect of the training you provided. Just Like in Training (1s):…
shepherd_taught_you_everything_i_know.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, when you spend a scene training your Ward, make a Shepherd Skill roll and note your successes. For the remainder of the session, you may spend these suc - cesses for any of the following effects, once per turn, so long as they mirror an aspect of the training you provided. Just Like in Training (1s): Grant +2 Enhancement to your Ward’s action. Y ou Won’t Stop Me (2s): Negate any Complications or Conditions your Ward is suffering for the remainder of the turn, including Injury Conditions. I Can Do This (variable): When your Ward spends Momentum, add an additional die for every Momentum and success spent. If your Ward is an SGC, you may spend Momentum on their behalf for this roll.

shepherd_vengeance_is_mine.name: Vengeance Is Mine
shepherd_vengeance_is_mine.description: You instinctively come to your ward’s defense when they’re hurt. As a reflexive action, when your ward takes damage spend 1 Momentum to immediately retaliate against the attacker, gaining Enhancement equal to the successes rolled against your ward, up to a maximum of three. You must be within close range of your ward…
shepherd_vengeance_is_mine.mechanicalEffects: You instinctively come to your ward’s defense when they’re hurt. As a reflexive action, when your ward takes damage spend 1 Momentum to immediately retaliate against the attacker, gaining Enhancement equal to the successes rolled against your ward, up to a maximum of three. You must be within close range of your ward or their attacker to use this Knack. Normal limitations on your attack (e.g. range) apply.

shepherd_my_senses_are_tingling.name: My Senses Are Tingling
shepherd_my_senses_are_tingling.description: You are aware if any Storyguide characters you meet have the Jinx, Nemesis, Rival, or Traitor Fatebinding Con - dition with your Ward or your Bandmates, but not which Condition they have.
shepherd_my_senses_are_tingling.mechanicalEffects: You are aware if any Storyguide characters you meet have the Jinx, Nemesis, Rival, or Traitor Fatebinding Con - dition with your Ward or your Bandmates, but not which Condition they have.

shepherd_out_of_the_frying_pan.name: Out Of The Frying Pan
shepherd_out_of_the_frying_pan.description: If your Ward is Taken Out within your line of sight, roll a Knack Skill. On a success, they negate the damage after Armor is applied and are not Taken Out. You may use this Knack a number of times per Episode equal to the difference in tier between you and your Ward.
shepherd_out_of_the_frying_pan.mechanicalEffects: If your Ward is Taken Out within your line of sight, roll a Knack Skill. On a success, they negate the damage after Armor is applied and are not Taken Out. You may use this Knack a number of times per Episode equal to the difference in tier between you and your Ward.

shepherd_punching_above_your_weight.name: Punching Above Your Weight
shepherd_punching_above_your_weight.description: Once per episode, you may spend Momentum when your Ward makes or defends against an attack. They make that action at Scale equal to the difference in tier between you and him.
shepherd_punching_above_your_weight.mechanicalEffects: Once per episode, you may spend Momentum when your Ward makes or defends against an attack. They make that action at Scale equal to the difference in tier between you and him.

shepherd_shared_wisdom.name: Shared Wisdom
shepherd_shared_wisdom.description: When your ward takes an action requiring a Skill they have no dots in, spend 1 Momentum for them to add dice equal to your difference in Tier for the duration of the scene. They cannot add more than your dots in the Skill. At the end of the scene, you may imbue a point of Legend for them to use half your rank in the…
shepherd_shared_wisdom.mechanicalEffects: When your ward takes an action requiring a Skill they have no dots in, spend 1 Momentum for them to add dice equal to your difference in Tier for the duration of the scene. They cannot add more than your dots in the Skill. At the end of the scene, you may imbue a point of Legend for them to use half your rank in the Skill until reclaimed.

shepherd_wise_counsel.name: Wise Counsel
shepherd_wise_counsel.description: While together in a Procedural scene, if your Ward is rolling to do research with a Skill they do not have any dots in, you may spend Momentum once per session and make a Knack Skill roll. They make their research roll as if they have a number of dots equal to the number of successes you rolled, up to five.
shepherd_wise_counsel.mechanicalEffects: While together in a Procedural scene, if your Ward is rolling to do research with a Skill they do not have any dots in, you may spend Momentum once per session and make a Knack Skill roll. They make their research roll as if they have a number of dots equal to the number of successes you rolled, up to five.

shepherd_you_can_do_this_all_day.name: You Can Do This All Day
shepherd_you_can_do_this_all_day.description: When your Ward is trying to buy off a Complication, spend Momentum and make a Knack Skill Roll. Your Ward may spend successes from this roll to buy off that Complication.
shepherd_you_can_do_this_all_day.mechanicalEffects: When your Ward is trying to buy off a Complication, spend Momentum and make a Knack Skill Roll. Your Ward may spend successes from this roll to buy off that Complication.

trickster_all_stories_are_true.name: All Stories Are True
trickster_all_stories_are_true.description: With this Knack, you lie with such Skill and grace that even Fate believes you, if only for a little while. Make a Knack Skill roll, adding Enhancements equal to half your Legend, and take an action to lie a new truth into being. You may spend successes on the following stunts: My Friends: Add 1 dot to Followers for…
trickster_all_stories_are_true.mechanicalEffects: With this Knack, you lie with such Skill and grace that even Fate believes you, if only for a little while. Make a Knack Skill roll, adding Enhancements equal to half your Legend, and take an action to lie a new truth into being. You may spend successes on the following stunts: My Friends: Add 1 dot to Followers for every 2 successes My Talent: Add 1 dot to a Skill for every 2 successes, or temporarily move a dot to another Skill for 1 success My Treasures: Lie a mundane item into existence, spending 2 successes for every 1 Enhancement My Lover: Spend 2 successes to add 1 Success to a Temporary Bond. Any benefits gained from this Knack fade away at the end of the Scene.

trickster_blather_and_skite.name: Blather And Skite
trickster_blather_and_skite.description: When you spout nonsense at your target, they must spend a moment trying to figure out what the heck you just said — buying you or someone else more time to accomplish any kind of underhanded task: sneaking into a place, slip - ping past a posted sentry, lying your way through security, and so on. This works…
trickster_blather_and_skite.mechanicalEffects: When you spout nonsense at your target, they must spend a moment trying to figure out what the heck you just said — buying you or someone else more time to accomplish any kind of underhanded task: sneaking into a place, slip - ping past a posted sentry, lying your way through security, and so on. This works automatically on any character of same or lower Tier, but requires a Knack Skill roll to work on someone of higher Tier. For each success rolled, you buy five minutes of in-game time or one turn of combat (which - ever is more immediately applicable) before enemies realize infiltrated and go on high alert. If you use this on one of your bandmates, you only succeed with the consent of the other character’s player.

trickster_face_in_the_crowd.name: Face In The Crowd
trickster_face_in_the_crowd.description: You blend seamlessly into a crowd. So long as there are more people present than twice your Legend rating, you blend in automatically, and all mundane efforts to spot you fail. Supernatural means of tracking and perception require a Clash of Wills.
trickster_face_in_the_crowd.mechanicalEffects: You blend seamlessly into a crowd. So long as there are more people present than twice your Legend rating, you blend in automatically, and all mundane efforts to spot you fail. Supernatural means of tracking and perception require a Clash of Wills.

trickster_glint_of_steel.name: Glint Of Steel
trickster_glint_of_steel.description: You reflect light into your opponent’s eyes, dazzling them at a critical moment. Spend 1 Momentum and make a Subterfuge + Cunning roll against a character’s Defense to use the Blind Stunt on the character. If you’re in a Showdown (Mythic Shards p. 138), you may perform this as a mixed action, and the +1 Difficulty…
trickster_glint_of_steel.mechanicalEffects: You reflect light into your opponent’s eyes, dazzling them at a critical moment. Spend 1 Momentum and make a Subterfuge + Cunning roll against a character’s Defense to use the Blind Stunt on the character. If you’re in a Showdown (Mythic Shards p. 138), you may perform this as a mixed action, and the +1 Difficulty also applies to their next interval roll.

trickster_in_sheeps_clothing.name: In Sheep’S Clothing
trickster_in_sheeps_clothing.description: When you disguise yourself, you do without needing to roll. You have the option to change your hair, skin, and eye color, apparent gender, and height within a few inches, but cannot assume the exact appearance of someone else. The disguise cannot be seen through, though your mannerisms and turn of phrase may give you…
trickster_in_sheeps_clothing.mechanicalEffects: When you disguise yourself, you do without needing to roll. You have the option to change your hair, skin, and eye color, apparent gender, and height within a few inches, but cannot assume the exact appearance of someone else. The disguise cannot be seen through, though your mannerisms and turn of phrase may give you away. At Storyguide discretion, Knack Skill rolls may be required to blend in.

trickster_i_meant_to_do_that.name: I Meant To Do That
trickster_i_meant_to_do_that.description: When you fail at an action, you may select additional consolations based on how you failed: Confusingly: Observers have no idea what you were trying to do, barring supernatural ability and defeating you in a Clash of Wills. Instructively: An ally who attempts the same action gains your Legend in Enhancement to the…
trickster_i_meant_to_do_that.mechanicalEffects: When you fail at an action, you may select additional consolations based on how you failed: Confusingly: Observers have no idea what you were trying to do, barring supernatural ability and defeating you in a Clash of Wills. Instructively: An ally who attempts the same action gains your Legend in Enhancement to the roll that applies before they roll. Spectacularly: Characters without an Attitude toward you create a Positive 1-point attitude toward you of “They’re Harmless,” and increase any Positive Atmosphere in the scene.

trickster_its_only_the_wind.name: It’S Only The Wind
trickster_its_only_the_wind.description: When you fail to conceal yourself from detection, you can choose to have your Consolation take the form of a dis - traction from your presence instead of gaining Momentum: a cat leaping out of the dark, a tree branch scraping a window, a cup that’s fallen off of a table, and so on. If you do, you can immediately make…
trickster_its_only_the_wind.mechanicalEffects: When you fail to conceal yourself from detection, you can choose to have your Consolation take the form of a dis - traction from your presence instead of gaining Momentum: a cat leaping out of the dark, a tree branch scraping a window, a cup that’s fallen off of a table, and so on. If you do, you can immediately make another roll to hide, with 2 Enhancement.

trickster_just_the_thing.name: Just The Thing
trickster_just_the_thing.description: When you have need of any mundane thing whatsoever, you may choose to have it on your person or immediately available. Every time you do this in a session, your next action gains the Complication “Debt Due” with a rating of the number of times you’ve used it. Debt Due: If unresolved, the true owner of the possessions…
trickster_just_the_thing.mechanicalEffects: When you have need of any mundane thing whatsoever, you may choose to have it on your person or immediately available. Every time you do this in a session, your next action gains the Complication “Debt Due” with a rating of the number of times you’ve used it. Debt Due: If unresolved, the true owner of the possessions or a similar reckoning appears at the end of the scene.

trickster_light_fingered.name: Light Fingered
trickster_light_fingered.description: When you steal an object or pickpocket someone, you do so without needing to roll, so long as the object is some - thing you can conceal in your hands. If you use this ability to lift something from a member of your band, you must do so with the consent of that character’s player. You cannot steal an item that is…
trickster_light_fingered.mechanicalEffects: When you steal an object or pickpocket someone, you do so without needing to roll, so long as the object is some - thing you can conceal in your hands. If you use this ability to lift something from a member of your band, you must do so with the consent of that character’s player. You cannot steal an item that is currently in use. Stealing a weapon from an enemy would first require the Disarm or Seize stunt. NUMBER, LETTER,

trickster_and_special_character.name: And Special Character
trickster_and_special_character.description: To attempt to keep a Trickster out of a secure system is folly. When trying to gain access to any secured computer network, gain +1 Enhancement before you roll.
trickster_and_special_character.mechanicalEffects: To attempt to keep a Trickster out of a secure system is folly. When trying to gain access to any secured computer network, gain +1 Enhancement before you roll.

trickster_redirect.name: Redirect
trickster_redirect.description: Spend a Momentum. You convert one enemy’s current attitude to anger from whatever it was before. At the same time, select a new target to become the object of that anger, causing your enemy to attack the new target in a rage.
trickster_redirect.mechanicalEffects: Spend a Momentum. You convert one enemy’s current attitude to anger from whatever it was before. At the same time, select a new target to become the object of that anger, causing your enemy to attack the new target in a rage.

trickster_rumor_miller.name: Rumor Miller
trickster_rumor_miller.description: Your lies catch on like wildfire, and you need only make the smallest post on social media to get a wild rumor circu - lating. Make a Knack Skill roll — any successes delivers the rumor about the target to those who should hear it — his boss, his husband, his best friends, etc.
trickster_rumor_miller.mechanicalEffects: Your lies catch on like wildfire, and you need only make the smallest post on social media to get a wild rumor circu - lating. Make a Knack Skill roll — any successes delivers the rumor about the target to those who should hear it — his boss, his husband, his best friends, etc.

trickster_smoke_and_mirrors.name: Smoke And Mirrors
trickster_smoke_and_mirrors.description: Once per scene, when you would be Taken Out, you in - stead spend Momentum, negate the damage that would have taken you out and move one range band away from your at - tacker — but leave behind a brief afterimage of your outline, which crumbles into dust seconds later.
trickster_smoke_and_mirrors.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, when you would be Taken Out, you in - stead spend Momentum, negate the damage that would have taken you out and move one range band away from your at - tacker — but leave behind a brief afterimage of your outline, which crumbles into dust seconds later.

trickster_subliminal_messages.name: Subliminal Messages
trickster_subliminal_messages.description: You can communicate with any number of specifically intended people through body language and insinuation, preventing any unintended party from understanding your actual meaning. Mortals can’t determine your meaning at all, and those with supernatural intuition still suffer a level 3 Complication; if not bought off,…
trickster_subliminal_messages.mechanicalEffects: You can communicate with any number of specifically intended people through body language and insinuation, preventing any unintended party from understanding your actual meaning. Mortals can’t determine your meaning at all, and those with supernatural intuition still suffer a level 3 Complication; if not bought off, they get only a partial meaning, missing some important detail.

trickster_takes_one_to_know_one.name: Takes One To Know One
trickster_takes_one_to_know_one.description: When you are the target of a scam or a lie, you recognize that a deception is taking place. You do not know what the truth is, but you instinctively understand that you are in the company of liars and cheaters. Whether or not you call out the cheat on his dishonest actions is up to you.
trickster_takes_one_to_know_one.mechanicalEffects: When you are the target of a scam or a lie, you recognize that a deception is taking place. You do not know what the truth is, but you instinctively understand that you are in the company of liars and cheaters. Whether or not you call out the cheat on his dishonest actions is up to you.

trickster_wasnt_me.name: Wasn’T Me
trickster_wasnt_me.description: When you do something with legal or social consequences, you delay the consequence by transferring blame to someone else of the same or lower Tier. This delay lasts until the end of the session by default, but may be delayed further by making a Knack Skill roll, and spending 1 success per scene of delay. To push blame…
trickster_wasnt_me.mechanicalEffects: When you do something with legal or social consequences, you delay the consequence by transferring blame to someone else of the same or lower Tier. This delay lasts until the end of the session by default, but may be delayed further by making a Knack Skill roll, and spending 1 success per scene of delay. To push blame onto a member of your band, you must do so with the consent of that character’s player. Once the delay ends, anyone of higher Tier than you who had been duped by this Knack realizes they’ve been tricked, and will likely seek revenge. WHO’S AT THE DOOR? Once per session you distract a target by introducing another character to the scene. It could be a knock at the door, an old friend spotted across the room, a titanspawn burst - ing through the wall, etc. Whatever the distraction, it gives you enough time to accomplish a discreet task — e.g. a brief private conversation, a peek at the target’s computer files — or leave the scene unnoticed. If the Storyguide decides the task requires a complex action, make a Knack Skill roll with each success buying you more time.

trickster_always_in_the_way.name: Always In The Way
trickster_always_in_the_way.description: You are just where the opposition would rather you not be, whether by intent or happenstance. When you take the complicate action (Scion: Origin, p. 118), create an additional “You’re here too?!” Complication at the same value. Your target applies any unresolved value as difficulty to their next action. When using…
trickster_always_in_the_way.mechanicalEffects: You are just where the opposition would rather you not be, whether by intent or happenstance. When you take the complicate action (Scion: Origin, p. 118), create an additional “You’re here too?!” Complication at the same value. Your target applies any unresolved value as difficulty to their next action. When using divine opposition with this Calling in Divine Rule, gain an additional point of effect.

trickster_better_things_to_do_anyway.name: Better Things To Do Anyway
trickster_better_things_to_do_anyway.description: Sometimes, you seemed destined for failure, but useful things come of whatever foolishness you mire yourself in. Once per procedural action, you may voluntarily fail a roll to have it count as a Milestone for a different Procedural action.
trickster_better_things_to_do_anyway.mechanicalEffects: Sometimes, you seemed destined for failure, but useful things come of whatever foolishness you mire yourself in. Once per procedural action, you may voluntarily fail a roll to have it count as a Milestone for a different Procedural action.

trickster_come_listen_here.name: Come Listen Here
trickster_come_listen_here.description: Your stories carry beyond the range of your voice, driving people to great deeds even if you’d rather they didn’t. Imbue Legend to consecrate a story you tell; those listeners who try to follow its moral, promise of glory, or other suggestive theme to do what would normally be impossible benefit from additional Scale.…
trickster_come_listen_here.mechanicalEffects: Your stories carry beyond the range of your voice, driving people to great deeds even if you’d rather they didn’t. Imbue Legend to consecrate a story you tell; those listeners who try to follow its moral, promise of glory, or other suggestive theme to do what would normally be impossible benefit from additional Scale. This may create a Realm Condition that reduces the cost for Chaos, Deception, or Fortune Di - vine Rule actions taken through it by 1.

trickster_doppelganger.name: Doppelganger
trickster_doppelganger.description: Make a Knack Skill roll and with any successes, make an exact copy of yourself. The copy has all your Attributes and Skills, Knacks and Boons, and is controlled by you. This doppelganger may be sent to perform any social or investigative task independently of you, though you are aware of the outcome (and the player is…
trickster_doppelganger.mechanicalEffects: Make a Knack Skill roll and with any successes, make an exact copy of yourself. The copy has all your Attributes and Skills, Knacks and Boons, and is controlled by you. This doppelganger may be sent to perform any social or investigative task independently of you, though you are aware of the outcome (and the player is free to roleplay her character in two places at once). It cannot benefit from teamwork actions and dissipates into dust if attacked. Otherwise, the copy lasts for a number of days equal to your Trickster Calling.

trickster_emperor_of_fools.name: Emperor Of Fools
trickster_emperor_of_fools.description: When you have need of a Birthright, you may choose to have it on your person or immediately available, the relevant sentient creatures convinced that they really should be helping you. Every time you do this in a Session, your next action gains the Complication “Debt Due” with a cumulative rating of the number of…
trickster_emperor_of_fools.mechanicalEffects: When you have need of a Birthright, you may choose to have it on your person or immediately available, the relevant sentient creatures convinced that they really should be helping you. Every time you do this in a Session, your next action gains the Complication “Debt Due” with a cumulative rating of the number of Birthright dots you’ve borrowed. If unre - solved, you cannot use this Knack for the rest of the session. Debt Due: If unresolved, the true owner of the possessions or a similar reckoning appears at the end of the scene.

trickster_exposed.name: Exposed
trickster_exposed.description: Spend a Momentum and tell a damaging lie about someone of the same or lower Tier. Everyone who hears you utter the lie believes it to be true, even if there is evidence proving elsewise. Attempts to exonerate your target provoke a Clash of Wills.
trickster_exposed.mechanicalEffects: Spend a Momentum and tell a damaging lie about someone of the same or lower Tier. Everyone who hears you utter the lie believes it to be true, even if there is evidence proving elsewise. Attempts to exonerate your target provoke a Clash of Wills.

trickster_fortunes_wheel.name: Fortune’S Wheel
trickster_fortunes_wheel.description: Once per scene, you may voluntarily botch a roll before or after you roll it. Select any or all: Opposing character who see your failure suffer your Trickster rating in additional Difficulty to all their rolls. Heal any -0 injuries you have. Friendly characters gain your Legend in Enhancement for their next roll. If…
trickster_fortunes_wheel.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, you may voluntarily botch a roll before or after you roll it. Select any or all: Opposing character who see your failure suffer your Trickster rating in additional Difficulty to all their rolls. Heal any -0 injuries you have. Friendly characters gain your Legend in Enhancement for their next roll. If you chose to Botch before you rolled: Regain Legend.

trickster_one_mans_trash.name: One Man’S Trash
trickster_one_mans_trash.description: Spend Momentum and make an ordinary piece of junk seem extremely rare and valuable. This item will sell or trade as if it had real value. Anyone of lower Tier buys this decep - tion instantly, squabbling over themselves for who will get to buy this unique thing. Targets of the same Tier or higher must make an Empathy…
trickster_one_mans_trash.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum and make an ordinary piece of junk seem extremely rare and valuable. This item will sell or trade as if it had real value.
