Anyone of lower Tier buys this decep - tion instantly, squabbling over themselves for who will get to buy this unique thing. Targets of the same Tier or higher must make an Empathy roll to see through this lie, but face +Legend Difficulty to convince anyone else that it is not just trash. SURPRISE! Voluntarily be Taken Out (for all intents and purposes, you appear to be dead or unconscious) and come back later, unharmed, at any point in time during the session to make a surprise attack or otherwise set up an ambush with +4 En - hancement, which applies before you roll. If someone has seen you pull this trick before, they resist the ambush as normal (you do not gain the bonus) and instead gain +4 Enhancement on combat rolls against you for the first round if they succeed. If it would better suit you, you may return dramatically in the middle of a social scene instead, adding the same Enhance - ment to the next most appropriate Social roll.

trickster_thief_of_form.name: Thief Of Form
trickster_thief_of_form.description: You may steal the shape of a trivial or helpless character. Choose either or both: They’re transformed into a harmless animal, plant, or animate object for the rest of the session. You assume their form, which requires a successful Clash of Wills to see through, for the rest of the scene.
trickster_thief_of_form.mechanicalEffects: You may steal the shape of a trivial or helpless character. Choose either or both: They’re transformed into a harmless animal, plant, or animate object for the rest of the session. You assume their form, which requires a successful Clash of Wills to see through, for the rest of the scene.

trickster_universal_good_for_nothing.name: Universal Good For Nothing
trickster_universal_good_for_nothing.description: You count “foolish nonsense” or “unrelated unproduc - tive activity” as a Milestones for Procedural actions.
trickster_universal_good_for_nothing.mechanicalEffects: You count “foolish nonsense” or “unrelated unproduc - tive activity” as a Milestones for Procedural actions.

trickster_wide_eyed_innocence.name: Wide-Eyed Innocence
trickster_wide_eyed_innocence.description: Nobody suspects you, right up until the moment you swipe the prize from under their nose, punch them in the face, or commit some other act of flamboyant derring-do right in front of them. You automatically avoid suspicion in a place you’re technically allowed to access and have En - hancement 3 to do so in places you…
trickster_wide_eyed_innocence.mechanicalEffects: Nobody suspects you, right up until the moment you swipe the prize from under their nose, punch them in the face, or commit some other act of flamboyant derring-do right in front of them. You automatically avoid suspicion in a place you’re technically allowed to access and have En - hancement 3 to do so in places you shouldn’t be. You don’t evade notice, only suspicion, and this Knack does nothing to get you out of trouble once you’ve committed your crime.

trickster_woven_from_lies.name: Woven From Lies
trickster_woven_from_lies.description: When you spin a story or craft an elaborate deception on an epic Scale (spreading a vicious rumor across the world via social media, convincing a whole society of people that you’re someone you’re not), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
trickster_woven_from_lies.mechanicalEffects: When you spin a story or craft an elaborate deception on an epic Scale (spreading a vicious rumor across the world via social media, convincing a whole society of people that you’re someone you’re not), imbue a point of Legend, rather than spending, to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

trickster_aint_i_a_stinker.name: Ain’T I A Stinker
trickster_aint_i_a_stinker.description: When you lie to a Storyguide character, convinc - ing them to do something they otherwise never would, Imbue for Scale, which applies to their action once per scene. This does not stack with any other supernatural sources of Scale.
trickster_aint_i_a_stinker.mechanicalEffects: When you lie to a Storyguide character, convinc - ing them to do something they otherwise never would, Imbue for Scale, which applies to their action once per scene. This does not stack with any other supernatural sources of Scale.

trickster_escape_artist.name: Escape Artist
trickster_escape_artist.description: Standard prisons or manacles cannot contain you, and you may Imbue for Scale to get out of any confine - ment: a supermax prison, a labyrinth, the confines of an Underworld.
trickster_escape_artist.mechanicalEffects: Standard prisons or manacles cannot contain you, and you may Imbue for Scale to get out of any confine - ment: a supermax prison, a labyrinth, the confines of an Underworld.

trickster_disguised_to_onlookers.name: Disguised To Onlookers
trickster_disguised_to_onlookers.description: Beings of a Lower Tier cannot see through your dis - guises, and you may choose whether your Omen presents itself. If you choose not to show it, it will return to wit - nesses’ memories (or appear in their dreams) after your trickery has unfolded.
trickster_disguised_to_onlookers.mechanicalEffects: Beings of a Lower Tier cannot see through your dis - guises, and you may choose whether your Omen presents itself. If you choose not to show it, it will return to wit - nesses’ memories (or appear in their dreams) after your trickery has unfolded.

trickster_disguised_to_the_world.name: Disguised To The World
trickster_disguised_to_the_world.description: Beyond simple illusion, your disguises alter reality itself. Once per session, you may completely change your face, sex, race, even species down to a biological level. You may temporarily shift your dots in physical attributes as you like. You also gain their other biological properties; such as a certain Norse…
trickster_disguised_to_the_world.mechanicalEffects: Beyond simple illusion, your disguises alter reality itself. Once per session, you may completely change your face, sex, race, even species down to a biological level. You may temporarily shift your dots in physical attributes as you like. You also gain their other biological properties; such as a certain Norse Trickster disguised as a horse becoming impregnated by one. However, you are limited to mundane, biological differences.

trickster_disguised_to_the_overworld.name: Disguised To The Overworld
trickster_disguised_to_the_overworld.description: While the preceding Knack disguises your biological makeup down to your DNA, this one affects how you appear to magic itself. Once per session, if you disguise yourself as a Denizen of the World, you may access one of their Knacks for the scene, though you also take any banes or Conditions inherent to that race.
trickster_disguised_to_the_overworld.mechanicalEffects: While the preceding Knack disguises your biological makeup down to your DNA, this one affects how you appear to magic itself. Once per session, if you disguise yourself as a Denizen of the World, you may access one of their Knacks for the scene, though you also take any banes or Conditions inherent to that race.

trickster_disguised_to_fate.name: Disguised To Fate
trickster_disguised_to_fate.description: (Prerequisite: Any two of the previous three “Dis - guised to” Knacks) Once per session, if you are disguised as a specific figure, you may call upon their Legendary Title as if it were your own. The figure in question does not immediately become aware of this, but will likely hear about the great Deeds they don’t…
trickster_disguised_to_fate.mechanicalEffects: (Prerequisite: Any two of the previous three “Dis - guised to” Knacks) Once per session, if you are disguised as a specific figure, you may call upon their Legendary Title as if it were your own. The figure in question does not immediately become aware of this, but will likely hear about the great Deeds they don’t remember taking part in.

trickster_theoi_specific_gift_horse.name: Theoi-Specific: Gift Horse
trickster_theoi_specific_gift_horse.description: A shirt poisoned in centaur blood. Flammable golden robes. A jar filled with all the horrors and pains of humanity. Once per session, you may use a Marvel at no cost to menace someone who has accepted a gift from you.
trickster_theoi_specific_gift_horse.mechanicalEffects: A shirt poisoned in centaur blood. Flammable golden robes. A jar filled with all the horrors and pains of humanity. Once per session, you may use a Marvel at no cost to menace someone who has accepted a gift from you.

trickster_crossroads.name: Crossroads
trickster_crossroads.description: To survive, sometimes even the divine must adapt. When worship of your Pantheon is forbidden, maybe it’s time to look like a different one. When this Knack is activated, you appear to all senses (including “Scent the Divine”) as a different Pantheon than your own. You can even mimic the Omen of a specific Legendary…
trickster_crossroads.mechanicalEffects: To survive, sometimes even the divine must adapt. When worship of your Pantheon is forbidden, maybe it’s time to look like a different one. When this Knack is activated, you appear to all senses (including “Scent the Divine”) as a different Pantheon than your own. You can even mimic the Omen of a specific Legendary figure, chosen when you purchase this Knack. Further, once per session you may Imbue, rather than Spend Legend, to mimic their Pantheon Specific Purview with a Marvel. Scions with this knack may even find their Mantle grow - ing to look like the figure they are emulating. Players and Storyguides are encouraged to make this happen, as Fate puts them on another’s path, and the character chooses between creating their own Legend or syncretizing into someone else’s.

warrior_bass_breaker.name: Bass Breaker
warrior_bass_breaker.description: You can use your voice as a weapon with the Bashing, Loud, Ranged, and Piercing tags, rolling your performing dice pool to attack. If you have the means to amplify your voice — whether mundane or mystic — you can spend 1 Momentum to grant it the Shockwave tag for one attack. This can also be purchased as a Monster…
warrior_bass_breaker.mechanicalEffects: You can use your voice as a weapon with the Bashing, Loud, Ranged, and Piercing tags, rolling your performing dice pool to attack. If you have the means to amplify your voice — whether mundane or mystic — you can spend 1 Momentum to grant it the Shockwave tag for one attack. This can also be purchased as a Monster Knack.

warrior_close_the_gap.name: Close The Gap
warrior_close_the_gap.description: The first time you make a combat movement roll, make a Knack Skill roll instead. Spend successes on the following Stunts for the rest of the fight: Charge! (1s): You make the Rush action without needing to make an opposed roll. This is negation is limited by the rules for applying Knack abilities — i.e. you may not…
warrior_close_the_gap.mechanicalEffects: The first time you make a combat movement roll, make a Knack Skill roll instead. Spend successes on the following Stunts for the rest of the fight: Charge! (1s): You make the Rush action without needing to make an opposed roll. This is negation is limited by the rules for applying Knack abilities — i.e. you may not apply it to anyone two Tiers higher than you. Inescapable (1s): Opponents of a lower Tier than you who are engaged with you in combat may not make the Disengage action. You must spend a success on this Stunt each time a different opponent would try to escape you, but only need to apply it once per target. Sure-footed (1s): Apply this Stunt to a combat movement action; Difficult terrain does not apply to this movement.

warrior_death_by_teacup.name: Death By Teacup
warrior_death_by_teacup.description: When you use an improvised weapon, it becomes as deadly as anything designed for the job. It takes on the profile of any existing weapon of a similar size or shape: A teacup becomes brass knuckles or a punch dagger; a shard of glass becomes a knife; a thrown shoe becomes a throwing hatchet, etc. It must appropriately…
warrior_death_by_teacup.mechanicalEffects: When you use an improvised weapon, it becomes as deadly as anything designed for the job. It takes on the profile of any existing weapon of a similar size or shape: A teacup becomes brass knuckles or a punch dagger; a shard of glass becomes a knife; a thrown shoe becomes a throwing hatchet, etc. It must appropriately fit something of a similar size and shape, as described in the examples listed. This benefit lasts until you no longer hold the object, or until it breaks, or until you are no longer using the object with any Warrior Skill — whichever comes first. In the case of thrown objects, the benefit extends until impact. A hurled shoe strikes with the force of a tomahawk and then becomes ordinary footwear when it hits the ground. This is compatible with Master of Weapons, though still adheres to the set limitations.

warrior_enhanced_impact.name: Enhanced Impact
warrior_enhanced_impact.description: Whenever you successfully deal Injury with your Knack Skill, you also knock the target back one range band. This does not do any extra damage, but can put someone in a tight spot.
warrior_enhanced_impact.mechanicalEffects: Whenever you successfully deal Injury with your Knack Skill, you also knock the target back one range band. This does not do any extra damage, but can put someone in a tight spot.

warrior_feat_of_arms.name: Feat Of Arms
warrior_feat_of_arms.description: When you successfully attack an enemy, spend Momentum; create additional Enhancement equal to your Warrior rating to spend on all non-Inflict Injury or Critical/Critical Hit stunts.
warrior_feat_of_arms.mechanicalEffects: When you successfully attack an enemy, spend Momentum; create additional Enhancement equal to your Warrior rating to spend on all non-Inflict Injury or Critical/Critical Hit stunts.

warrior_fog_of_war.name: Fog Of War
warrior_fog_of_war.description: This Knack is the embodiment of the maxim all warfare is based in deception. As long as you choose not to take any other action, you may channel the chaos and unpredict - ability of battle as a weapon. Make a Knack Skill roll, with 1 Enhancement. The successes apply a Complication to all enemy combatants within Long…
warrior_fog_of_war.mechanicalEffects: This Knack is the embodiment of the maxim all warfare is based in deception. As long as you choose not to take any other action, you may channel the chaos and unpredict - ability of battle as a weapon. Make a Knack Skill roll, with 1 Enhancement. The successes apply a Complication to all enemy combatants within Long range. Failure to buy off this Complication causes any successful action to impact the wrong target; shots hit the wrong person, medical aid is administered to the healthy, and inspiring speeches are delivered to the enemy. The Storyguide should determine how detrimental the new target is based on how much of the Complication was bought off.

warrior_hells_coming_with_me.name: Hell’S Coming With Me
warrior_hells_coming_with_me.description: You take on as many foes as you want. When you or an ally
warrior_hells_coming_with_me.mechanicalEffects: You take on as many foes as you want. When you or an ally

warrior_legendary_wrestler.name: Legendary Wrestler
warrior_legendary_wrestler.description: You might be trained in an ancient style in homage of the Gods, or you just revel in the physical struggle of grappling. Regardless, when you attempt any grappling Stunts ( Scion: Origin p. 117) you gain 1 Enhancement before your roll.
warrior_legendary_wrestler.mechanicalEffects: You might be trained in an ancient style in homage of the Gods, or you just revel in the physical struggle of grappling. Regardless, when you attempt any grappling Stunts ( Scion: Origin p. 117) you gain 1 Enhancement before your roll.

warrior_master_of_weapons.name: Master Of Weapons
warrior_master_of_weapons.description: At the beginning of the session, choose one of your weapons to be your favored weapon. When you use your favored weapon, add a number of additional tag points to it up to your Warrior Calling. These do not have to fit the weap - on’s existing profile: A sword can be made to strike at Far range, for example. Spend…
warrior_master_of_weapons.mechanicalEffects: At the beginning of the session, choose one of your weapons to be your favored weapon. When you use your favored weapon, add a number of additional tag points to it up to your Warrior Calling. These do not have to fit the weap - on’s existing profile: A sword can be made to strike at Far range, for example. Spend Momentum to switch the benefit to another weapon. Negative cost tags cannot be purchased with this Knack.

warrior_maze_of_steel.name: Maze Of Steel
warrior_maze_of_steel.description: Spend Momentum. You gain the Condition “Counterattack.” Enemies who attack you or characters you protect in the same range band suffer from Complication with a rating equal to your Warrior rating. If unresolved, they suffer 1 damage. “Counterattack” resolves at the end of your Warrior rating in (the Knack user’s)…
warrior_maze_of_steel.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum. You gain the Condition “Counterattack.” Enemies who attack you or characters you protect in the same range band suffer from Complication with a rating equal to your Warrior rating. If unresolved, they suffer 1 damage. “Counterattack” resolves at the end of your Warrior rating in (the Knack user’s) turns.

warrior_one_last_shot.name: One Last Shot
warrior_one_last_shot.description: Once per scene, when using a ranged weapon with limited ammunition (not including one-use weapons like gre - nades), you can declare you are out of ammunition instead of attacking with it. On your next turn, you produce one more piece of ammunition for your attack: add 2 Enhancement and the Piercing tag before…
warrior_one_last_shot.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, when using a ranged weapon with limited ammunition (not including one-use weapons like gre - nades), you can declare you are out of ammunition instead of attacking with it. On your next turn, you produce one more piece of ammunition for your attack: add 2 Enhancement and the Piercing tag before rolling, after which you are out of ammo and must reload (Scion: Origin, p.123).

warrior_sheer_brutality.name: Sheer Brutality
warrior_sheer_brutality.description: Through decisive action you strike before your oppo - nent, hard and without mercy. Some may see you as a bul - ly, but you feel that the greatest defense is a great offense. Whenever you attack a character who has not yet acted in the current combat, you gain 1 Enhancement and the 9-again quality. If the target of…
warrior_sheer_brutality.mechanicalEffects: Through decisive action you strike before your oppo - nent, hard and without mercy. Some may see you as a bul - ly, but you feel that the greatest defense is a great offense. Whenever you attack a character who has not yet acted in the current combat, you gain 1 Enhancement and the 9-again quality. If the target of your attack is a trivial character, you can defeat them without a roll. This Knack can benefit surprise attacks — the opponent need not know a fight is coming. If your target attempts to use a Knack or Boon to react to you, they must succeed in a Clash of Wills.

warrior_tempered.name: Tempered
warrior_tempered.description: When you wear no armor, you are considered to have the Armored (Soft) tag. This benefit stacks with the increased difficulty of the inflict damage Stunt granted by any other ar - mor you wear when you fight lesser foes (minor characters, or anyone a Tier lower than you).
warrior_tempered.mechanicalEffects: When you wear no armor, you are considered to have the Armored (Soft) tag. This benefit stacks with the increased difficulty of the inflict damage Stunt granted by any other ar - mor you wear when you fight lesser foes (minor characters, or anyone a Tier lower than you).

warrior_the_biggest_threat.name: The Biggest Threat
warrior_the_biggest_threat.description: When you make a show of force or intimidate your en - emy, make a Knack Skill roll. On a success, the target must focus its efforts on dealing with you first, suffering +2 Diffi - culty to attack anyone else.
warrior_the_biggest_threat.mechanicalEffects: When you make a show of force or intimidate your en - emy, make a Knack Skill roll. On a success, the target must focus its efforts on dealing with you first, suffering +2 Diffi - culty to attack anyone else.

warrior_the_perfect_soldier.name: The Perfect Soldier
warrior_the_perfect_soldier.description: While other warriors fight for reasons ranging from revenge to glory, to sheer rage, a Soldier is a tool, part of a machine of warfare and violence. So long as you fight as part of a defined unit and are following the orders of a clear and direct superior, you receive 8-again on all rolls to accomplish whatever…
warrior_the_perfect_soldier.mechanicalEffects: While other warriors fight for reasons ranging from revenge to glory, to sheer rage, a Soldier is a tool, part of a machine of warfare and violence. So long as you fight as part of a defined unit and are following the orders of a clear and direct superior, you receive 8-again on all rolls to accomplish whatever mission you have been assigned. While this will most often apply to Athletics, Close Combat, and Firearms actions, it can also be broader, depending on the mission objective. Attempts to sabotage or gain intelligence could benefit from Technology, and a rescue mission might allow for Medicine or even Empathy.

warrior_nemetondevos_specific_trimarkisi.name: Nemetondevos-Specific: Trimarkisia
warrior_nemetondevos_specific_trimarkisi.description: When the Keltoi marched on ancient Greece, the Greeks were baffled at how the invaders could replace their fallen sol - diers almost immediately. One servant brought the wounded warrior to safety while a second took up the fight, using the trimarkisia, or “three horsemen,” technique. Make a Knack Skill roll and gain…
warrior_nemetondevos_specific_trimarkisi.mechanicalEffects: When the Keltoi marched on ancient Greece, the Greeks were baffled at how the invaders could replace their fallen sol - diers almost immediately. One servant brought the wounded warrior to safety while a second took up the fight, using the trimarkisia, or “three horsemen,” technique. Make a Knack Skill roll and gain temporary dots of the Followers Birthright (Scion: Hero, p. 203) equal to successes rolled, to a maximum of Followers 5. This represents your foresight in coordinating auxiliary forces and finding or recruiting backup whenever you need it. These Followers have the Heavy archetype and gain tags in the following order as their rating increases: Tough, Group, Knack (The Biggest Threat; Scion: Hero, p. 235), Savage, Mob.

warrior_trick_shot.name: Trick Shot
warrior_trick_shot.description: When showing off with a ranged weapon, convert any additional Difficulty imposed because of your showman - ship into Enhancement instead which may be spent on any Ranged Attack Stunt besides Inflict Damage. This applies before your roll.
warrior_trick_shot.mechanicalEffects: When showing off with a ranged weapon, convert any additional Difficulty imposed because of your showman - ship into Enhancement instead which may be spent on any Ranged Attack Stunt besides Inflict Damage. This applies before your roll.

warrior_twist_the_knife.name: Twist The Knife
warrior_twist_the_knife.description: You know just where to strike to make pain explode through your enemy. When your enemies have one or more Injury Conditions, your character gains access to the following Stunt: Painful Blow (3s): Increase the penalty imposed by the target’s Injury Conditions by 1 to a maximum of 2. Against Antagonists, impose a +1…
warrior_twist_the_knife.mechanicalEffects: You know just where to strike to make pain explode through your enemy. When your enemies have one or more Injury Conditions, your character gains access to the following Stunt: Painful Blow (3s): Increase the penalty imposed by the target’s Injury Conditions by 1 to a maximum of 2. Against Antagonists, impose a +1 Difficulty to all their actions.

warrior_army_of_one.name: Army Of One
warrior_army_of_one.description: When you fight outnumbered, you do not take any penalties or increased difficulty that being outnumbered would cause. You gain half your Legend, round up as an Enhance - ment to all attacks so long as there are more opponents present than you and your band. When fighting a greater force as a Feat of Scale, invoke your…
warrior_army_of_one.mechanicalEffects: When you fight outnumbered, you do not take any penalties or increased difficulty that being outnumbered would cause. You gain half your Legend, round up as an Enhance - ment to all attacks so long as there are more opponents present than you and your band. When fighting a greater force as a Feat of Scale, invoke your Legendary Title and imbue Legend instead of spending it.

warrior_eternitys_barracks.name: Eternity’S Barracks
warrior_eternitys_barracks.description: Blood, sweat, and effort suffuse the places you prepare for war, calling for other heroes to rise to the call of battle. Imbue Legend to consecrate a training ground, mustering field, barracks, or other place of martial training. Those readying for conflict benefit from additional Scale for confronting impossible odds…
warrior_eternitys_barracks.mechanicalEffects: Blood, sweat, and effort suffuse the places you prepare for war, calling for other heroes to rise to the call of battle. Imbue Legend to consecrate a training ground, mustering field, barracks, or other place of martial training. Those readying for conflict benefit from additional Scale for confronting impossible odds or epic foes. This may create a Realm Con - dition that reduces the cost for Epic Dexterity, Epic Strength, or War Divine Rule actions taken through it by 1.

warrior_gigantocide.name: Gigantocide
warrior_gigantocide.description: Commit Legend rather than spending Legend when you oppose an enormous Foe as Feat of Scale. If they possess segments, the first time in a turn you take out a segment, immediately take out an additional segment. If they count as a Goliath (Scion: Demigod p. 213), the first time you overcome a Milestone, immediately…
warrior_gigantocide.mechanicalEffects: Commit Legend rather than spending Legend when you oppose an enormous Foe as Feat of Scale. If they possess segments, the first time in a turn you take out a segment, immediately take out an additional segment. If they count as a Goliath (Scion: Demigod p. 213), the first time you overcome a Milestone, immediately overcome an additional Milestone.

warrior_hurl_to_the_moon.name: Hurl To The Moon
warrior_hurl_to_the_moon.description: Imbue a point of Legend instead of spending Legend to lift and throw objects with a Size rating higher than yours when performing a brute force Feat of Scale. Objects thrown this way can also be hurled to medium range. Outside of throwing a huge object, this Knack allows you to make all Thrown attacks at long range,…
warrior_hurl_to_the_moon.mechanicalEffects: Imbue a point of Legend instead of spending Legend to lift and throw objects with a Size rating higher than yours when performing a brute force Feat of Scale. Objects thrown this way can also be hurled to medium range. Outside of throwing a huge object, this Knack allows you to make all Thrown attacks at long range, regardless of the range tag on any weapon. You roll the attack as a normal for Thrown.

warrior_no_further.name: No Further
warrior_no_further.description: The Field you are fighting in becomes divine territory. Attacks your enemies make while in divine territory suffer from the Complication “Exposed” with a rating equal to your Warrior rating. If unresolved, they suffer the unresolved rating as an equal amount of the “Imperiled” condition. Imperiled: An Imperiled…
warrior_no_further.mechanicalEffects: The Field you are fighting in becomes divine territory. Attacks your enemies make while in divine territory suffer from the Complication “Exposed” with a rating equal to your Warrior rating. If unresolved, they suffer the unresolved rating as an equal amount of the “Imperiled” condition. Imperiled: An Imperiled character reduces their De - fense and the cost of the Critical/Critical Hit stunts by its rating; Imperiled reduces by 1 every time they take damage and resolves at 0. Imperiled specifically can reduce an affected character’s Defense to 0.

warrior_quitter.name: Quitter
warrior_quitter.description: One punch from you puts op - ponents on their backs. Make a Knack Skill roll when striking an SGC. On a success, knock prone an oppo - nent of a lower Tier, stunning them for a number of rounds equal to your Warrior dots. Opponents of equal or higher tier contest with Legend + Stamina vs. your Legend + Might.
warrior_quitter.mechanicalEffects: One punch from you puts op - ponents on their backs. Make a Knack Skill roll when striking an SGC. On a success, knock prone an oppo - nent of a lower Tier, stunning them for a number of rounds equal to your Warrior dots. Opponents of equal or higher tier contest with Legend + Stamina vs. your Legend + Might.

warrior_pleasure.name: Pleasure
warrior_pleasure.description: When you have someone at your mercy, either tied up or unconscious, you can inflict an Injury Condition on them to boost your Band’s morale. Everyone in the band gains +2 Enhancement to their actions for the rest of the scene. If the Injury Condition renders them Taken Out, gain +3 Enhancement instead.
warrior_pleasure.mechanicalEffects: When you have someone at your mercy, either tied up or unconscious, you can inflict an Injury Condition on them to boost your Band’s morale. Everyone in the band gains +2 Enhancement to their actions for the rest of the scene. If the Injury Condition renders them Taken Out, gain +3 Enhancement instead.

warrior_path_of_blades.name: Path Of Blades
warrior_path_of_blades.description: To approach you in battle is to court death. Spend Momentum. When an enemy attacks you they suffer Complication equal to your Warrior rating. They suffer any unresolved value as the Imperiled Condition.
warrior_path_of_blades.mechanicalEffects: To approach you in battle is to court death. Spend Momentum. When an enemy attacks you they suffer Complication equal to your Warrior rating. They suffer any unresolved value as the Imperiled Condition.

warrior_perfect_defense.name: Perfect Defense
warrior_perfect_defense.description: Once per fight, declare that an attack made against you by an enemy of the same Tier or lower does not affect you in any way. To do this a second time, spend Momentum. This may not be used more than twice a fight.
warrior_perfect_defense.mechanicalEffects: Once per fight, declare that an attack made against you by an enemy of the same Tier or lower does not affect you in any way. To do this a second time, spend Momentum. This may not be used more than twice a fight.

warrior_red_handed.name: Red Handed
warrior_red_handed.description: When you Take Out a character, you may immediately heal all your -0 and one -1 Injury Conditions. If they’re not a trivial character, you gain the higher of Enhancement 1 or your Legend on your next action. If they are of equal or higher-tier, you may regain Legend once per scene.
warrior_red_handed.mechanicalEffects: When you Take Out a character, you may immediately heal all your -0 and one -1 Injury Conditions. If they’re not a trivial character, you gain the higher of Enhancement 1 or your Legend on your next action. If they are of equal or higher-tier, you may regain Legend once per scene.

warrior_the_heavy_end_of_the_hammer.name: The Heavy End Of The Hammer
warrior_the_heavy_end_of_the_hammer.description: Your blows send enemies reeling, leaving them unprepared for what’s to come. You gain access to the following Stunt: Batter (Variable): For every success spent on this Stunt, the target gains a point of Imperiled at the end of your action.
warrior_the_heavy_end_of_the_hammer.mechanicalEffects: Your blows send enemies reeling, leaving them unprepared for what’s to come. You gain access to the following Stunt: Batter (Variable): For every success spent on this Stunt, the target gains a point of Imperiled at the end of your action.

warrior_theyre_everywhere.name: They’Re Everywhere
warrior_theyre_everywhere.description: The Field you are fighting in becomes divine territory. When an enemy enters divine territory, you have the option to make one attack against them, regardless of which range band they have entered, and which may not be boosted by any Knacks that allow you to make extra attacks. You use this ability even if you have…
warrior_theyre_everywhere.mechanicalEffects: The Field you are fighting in becomes divine territory. When an enemy enters divine territory, you have the option to make one attack against them, regardless of which range band they have entered, and which may not be boosted by any Knacks that allow you to make extra attacks. You use this ability even if you have already taken your action this round and may do so no matter how many enemies enter your di - vine territory, but you may only make one attack per enemy.

warrior_vanquish.name: Vanquish
warrior_vanquish.description: Once per session, you may declare a deadly blow against an opponent. They must choose: either immediately suffer Imperiled at your Warrior rating (Imperiled: An Imperiled character reduces their Defense and the cost of the Critical/ Critical Hit stunts by its rating; Imperiled reduces by 1 every time they take damage…
warrior_vanquish.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, you may declare a deadly blow against an opponent. They must choose: either immediately suffer Imperiled at your Warrior rating (Imperiled: An Imperiled character reduces their Defense and the cost of the Critical/ Critical Hit stunts by its rating; Imperiled reduces by 1 every time they take damage and resolves at 0. Imperiled specifically can reduce an affected character’s Defense to 0.), or their Defense counts as 0 against this attack. Characters whose defenses already count as 0 may not select the latter option.

warrior_divine_duel.name: Divine Duel
warrior_divine_duel.description: Once per scene, you may Imbue for Scale to fight a single opponent in a one-on-one battle. While bandmates and allies can offer magical help, for this Knack to be applicable any direct attacks must be limited to the two combatants.
warrior_divine_duel.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, you may Imbue for Scale to fight a single opponent in a one-on-one battle. While bandmates and allies can offer magical help, for this Knack to be applicable any direct attacks must be limited to the two combatants.

warrior_deterrence_policy.name: Deterrence Policy
warrior_deterrence_policy.description: Sometimes, the better you are at violence the less you need to use it, especially when your legendary reputation comes into play. Once per scene, Imbue for Scale to intimidate any opponent into backing down from a physical altercation. GOOD FIGHT! Legendary friendships are forged in heated battles. Once per arc, if…
warrior_deterrence_policy.mechanicalEffects: Sometimes, the better you are at violence the less you need to use it, especially when your legendary reputation comes into play. Once per scene, Imbue for Scale to intimidate any opponent into backing down from a physical altercation. GOOD FIGHT! Legendary friendships are forged in heated battles. Once per arc, if you win a one-on-one battle where you take at least two injury conditions, you may choose to Fatebind your opponent as a Boon Companion. Only one character may be Fatebound as such at a time, but they do not count against your maximum number of Fatebinding conditions. The strength of the Fatebinding is equal to your dots in the Warrior Calling, and this companion alone may be invoked twice in a session for aid.

warrior_punch_the_problem.name: Punch The Problem
warrior_punch_the_problem.description: Whether shooting a traffic light, solving a complex knot by cutting it in half, or punching a jukebox to play your lover’s favorite song, you are able to solve a non-vi - olent problem with violence. Once per session, you may substitute any dice roll with your favorite attack roll, along with any of its usual…
warrior_punch_the_problem.mechanicalEffects: Whether shooting a traffic light, solving a complex knot by cutting it in half, or punching a jukebox to play your lover’s favorite song, you are able to solve a non-vi - olent problem with violence. Once per session, you may substitute any dice roll with your favorite attack roll, along with any of its usual Enhancements.

warrior_size_them_up.name: Size Them Up
warrior_size_them_up.description: This isn’t your first rodeo. Once per session, you may look at a single antagonist and immediately know their Qualities, Flairs, and what abilities constitute their pools.
warrior_size_them_up.mechanicalEffects: This isn’t your first rodeo. Once per session, you may look at a single antagonist and immediately know their Qualities, Flairs, and what abilities constitute their pools.

warrior_your_fate_is_sealed.name: Your Fate Is Sealed
warrior_your_fate_is_sealed.description: When a warrior of the Tengri truly needs to kill their enemy, they pronounce the fate of a weapon’s blow. They might tell an arrow that its Fate is to pierce the enemy’s brain, tell their sword that its Fate is to slay or even inform their fists that their Fate is to seize the heart of the foe. You may call on this…
warrior_your_fate_is_sealed.mechanicalEffects: When a warrior of the Tengri truly needs to kill their enemy, they pronounce the fate of a weapon’s blow. They might tell an arrow that its Fate is to pierce the enemy’s brain, tell their sword that its Fate is to slay or even inform their fists that their Fate is to seize the heart of the foe. You may call on this power whenever you would gain Legend from a Fatebinding. Instead of gaining that Legend, you may select a single foe present in the scene and pronounce their Fate to your weapons. For the rest of the scene, that foe cannot get any defensive benefits from Tension spending whatsoever

warrior_tuatha_specific_the_riastradh.name: Tuatha-Specific: The Riastradh
warrior_tuatha_specific_the_riastradh.description: Like Cuchulain, you have mastered the horrifying “warp spasm.” Once per session, you may imbue a Legend point to frenzy yourself into the Riadstradh Condition as a Simple action. If you break a geis under the Condition, it resolves immediately and the legend becomes spent.
warrior_tuatha_specific_the_riastradh.mechanicalEffects: Like Cuchulain, you have mastered the horrifying “warp spasm.” Once per session, you may imbue a Legend point to frenzy yourself into the Riadstradh Condition as a Simple action. If you break a geis under the Condition, it resolves immediately and the legend becomes spent.

warrior_sir_specific_not_like_this.name: Sir-Specific: Not Like This
warrior_sir_specific_not_like_this.description: If an attack would give you a Maimed-or-higher In - jury Condition, but does not line up with your destined fate, spend a point of Momentum to ignore the damage. However, whether this Knack is activated or not, the first time in an arc when an attack does fall under your fate, take the injury as a persistent condition…
warrior_sir_specific_not_like_this.mechanicalEffects: If an attack would give you a Maimed-or-higher In - jury Condition, but does not line up with your destined fate, spend a point of Momentum to ignore the damage. However, whether this Knack is activated or not, the first time in an arc when an attack does fall under your fate, take the injury as a persistent condition and add one point to the Tension pool. This injury condition does not count toward your health boxes. he following Knacks apply to characters who possess one or more Titan Callings.

adversary_all_those_lovely_enemies.name: All Those Lovely Enemies
adversary_all_those_lovely_enemies.description: You sniff out enmity. Pick one target in a scene; you know anyone who they have serious negative feelings for (an Attitude of at least –2 or worse), and anyone else present who has negative attitudes towards your target. If your tar - get has an Attitude of 2 or higher towards you (negative or positive), this works…
adversary_all_those_lovely_enemies.mechanicalEffects: You sniff out enmity. Pick one target in a scene; you know anyone who they have serious negative feelings for (an Attitude of at least –2 or worse), and anyone else present who has negative attitudes towards your target. If your tar - get has an Attitude of 2 or higher towards you (negative or positive), this works automatically. If not, make a Knack Skill roll, with a Difficulty equal to their Tier.

adversary_cant_kill_the_rooster.name: Can’T Kill The Rooster
adversary_cant_kill_the_rooster.description: Spend Momentum during combat to gain Enhancement to your Defense equal to the Attitude targets have towards you for the scene. (a general Hatred of Scions would not apply, but a specific hate of your character would, for example.)
adversary_cant_kill_the_rooster.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum during combat to gain Enhancement to your Defense equal to the Attitude targets have towards you for the scene. (a general Hatred of Scions would not apply, but a specific hate of your character would, for example.)

adversary_enemy_of_my_enemy.name: Enemy Of My Enemy
adversary_enemy_of_my_enemy.description: You automatically know when you meet a character who shares one of your negative Attitudes towards a specific person or group, and a successful Read Attitude action re - veals useful or interesting memories about the reasons for that dislike. Characters of a higher Tier can conceal this with a Clash of Wills.
adversary_enemy_of_my_enemy.mechanicalEffects: You automatically know when you meet a character who shares one of your negative Attitudes towards a specific person or group, and a successful Read Attitude action re - veals useful or interesting memories about the reasons for that dislike. Characters of a higher Tier can conceal this with a Clash of Wills.

adversary_familiar_wounds.name: Familiar Wounds
adversary_familiar_wounds.description: When you make an attack against a target with a weap - on owned by someone with at least a +2 Positive attitude towards the target, you may choose to change the damage type between Bashing, Lethal, and Aggravated freely, and you may give the weapon the Brutal or Piercing tag. If you are the owner of a weapon you use…
adversary_familiar_wounds.mechanicalEffects: When you make an attack against a target with a weap - on owned by someone with at least a +2 Positive attitude towards the target, you may choose to change the damage type between Bashing, Lethal, and Aggravated freely, and you may give the weapon the Brutal or Piercing tag. If you are the owner of a weapon you use with this Knack, the weapon is destroyed after a causing an Injury, Fate recoiling on it.

adversary_i_know_your_fancy_moves.name: I Know Your Fancy Moves
adversary_i_know_your_fancy_moves.description: Your insight into your foe gives you an edge you can use to cut them. Spend 1 Momentum to learn the names and values of a foe’s dice pools.
adversary_i_know_your_fancy_moves.mechanicalEffects: Your insight into your foe gives you an edge you can use to cut them. Spend 1 Momentum to learn the names and values of a foe’s dice pools.

adversary_lets_contain_multitudes.name: Let’S Contain Multitudes
adversary_lets_contain_multitudes.description: You may possess both positive and negative Attitudes towards an individual or organization and choose which applies for any given intrigue roll. You may choose to create corresponding Attitudes in a target when using the Shift Attitude roll, in which case a successful roll creates an additional Attitude rather than…
adversary_lets_contain_multitudes.mechanicalEffects: You may possess both positive and negative Attitudes towards an individual or organization and choose which applies for any given intrigue roll. You may choose to create corresponding Attitudes in a target when using the Shift Attitude roll, in which case a successful roll creates an additional Attitude rather than shifting their existing feelings. For ex - ample, if a character had an Attitude –2 of serious loathing towards you, you use Shift Attitude to create a matching Attitude +2 for being strangely compelling or too annoying to kill. If you do this, your target may not use their Attitude enhancement when trying to resist your Shift Attitude roll.

adversary_my_misfortune_is_your_misfortu.name: My Misfortune Is Your Misfortune
adversary_my_misfortune_is_your_misfortu.description: Spend Momentum when a character imposes a Complication on you, redirecting it to themselves or someone they care about in the scene. Your first use of this Knack in a scene is free.
adversary_my_misfortune_is_your_misfortu.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum when a character imposes a Complication on you, redirecting it to themselves or someone they care about in the scene. Your first use of this Knack in a scene is free.

adversary_no_champion_unchallenged.name: No Champion Unchallenged
adversary_no_champion_unchallenged.description: Once per scene, spend Momentum when you challenge a character with an Attitude of 2 or higher or -2 or lower toward you to a contest or fight. If the Storyguide decides they are categorically unable to accept or compete, regain the Momentum. If they accept, gain your Adversary rating in Enhancement to opposed or…
adversary_no_champion_unchallenged.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, spend Momentum when you challenge a character with an Attitude of 2 or higher or -2 or lower toward you to a contest or fight. If the Storyguide decides they are categorically unable to accept or compete, regain the Momentum. If they accept, gain your Adversary rating in Enhancement to opposed or Complex actions to defeat them outside of combat, or to your Defense against charac - ters other than the challenged character in combat. If they refuse, choose one: Regain 1 Legend. Cause other characters present to gain a 1 point Attitude of shame toward your tar - get, or increase one if it already existed. Increase or decrease an attitude your target holds to you by 1.

adversary_nothing_is_inevitable.name: Nothing Is Inevitable
adversary_nothing_is_inevitable.description: When you spare the life of a defeated enemy who has a negative Attitude towards you, you gain the Condition “Force of Opposition.” This grants you +2 Enhancement to any rolls related to thwarting that enemy’s plans or aiding their other enemies, applied before you roll. You may resolve this Condition at any time to…
adversary_nothing_is_inevitable.mechanicalEffects: When you spare the life of a defeated enemy who has a negative Attitude towards you, you gain the Condition “Force of Opposition.” This grants you +2 Enhancement to any rolls related to thwarting that enemy’s plans or aiding their other enemies, applied before you roll. You may resolve this Condition at any time to heal all damage conditions they or their allies have dealt to you. Otherwise, it resolves at the end of the story.

adversary_perfectly_symmetrical_violence.name: Perfectly Symmetrical Violence
adversary_perfectly_symmetrical_violence.description: When a character injures you, spend 2 Momentum to make an immediate attack against them. This does not re - quire a mixed action, and you can use it even if you’ve al - ready acted in the round.
adversary_perfectly_symmetrical_violence.mechanicalEffects: When a character injures you, spend 2 Momentum to make an immediate attack against them. This does not re - quire a mixed action, and you can use it even if you’ve al - ready acted in the round.

adversary_pride_before_a_fall.name: Pride Before A Fall
adversary_pride_before_a_fall.description: When a character you have a negative attitude towards takes an action with Enhancement, you may spend Momentum to inflict a dice penalty equal to the Enhancement (to a maximum of your Adversary rating). If this causes them to fail, they do so in an especially ironic, embarrassing, or tragic way. Your first use of this…
adversary_pride_before_a_fall.mechanicalEffects: When a character you have a negative attitude towards takes an action with Enhancement, you may spend Momentum to inflict a dice penalty equal to the Enhancement (to a maximum of your Adversary rating). If this causes them to fail, they do so in an especially ironic, embarrassing, or tragic way. Your first use of this Knack in a scene is free.

adversary_sudden_but_inevitable.name: Sudden But Inevitable
adversary_sudden_but_inevitable.description: When you attack a target who has a positive Attitude towards you, whether physically in combat or socially in intrigue, you may add that Attitude’s rating as Enhancement. In many cases, this will result in the target removing that Attitude, and replacing it with a negative Attitude.
adversary_sudden_but_inevitable.mechanicalEffects: When you attack a target who has a positive Attitude towards you, whether physically in combat or socially in intrigue, you may add that Attitude’s rating as Enhancement. In many cases, this will result in the target removing that Attitude, and replacing it with a negative Attitude.

adversary_true_friendship.name: True Friendship
adversary_true_friendship.description: During intrigue, you may treat positive Attitudes to - wards an individual as Enhancement for encouraging the belief “acting against my friend’s desires is in their best interest” or encouraging the behavior “I will oppose my friend’s desires as soon as I possibly can,” instead of your target gaining that Attitude as…
adversary_true_friendship.mechanicalEffects: During intrigue, you may treat positive Attitudes to - wards an individual as Enhancement for encouraging the belief “acting against my friend’s desires is in their best interest” or encouraging the behavior “I will oppose my friend’s desires as soon as I possibly can,” instead of your target gaining that Attitude as Enhancement to resist your roll.

adversary_you_need_haters.name: You Need Haters
adversary_you_need_haters.description: Haters keep you sharp, and you make sure your enemies have plenty of haters. On a successful Knack Skill roll, in - crease the difficulty for one target to shift attitude in their favor up to your Adversary dots. You may spend 1 Momen - tum to affect multiple characters. You don’t need to spend Momentum if the…
adversary_you_need_haters.mechanicalEffects: Haters keep you sharp, and you make sure your enemies have plenty of haters. On a successful Knack Skill roll, in - crease the difficulty for one target to shift attitude in their favor up to your Adversary dots. You may spend 1 Momen - tum to affect multiple characters. You don’t need to spend Momentum if the additional targets are trivial characters.

adversary_another_price_to_pay.name: Another Price To Pay
adversary_another_price_to_pay.description: When you warn someone off a course of action, the price for ignoring you is painful indeed. When you take the complicate action, create an additional “Painful Price” Complication at the same rating. The enemy suffers an Injury and −1 to their defense if the Complication isn’t resolved. The defense penalty can stack up…
adversary_another_price_to_pay.mechanicalEffects: When you warn someone off a course of action, the price for ignoring you is painful indeed. When you take the complicate action, create an additional “Painful Price” Complication at the same rating. The enemy suffers an Injury and −1 to their defense if the Complication isn’t resolved. The defense penalty can stack up to three times and resolves at the end of the scene. AT YOUR SIDE, IN YOUR WAY Whenever someone you have a negative Attitude to - wards is in mortal peril, or someone you have a positive At - titude towards is about to succeed at a major goal, you know that it’s occurring — though not the details of the event. You may spend Momentum to appear in their scene, as long as you are both in the same World or within five days travel in the same Otherworld. Note: This may apply to other players’ characters (especially if they’re about to achieve a Deed) with that player’s permission.

adversary_a_wicked_idea.name: A Wicked Idea
adversary_a_wicked_idea.description: Spend Momentum to suggest a dangerous, outlandish, or malicious course of action, passing it off as just a joke. The next time the target has a good opportunity to follow your suggestion, they suffer a +2 Complication to all actions for the rest of the scene as they’re distracted by mustering their self-control. If…
adversary_a_wicked_idea.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to suggest a dangerous, outlandish, or malicious course of action, passing it off as just a joke. The next time the target has a good opportunity to follow your suggestion, they suffer a +2 Complication to all actions for the rest of the scene as they’re distracted by mustering their self-control. If not bought off, these Complications lead them to slip unintended information, waste opportunities, overlook obvious details, or reveal what they’re thinking of at the worst moment in their distraction. Characters of a higher Tier can resist with a Clash of Wills, pitting their Composure + Legend against your Manipulation + Legend.

adversary_contra_mundum.name: Contra Mundum
adversary_contra_mundum.description: Opposing the World is easy, because the World always opposes itself. Pick an individual, organization, or thing. Your actions to rally characters or items against that target increase their Scale for leadership purposes by your Tier or your target’s Attitude towards you, whichever is higher. You may spend Momentum to…
adversary_contra_mundum.mechanicalEffects: Opposing the World is easy, because the World always opposes itself. Pick an individual, organization, or thing. Your actions to rally characters or items against that target increase their Scale for leadership purposes by your Tier or your target’s Attitude towards you, whichever is higher. You may spend Momentum to change your target for Contra Mundum once a session.

adversary_enemies_forever.name: Enemies Forever
adversary_enemies_forever.description: Pick a target who has at an Attitude of –2 or worse towards you. Neither you nor your target can die unless the other does the killing, or you are both somehow killed simultaneously. This Knack can target only a single target at a time, which you may change once per session.
adversary_enemies_forever.mechanicalEffects: Pick a target who has at an Attitude of –2 or worse towards you. Neither you nor your target can die unless the other does the killing, or you are both somehow killed simultaneously. This Knack can target only a single target at a time, which you may change once per session.

adversary_evil_appearing.name: Evil Appearing
adversary_evil_appearing.description: When you initiate combat or intrigue with an unsus - pecting target, all characters of a lower Tier must either abandon them, refuse to intervene, or suffer +2 Difficulty on all their rolls in the Scene. If the target has a positive Atti - tude towards you, they suffer the Complication “Collateral Betrayal” at a…
adversary_evil_appearing.mechanicalEffects: When you initiate combat or intrigue with an unsus - pecting target, all characters of a lower Tier must either abandon them, refuse to intervene, or suffer +2 Difficulty on all their rolls in the Scene. If the target has a positive Atti - tude towards you, they suffer the Complication “Collateral Betrayal” at a rating of their Attitude for the scene. It turns lower Tier characters against them until bought off. If the target has a negative Attitude towards you, they suffer the Complication “Blinded by Anger” at a rating of their Atti - tude for the Scene. It reduces their Defense in Combat or resistance pool in intrigue for the next roll by the remaining rating if not fully bought off.

adversary_fever_ridden.name: Fever-Ridden
adversary_fever_ridden.description: Bogovoi-Specific Likhoradka is known to possess others in the form of a spiritual disease. Spend Momentum to transform into an infectious cloud, inhabiting a character within Short range. For the duration, you share all of their senses. Once per scene while infecting them, you may make an influence roll to convince…
adversary_fever_ridden.mechanicalEffects: Bogovoi-Specific Likhoradka is known to possess others in the form of a spiritual disease. Spend Momentum to transform into an infectious cloud, inhabiting a character within Short range. For the duration, you share all of their senses. Once per scene while infecting them, you may make an influence roll to convince them to do something; if they don’t know you’re inside them — because you afflicted them in their sleep — you gain +2 Enhancement. Because you exist as a fever inside of them, powers that heal diseases exorcise you; otherwise, charac - ters roll Integrity + Stamina after a day’s rest; once they’ve accumulated your Legend in successes, you are forced out. Characters of your Tier or higher can resist infection with a Clash of Wills.

adversary_from_hells_heart.name: From Hell’S Heart
adversary_from_hells_heart.description: The distance your combat or intrigue actions can affect a target increases based on their Attitude towards you. At Attitude 2, your combat actions can target them up to long range in combat and your intrigue actions can affect them at any distance they could normally perceive you from, without penalty. At Attitude 3,…
adversary_from_hells_heart.mechanicalEffects: The distance your combat or intrigue actions can affect a target increases based on their Attitude towards you. At Attitude 2, your combat actions can target them up to long range in combat and your intrigue actions can affect them at any distance they could normally perceive you from, without penalty. At Attitude 3, you can target them from anywhere within extreme range. At Attitude 4, anywhere on the same continent. At Attitude 5, anywhere in the World, or anywhere within five days travel in an Otherworld. They may attempt a counterattack or social action at the same range after you make an attack, however, and after you have successfully at - tacked or influenced a target at this range, you can’t use this power again against the same target for the rest of the session.

adversary_inside_their_heads.name: Inside Their Heads
adversary_inside_their_heads.description: Once you’ve wormed into someone’s heart, you’re al - ways in sync with its beats. Characters who have Attitudes towards you of +2 or higher suffer your Adversary rating in additional Difficulty when trying to lie to or deceive you. In Divine Rule play, you can always detect their actions within a given realm unless…
adversary_inside_their_heads.mechanicalEffects: Once you’ve wormed into someone’s heart, you’re al - ways in sync with its beats. Characters who have Attitudes towards you of +2 or higher suffer your Adversary rating in additional Difficulty when trying to lie to or deceive you. In Divine Rule play, you can always detect their actions within a given realm unless their approach is subtle or stealthy.

adversary_lovely_plans_and_wicked_plots.name: Lovely Plans And Wicked Plots
adversary_lovely_plans_and_wicked_plots.description: Few things bring people closer together than bringing down someone everyone hates. Imbue Legend to consecrate a dire plot, fiendish plan, or foul conspiracy. Those taking part gain additional Scale for epic or grandiose measure taken against the target of the plot. Pick a Purview when taking this Knack; when you…
adversary_lovely_plans_and_wicked_plots.mechanicalEffects: Few things bring people closer together than bringing down someone everyone hates. Imbue Legend to consecrate a dire plot, fiendish plan, or foul conspiracy. Those taking part gain additional Scale for epic or grandiose measure taken against the target of the plot. Pick a Purview when taking this Knack; when you create a Realm Condition with that Purview that would benefit from a sprawling conspiracy or intricate plot, increase its effect by 1.

adversary_my_best_enemy.name: My Best Enemy
adversary_my_best_enemy.description: You can have a number of temporary Fatebindings equal to your Adversary rating in addition to your usual limit. These temporary Fatebindings can’t be raised above 3. Characters of your Tier or higher can resist with a Clash of Wills. For the Fatebinding’s duration (based on its Strength), see Scion: Hero, p. 197 .

adversary_nothing_is_forbidden.name: Nothing Is Forbidden
adversary_nothing_is_forbidden.description: Against targets with an Attitude of 2 or higher towards you, you gain access to the following stunts in combat: Blood Like Wine (variable): Immediately resolve this as an Influence action with the number of successes spent on it against the target. And the following stunt in intrigue: Tears Like Honey (variable):…
adversary_nothing_is_forbidden.mechanicalEffects: Against targets with an Attitude of 2 or higher towards you, you gain access to the following stunts in combat: Blood Like Wine (variable): Immediately resolve this as an Influence action with the number of successes spent on it against the target. And the following stunt in intrigue: Tears Like Honey (variable): Immediately resolve this as an Inflict Damage stunt with the number of successes spent on it against the target. Bystanders must successfully Clash of Wills against you to understand the nature of what transpired in either case.

adversary_opposition_without_limit.name: Opposition Without Limit
adversary_opposition_without_limit.description: When you command, rally, or intrigue enormous forces to oppose another character, imbue, rather than spend, a point of Legend to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
adversary_opposition_without_limit.mechanicalEffects: When you command, rally, or intrigue enormous forces to oppose another character, imbue, rather than spend, a point of Legend to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

adversary_ruin_your_life.name: Ruin Your Life
adversary_ruin_your_life.description: Netjer-Specific With cunning like Isfet, you adopt an enemy’s identity to ruin their life. Gain Enhancement equal to their negative attitude towards you on any roll to convince others you’re them, with access to the following Stunts: Not a Trace (1s): Any physical and electronic evidence you leave behind is flimsy at…
adversary_ruin_your_life.mechanicalEffects: Netjer-Specific With cunning like Isfet, you adopt an enemy’s identity to ruin their life. Gain Enhancement equal to their negative attitude towards you on any roll to convince others you’re them, with access to the following Stunts: Not a Trace (1s): Any physical and electronic evidence you leave behind is flimsy at best — fingerprints are incom - plete, security footage is too grainy to make an Id, and so on. The Wrong Trace Entirely (3s): A piece of evidence you leave behind magically changes to implicate someone else — putting their prints on the gun or their metadata on the file.

adversary_satisfaction_or_the_knife.name: Satisfaction Or The Knife
adversary_satisfaction_or_the_knife.description: Once per session, when you demand something from someone with an Attitude of 2 or higher towards you, they must choose to either admit your righteousness or your might. If they admit your righteousness, you gain +1 Scale for purposes of convincing them in intrigue for the rest of the session; if they admit your might,…
adversary_satisfaction_or_the_knife.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, when you demand something from someone with an Attitude of 2 or higher towards you, they must choose to either admit your righteousness or your might. If they admit your righteousness, you gain +1 Scale for purposes of convincing them in intrigue for the rest of the session; if they admit your might, you gain that Scale instead for purposes of combat against them. You may not attempt to influence which they choose with intrigue or supernatural suasion.

adversary_their_shoulders.name: Their Shoulders
adversary_their_shoulders.description: When directly opposing a character or their plans who possesses a positive Attitude toward you, you may spend Momentum. Increase the Scale of your actions to oppose them by the rating of their attitude, up to a maximum of their own relevant Scale. This includes any Scale they benefit from due to outside sources, such…
adversary_their_shoulders.mechanicalEffects: When directly opposing a character or their plans who possesses a positive Attitude toward you, you may spend Momentum. Increase the Scale of your actions to oppose them by the rating of their attitude, up to a maximum of their own relevant Scale. This includes any Scale they benefit from due to outside sources, such as equipment or favorable conditions. THAT VENOM, DECEPTION Pālas-Specific Spend 1 Momentum to gain +2 Enhancement on rolls to spread gossip about someone. Anyone who believes the gossip is compelled to share it with others. Characters of your Tier or higher can resist with a Clash of Wills (your Manipulation + Legend vs their Composure + Legend). If the subject of the gossip has a negative attitude towards you or is trivial, this Knack is free.

adversary_wrath_is_sustenance.name: Wrath Is Sustenance
adversary_wrath_is_sustenance.description: K’uh-Specific Like Vucub Caquix, you can subsist on enmity alone. You reduce penalties based on fatigue, hunger, and other needs by your highest negative attitude. You may add your Adversary rating as an Enhancement to a contested roll against a character to whom you have a negative attitude.

destroyer_all_fall_down.name: All Fall Down
destroyer_all_fall_down.description: When purchasing the Knockdown or Shove Stunts, you may grant yourself the Shockwave tag, applying the same Stunt against everyone at close range with Defense equal to or less than your original target. If you spend Momentum, it applies at short range instead, affecting up to (Destroyer) non-trivial targets.

destroyer_asphalt_apocalypse.name: Asphalt Apocalypse
destroyer_asphalt_apocalypse.description: Spend Momentum to either tear up everything around you out to short range, or everything in a direct line from you out to long range. Anyone caught in the effect is knocked back one range band, and the affected area becomes difficult terrain.
destroyer_asphalt_apocalypse.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to either tear up everything around you out to short range, or everything in a direct line from you out to long range. Anyone caught in the effect is knocked back one range band, and the affected area becomes difficult terrain.

destroyer_baneful_touch.name: Baneful Touch
destroyer_baneful_touch.description: When you touch someone, spend Momentum to curse their body, mind, or will. They suffer +1 Difficulty to either Physical, Social, or Mental actions as a special cursed Condition until you either grant them mercy or they receive supernatural healing from someone of your Tier or higher. Char - acters may only be affected…
destroyer_baneful_touch.mechanicalEffects: When you touch someone, spend Momentum to curse their body, mind, or will. They suffer +1 Difficulty to either Physical, Social, or Mental actions as a special cursed Condition until you either grant them mercy or they receive supernatural healing from someone of your Tier or higher. Char - acters may only be affected by one iteration of this Knack at a time, even if targeted by different Scions. The Momentum cost is waived against trivial characters.

destroyer_bust_down_the_walls.name: Bust Down The Walls
destroyer_bust_down_the_walls.description: You gain +2 Enhancement on actions to brute force your way through obstacles, whether you’re breaking down doors, muscling past the bouncer, or barreling down a boo - by-trapped hallway. If you spend Momentum, this Enhancement applies before the roll.
destroyer_bust_down_the_walls.mechanicalEffects: You gain +2 Enhancement on actions to brute force your way through obstacles, whether you’re breaking down doors, muscling past the bouncer, or barreling down a boo - by-trapped hallway. If you spend Momentum, this Enhancement applies before the roll.

destroyer_break_the_aegis.name: Break The Aegis
destroyer_break_the_aegis.description: Shields, armor, walls — all are as dust before the De - stroyer. After a successful attack, you gain access to the following stunts: No Shelter (1s or 3s): Destroy the target’s cover, and any other potential source of cover in close range. If the target has Heavy cover, this costs three successes. Rend and Rust (1s):…
destroyer_break_the_aegis.mechanicalEffects: Shields, armor, walls — all are as dust before the De - stroyer. After a successful attack, you gain access to the following stunts: No Shelter (1s or 3s): Destroy the target’s cover, and any other potential source of cover in close range. If the target has Heavy cover, this costs three successes. Rend and Rust (1s): Lower the value of a target’s Soft or Hard armor tag by one until the end of the fight. You can pur - chase this stunt multiple times to degrade more powerful armor.

destroyer_entropic_eye.name: Entropic Eye
destroyer_entropic_eye.description: Once per scene, you may roll your Knack Skill to examine nearby vulnerabilities. You may spend a banked success to ask one of the following questions and get an accurate, useful answer from the Storyteller. When you act on these answers or advise another character to do so, gain +1 Enhancement. What vulnerabilities…
destroyer_entropic_eye.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, you may roll your Knack Skill to examine nearby vulnerabilities. You may spend a banked success to ask one of the following questions and get an accurate, useful answer from the Storyteller. When you act on these answers or advise another character to do so, gain +1 Enhancement. What vulnerabilities does this (character, object, or struc - ture) have? How can I inflict maximum damage against this (character, object, or structure)? Where is this (character, object, or structure)’s blind spot? What here can give me an advantage against this (character, object, or structure)?

destroyer_it_all_ends_in_silence.name: It All Ends In Silence
destroyer_it_all_ends_in_silence.description: Spend Momentum to create a Field that suppresses sound throughout the scene, granting +1 Enhancement to all Stealth rolls. Characters attempting to make noise suffer a +3 Complication; if not bought off, their words can’t be heard beyond Short range. JURACÁN’S DANCE Zemí-Specific Like Juracán’s storm-calling dance,…
destroyer_it_all_ends_in_silence.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to create a Field that suppresses sound throughout the scene, granting +1 Enhancement to all Stealth rolls. JURACÁN’S DANCE Zemí-Specific Like Juracán’s storm-calling dance, you may destroy not just with violence, but with art. You gain +2 Enhancement to encourage destructive or revolutionary behavior through performance or art or to create an atmosphere of outrage or violence. Characters who embrace this mission gain +1 En - hancement to their attacks against the target, bolstered by your divine power.

destroyer_mantle_of_unmaking.name: Mantle Of Unmaking
destroyer_mantle_of_unmaking.description: You have +1 Defense against attacks made at close range. When you use the Disarm Stunt ( Scion: Origin , p. 116), you may destroy a mundane weapon instead of simply disarming it.
destroyer_mantle_of_unmaking.mechanicalEffects: You have +1 Defense against attacks made at close range. When you use the Disarm Stunt ( Scion: Origin , p. 116), you may destroy a mundane weapon instead of simply disarming it.

destroyer_not_a_trace.name: Not A Trace
destroyer_not_a_trace.description: At the end of a scene, you destroy all physical evidence you were present — fingerprints, DNA, and even electronic security recordings are all wiped away, but individual char - acters remember you just fine.
destroyer_not_a_trace.mechanicalEffects: At the end of a scene, you destroy all physical evidence you were present — fingerprints, DNA, and even electronic security recordings are all wiped away, but individual char - acters remember you just fine.

destroyer_not_today.name: Not Today
destroyer_not_today.description: You put your life on the line on a daily basis. This time might be the last, but you won’t let them perish. When

destroyer_on_sight.name: On Sight
destroyer_on_sight.description: You mark a target for destruction. Make a Knack Skill roll. At some point within the next day, a group of SGC characters attack the target. You don’t need to be present for the attack, and it doesn’t need to be physical in nature. You can choose to have the target beat down by assassins, cops, amazons, or bouncers;…
destroyer_on_sight.mechanicalEffects: You mark a target for destruction. Make a Knack Skill roll. At some point within the next day, a group of SGC characters attack the target. You don’t need to be present for the attack, and it doesn’t need to be physical in nature. You can choose to have the target beat down by assassins, cops, amazons, or bouncers; socially canceled by trendsetters, Nymphstagram influencers, or socialites; or made the laughingstock of their chosen professional community. Physical attacks are quick beatings resulting in 1 damage for every success on your Knack Skill roll. Social or mental assaults come in the form of several verbal jabs in rapid succession adding +1 difficulty to their next relevant action. Characters of a higher Tier resist with a Clash of Wills.

destroyer_out_of_my_way.name: Out Of My Way
destroyer_out_of_my_way.description: You smash through obstacles between you and your target, denying them cover. As a simple or mixed action, roll an attack against cover (Defense 1) or a character. If you attack cover, you deal 2 Injuries per success. If you attack a char - acter, you reduce any Enhancements they may have from environmental factors or…
destroyer_out_of_my_way.mechanicalEffects: You smash through obstacles between you and your target, denying them cover. As a simple or mixed action, roll an attack against cover (Defense 1) or a character. If you attack cover, you deal 2 Injuries per success. If you attack a char - acter, you reduce any Enhancements they may have from environmental factors or allies by −1 for every 2 successes.

destroyer_sever_the_ties.name: Sever The Ties
destroyer_sever_the_ties.description: Whenever you use the Shift Attitude stunt to under - mine a character’s loyalty, affection, or other connection to a person or organization, you may spend Momentum to shift it an additional point. If this reduces it to zero or less, any attempts to rebuild that attitude (or a related one) during the rest of the season…
destroyer_sever_the_ties.mechanicalEffects: Whenever you use the Shift Attitude stunt to under - mine a character’s loyalty, affection, or other connection to a person or organization, you may spend Momentum to shift it an additional point. If this reduces it to zero or less, any attempts to rebuild that attitude (or a related one) during the rest of the season increase their difficulty by 2. Your first use of this Knack in a scene is free.

destroyer_shattering_grasp.name: Shattering Grasp
destroyer_shattering_grasp.description: When you lay hands on an object or structure with a size-based Scale less than your Destroyer dots, roll Knack Skill. With any successes, it shatters instantly. Spend Mo - mentum and destroy any object you can perceive without needing to touch it.
destroyer_shattering_grasp.mechanicalEffects: When you lay hands on an object or structure with a size-based Scale less than your Destroyer dots, roll Knack Skill. With any successes, it shatters instantly. Spend Mo - mentum and destroy any object you can perceive without needing to touch it.

destroyer_thresher_of_lives.name: Thresher Of Lives
destroyer_thresher_of_lives.description: When you defeat an enemy character, pick another target. Reduce their Defense and the cost of the Critical stunt against them by 1 until they suffer damage or the scene ends.
destroyer_thresher_of_lives.mechanicalEffects: When you defeat an enemy character, pick another target. Reduce their Defense and the cost of the Critical stunt against them by 1 until they suffer damage or the scene ends.

destroyer_what_you_fear_losing.name: What You Fear Losing
destroyer_what_you_fear_losing.description: When you take a Read Attitude action against a character, you also intuit something in the scene they would fear to lose. You gain a +2 Enhancement to threats you make that endanger the target, and the character can’t use their nega - tive attitude towards you.

destroyer_apex_of_ruin.name: Apex Of Ruin
destroyer_apex_of_ruin.description: Even if a foe is ignorant of your nature, their weapons recognize your brutal supremacy, wasting away as they strike at you. This doesn’t actually produce a literal weapon, but if you make a finger gun at someone, they’ll still end up with a gunshot wound, no bullets required. This Knack cannot be enhanced by Master of Weapons.

destroyer_by_will_alone.name: By Will Alone
destroyer_by_will_alone.description: Choose a number of non-Birthright weapons equal to your Destroyer dots. destroyer_craters_for_footprints.name: Craters For Footprints
destroyer_craters_for_footprints.description: Your pathway is a rubble strewn wake. Whenever you enter a new location (including moving a range band in combat), you crack pavement, shatter glass, and create an area of difficult terrain covering the range bands you moved through that doesn’t affect you wherever you end the movement. Whenever you enter a new location (including moving a range band in combat), you crack pavement, shatter glass, and create an area of difficult terrain covering the range bands you moved through that doesn’t affect you wherever you end the movement. You may consciously suppress this effect for a scene with a Knack Skill roll. In Divine Rule play, whenever you create a Realm Condition with the Personal Aura stunt, it automatically benefits from one purchase of the Dire Hazard stunt.

destroyer_crushing_aura.name: Crushing Aura
destroyer_crushing_aura.description: Anyone in close range of you is subject to dangerous terrain, which causes a +1 Injury if not bought off. You may reflexively designate up to your Destroyer dots in characters who are immune to this aura, so be careful around houseg - uests and crowds.

destroyer_embrace_the_end.description: Y azata-Specific Like Zarik, your touch is heavy with the inevitability of death. When you make an attack, you gain access to the following stunts to infect and wither your foe: Festering Wound (1s): Injury Conditions inflicted by this attack heal at half the usual rate, and attempts to treat them suffer +2 difficulty. Decay of Age (3s): Until the Injury Conditions inflicted by this attack are healed, the target suffers a −1 penalty to a physical Attribute of your choice.

destroyer_herald_of_the_end.name: Herald Of The End
destroyer_herald_of_the_end.description: When you work to destroy a person, place, or thing that can be measured with Scale (overthrowing a World leader, razing a city, or bankrupting a multinational corporation), you may imbue, rather than spend, a point of Legend to in - voke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
