destroyer_herald_of_the_end.mechanicalEffects: When you work to destroy a person, place, or thing that can be measured with Scale (overthrowing a World leader, razing a city, or bankrupting a multinational corporation), you may imbue, rather than spend, a point of Legend to in - voke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

destroyer_in_a_black_flash.name: In A Black Flash
destroyer_in_a_black_flash.description: No sooner do you conceive of violence than is it un - leashed. At the beginning of combat, before initiative is rolled, you may spend Momentum to direct destructive energy at a target within medium range. Make a Knack roll; on a success, obliterate a trivial target, or cause an injury to a worthy tar - get; you may…
destroyer_in_a_black_flash.mechanicalEffects: No sooner do you conceive of violence than is it un - leashed. At the beginning of combat, before initiative is rolled, you may spend Momentum to direct destructive energy at a target within medium range. Make a Knack roll; on a success, obliterate a trivial target, or cause an injury to a worthy tar - get; you may spend additional successes for the Critical stunt. Enemies may use powers or marvels to protect themselves through a Clash of Wills. When using Direct Assault through this Calling in Divine Rule, gain an additional point of effect.

destroyer_jotuns_armory.name: Jotun’S Armory
destroyer_jotuns_armory.description: Æsir-Specific You can reflexively and automatically break trivial pieces of scenery to use as oversized weaponry — stop signs, car bumpers, kayaks, whatever takes your fancy. These are treated as Heavy weapons with the Melee tag, your choice of Bashing or Lethal, and one final tag chosen from Brutal, Pushing, Reach,…
destroyer_jotuns_armory.mechanicalEffects: Æsir-Specific You can reflexively and automatically break trivial pieces of scenery to use as oversized weaponry — stop signs, car bumpers, kayaks, whatever takes your fancy. These are treated as Heavy weapons with the Melee tag, your choice of Bashing or Lethal, and one final tag chosen from Brutal, Pushing, Reach, or Stun. If you have access to size-based Scale, this Knack grows to match; you can always wield weapons just a little too big for your current size.

destroyer_redacted_by_the_void.name: Redacted By The Void
destroyer_redacted_by_the_void.description: You are a non-entity who distorts the records of the World. Any evidence of your presence in a scene is auto - matically destroyed at the scene’s end unless purposefully preserved by a being of your Tier or higher with a successful Clash of Wills. Actions to tail, track, or hunt you suffer +2 Difficulty. Trivial…
destroyer_redacted_by_the_void.mechanicalEffects: You are a non-entity who distorts the records of the World. Any evidence of your presence in a scene is auto - matically destroyed at the scene’s end unless purposefully preserved by a being of your Tier or higher with a successful Clash of Wills. Actions to tail, track, or hunt you suffer +2 Difficulty. Trivial characters instantly forget about you once out of your presence; supernatural effects meant to restore or read their memory return only static and white noise.

destroyer_salt_the_earth.name: Salt The Earth
destroyer_salt_the_earth.description: When you destroy something, make a Knack Skill roll. With any successes, you do it so completely that no trace of the thing remains. With five or more successes, you may spend Momentum to erase the thing from the memories of others. This only affects targets on a personal level, unless you perform a Destroyer Feat of…
destroyer_salt_the_earth.mechanicalEffects: When you destroy something, make a Knack Skill roll. With any successes, you do it so completely that no trace of the thing remains. With five or more successes, you may spend Momentum to erase the thing from the memories of others. This only affects targets on a personal level, unless you perform a Destroyer Feat of Scale.

destroyer_swallow_the_moon.name: Swallow The Moon
destroyer_swallow_the_moon.description: Bahala-Specific Just as Bakunawa ate six of the World’s seven moons, so may you devour the elements to reduce their power. Spend Momentum and select a Purview, diminishing its power over the scene — Complications and Enhancements related to it reduce by 2, and attempts to “destroy” examples of it can purchase the…
destroyer_swallow_the_moon.mechanicalEffects: Bahala-Specific Just as Bakunawa ate six of the World’s seven moons, so may you devour the elements to reduce their power. Spend Momentum and select a Purview, diminishing its power over the scene — Complications and Enhancements related to it reduce by 2, and attempts to “destroy” examples of it can purchase the Inflict Damage stunt an extra time. Characters with that Purview can contest this with a Clash of Wills, pitting your (Legend + Might) against their (Legend + Stamina).

destroyer_the_evil_eye.name: The Evil Eye
destroyer_the_evil_eye.description: Tuatha De Danann-Specific Like Balor’s, your gaze is terrible to behold. When another character locks eyes with you, roll an Integrity + Presence attack against them with the Piercing and Lethal tags. For the rest of the scene, they suffer a +2 Complication to vision-based actions against you to avoid suffering an…
destroyer_the_evil_eye.mechanicalEffects: Tuatha De Danann-Specific Like Balor’s, your gaze is terrible to behold. When another character locks eyes with you, roll an Integrity + Presence attack against them with the Piercing and Lethal tags. For the rest of the scene, they suffer a +2 Complication to vision-based actions against you to avoid suffering an Injury Condition.

destroyer_the_walking_dread.name: The Walking Dread
destroyer_the_walking_dread.description: Spend Momentum to create an atmosphere of exis - tential dread and nihilism across the Field as desecrated territory. This atmosphere has a strength equal to half your Destroyer dots, rounded up, and overrides the current atmosphere unless it is backed by an effect of your Tier or higher, resolved by a Clash of Wills.…
destroyer_the_walking_dread.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to create an atmosphere of exis - tential dread and nihilism across the Field as desecrated territory. This atmosphere has a strength equal to half your Destroyer dots, rounded up, and overrides the current atmosphere unless it is backed by an effect of your Tier or higher, resolved by a Clash of Wills. Characters in your desecrated territory suffer a Complication equal to your Destroyer dots; if not bought off, they either cower or flee.

destroyer_widening_gyre.name: Widening Gyre
destroyer_widening_gyre.description: At the beginning of your turn, you may choose to lower the cost of the Cause Injury and Critical stunts against char - acters and the Difficulty to break objects within close range by the number of characters Taken Out or significant objects (such as Cover) destroyed in the current scene. If no additional objects are…
destroyer_widening_gyre.mechanicalEffects: At the beginning of your turn, you may choose to lower the cost of the Cause Injury and Critical stunts against char - acters and the Difficulty to break objects within close range by the number of characters Taken Out or significant objects (such as Cover) destroyed in the current scene. If no additional objects are destroyed or character are Taken Out by the end of the turn, you suffer a Bruised Injury and the effects end. Otherwise, it extends a range band, to a maximum of Extreme. The Storyguide determines what counts as a significant ob - ject, but should interpret it in the favor of the players.

monster_appetite_for_victory.name: Appetite For Victory
monster_appetite_for_victory.description: When a non-trivial enemy is Taken Out by you, spend Momentum and heal one Injury, starting with the most se - vere. This cannot heal any Injuries taken to Armor, except the natural armor granted by the Chimera Hide Knack. While under the effects of your Monstrous Urge, the Mo - mentum cost is waived the first time…
monster_appetite_for_victory.mechanicalEffects: When a non-trivial enemy is Taken Out by you, spend Momentum and heal one Injury, starting with the most se - vere. This cannot heal any Injuries taken to Armor, except the natural armor granted by the Chimera Hide Knack. While under the effects of your Monstrous Urge, the Mo - mentum cost is waived the first time this Knack is used.

monster_chimera_hide.name: Chimera Hide
monster_chimera_hide.description: While under the Monstrous Urges Condition, your flesh transforms, becoming chitin, blubbery hide, scales, or some other form of natural armor. When you take this Knack, you may spend up to your Monster rating on tags to determine the effects of your armor. If you take Hard armor, any damage dealt to it heals as if it…
monster_chimera_hide.mechanicalEffects: While under the Monstrous Urges Condition, your flesh transforms, becoming chitin, blubbery hide, scales, or some other form of natural armor. When you take this Knack, you may spend up to your Monster rating on tags to determine the effects of your armor. If you take Hard armor, any damage dealt to it heals as if it were your own flesh; if you invoke Chimera Hide again before it has a chance to heal, the damage still remains. This Knack replaces any other form of natural or worn armor as your monstrous hide bursts through anything that might contain it.

monster_debts_paid_in_blood.name: Debts Paid In Blood
monster_debts_paid_in_blood.description: Teōtl-Specific You automatically know the distance, direction, and shortest path to any character who is indebted to you fi - nancially, socially, or otherwise. They suffer a Complication equal to your Monster Calling on any attempts to evade you, defraud you, or refuse repayment; unless bought off, they suffer a…
monster_debts_paid_in_blood.mechanicalEffects: Teōtl-Specific You automatically know the distance, direction, and shortest path to any character who is indebted to you fi - nancially, socially, or otherwise. They suffer a Complication equal to your Monster Calling on any attempts to evade you, defraud you, or refuse repayment; unless bought off, they suffer a messy Injury, and you detect their intentions regardless of distance, their sweet blood flowing from your lips.

monster_fear_made_flesh.name: Fear Made Flesh
monster_fear_made_flesh.description: When you interact with someone, you learn their big - gest fears and phobias. You can subtly change your features to evoke those fears, gaining +1 Enhancement to intimidate, frighten, or coerce them, which applies before you roll. The target suffers +1 Difficulty to any action they take against you while in your…
monster_fear_made_flesh.mechanicalEffects: When you interact with someone, you learn their big - gest fears and phobias. You can subtly change your features to evoke those fears, gaining +1 Enhancement to intimidate, frighten, or coerce them, which applies before you roll. The target suffers +1 Difficulty to any action they take against you while in your presence.

monster_nightmare_stalker.name: Nightmare Stalker
monster_nightmare_stalker.description: When you injure, intimidate, or frighten someone, you may mark them as your prey. If you do, roll your Knack Skill and bank the successes. You gain access to the following Stunts, which can only be used by spending these banked successes. If you declare another character to be your prey, you lose any previously banked…
monster_nightmare_stalker.mechanicalEffects: When you injure, intimidate, or frighten someone, you may mark them as your prey. If you do, roll your Knack Skill and bank the successes. You gain access to the following Stunts, which can only be used by spending these banked successes. If you declare another character to be your prey, you lose any previously banked successes. No Rest for the Wicked (2s): Your prey is unable to fall asleep naturally, inflicting the insomnia Condition, which prevents a character from sleeping and inflicts +1 Difficulty on complex mental action, or +2 if they haven’t slept in more than two days. This Condition resolves in 72 hours, or after eight hours of rest under the effects of prescription-grade narcotics. Under the Bed (4s): You appear near your prey the next time they enter a place of refuge and safety. NO CLOSE-UPS, PLEASE Your visage is a nightmare — and like a nightmare, de - tails quickly fade even when the fear remains. Characters suffer a +2 difficulty to remember or describe you after the end of the scene or to recognize you on sight. Trivial characters can’t do so at all unless you’ve deliberately threatened or frightened them. In that case, they remember your face vividly but are utterly incapable of describing it. NO DUEL — JUST BLOOD You violently reject a duel, lashing out recklessly. As a simple or mixed action, attack an enemy in a Showdown

monster_red_of_claw_and_fang.name: Red Of Claw And Fang
monster_red_of_claw_and_fang.description: You gain a monstrous Natural weapon, like a stinger, horns, or spines. It has the Natural tag, and a number of ad - ditional tag points equal to your Monster Calling. Attempts to conceal this feature have a +1 Difficulty, but you can spend Momentum to hide it, causing it to retract into your flesh; it may then be…
monster_red_of_claw_and_fang.mechanicalEffects: You gain a monstrous Natural weapon, like a stinger, horns, or spines. It has the Natural tag, and a number of ad - ditional tag points equal to your Monster Calling. Attempts to conceal this feature have a +1 Difficulty, but you can spend Momentum to hide it, causing it to retract into your flesh; it may then be released as a reflexive action. You can take this Knack (Monster) times, creating a new Natural weapon each time.

monster_run_riot.name: Run Riot
monster_run_riot.description: Increase the cost of buying the Critical stunt against you by 1, increasing to 2 when your Monster rating reaches 3. When succumbing to your Monstrous Urge, you don’t suffer the ef - fects of any Injury Complications until you resolve your Urge.
monster_run_riot.mechanicalEffects: Increase the cost of buying the Critical stunt against you by 1, increasing to 2 when your Monster rating reaches 3. When succumbing to your Monstrous Urge, you don’t suffer the ef - fects of any Injury Complications until you resolve your Urge.

monster_stinging_stink.name: Stinging Stink
monster_stinging_stink.description: Manitou-Specific Like Aniwye, your presence is a nasal assault. As an action, you may spread a cloud of noxious musk that inflicts the Noxious Condition on everyone within Short range. This takes hours of vigorous scrubbing to remove and inflicts a +2 Complication on social influence rolls to avoid causing offense or…
monster_stinging_stink.mechanicalEffects: Manitou-Specific Like Aniwye, your presence is a nasal assault. As an action, you may spread a cloud of noxious musk that inflicts the Noxious Condition on everyone within Short range. This takes hours of vigorous scrubbing to remove and inflicts a +2 Complication on social influence rolls to avoid causing offense or Stealth rolls to avoid leaving an obvious trail for the remainder of the scene.

monster_taste_for_blood.name: Taste For Blood
monster_taste_for_blood.description: The first time that you injure or are injured by an enemy in a scene, roll your Knack Skill and bank the successes. You gain access to the following Stunts for the rest of the scene and may spend banked successes to activate them after a successful attack. Frenzy (2s): You may inflict an additional injury condi -…
monster_taste_for_blood.mechanicalEffects: The first time that you injure or are injured by an enemy in a scene, roll your Knack Skill and bank the successes. You gain access to the following Stunts for the rest of the scene and may spend banked successes to activate them after a successful attack. Frenzy (2s): You may inflict an additional injury condi - tion. You cannot stack this with the Critical Hit Stunt. Until the end of your next turn, the Difficulty to hit you is reduced by one. This Stunt can only be bought once per fight. Trouble the Wound (2s): Until the end of their next turn, the target increases their Difficulty penalty from Injury conditions by two, to a maximum of five.

monster_the_face_of_fear.name: The Face Of Fear
monster_the_face_of_fear.description: Spend Momentum to intuit one of a character’s primal fears — for example, spiders or drowning. You may transform your appearance to become a monstrous embodiment of that fear, granting you +1 Enhancement for terrifying others in general and +3 against the specific target. Your first use of this Knack in a scene is…
monster_the_face_of_fear.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to intuit one of a character’s primal fears — for example, spiders or drowning. You may transform your appearance to become a monstrous embodiment of that fear, granting you +1 Enhancement for terrifying others in general and +3 against the specific target. Your first use of this Knack in a scene is free, as are uses against trivial characters.

monster_toxic_blood.name: Toxic Blood
monster_toxic_blood.description: Your blood (and saliva) changes to suit your whims, allowing you to transform it into either poison or medicine. You gain a library of mundane compounds equal to your Monster dots and may reflexively shift the effects of your blood between them. Most are treated as inflicting the Poisoned Condition ( Scion: Origin, p.…
monster_toxic_blood.mechanicalEffects: Your blood (and saliva) changes to suit your whims, allowing you to transform it into either poison or medicine. You gain a library of mundane compounds equal to your Monster dots and may reflexively shift the effects of your blood between them. Most are treated as inflicting the Poisoned Condition ( Scion: Origin, p. 125) but can include choices like soporifics, paralytics, or even relatively benign substances like aspirin.

monster_unearthly_appetite.name: Unearthly Appetite
monster_unearthly_appetite.description: You are capable of safely eating anything, so long as it fits in your mouth, and gain nutritional value from it. If you consume something that has been intentionally poisoned, spend Momentum to negate any harmful effects. This cost is waved while under the effects of your Monstrous Urge.
monster_unearthly_appetite.mechanicalEffects: You are capable of safely eating anything, so long as it fits in your mouth, and gain nutritional value from it. If you consume something that has been intentionally poisoned, spend Momentum to negate any harmful effects. This cost is waved while under the effects of your Monstrous Urge.

monster_wont_go_down.name: Won’T Go Down
monster_wont_go_down.description: You gain an additional Bruised Injury level and reduce the penalty of Maimed Injuries to +3. If you have three or more Monster dots, gain another additional Bruised level.
monster_wont_go_down.mechanicalEffects: You gain an additional Bruised Injury level and reduce the penalty of Maimed Injuries to +3. If you have three or more Monster dots, gain another additional Bruised level.

monster_behind_the_veil.name: Behind The Veil
monster_behind_the_veil.description: Once per session you can spend 1 Momentum to prevent witnesses from connecting you to actions you performed under your Monstrous Urge. Witnesses fully remember the event; they just don’t remember you being the culprit. They might remem - ber another monster doing the deed, attribute your actions to someone else, or…
monster_behind_the_veil.mechanicalEffects: Once per session you can spend 1 Momentum to prevent witnesses from connecting you to actions you performed under your Monstrous Urge. Witnesses fully remember the event; they just don’t remember you being the culprit. They might remem - ber another monster doing the deed, attribute your actions to someone else, or just be unable to recall who or what was the source of the incident. Characters of equal or higher Tier resist with Legend + Composure vs. your Legend + Presence.

monster_bestial_gifts.name: Bestial Gifts
monster_bestial_gifts.description: You may gift your monstrous nature to the worthy and the unwilling alike. One target you touch immediately suc - cumbs to your Monstrous Urge and takes on aspects of your inhuman form, gaining your Monster rating in Enhancement to actions that would benefit from your form. The transformation ends when they resolve the…
monster_bestial_gifts.mechanicalEffects: You may gift your monstrous nature to the worthy and the unwilling alike. One target you touch immediately suc - cumbs to your Monstrous Urge and takes on aspects of your inhuman form, gaining your Monster rating in Enhancement to actions that would benefit from your form. The transformation ends when they resolve the Monstrous Urge condition. Automatically affect willing or lower Tier characters; succeed on an opposed Knack roll to affect unwilling high-tier targets.

monster_birth_by_blood.name: Birth By Blood
monster_birth_by_blood.description: Spend Momentum and suffer a +2 Injury condition to use your flesh and blood to create a monstrous creature. This creature must be something you are familiar with and have a rating equal to or less than your Monster dots. Your spawn serves you loyally but not sacrificially; if pressed to the verge of death, it will…
monster_birth_by_blood.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum and suffer a +2 Injury condition to use your flesh and blood to create a monstrous creature. This creature must be something you are familiar with and have a rating equal to or less than your Monster dots. Your spawn serves you loyally but not sacrificially; if pressed to the verge of death, it will flee and return when healed. It lasts as long as the Injury Condition that created it, but once that has healed, it will waste away over the course of a few hours unless bought with experience, granting it true, independent life.

monster_evolving_threat.name: Evolving Threat
monster_evolving_threat.description: At the start of your turn, you gain the Resistant armor tag against a type of damage you received last turn or add a 1 point tag to one of your Natural weapons. You may bank unspent points over multiple turns to purchase more expensive tags. You may gain a total of new tags equal to your Monster rating. At the end of…
monster_evolving_threat.mechanicalEffects: At the start of your turn, you gain the Resistant armor tag against a type of damage you received last turn or add a 1 point tag to one of your Natural weapons. You may bank unspent points over multiple turns to purchase more expensive tags. You may gain a total of new tags equal to your Monster rating. At the end of the scene, they slough off, and your form returns to normal.

monster_it_was_me_all_along.name: It Was Me All Along
monster_it_was_me_all_along.description: Once per scene, you can reflexively have a trivial character reveal that they were you all along, ripping off their form to reveal your own underneath. The Storyguide can veto this declaration if it is literally impossible for you to be there — such as a sanctuary anathema to your kind, or a prison with no entrance or…
monster_it_was_me_all_along.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, you can reflexively have a trivial character reveal that they were you all along, ripping off their form to reveal your own underneath. The Storyguide can veto this declaration if it is literally impossible for you to be there — such as a sanctuary anathema to your kind, or a prison with no entrance or exit.

monster_lifeblood_buffet.name: Lifeblood Buffet
monster_lifeblood_buffet.description: You gain a close combat attack with the Natural, Melee, Lethal, and Concealable tags, such as retractable fangs, ex - tending talons, or a touch that absorbs body heat. When you purchase the Inflict Damage Stunt with it, you may spend Momentum to heal a Bruised or Injured Condition; if you also purchase the Critical…
monster_lifeblood_buffet.mechanicalEffects: You gain a close combat attack with the Natural, Melee, Lethal, and Concealable tags, such as retractable fangs, ex - tending talons, or a touch that absorbs body heat. When you purchase the Inflict Damage Stunt with it, you may spend Momentum to heal a Bruised or Injured Condition; if you also purchase the Critical Stunt, you can heal a Maimed condition instead. Feeding on trivial characters can only heal Bruised Conditions.

monster_monsters_in_the_mirror.name: Monsters In The Mirror
monster_monsters_in_the_mirror.description: Your monstrosity is infectious, allowing you to draw forth the worst instincts in others. Spend Momentum to in - flict the Monstrous Urges Condition (Scion Player’s Guide: Saints & Monsters, p. 93 or Titanomachy, p. 153) on your target; if they fail to buy off the condition, the character’s actions risk inflicting…
monster_monsters_in_the_mirror.mechanicalEffects: Your monstrosity is infectious, allowing you to draw forth the worst instincts in others. Spend Momentum to in - flict the Monstrous Urges Condition (Scion Player’s Guide: Saints & Monsters, p. 93 or Titanomachy, p. 153) on your target; if they fail to buy off the condition, the character’s actions risk inflicting collateral damage or offending and frightening others around them. Characters of your Tier and higher can resist with a Clash of Wills.

monster_predators_instincts.name: Predator’S Instincts
monster_predators_instincts.description: When you give in to your animalistic urges on an epic Scale (hunting dragons as prey, devouring a paramilitary force, or rampaging through the Metropolitan Museum of Art), imbue, rather than spend, a point of Legend to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
monster_predators_instincts.mechanicalEffects: When you give in to your animalistic urges on an epic Scale (hunting dragons as prey, devouring a paramilitary force, or rampaging through the Metropolitan Museum of Art), imbue, rather than spend, a point of Legend to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

monster_ravenous_force.name: Ravenous Force
monster_ravenous_force.description: Your drive to consume is a legendary hazard. You may reflexively damage and consume up to five points of cover within close range without consuming your action on each turn; if you destroy a piece of cover in this way, you gain +1 Defense for the rest of the round. In Divine Rule, if you attempt to destroy a Realm…
monster_ravenous_force.mechanicalEffects: Your drive to consume is a legendary hazard. You may reflexively damage and consume up to five points of cover within close range without consuming your action on each turn; if you destroy a piece of cover in this way, you gain +1 Defense for the rest of the round. In Divine Rule, if you attempt to destroy a Realm Condition or similar permanent feature, gain an additional point of effect.

monster_strange_skins.name: Strange Skins
monster_strange_skins.description: You can shapeshift into a number of alternative forms. These forms are built as creatures, none of which can have a rating higher than your Monster dots, and you may have up to twice your Monster dots in forms overall. When in an alternate form, you can use their primary dice pool instead of your own. You suffer +2…
monster_strange_skins.mechanicalEffects: You can shapeshift into a number of alternative forms. These forms are built as creatures, none of which can have a rating higher than your Monster dots, and you may have up to twice your Monster dots in forms overall. When in an alternate form, you can use their primary dice pool instead of your own. You suffer +2 Complications when your animal form interferes with your actions. Changing your shape is a simple action, or reflexive if you spend Momentum. You may purchase this Knack up to (Legend) times, each time adding a number of dots to your form library equal to your Monster rating. These repurchases do not take up additional Knack slots.

monster_skulking_horror.name: Skulking Horror
monster_skulking_horror.description: While you are concealed, and no other character knows your exact location, you can move to another location you can see within Long range without crossing the intervening space.
monster_skulking_horror.mechanicalEffects: While you are concealed, and no other character knows your exact location, you can move to another location you can see within Long range without crossing the intervening space.

monster_sacrificial_spawn.name: Sacrificial Spawn
monster_sacrificial_spawn.description: Tengri-Specific As Atai Ulaan’s body spawned monsters from every part, so too may a Tengri Titan. You may harmlessly remove a body part — an eye, limb, or so on — and transform it into a titans - pawn for the rest of the scene. It is created as a Creature with a rating equal to (2 + the Complication inflicted by the…
monster_sacrificial_spawn.mechanicalEffects: Tengri-Specific As Atai Ulaan’s body spawned monsters from every part, so too may a Tengri Titan. You may harmlessly remove a body part — an eye, limb, or so on — and transform it into a titans - pawn for the rest of the scene. It is created as a Creature with a rating equal to (2 + the Complication inflicted by the loss of the part, chosen by you to a maximum Complication of 3).

monster_source_of_doom.name: Source Of Doom
monster_source_of_doom.description: Hordes respond to your howls and creeping legions seethe forth at your command. When you spread your monstrous urge on an epic scale, imbue rather than spend to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
monster_source_of_doom.mechanicalEffects: Hordes respond to your howls and creeping legions seethe forth at your command. When you spread your monstrous urge on an epic scale, imbue rather than spend to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

monster_terrifying_roar.name: Terrifying Roar
monster_terrifying_roar.description: You unleash a blood-curdling roar that sends even the bravest into retreat. Spend Momentum and roll your Knack Skill. With any successes, characters out to long range suffer a +2 Complication. Trivial characters flee automatically, while characters of lesser Tier add your Monster dots to the Complication. If not…
monster_terrifying_roar.mechanicalEffects: You unleash a blood-curdling roar that sends even the bravest into retreat. Spend Momentum and roll your Knack Skill. With any successes, characters out to long range suffer a +2 Complication. Trivial characters flee automatically, while characters of lesser Tier add your Monster dots to the Complication. If not bought off, affected targets must flee the scene.

monster_titanic_stature.name: Titanic Stature
monster_titanic_stature.description: When you are under the Monstrous Urges condition, you grow to more than twice your normal size and take on a fearsome mien with throbbing veins and corded sinew. Your size provides you +1 Scale, and you can spend Momentum to apply the Shockwave tag to any attack that leverages your giant form.
monster_titanic_stature.mechanicalEffects: When you are under the Monstrous Urges condition, you grow to more than twice your normal size and take on a fearsome mien with throbbing veins and corded sinew. Your size provides you +1 Scale, and you can spend Momentum to apply the Shockwave tag to any attack that leverages your giant form.

monster_zenith_of_creatures.name: Zenith Of Creatures
monster_zenith_of_creatures.description: Spend Momentum; your form briefly turns massive and dangerous, causing you to gain +1 size Scale for the rest of the turn, and any attacks you make benefit from the Reach tag. If you’re in your Monstrous Urge Condition, you may choose to stay enlarged for the rest of the scene instead. In Divine Rule play, gain an…
monster_zenith_of_creatures.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum; your form briefly turns massive and dangerous, causing you to gain +1 size Scale for the rest of the turn, and any attacks you make benefit from the Reach tag. If you’re in your Monstrous Urge Condition, you may choose to stay enlarged for the rest of the scene instead. In Divine Rule play, gain an additional point of effect when creating a Realm Condition with the Personal Aura Stunt if it includes shifting into a monstrous form.

primeval_at_home_in_a_hurricane.name: At Home In A Hurricane
primeval_at_home_in_a_hurricane.description: You may spend Momentum to ignore all Complications and Difficulty increases from environmental Conditions or Fields for a scene, and instead gain +2 Enhancement to any actions that would have been affected by those environmental conditions. If a character of an equal or higher Tier created the environmental effect,…
primeval_at_home_in_a_hurricane.mechanicalEffects: You may spend Momentum to ignore all Complications and Difficulty increases from environmental Conditions or Fields for a scene, and instead gain +2 Enhancement to any actions that would have been affected by those environmental conditions. If a character of an equal or higher Tier created the environmental effect, you must make a Clash of Wills, but expend no Momentum if you fail. You gain access to the following Stunt on all actions. Redirect the Flow (2s): An ally of your choice benefits from the protection of Never Not at Home for the rest of the Scene.

primeval_bending_the_world.name: Bending The World
primeval_bending_the_world.description: You may take Close range actions at a distance using wind, plants, and other natural phenomena as your append - ages. These use your usual dice pools, but dice from your At - tribute cannot exceed your Primeval rating. Actions suffer a +1 Complication at Medium range and +2 at Long; if not bought off, your work slows…
primeval_bending_the_world.mechanicalEffects: You may take Close range actions at a distance using wind, plants, and other natural phenomena as your append - ages. These use your usual dice pools, but dice from your At - tribute cannot exceed your Primeval rating. Actions suffer a +1 Complication at Medium range and +2 at Long; if not bought off, your work slows down dramatically or has clumsy results.

primeval_chasing_the_storm.name: Chasing The Storm
primeval_chasing_the_storm.description: When you take a rolled Movement action or make a Chase roll, you gain access to the following Stunts: Churning Wake (variable): Any opponent attempting to move closer or pursue you must resolve a “Storm Hazard” Complication equal to this Stunt’s successes. This inflicts Injury Conditions based on its unresolved…
primeval_chasing_the_storm.mechanicalEffects: When you take a rolled Movement action or make a Chase roll, you gain access to the following Stunts: Churning Wake (variable): Any opponent attempting to move closer or pursue you must resolve a “Storm Hazard” Complication equal to this Stunt’s successes. This inflicts Injury Conditions based on its unresolved rating. Wreathed in Thunder (1s): You create expendable Cover where you end your movement, which your enemies may not benefit from.

primeval_i_am_high_noon.name: I Am High Noon
primeval_i_am_high_noon.description: You briefly become your primeval self, changing the nature of combat. Once per scene, you may spend 1 Momentum to transform into an aspect of your true self, radically changing your environment. The sudden shift in situation grants you a +1 Enhancement to your next action and imposes a +1 Difficulty to one opponent’s…
primeval_i_am_high_noon.mechanicalEffects: You briefly become your primeval self, changing the nature of combat. Once per scene, you may spend 1 Momentum to transform into an aspect of your true self, radically changing your environment. The sudden shift in situation grants you a +1 Enhancement to your next action and imposes a +1 Difficulty to one opponent’s next action. The environmental effects remain until the end of the scene.

primeval_lands_favor.name: Land’S Favor
primeval_lands_favor.description: Whenever you’re in combat, you can conspire with the land to provide you with Hard Cover instantly available to you. Suddenly present old growth trees, remarkably out of place plinths of ancient stone, and strangely durable layers of ice are all possible. If an enemy destroys or circumnav - igates the cover, they have…
primeval_lands_favor.mechanicalEffects: Whenever you’re in combat, you can conspire with the land to provide you with Hard Cover instantly available to you. Suddenly present old growth trees, remarkably out of place plinths of ancient stone, and strangely durable layers of ice are all possible. If an enemy destroys or circumnav - igates the cover, they have to deal with +2 Complication for “Annoyed Land” and find themselves unceremoniously exposed to your attacks. If not bought off, any subsequent attacks gain Arcing against them.

primeval_none_grasp_the_wind.name: None Grasp The Wind
primeval_none_grasp_the_wind.description: You gain +2 Enhancement on all attempts to resist being physically constrained, even Clashes of Wills. Spend Mo - mentum to move through a barrier, as long as it’s not airtight.
primeval_none_grasp_the_wind.mechanicalEffects: You gain +2 Enhancement on all attempts to resist being physically constrained, even Clashes of Wills. Spend Mo - mentum to move through a barrier, as long as it’s not airtight.

primeval_ten_ton_hammers.name: Ten Ton Hammers
primeval_ten_ton_hammers.description: When you labor over acts of creation and construction, you can wield the World itself as a tool; your fires rage like those of the sun, your bellows the seasonal winds, your hammers the mountains themselves. When using the procedural crafting rules, you can automatically satisfy one Milestone with your Primeval…
primeval_ten_ton_hammers.mechanicalEffects: When you labor over acts of creation and construction, you can wield the World itself as a tool; your fires rage like those of the sun, your bellows the seasonal winds, your hammers the mountains themselves. When using the procedural crafting rules, you can automatically satisfy one Milestone with your Primeval industry.

primeval_the_old_ways.name: The Old Ways
primeval_the_old_ways.description: Nemetondevos-Specific Like the Titans of the Wild Reclaiming, you may set yourself against human industry. Spend Momentum to inflict a Complication equal to your Primeval rating on an action using a complex tool — guns and phones, obviously, but anything more finicky than a crossbow will do. If not bought off, the…
primeval_the_old_ways.mechanicalEffects: Nemetondevos-Specific Like the Titans of the Wild Reclaiming, you may set yourself against human industry. Spend Momentum to inflict a Complication equal to your Primeval rating on an action using a complex tool — guns and phones, obviously, but anything more finicky than a crossbow will do. If not bought off, the item is destroyed at the end of the action and returned to its constituent elements. The first time you use this in a scene is free, as are any uses against trivial characters.

primeval_the_tender_wilds.name: The Tender Wilds
primeval_the_tender_wilds.description: Once per session, you may have the World take on one of your burdens, drawing forth anything from despair to injury to magical curses and binding it away from you. Select a Condition affecting you. It immediately stops affecting you, and becomes an externalized object in a nearby wild space, such as a sword wound…
primeval_the_tender_wilds.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, you may have the World take on one of your burdens, drawing forth anything from despair to injury to magical curses and binding it away from you. Select a Condition affecting you. It immediately stops affecting you, and becomes an externalized object in a nearby wild space, such as a sword wound becoming a crumbling seam of sandstone in a gorge, or a curse becoming a rotting stump in a forest.

primeval_the_world_is_my_partner.name: The World Is My Partner
primeval_the_world_is_my_partner.description: You gain a bond with your Purview that resets itself to your Primeval rating at the start of each session. You may spend or bank successes to it just like any other bond on actions that dramatically affirm your commitment to the Purview and what it represents.
primeval_the_world_is_my_partner.mechanicalEffects: You gain a bond with your Purview that resets itself to your Primeval rating at the start of each session. You may spend or bank successes to it just like any other bond on actions that dramatically affirm your commitment to the Purview and what it represents.

primeval_the_world_provides.name: The World Provides
primeval_the_world_provides.description: As an action, you can shape a simple, mundane object out of stone, wood, iron, or similar common elemental materials. This replaces the need for any non-unique resources or supplies during crafting projects.
primeval_the_world_provides.mechanicalEffects: As an action, you can shape a simple, mundane object out of stone, wood, iron, or similar common elemental materials. This replaces the need for any non-unique resources or supplies during crafting projects.

primeval_whirling_cosmos.name: Whirling Cosmos
primeval_whirling_cosmos.description: You’re in tune with the cyclical nature of the seasons, the tides, the planets, or some other inevitable change in nature. You may spend Momentum to gain the following bonuses for the next three rounds; only one each round, and only once each (i.e., you could use Zenith on the first round, Rising on the second, and…
primeval_whirling_cosmos.mechanicalEffects: You’re in tune with the cyclical nature of the seasons, the tides, the planets, or some other inevitable change in nature. You may spend Momentum to gain the following bonuses for the next three rounds; only one each round, and only once each (i.e., you could use Zenith on the first round, Rising on the second, and Falling on the third, but not Zenith on the first and second and Falling on the third, or Zenith twice on the first). Rising: You gain +2 Enhancement for an Attack action. Zenith: You gain +2 Enhancement for a non-Attack action Falling: You gain +2 Enhancement for Defense.

primeval_whispering_weald_verse.name: Whispering Weald Verse
primeval_whispering_weald_verse.description: During procedural information gathering play, you may always target the landscape or long-lasting environmental features with any of the available approaches for finding clues. This may open up additional avenues of investigation, and also allows you to ignore any Complications involving enemies overhearing or…
primeval_whispering_weald_verse.mechanicalEffects: During procedural information gathering play, you may always target the landscape or long-lasting environmental features with any of the available approaches for finding clues. This may open up additional avenues of investigation, and also allows you to ignore any Complications involving enemies overhearing or interlopers noticing you.

primeval_all_disaster.name: All Disaster
primeval_all_disaster.description: Make a Primeval Skill roll. With any successes, you fill an area with primal eruptions as you call them forth from the World, whether they be storms, earthly upheavals, unlikely rains of celestial objects, or improbably violent waves. The more successes, the larger the disaster. In combat, spend Momentum to do this…
primeval_all_disaster.mechanicalEffects: Make a Primeval Skill roll. With any successes, you fill an area with primal eruptions as you call them forth from the World, whether they be storms, earthly upheavals, unlikely rains of celestial objects, or improbably violent waves. The more successes, the larger the disaster. In combat, spend Momentum to do this quickly, distributing successes to making “Primal Hazard” Complications in local Fields of your choosing. They inflict Injury Conditions based on their unresolved rating. Disaster always calls further disaster; add one to the Collateral pool whenever you use this Knack.

primeval_always_been_here.name: Always Been Here
primeval_always_been_here.description: You may choose to ask a place for help, whether it’s an ancient valley, a verdant meadow, or a trash-stuffed alleyway incongruously crammed between two high-rise condos. When you do, spend Momentum and make a Knack Skill roll. Success allows you to call forth allies from natural and supernatural inhabitants of the…
primeval_always_been_here.mechanicalEffects: You may choose to ask a place for help, whether it’s an ancient valley, a verdant meadow, or a trash-stuffed alleyway incongruously crammed between two high-rise condos. When you do, spend Momentum and make a Knack Skill roll. Success allows you to call forth allies from natural and supernatural inhabitants of the place alike, as either the Creature or Followers Birthright, with a rating equal to your Primeval Calling. Such monsters and strange legions follow you loyally for the rest of the session, for the duration of an in-game day, or until you use this Knack again.

primeval_earthblood_and_starflesh.name: Earthblood And Starflesh
primeval_earthblood_and_starflesh.description: Once per session, you may choose to discorporate into elemental energies and primal matter, becoming part of the landscape or local weather effects. This removes any Bruised Conditions you have, and you can’t be attacked or otherwise interacted with by anyone without appropriate supernatu - ral abilities (who must…
primeval_earthblood_and_starflesh.mechanicalEffects: Once per session, you may choose to discorporate into elemental energies and primal matter, becoming part of the landscape or local weather effects. This removes any Bruised Conditions you have, and you can’t be attacked or otherwise interacted with by anyone without appropriate supernatu - ral abilities (who must still win a Clash of Wills to target or affect you). At any point later, you may reform and resume normal existence, either at the location you discorporated or in the presence of a friendly character who was there when you initially used this Knack.

primeval_implacable_as_winter.name: Implacable As Winter
primeval_implacable_as_winter.description: Once per scene, you may reset one attitude to 0 or re - duce the influence of an atmosphere on you by your Prime - val rating. For the rest of the scene, attempts to play on your ambitions or desires suffer a +2 Complication; if not bought off, the target suffers an Injury as the elements rage against his audacity.
primeval_implacable_as_winter.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, you may reset one attitude to 0 or re - duce the influence of an atmosphere on you by your Prime - val rating. For the rest of the scene, attempts to play on your ambitions or desires suffer a +2 Complication; if not bought off, the target suffers an Injury as the elements rage against his audacity.

primeval_lay_across_the_land.name: Lay Across The Land
primeval_lay_across_the_land.description: Spend Momentum to become a natural feature such as a stream, a copse of trees, or a rocky hillock for a scene. You occupy your current field and cannot move beyond it, but benefit from Size 3 Scale for purposes of defense and durability, may add your Primeval rating as Enhancement to noncombat actions that would…
primeval_lay_across_the_land.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to become a natural feature such as a stream, a copse of trees, or a rocky hillock for a scene. You occupy your current field and cannot move beyond it, but benefit from Size 3 Scale for purposes of defense and durability, may add your Primeval rating as Enhancement to noncombat actions that would benefit from your massive natural presence and reach, and the Shockwave and appro - priate Elemental tags to any attacks you make in combat.

primeval_living_font.name: Living Font
primeval_living_font.description: the World’s miracles flow from you like water but threaten to rush uncontrollably into the world the more power you exert. You may pay for marvels from Primeval Purviews by adding dice to the Collateral pool (see Titanomachy, p. 142) in place of spending Legend, or to Tension if the Collater - al pool is not in play.…
primeval_living_font.mechanicalEffects: the World’s miracles flow from you like water but threaten to rush uncontrollably into the world the more power you exert. You may pay for marvels from Primeval Purviews by adding dice to the Collateral pool (see Titanomachy, p. 142) in place of spending Legend, or to Tension if the Collater - al pool is not in play. In Divine Rule play, creating a Realm Condition with a Primeval Purview doesn’t count as an in - vestment of that Purview once per session.

primeval_personal_territory.name: Personal Territory
primeval_personal_territory.description: The elements constantly rearrange themselves in your presence. Other characters treat close range to you as dif - ficult terrain, though you may exempt up to your Primeval Calling of them from this Knack’s effects at any one time. You may spend Momentum to increase this effect by a range band for a turn or to make it…
primeval_personal_territory.mechanicalEffects: The elements constantly rearrange themselves in your presence. Other characters treat close range to you as dif - ficult terrain, though you may exempt up to your Primeval Calling of them from this Knack’s effects at any one time. You may spend Momentum to increase this effect by a range band for a turn or to make it also count as Complication 1 dangerous terrain. You may spend Momentum for this effect multiple times in a turn to intensify it. In Divine Rule play, gain an additional point of effect when using a primeval Purview to create a Realm Condition. RISING TIDE, FALLING SKY There is no force of the World that is beyond your use. When you work to call up enormous elemental forces or call down great natural destruction, imbue rather than spend Legend to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

primeval_single_minded_disaster.name: Single-Minded Disaster
primeval_single_minded_disaster.description: Kami-Specific Loudly declare your intentions for the immediate scene. You gain Enhancement equal to your Primeval rating to resist any action that dissuades or impedes your attempt. For example, if you declare you’re going to tear apart a ti - tanspawn, you get the bonus to avoid some well-meaning bystander…
primeval_single_minded_disaster.mechanicalEffects: Kami-Specific Loudly declare your intentions for the immediate scene. You gain Enhancement equal to your Primeval rating to resist any action that dissuades or impedes your attempt. For example, if you declare you’re going to tear apart a ti - tanspawn, you get the bonus to avoid some well-meaning bystander restraining you, or a Bandmate talking you out of this reckless endeavor, but not to your rolls to actually make the attack. You suffer a Complication of the same rating when you do anything except pursue your stated mission. If not bought off, you suffer an Injury Condition as your own nature betrays you.

primeval_the_bodys_trove.name: The Body’S Trove
primeval_the_bodys_trove.description: Theoi-Specific As Gaea concealed secrets within her cavernous depths, so too may you store useful tools and servitors within you. You may absorb up to your Primeval rating in objects or willing characters of roughly your size, who are kept safe and (mostly) comfortable. They always leave some hint — tattoos, wriggling…
primeval_the_bodys_trove.mechanicalEffects: Theoi-Specific As Gaea concealed secrets within her cavernous depths, so too may you store useful tools and servitors within you. You may absorb up to your Primeval rating in objects or willing characters of roughly your size, who are kept safe and (mostly) comfortable. They always leave some hint — tattoos, wriggling flesh, strange marks, identifiable with a difficulty 3 Occult + Intellect roll. Extracting a stored object or character requires an action.

primeval_the_bones_of_the_universe.name: The Bones Of The Universe
primeval_the_bones_of_the_universe.description: You know the secret structure of the World and beyond, and may move through passages ancient when the Gods were young. When you choose to travel, you may travel from like to like, putting a boat into the water on the Great Lakes only to emerge from Lake Victoria, walk into the Sahara and walk out of the Gobi, or even…
primeval_the_bones_of_the_universe.mechanicalEffects: You know the secret structure of the World and beyond, and may move through passages ancient when the Gods were young. When you choose to travel, you may travel from like to like, putting a boat into the water on the Great Lakes only to emerge from Lake Victoria, walk into the Sahara and walk out of the Gobi, or even dig through a snowbank in Alaska to emerge from the snowpack in the Alps. Such travel takes no longer than a day’s travel (about eight hours). While native dangers or obstructions from either your entry or exit might bar your way, those otherwise trying to track or waylay you must make a Clash of Wills to intercept you before you reach your destination. If the connection between elements you travel through is tenuous (“Well, Central Park and the Amazon both have trees!”) or relies on the constructions of man (such as going from sewer system to sewer system), spend Momentum to use this Knack.

primeval_the_caldera_overflows.name: The Caldera Overflows
primeval_the_caldera_overflows.description: Atua-Specific Harm to you is dangerous to all. When you suffer an Injury Condition, you spread dangerous terrain out to maximum Medium range based on an outpouring of one of your Purviews. Characters within range suffer a Complication on their next action based on your Injury (1 for Bruised, 2 for Injured, 3 for…
primeval_the_caldera_overflows.mechanicalEffects: Atua-Specific Harm to you is dangerous to all. When you suffer an Injury Condition, you spread dangerous terrain out to maximum Medium range based on an outpouring of one of your Purviews. Characters within range suffer a Complication on their next action based on your Injury (1 for Bruised, 2 for Injured, 3 for Maimed), which they must buy off to avoid suffering an Injury of their own. You may spend Momentum to increase the Complication by 1 level per point of Momentum to a maximum of 3.

primeval_the_voice_of_the_storm.name: The Voice Of The Storm
primeval_the_voice_of_the_storm.description: You may send forth your intent into the World, delivering messages through the patterns in leaves, the whispers in crashing waves, or the crackling of fire. This allows you to communicate with any willing target, while you may spend Momentum to deliver messages to unwilling targets. In ei - ther case, you may choose…
primeval_the_voice_of_the_storm.mechanicalEffects: You may send forth your intent into the World, delivering messages through the patterns in leaves, the whispers in crashing waves, or the crackling of fire. This allows you to communicate with any willing target, while you may spend Momentum to deliver messages to unwilling targets. In ei - ther case, you may choose to allow them a short reply, and may make intrigue actions targeting them.

primeval_the_world_entire.name: The World Entire
primeval_the_world_entire.description: When you work to turn existing natural forces to your will on a massive scale, such as rerouting rivers, directing wildfires, or taking advantage of a tidal change, imbue, rather than spend, a point of Legend to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
primeval_the_world_entire.mechanicalEffects: When you work to turn existing natural forces to your will on a massive scale, such as rerouting rivers, directing wildfires, or taking advantage of a tidal change, imbue, rather than spend, a point of Legend to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

tyrant_accept_no_failure.name: Accept No Failure
tyrant_accept_no_failure.description: When a subordinate or character who possess an atti - tude of Fear toward you at two points or greater fails a roll in your presence, you may cause them to suffer 1 point of Injury to reroll it, though they must take the second result. Player characters may choose to ignore this effect.
tyrant_accept_no_failure.mechanicalEffects: When a subordinate or character who possess an atti - tude of Fear toward you at two points or greater fails a roll in your presence, you may cause them to suffer 1 point of Injury to reroll it, though they must take the second result. Player characters may choose to ignore this effect.

tyrant_an_impossible_quest.name: An Impossible Quest
tyrant_an_impossible_quest.description: Plant Dôn-Specific When you use an Encourage Behavior action to goad someone into a difficult task, you gain +2 Enhancement, and they can’t leverage their negative attitude towards you so long as you offer them some reasonable reward. If they complete your task, you must make good on the reward and suffer a…
tyrant_an_impossible_quest.mechanicalEffects: Plant Dôn-Specific When you use an Encourage Behavior action to goad someone into a difficult task, you gain +2 Enhancement, and they can’t leverage their negative attitude towards you so long as you offer them some reasonable reward. If they complete your task, you must make good on the reward and suffer a Complication equal to your Tyrant rating until you do so.

tyrant_a_voice_like_doom.name: A Voice Like Doom
tyrant_a_voice_like_doom.description: During intrigue play, whenever you try to Shift Attitude or Atmosphere during intrigue play to create feelings of fear or to Encourage Behavior to enforce obedience, you may choose to increase the Collateral pool by up to your Tyrant Calling in dice. For each die you add to the Collateral pool, add +1 Enhancement,…
tyrant_a_voice_like_doom.mechanicalEffects: During intrigue play, whenever you try to Shift Attitude or Atmosphere during intrigue play to create feelings of fear or to Encourage Behavior to enforce obedience, you may choose to increase the Collateral pool by up to your Tyrant Calling in dice. For each die you add to the Collateral pool, add +1 Enhancement, which applies before you roll.

tyrant_compliance_is_rewarded.name: Compliance Is Rewarded
tyrant_compliance_is_rewarded.description: Spend 1 Momentum to resolve a Condition afflicting a target who recognizes you as their superior. The next time they try to defy you, they gain a Complication equal to your Tyrant dots; if not bought off, the Condition reasserts itself, and they suffer an Injury. If the Condition was imposed by a character of a higher…
tyrant_compliance_is_rewarded.mechanicalEffects: Spend 1 Momentum to resolve a Condition afflicting a target who recognizes you as their superior. The next time they try to defy you, they gain a Complication equal to your Tyrant dots; if not bought off, the Condition reasserts itself, and they suffer an Injury. If the Condition was imposed by a character of a higher Tier than you, activating this Knack requires a Clash of Wills with Legend + Presence.

tyrant_crushing_inquest.name: Crushing Inquest
tyrant_crushing_inquest.description: During information gathering play, you gain access to the following Stunt: Tyrant’s Weight (1-3s): For each success you spend, create an atmosphere of Fear for any social encounters with a rating equal to the successes spent for the rest of the session.
tyrant_crushing_inquest.mechanicalEffects: During information gathering play, you gain access to the following Stunt: Tyrant’s Weight (1-3s): For each success you spend, create an atmosphere of Fear for any social encounters with a rating equal to the successes spent for the rest of the session.

tyrant_get_out_of_my_sight.name: Get Out Of My Sight
tyrant_get_out_of_my_sight.description: You order a foe to turn tail and run, and they meekly
tyrant_get_out_of_my_sight.mechanicalEffects: You order a foe to turn tail and run, and they meekly

tyrant_greasing_the_palm.name: Greasing The Palm
tyrant_greasing_the_palm.description: Shén-Specific Spend 1 Momentum to intuit the perfect bribe to get a particular official to do something for you or overlook your actions. If you give it to them, they improve their attitude towards you by 1 and suffer a Complication equal to your Tyrant Calling on any attempt to betray or undermine you for the rest of…
tyrant_greasing_the_palm.mechanicalEffects: Shén-Specific Spend 1 Momentum to intuit the perfect bribe to get a particular official to do something for you or overlook your actions. If you give it to them, they improve their attitude towards you by 1 and suffer a Complication equal to your Tyrant Calling on any attempt to betray or undermine you for the rest of the story; if not bought off, their superiors learn they accepted a bribe, and they suffer appropriate conse - quences. Your first use of this Knack in a scene is free, as are uses against trivial characters.

tyrant_present_dread.name: Present Dread
tyrant_present_dread.description: You may spend Momentum to create the Aura of Op - pression Complication for anyone opposing or attacking you for a Scene. Aura of Oppression (2s): Failing to resolve this Compli - cation creates an Attitude of fear for the character attempt - ing the action towards the Scion who created it equal to the Complication’s…
tyrant_present_dread.mechanicalEffects: You may spend Momentum to create the Aura of Op - pression Complication for anyone opposing or attacking you for a Scene. Aura of Oppression (2s): Failing to resolve this Compli - cation creates an Attitude of fear for the character attempt - ing the action towards the Scion who created it equal to the Complication’s unresolved rating.

tyrant_ready_displeasure.name: Ready Displeasure
tyrant_ready_displeasure.description: Whenever someone who serves you or has sworn to follow you disobeys the spirit of your orders, you immediately know (though not what exactly they did or why they did it).
tyrant_ready_displeasure.mechanicalEffects: Whenever someone who serves you or has sworn to follow you disobeys the spirit of your orders, you immediately know (though not what exactly they did or why they did it).

tyrant_reward_the_obedient.name: Reward The Obedient
tyrant_reward_the_obedient.description: You may make a Knack Skill roll against a target, op - posed by their Integrity + Composure or Resolve or most relevant dice pool. On a success, create the condition “Tyrant’s Command” on them. Anytime a character suffering from the “Tyrant’s Command” condition disobeys you, you may end the Condition to instantly…
tyrant_reward_the_obedient.mechanicalEffects: You may make a Knack Skill roll against a target, op - posed by their Integrity + Composure or Resolve or most relevant dice pool. On a success, create the condition “Tyrant’s Command” on them. Anytime a character suffering from the “Tyrant’s Command” condition disobeys you, you may end the Condition to instantly inflict one damage to the target. Otherwise, the Condition resolves after they’re away from your presence for at least a day.

tyrant_the_last_word.name: The Last Word
tyrant_the_last_word.description: Spend 1 Momentum to put an end to a topic of discus - sion or debate that can’t be brought up again for the rest of the scene. Characters of your Tier or higher can resist with a Clash of Wills, pitting their Legend + Composure against your Legend + Presence.
tyrant_the_last_word.mechanicalEffects: Spend 1 Momentum to put an end to a topic of discus - sion or debate that can’t be brought up again for the rest of the scene. Characters of your Tier or higher can resist with a Clash of Wills, pitting their Legend + Composure against your Legend + Presence.

tyrant_tools_of_tyranny.name: Tools Of Tyranny
tyrant_tools_of_tyranny.description: Intrigue actions or physical attacks made by your sworn subordinates (including followers or beasts) against targets with an Attitude of fear towards you or in an atmosphere of fear gain Enhancement +1. If you’re present, intrigue actions benefitting from this Knack resolve an additional Milestone on a success, while…
tyrant_tools_of_tyranny.mechanicalEffects: Intrigue actions or physical attacks made by your sworn subordinates (including followers or beasts) against targets with an Attitude of fear towards you or in an atmosphere of fear gain Enhancement +1. If you’re present, intrigue actions benefitting from this Knack resolve an additional Milestone on a success, while physical attacks gain the Brutal tag. WHOM DO YOU SERVE? Spend 1 Momentum to automatically intuit the loyalties of a character in the scene, getting a rough but accurate sense of their allies, superiors, and attitudes towards each. This includes characters not present in the scene; if you meet them later, you recognize them as the recipient of that allegiance. Your first use of this Knack in a scene is free, as are uses against trivial characters.

tyrant_absolute_terror.name: Absolute Terror
tyrant_absolute_terror.description: The dread you inspire warps attempts to oppose or harm you. Foes attacking or opposing you suffer any Atti - tudes of fear they possess towards you as additional Diffi - culty on their rolls, while foes opposing you with inanimate objects that should happen to fear you must overcome their weapon’s Attitude as…
tyrant_absolute_terror.mechanicalEffects: The dread you inspire warps attempts to oppose or harm you. Foes attacking or opposing you suffer any Atti - tudes of fear they possess towards you as additional Diffi - culty on their rolls, while foes opposing you with inanimate objects that should happen to fear you must overcome their weapon’s Attitude as Complication or be disarmed.

tyrant_auspices_of_attar.name: Auspices Of Attar
tyrant_auspices_of_attar.description: Ilhm-Specific As Attar once rallied humanity against Ba’al, so too may younger Tyrants sound their clarion call. Use an action to draw trivial characters into your service as Heavy Followers with additional tags equal to your Tyrant Calling; this is usually nigh instant, but even in truly isolated areas, they arrive…
tyrant_auspices_of_attar.mechanicalEffects: Ilhm-Specific As Attar once rallied humanity against Ba’al, so too may younger Tyrants sound their clarion call. Use an action to draw trivial characters into your service as Heavy Followers with additional tags equal to your Tyrant Calling; this is usually nigh instant, but even in truly isolated areas, they arrive no later than the start of the next scene. They serve loyally for one battle or scene. All who die for your cause fade into stardust, commemorated above in the Heavens.

tyrant_broke_no_opposition.name: Broke No Opposition
tyrant_broke_no_opposition.description: Characters opposing you must treat close range as dangerous terrain (Scion: Origin p. 73), at a Complication rating equal to the higher of their Attitude of fear toward you or the Atmosphere of fear in the scene.
tyrant_broke_no_opposition.mechanicalEffects: Characters opposing you must treat close range as dangerous terrain (Scion: Origin p. 73), at a Complication rating equal to the higher of their Attitude of fear toward you or the Atmosphere of fear in the scene.

tyrant_dwelling_in_darkness.name: Dwelling In Darkness
tyrant_dwelling_in_darkness.description: Apu-Specific Many among the Apu Titans brood in dark places, remnants from the void before time. You may consecrate a location that you own or control as your dark stronghold. You can spend 1 Momentum when suffering an Injury or setback to a plan, returning instantly to your dark stronghold alongside your Bandmates…
tyrant_dwelling_in_darkness.mechanicalEffects: Apu-Specific Many among the Apu Titans brood in dark places, remnants from the void before time. You may consecrate a location that you own or control as your dark stronghold. You can spend 1 Momentum when suffering an Injury or setback to a plan, returning instantly to your dark stronghold alongside your Bandmates and up to your Tyrant Calling in other willing characters. When you travel towards it by any means, the journey takes half as long as it should. You may consecrate a new location as your dark stronghold in a nightlong ritual, releasing your claim on the prior.

tyrant_faceless_legions.name: Faceless Legions
tyrant_faceless_legions.description: Make a Knack roll. On a success, you gain followers equal to your Tyrant rating for the remainder of the session, your personal gravity drawing weak-willed humans and lesser supernatural beings to your service. If they fail a roll, you may dismiss them, make an example of them, or disdainfully abandon them. If you do,…
tyrant_faceless_legions.mechanicalEffects: Make a Knack roll. On a success, you gain followers equal to your Tyrant rating for the remainder of the session, your personal gravity drawing weak-willed humans and lesser supernatural beings to your service. If they fail a roll, you may dismiss them, make an example of them, or disdainfully abandon them. If you do, you lose access to Faceless Legions for the rest of the session, but you gain your Tyrant dots in Enhancement to succeed at whatever they failed at. You may not have more than one group of followers collected by Faceless Legions bound to you at once.

tyrant_haughty_summons.name: Haughty Summons
tyrant_haughty_summons.description: You may call a character sworn to your service or a Birthright similarly attached to you to your side in a fright - ful wind. Spend Momentum; if they could plausibly come to your side in a scene, they arrive immediately; a day, they arrive at the end of the Scene, any longer, they arrive at the next dawn or dusk. If…
tyrant_haughty_summons.mechanicalEffects: You may call a character sworn to your service or a Birthright similarly attached to you to your side in a fright - ful wind. Spend Momentum; if they could plausibly come to your side in a scene, they arrive immediately; a day, they arrive at the end of the Scene, any longer, they arrive at the next dawn or dusk. If supernaturally kept from meeting your call, you may Clash of Wills against whatever force holds them in durance. Birthrights need not be capable of their own conveyance normally to respond to the summons; players’ characters must always give consent to be affected by this power.

tyrant_i_am_that_which_is_to_be_obeyed.name: I Am That Which Is To Be Obeyed
tyrant_i_am_that_which_is_to_be_obeyed.description: When you attempt to assert authority on an Epic scale, such as asserting rulership over a continent or pulling rank on a Titan, imbue rather than spend to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
tyrant_i_am_that_which_is_to_be_obeyed.mechanicalEffects: When you attempt to assert authority on an Epic scale, such as asserting rulership over a continent or pulling rank on a Titan, imbue rather than spend to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

tyrant_mights_prerogative.name: Might’S Prerogative
tyrant_mights_prerogative.description: Other people exist for your convenience, and sometimes your protection. You may treat subordinates and trivial characters as light cover in combat and may always choose for the results of a collateral pool roll to affect them instead of directly affecting you (though this does not prevent potential Fatebindings). In…
tyrant_mights_prerogative.mechanicalEffects: Other people exist for your convenience, and sometimes your protection. You may treat subordinates and trivial characters as light cover in combat and may always choose for the results of a collateral pool roll to affect them instead of directly affecting you (though this does not prevent potential Fatebindings). In Divine Rule, you may choose to destroy a Realm Condition you are invested in in place of suffering a Divine Wound once per session.

tyrant_no_balm_for_terror.name: No Balm For Terror
tyrant_no_balm_for_terror.description: Fear is beyond a weapon; in your hands, it’s the creeping tide of oblivion. You may afflict characters with an Attitude of fear or similar emotions towards you with disease or poison conditions at the same rating as the attitude. Trivial characters are at your mercy, while others suffer additional difficulty to any…
tyrant_no_balm_for_terror.mechanicalEffects: Fear is beyond a weapon; in your hands, it’s the creeping tide of oblivion. You may afflict characters with an Attitude of fear or similar emotions towards you with disease or poison conditions at the same rating as the attitude. Trivial characters are at your mercy, while others suffer additional difficulty to any rolls to recover equal to the Attitude. In Divine Rule play, reduce the cost of the Divine Hazard and Slaying Force Stunts by 1

tyrant_obvious_superiority.name: Obvious Superiority
tyrant_obvious_superiority.description: Devá-Specific You gain +2 Enhancement to resist influence and effects that would compel you to submit to someone else’s authority or recognize someone’s status. Once per scene, when resisting such an effect, you may impose a Complication on the source’s next influence action equal to your Tyrant dots; if they fail to…
tyrant_obvious_superiority.mechanicalEffects: Devá-Specific You gain +2 Enhancement to resist influence and effects that would compel you to submit to someone else’s authority or recognize someone’s status. Once per scene, when resisting such an effect, you may impose a Complication on the source’s next influence action equal to your Tyrant dots; if they fail to buy it off, observers see their influence in the worst possible light, like unhinged ramblings, insecure arrogance, or entitled outrage. SHATTER TABLETS, SEIZE CROWNS Annua-Specific Upon defeating someone in an obvious contest that they have openly or tacitly agreed to, you may claim one of their honors, positions, or possessions as your own. Until they surrender it to you, they suffer a Complication equal to your Tyrant rank on related actions — driving their illicitly kept car, managing the business that ought to be yours, and so on. If not bought off, characters gossip about the target as a sore loser, cheater, or deal breaker, souring attitudes and atmospheres with every action.

tyrant_solipsistic_disdain.name: Solipsistic Disdain
tyrant_solipsistic_disdain.description: Once per scene, you may spend Momentum to ignore an attack against your person, refusing to acknowledge its existence and becoming utterly unaffected by any of its effects. If this was in response to an ambush or surprise attack, you may use this Knack without spending Momentum and may use it one more time during the…
tyrant_solipsistic_disdain.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, you may spend Momentum to ignore an attack against your person, refusing to acknowledge its existence and becoming utterly unaffected by any of its effects. If this was in response to an ambush or surprise attack, you may use this Knack without spending Momentum and may use it one more time during the Scene.

tyrant_squirming_masses.name: Squirming Masses
tyrant_squirming_masses.description: When attempting to inflict fear or coerce obedience on a huge Scale, such as cowing an army or demanding the labor of an entire country, imbue, rather than spend, a point of Legend to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.
tyrant_squirming_masses.mechanicalEffects: When attempting to inflict fear or coerce obedience on a huge Scale, such as cowing an army or demanding the labor of an entire country, imbue, rather than spend, a point of Legend to invoke your Legendary Title as a Feat of Scale.

tyrant_survey_the_empire.name: Survey The Empire
tyrant_survey_the_empire.description: You may take a Leadership + Cunning action to get a sense of the morale, disposition, and needs of anyone below your Tier who is loyal to you or subject to your authority — deifans, worshippers, employees, goons, etc. You gain 1 Leadership Scale to influence them, and you may spend 1 Momentum to fully inhabit the…
tyrant_survey_the_empire.mechanicalEffects: You may take a Leadership + Cunning action to get a sense of the morale, disposition, and needs of anyone below your Tier who is loyal to you or subject to your authority — deifans, worshippers, employees, goons, etc. You gain 1 Leadership Scale to influence them, and you may spend 1 Momentum to fully inhabit the senses of one of these chosen characters for the scene.

tyrant_the_fear.name: The Fear
tyrant_the_fear.description: The fear and terror you cause is absolute, even affecting targets that would normally be unable to feel fear such as unintelligent constructs or inanimate objects. Trivial opponents are unable to target you with physical attacks or other actions to hinder you, barring outside supernatural means, and you may inflict…
tyrant_the_fear.mechanicalEffects: The fear and terror you cause is absolute, even affecting targets that would normally be unable to feel fear such as unintelligent constructs or inanimate objects. Trivial opponents are unable to target you with physical attacks or other actions to hinder you, barring outside supernatural means, and you may inflict Attitudes of fear or similar emotions on normally invalid targets, such as “fearless skeleton warriors” or “that wall.” Lower Tier foes must succeed at an Integrity + Composure or Resolve or most relevant dice pool roll to affect you, which counts as a normal action in action-adventure play. Foes protected against fear by supernatural means may make a Clash of Wills roll to oppose your ability to create dread.

tyrant_under_my_thumb.name: Under My Thumb
tyrant_under_my_thumb.description: Sometimes you need to remind those beneath you who’s really in charge. When exerting control over another, imbue instead of spending a Legend to invoke your Legendary Title on actions involving coercion, force, or manipulation to get a target to follow your command.
tyrant_under_my_thumb.mechanicalEffects: Sometimes you need to remind those beneath you who’s really in charge. When exerting control over another, imbue instead of spending a Legend to invoke your Legendary Title on actions involving coercion, force, or manipulation to get a target to follow your command.

tyrant_wicked_industry.name: Wicked Industry
tyrant_wicked_industry.description: When crafting, you may always count “the toil of desperate servants” and “dire plots planned in darkness” as Milestones. Dragons can benefit from the following selection of Knacks.
tyrant_wicked_industry.mechanicalEffects: When crafting, you may always count “the toil of desperate servants” and “dire plots planned in darkness” as Milestones. Dragons can benefit from the following selection of Knacks.

collector_bottomless_stash.name: Bottomless Stash
collector_bottomless_stash.description: You never need to roll to acquire mundane supplies or goods, as you always know where and how to find them. Unless the item is exceedingly rare (or being blocked from access by a rival), you get what you need with little compli - cation — this does not make materials cost less or arrive any faster should they need to…
collector_bottomless_stash.mechanicalEffects: You never need to roll to acquire mundane supplies or goods, as you always know where and how to find them. Unless the item is exceedingly rare (or being blocked from access by a rival), you get what you need with little compli - cation — this does not make materials cost less or arrive any faster should they need to be transported to you. If someone or something is preventing you from acquiring materials, make a Clash of Wills.

collector_discerning_collector.name: Discerning Collector
collector_discerning_collector.description: Choose a type of object to hoard. Whenever you take actions to acquire more of this object for your hoard, you gain your Collector dots in Enhancement to any applicable rolls made to add it to your collection. This can be any attempt, from a legal attempt to negotiate price, to less scrupulous methods like theft.…
