collector_discerning_collector.mechanicalEffects: Choose a type of object to hoard. Whenever you take actions to acquire more of this object for your hoard, you gain your Collector dots in Enhancement to any applicable rolls made to add it to your collection. This can be any attempt, from a legal attempt to negotiate price, to less scrupulous methods like theft. Combat rolls do not apply.

collector_infinite_pockets.name: Infinite Pockets
collector_infinite_pockets.description: Produce any item from your hoard in an instant, though it must be able to fit in your pocket or your hand. To pull something much bigger out of a suitcase, backpack, carpet bag, or musical instrument case, etc. spend Momentum. Al - ternatively, spend Momentum to instead produce the samesized object from a part of your…
collector_infinite_pockets.mechanicalEffects: Produce any item from your hoard in an instant, though it must be able to fit in your pocket or your hand. To pull something much bigger out of a suitcase, backpack, carpet bag, or musical instrument case, etc. spend Momentum. Al - ternatively, spend Momentum to instead produce the samesized object from a part of your body (usually the mouth, though producing it from an ear, nostril, or palm is just as common). Larger items may not be produced from your body.

collector_obsessive_tally.name: Obsessive Tally
collector_obsessive_tally.description: You are capable of impressive feats of mental math, able to count any number of objects in mere instants. Your mind filters important data from irrelevant information, leaving only the greater pattern behind. For any roll where this would apply, add +2 Enhancement which applies before you roll — for example, an…
collector_obsessive_tally.mechanicalEffects: You are capable of impressive feats of mental math, able to count any number of objects in mere instants. Your mind filters important data from irrelevant information, leaving only the greater pattern behind. For any roll where this would apply, add +2 Enhancement which applies before you roll — for example, an Analyze roll during Procedural play. This does not allow you to do impossible feats, such as numbering all the stars in the sky or counting every grain of sand on the beach but will allow you to notice a trend in a killer’s behavior, or predict the actions of an enemy spy. If you are able to perform Collector Feats of Scale, this Knack may be used as such, overriding the previous statement.

collector_one_for_the_collection.name: One For The Collection
collector_one_for_the_collection.description: When you acquire an object — whether legitimately, through barter or purchase or illegally through theft — you may tuck it into a pocket and return it instantly to your hoard. It must fit into a pocket or your hand. Spend Momentum to stuff a much larger object into a larger container (a musical instrument case, a…
collector_one_for_the_collection.mechanicalEffects: When you acquire an object — whether legitimately, through barter or purchase or illegally through theft — you may tuck it into a pocket and return it instantly to your hoard. It must fit into a pocket or your hand. Spend Momentum to stuff a much larger object into a larger container (a musical instrument case, a duffle bag, etc.) and return it to your hoard. A second purchase of this Knack allows you to consume the object to banish it to your hoard instead.

collector_scent_of_treasure.name: Scent Of Treasure
collector_scent_of_treasure.description: When you pursue an object for your hoard, make a Knack Skill roll. For each success, ask the Storyguide one of the following questions, which must be answered honestly: How far away is it? In what direction is it? What lies between here and the object? Who has it now? Who else wants to obtain it?
collector_scent_of_treasure.mechanicalEffects: When you pursue an object for your hoard, make a Knack Skill roll. For each success, ask the Storyguide one of the following questions, which must be answered honestly: How far away is it? In what direction is it? What lies between here and the object? Who has it now? Who else wants to obtain it?

collector_wireless_alarm.name: Wireless Alarm
collector_wireless_alarm.description: You’re alerted the instant anyone steals or touches anything in your hoard and can spend Momentum to appear wherever your items are stashed. You are also always able to identify a stolen object, even if it wasn’t taken from you.
collector_wireless_alarm.mechanicalEffects: You’re alerted the instant anyone steals or touches anything in your hoard and can spend Momentum to appear wherever your items are stashed. You are also always able to identify a stolen object, even if it wasn’t taken from you.

destroyer_armor_shearing_jaws.name: Armor-Shearing Jaws
destroyer_armor_shearing_jaws.description: Your Natural tag attacks automatically gain the Piercing tag and count as 1 Scale greater for the purposes of destroying inanimate objects. If you have Rending Claws transformed, gain +1 Enhancement to attacks made against objects or ar - mored targets.
destroyer_armor_shearing_jaws.mechanicalEffects: Your Natural tag attacks automatically gain the Piercing tag and count as 1 Scale greater for the purposes of destroying inanimate objects. If you have Rending Claws transformed, gain +1 Enhancement to attacks made against objects or ar - mored targets.

destroyer_devourer_of_stone.name: Devourer Of Stone
destroyer_devourer_of_stone.description: You are capable of biting through and eating anything inedible: glass, stone, wood, steel, etc. and consuming it as though it had nutritional value. You cannot eat anything you can’t fit into your mouth. This does mean that in full dragon form, you can bite through buildings, armored vehicles, and military-grade…
destroyer_devourer_of_stone.mechanicalEffects: You are capable of biting through and eating anything inedible: glass, stone, wood, steel, etc. and consuming it as though it had nutritional value. You cannot eat anything you can’t fit into your mouth. This does mean that in full dragon form, you can bite through buildings, armored vehicles, and military-grade equipment. Spend Momentum to be able to consume anything that has been intentionally poisoned.

destroyer_enhanced_impact.name: Enhanced Impact
destroyer_enhanced_impact.description: Whenever you successfully deal Injury with your Knack Skill, you also knock the target back one range band. This does not do any extra damage but can put someone in a tight spot.
destroyer_enhanced_impact.mechanicalEffects: Whenever you successfully deal Injury with your Knack Skill, you also knock the target back one range band. This does not do any extra damage but can put someone in a tight spot.

destroyer_leeching_strength.name: Leeching Strength
destroyer_leeching_strength.description: You have the power to drain the inherent properties from an object. When you use this Knack, make a Knack Skill roll. The object must be something you can hold in one hand. On any successes, you destroy the object (by crushing, consuming, smashing, etc., at your choice) and absorb the essence of its qualities. These…
destroyer_leeching_strength.mechanicalEffects: You have the power to drain the inherent properties from an object. When you use this Knack, make a Knack Skill roll. The object must be something you can hold in one hand. On any successes, you destroy the object (by crushing, consuming, smashing, etc., at your choice) and absorb the essence of its qualities. These devoured properties persist for the duration of the scene. For example: consuming the power out of a burning torch would give you the Elemental (Fire) damage tag to your attacks or eating a diamond might grant Hard (1) Armor, etc. The Storyguide and the player adjudicate which tags and properties an item bestows, though it should make sense for the object’s profile.

destroyer_terrible_dragon_roar.name: Terrible Dragon Roar
destroyer_terrible_dragon_roar.description: You attack your foes with a forceful shout, or shatter walls with the power of your voice. Spend Momentum and make an attack using your Knack Skill, if it is higher than Close Combat or Athletics. When used against an enemy, it is an attack with the following tags: Lethal, Loud, Messy, Piercing, Pushing, Reach. When…
destroyer_terrible_dragon_roar.mechanicalEffects: You attack your foes with a forceful shout, or shatter walls with the power of your voice. Spend Momentum and make an attack using your Knack Skill, if it is higher than Close Combat or Athletics. When used against an enemy, it is an attack with the following tags: Lethal, Loud, Messy, Piercing, Pushing, Reach. When used against an object with a Scale less than your Destroyer dots, roll Knack Skill. With any successes, it shatters in an instant.

destroyer_render_of_cities.name: Render Of Cities
destroyer_render_of_cities.description: Prerequisite: Terrible Dragon Roar You become a whirlwind of destruction, adding your Destroyer rating to force Scale for the purposes of demolition and mass destruction. In a fight, spend Momentum to add the Shockwave tag to all attacks you make until the end of the Turn.
destroyer_render_of_cities.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: Terrible Dragon Roar You become a whirlwind of destruction, adding your Destroyer rating to force Scale for the purposes of demolition and mass destruction. In a fight, spend Momentum to add the Shockwave tag to all attacks you make until the end of the Turn.

destroyer_world_eater.name: World-Eater
destroyer_world_eater.description: When you destroy something, make a Knack Skill roll. On any successes, you do it so completely that no trace of the thing remains. At five or more successes, you may spend Momentum to erase the thing from the memories of others. This only affects small scale things, unless you also have the ability to perform…
destroyer_world_eater.mechanicalEffects: When you destroy something, make a Knack Skill roll. On any successes, you do it so completely that no trace of the thing remains. At five or more successes, you may spend Momentum to erase the thing from the memories of others. This only affects small scale things, unless you also have the ability to perform Destroyer Feats of Scale.

guardian_bestow_responsibility.name: Bestow Responsibility
guardian_bestow_responsibility.description: When you task a target of lower Tier with protecting something important to you (such as your lair or hoard), they protect it as you would, taking actions relevant to your inter - ests. You automatically know if the character tasked with protection is in trouble, wounded, or has failed in their given task.
guardian_bestow_responsibility.mechanicalEffects: When you task a target of lower Tier with protecting something important to you (such as your lair or hoard), they protect it as you would, taking actions relevant to your inter - ests. You automatically know if the character tasked with protection is in trouble, wounded, or has failed in their given task.

guardian_clarity_of_purpose.name: Clarity Of Purpose
guardian_clarity_of_purpose.description: Dedicate yourself to an ideal of your choosing (fight for love and justice, defend the weak, save the World from invasion). When you take action to defend this ideal, gain +1 Enhancement to all applicable rolls and any Stunts you may have gained from Knacks, including transformations.
guardian_clarity_of_purpose.mechanicalEffects: Dedicate yourself to an ideal of your choosing (fight for love and justice, defend the weak, save the World from invasion). When you take action to defend this ideal, gain +1 Enhancement to all applicable rolls and any Stunts you may have gained from Knacks, including transformations.

guardian_honed_alertness.name: Honed Alertness
guardian_honed_alertness.description: While you protect someone, neither you nor the character in your care can be ambushed. If an enemy has an effect that would contest this, make a Clash of Wills. You may spend Momentum to grant either Hard (1) armor or (Guardian dots/2, rounded up) to Defense to your protected target until the end of your next turn.
guardian_honed_alertness.mechanicalEffects: While you protect someone, neither you nor the character in your care can be ambushed. If an enemy has an effect that would contest this, make a Clash of Wills. You may spend Momentum to grant either Hard (1) armor or (Guardian dots/2, rounded up) to Defense to your protected target until the end of your next turn.

guardian_imbue_talisman.name: Imbue Talisman
guardian_imbue_talisman.description: Bless an object (usually from your hoard and given to someone you wish to protect but not required) and make a Knack Skill roll. If any successes are achieved, it then grants the bearer +2 Enhancement to rolls made to defend or protect against a particular person, thing, or situation as defined at the time of blessing.
guardian_imbue_talisman.mechanicalEffects: Bless an object (usually from your hoard and given to someone you wish to protect but not required) and make a Knack Skill roll. If any successes are achieved, it then grants the bearer +2 Enhancement to rolls made to defend or protect against a particular person, thing, or situation as defined at the time of blessing.

guardian_living_pillar_2.name: Living Pillar
guardian_living_pillar_2.description: Prerequisite: Vigilant Protector When you protect someone else with your body, you are immune to environmental hazards: The flames of a burning building do not scorch you, a landslide does not crush you, water cannot drown you, and so on. As long as you keep your target close (within arm’s reach), they benefit from…
guardian_living_pillar_2.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: Vigilant Protector When you protect someone else with your body, you are immune to environmental hazards: The flames of a burning building do not scorch you, a landslide does not crush you, water cannot drown you, and so on. As long as you keep your target close (within arm’s reach), they benefit from the same immunity, but still need to eat, sleep, etc., so it’s best to leave a hazardous area as quickly as possible. If you have Elemental Immunity transformed, you may instead spend 2 Momentum to apply this immunity to your protected target without them needing to be near you.

guardian_vigilant_protector.name: Vigilant Protector
guardian_vigilant_protector.description: When you stand guard over a person, place, or thing (eggs, your hoard, a bodyguard’s charge), you do not need to eat or sleep so long as your vigil persists. This benefit extends so long as the protected target remains within your sight. You may do other things — talk, interact, move around, etc. — but must devote…
guardian_vigilant_protector.mechanicalEffects: When you stand guard over a person, place, or thing (eggs, your hoard, a bodyguard’s charge), you do not need to eat or sleep so long as your vigil persists. This benefit extends so long as the protected target remains within your sight. You may do other things — talk, interact, move around, etc. — but must devote most of your time to keeping your vigil. You may only keep vigil over one thing at a time.

guardian_warning_sense.name: Warning Sense
guardian_warning_sense.description: You sense the presence of danger before it emerges. Spend Momentum and double the successes on any roll to detect ambushes or to discern whether a person means harm.
guardian_warning_sense.mechanicalEffects: You sense the presence of danger before it emerges. Spend Momentum and double the successes on any roll to detect ambushes or to discern whether a person means harm.

healer_absorb_ailment.name: Absorb Ailment
healer_absorb_ailment.description: Touch an ailing target and make a Knack Skill roll. On any successes, you absorb whatever is afflicting the target, taking on the Injuries, poisons, or diseases they might be suffering, and you must contend with their effects yourself. The target recovers as if they had never been affected in the first place.
healer_absorb_ailment.mechanicalEffects: Touch an ailing target and make a Knack Skill roll. On any successes, you absorb whatever is afflicting the target, taking on the Injuries, poisons, or diseases they might be suffering, and you must contend with their effects yourself. The target recovers as if they had never been affected in the first place.

healer_combat_medic_2.name: Combat Medic
healer_combat_medic_2.description: When you tend to an ally’s wounds in the heat of battle, once per turn remove any +1 Bruised Injury they may be suffering — including damage sustained to armor — without needing to roll. You may not make Mixed actions when uti - lizing this Knack.
healer_combat_medic_2.mechanicalEffects: When you tend to an ally’s wounds in the heat of battle, once per turn remove any +1 Bruised Injury they may be suffering — including damage sustained to armor — without needing to roll. You may not make Mixed actions when uti - lizing this Knack.

healer_herd_immunity.name: Herd Immunity
healer_herd_immunity.description: Designate up to your Knack Skill in targets to be in your care. While under your protection, they get +2 Enhancement to all rolls to resist disease and poison, and to recover from injury which lasts as long as Herd Immunity is one of your active Knacks. Storyguide characters you protect in this way are automatically…
healer_herd_immunity.mechanicalEffects: Designate up to your Knack Skill in targets to be in your care. While under your protection, they get +2 Enhancement to all rolls to resist disease and poison, and to recover from injury which lasts as long as Herd Immunity is one of your active Knacks. Storyguide characters you protect in this way are automatically protected — that is, the Storyguide does not need to make rolls when they would be affected by disease or poison.

healer_instant_diagnosis_2.name: Instant Diagnosis
healer_instant_diagnosis_2.description: When you spend time interacting with an ailing target, you diagnose what is wrong with them, as well as any other pertinent medical information. In the event that you are di - agnosing a patient suffering from a supernatural disease, this may require a Knack Skill roll, which is opposed by whomever afflicted the…
healer_instant_diagnosis_2.mechanicalEffects: When you spend time interacting with an ailing target, you diagnose what is wrong with them, as well as any other pertinent medical information. In the event that you are di - agnosing a patient suffering from a supernatural disease, this may require a Knack Skill roll, which is opposed by whomever afflicted the victim.

healer_internal_refinery_2.name: Internal Refinery
healer_internal_refinery_2.description: When exposed to a poison or disease, make a Knack Skill roll. A success instantly cures yourself. By spending a point of Momentum, you then also generate one dose of a cure or antidote, which you can secrete and administer to another person. If you have the Dragon’s Fangs transformed, you may instead spend Momentum to…
healer_internal_refinery_2.mechanicalEffects: When exposed to a poison or disease, make a Knack Skill roll. A success instantly cures yourself. By spending a point of Momentum, you then also generate one dose of a cure or antidote, which you can secrete and administer to another person. If you have the Dragon’s Fangs transformed, you may instead spend Momentum to absorb the poison and inflict it via the bite attack.

healer_rapid_regrowth.name: Rapid Regrowth
healer_rapid_regrowth.description: When you attend to a wounded target — including yourself — make a Knack Skill roll. With any successes, the target ignores any Injury complications (though this does not re - move the injury) until the end of the scene. At the end of the scene, they roll Athletics or Integrity (whichever is higher) + Stamina + your…
healer_rapid_regrowth.mechanicalEffects: When you attend to a wounded target — including yourself — make a Knack Skill roll. With any successes, the target ignores any Injury complications (though this does not re - move the injury) until the end of the scene. At the end of the scene, they roll Athletics or Integrity (whichever is higher) + Stamina + your Healer Calling. They heal Injuries based on the number of successes achieved (so 4 would heal Maimed, 2 heals Injured, and so on).

healer_violent_purification.name: Violent Purification
healer_violent_purification.description: When you suffer from a disease or poison, make a Knack Skill roll with a Difficulty equal to the remaining value of the Condition or Complication. If successful, the disease or poison is violently expelled from your body in a hideous miasma. Anyone exposed to the ejection from your body must roll to resist being…
healer_violent_purification.mechanicalEffects: When you suffer from a disease or poison, make a Knack Skill roll with a Difficulty equal to the remaining value of the Condition or Complication. If successful, the disease or poison is violently expelled from your body in a hideous miasma. Anyone exposed to the ejection from your body must roll to resist being poisoned or diseased themselves.

judge_enforcers_eye.name: Enforcer’S Eye
judge_enforcers_eye.description: When observing a crowd or another group of characters (such as assembled personages at a party), you automati - cally identify anyone with a criminal background. Gain +1 Enhancement to any actions taken to either further pursue their criminal activities, or to bring them to justice. If the target is of a Tier higher…
judge_enforcers_eye.mechanicalEffects: When observing a crowd or another group of characters (such as assembled personages at a party), you automati - cally identify anyone with a criminal background. Gain +1 Enhancement to any actions taken to either further pursue their criminal activities, or to bring them to justice. If the target is of a Tier higher than you or is concealing their identity via magic, make a Clash of Wills.

judge_lie_detector_2.name: Lie Detector
judge_lie_detector_2.description: Anyone of a Tier lower than you must overcome Com - plication 2, “Under Scrutiny” when lying to you; failure or inability to buy off this Complication results in a confession from the target. Spend Momentum, and they simply cannot lie to you at all. The Storyguide should also notify you when a lie has been told,…
judge_lie_detector_2.mechanicalEffects: Anyone of a Tier lower than you must overcome Com - plication 2, “Under Scrutiny” when lying to you; failure or inability to buy off this Complication results in a confession from the target. Spend Momentum, and they simply cannot lie to you at all. The Storyguide should also notify you when a lie has been told, though it does not automatically reveal the truth, but also reveals nebulous truth, such as “he has been convinced this is true” — which should always be a means for characters to pursue the person who manipulated the target in the first place. ONE MORE QUESTION! When questioning a target that has broken a rule or law — either one you established, or one belonging to a nation, state, etc. — they are compelled to keep answering your questions as long as you keep asking them. The questions need only be vaguely related to the broken rule or law. The target must use a Basic Action to answer the question, which may be part of a Mixed Action. They do not need to answer honestly but they do need to answer. Targets of the same Tier or greater can make a Clash of Wills to break free of the compulsion. You may use this Knack in combat as well as in any Intrigue or Procedural scene.

judge_petty_tyrant.name: Petty Tyrant
judge_petty_tyrant.description: While in your Lair, you may establish up to your Judge Calling in arbitrary rules, which you may change or adjust at the start of any scene. Any Storyguide character who doesn’t follow your rules gains a +2 Complication of “Rulebreaker” to all actions while within your domain, if a target refuses or is unable to buy…
judge_petty_tyrant.mechanicalEffects: While in your Lair, you may establish up to your Judge Calling in arbitrary rules, which you may change or adjust at the start of any scene. Any Storyguide character who doesn’t follow your rules gains a +2 Complication of “Rulebreaker” to all actions while within your domain, if a target refuses or is unable to buy off the Complication, they are compelled to leave your Lair and must do so immediately. If they cannot do so immediately, they must make every effort to do so as swiftly as possible. Other players’ characters are not re - quired to obey your petty edicts. This Knack applies even if you have tricked an enemy into breaking your rules.

judge_seat_of_power.name: Seat Of Power
judge_seat_of_power.description: While in a place in which you hold power (your lair or any other establishment or organization under your control, etc.) the atmosphere for dealing with you can never be bet - ter or worse than neutral at your choice, and any positive or negative atmosphere is increased or decreased by 1 to the regular maximum or…
judge_seat_of_power.mechanicalEffects: While in a place in which you hold power (your lair or any other establishment or organization under your control, etc.) the atmosphere for dealing with you can never be bet - ter or worse than neutral at your choice, and any positive or negative atmosphere is increased or decreased by 1 to the regular maximum or minimum of +/-3.

judge_terror_of_the_guilty_2.name: Terror Of The Guilty
judge_terror_of_the_guilty_2.description: Anyone guilty of a wrongdoing of your choosing who is of lower Tier than you cannot bear to be in your presence and will flee in panic and terror or break down weeping and confessing. The wrongdoing must be something abhorrent to your personal ethics and/or morality, or applicable to the laws of your place of origin.…
judge_terror_of_the_guilty_2.mechanicalEffects: Anyone guilty of a wrongdoing of your choosing who is of lower Tier than you cannot bear to be in your presence and will flee in panic and terror or break down weeping and confessing. The wrongdoing must be something abhorrent to your personal ethics and/or morality, or applicable to the laws of your place of origin. To apply this to anyone of the same Tier or higher, spend Momentum and win a Clash of Wills.

judge_the_pain_of_dishonesty_2.name: The Pain Of Dishonesty
judge_the_pain_of_dishonesty_2.description: Prerequisite: Lie Detector Spend Momentum and anyone who lies directly to you suffers a +1 Injury Condition. You choose whether or not to inflict the damage or Condition, automatically alerting you of the lie (though it does not reveal the truth). You also know the severity of the lie and therefore can choose not to…
judge_the_pain_of_dishonesty_2.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: Lie Detector Spend Momentum and anyone who lies directly to you suffers a +1 Injury Condition. You choose whether or not to inflict the damage or Condition, automatically alerting you of the lie (though it does not reveal the truth). You also know the severity of the lie and therefore can choose not to harm someone who is lying to preserve someone’s feelings as opposed to lying to obstruct a criminal investigation. If the target is another player’s character with whom you have Bond, the Bond lessens by 1 unless the character chooses to reveal the truth.

ruler_fearless_presence.name: Fearless Presence
ruler_fearless_presence.description: Prerequisite: Perfect Poise As long as they can see you, your followers of lesser Tier are fearless and do not panic or flee. They will walk into the Underworld, plunge into a Titanic monster’s mouth, or face down a wrathful storm brewed up by a petulant god so long as you lead them.
ruler_fearless_presence.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: Perfect Poise As long as they can see you, your followers of lesser Tier are fearless and do not panic or flee. They will walk into the Underworld, plunge into a Titanic monster’s mouth, or face down a wrathful storm brewed up by a petulant god so long as you lead them.

ruler_invoke_anger.name: Invoke Anger
ruler_invoke_anger.description: Target one enemy that you can see. Make a Knack Skill roll, resisted by the target’s Integrity. On a success, invert the target’s attitude to a negative one. Once the target has been enraged, you may spend Momentum to drive the target to attack another character in the scene.
ruler_invoke_anger.mechanicalEffects: Target one enemy that you can see. Make a Knack Skill roll, resisted by the target’s Integrity. On a success, invert the target’s attitude to a negative one. Once the target has been enraged, you may spend Momentum to drive the target to attack another character in the scene.

ruler_invulnerable_master.name: Invulnerable Master
ruler_invulnerable_master.description: While leading followers loyal to you (Storyguide characters gained through Birthrights or roleplay, not bandmates), you can spend 1 Momentum to shrug off a +1 Bruised injury or 2 Momentum to ignore a +2 Injured injury when they would be inflicted.
ruler_invulnerable_master.mechanicalEffects: While leading followers loyal to you (Storyguide characters gained through Birthrights or roleplay, not bandmates), you can spend 1 Momentum to shrug off a +1 Bruised injury or 2 Momentum to ignore a +2 Injured injury when they would be inflicted.

ruler_irrepressible_charisma.name: Irrepressible Charisma
ruler_irrepressible_charisma.description: When you make a first impression, roll your Knack Skill. On a success, the target remembers you favorably, improving the Attitude of everyone you interact with for the first time by 1.
ruler_irrepressible_charisma.mechanicalEffects: When you make a first impression, roll your Knack Skill. On a success, the target remembers you favorably, improving the Attitude of everyone you interact with for the first time by 1.

ruler_loyal_servant.name: Loyal Servant
ruler_loyal_servant.description: When you dispatch a subordinate to deliver a message or speak as a proxy on your behalf, they represent you and your interests as if you were present. You automatically know if the character you have sent in your stead has been ignored, mistreated, or if someone has not-so-proverbially shot the messenger. Gain +1…
ruler_loyal_servant.mechanicalEffects: When you dispatch a subordinate to deliver a message or speak as a proxy on your behalf, they represent you and your interests as if you were present. You automatically know if the character you have sent in your stead has been ignored, mistreated, or if someone has not-so-proverbially shot the messenger. Gain +1 Enhancement to all rolls to get vengeance for the slight until the end of the story or until you successfully get even, whichever comes first.

ruler_pack_alpha.name: Pack Alpha
ruler_pack_alpha.description: When you display superior might or your impressive physique before a group of onlookers (of your Tier or lower), make a Knack Skill roll. On any success, they become Pawns (as the Birthright) with a rating equal to your Ruler Calling at the time of acquisition. They remain loyal to you until the end of the story and…
ruler_pack_alpha.mechanicalEffects: When you display superior might or your impressive physique before a group of onlookers (of your Tier or lower), make a Knack Skill roll. On any success, they become Pawns (as the Birthright) with a rating equal to your Ruler Calling at the time of acquisition. They remain loyal to you until the end of the story and can be purchased at the equivalent Birthright cost with experience when this effect wears off.

ruler_perfect_poise.name: Perfect Poise
ruler_perfect_poise.description: You cannot be shaken by panic or fear unless it is from another supernatural source — in which case, you gain +2 Enhancement to resist it (such as making Clash of Wills rolls) that applies before you roll. You also gain +1 Enhancement to all Social rolls involving grace, poise, or composure, and to keep a “poker…
ruler_perfect_poise.mechanicalEffects: You cannot be shaken by panic or fear unless it is from another supernatural source — in which case, you gain +2 Enhancement to resist it (such as making Clash of Wills rolls) that applies before you roll. You also gain +1 Enhancement to all Social rolls involving grace, poise, or composure, and to keep a “poker face.” This also applies before you roll.

mystic_immortal_mastermind.name: Immortal Mastermind
mystic_immortal_mastermind.description: Prerequisite: Sage Counsel When you make a plan of action and direct others to fol - low, it grants them +1 Enhancement to all actions. Anyone who doesn’t follow your plan gains +1 Difficulty to all actions. Bandmates are not under any obligation to follow your every word but do gain the benefit if they opt to…
mystic_immortal_mastermind.mechanicalEffects: Prerequisite: Sage Counsel When you make a plan of action and direct others to fol - low, it grants them +1 Enhancement to all actions. Anyone who doesn’t follow your plan gains +1 Difficulty to all actions. Bandmates are not under any obligation to follow your every word but do gain the benefit if they opt to participate. When dealing with an enemy, you are free to create a plan in order to bait your opposition into suffering the Difficulty — just as planned.

mystic_joyous_revelation.name: Joyous Revelation
mystic_joyous_revelation.description: Your draconic nature exults when you succumb to the power of Memory. When you resolve the Revelation Con - dition and you assume your draconic form, you may choose to gain Enhancement instead of additional dice when you spend Momentum. Enhancement gained this way applies before you roll.
mystic_joyous_revelation.mechanicalEffects: Your draconic nature exults when you succumb to the power of Memory. When you resolve the Revelation Con - dition and you assume your draconic form, you may choose to gain Enhancement instead of additional dice when you spend Momentum. Enhancement gained this way applies before you roll.

mystic_linked_to_the_past.name: Linked To The Past
mystic_linked_to_the_past.description: Your connection to draconic memory runs deeper than others, allowing you to delve further into the web of connection. You may gain 1 additional Memory Condition and may invoke one Memory Condition twice per session. A second purchase of this Knack allows you to make a Knack Skill roll — on any successes, one of your…
mystic_linked_to_the_past.mechanicalEffects: Your connection to draconic memory runs deeper than others, allowing you to delve further into the web of connection. You may gain 1 additional Memory Condition and may invoke one Memory Condition twice per session. A second purchase of this Knack allows you to make a Knack Skill roll — on any successes, one of your broodmates may also invoke one Memory Condition a second time per session.

mystic_omniglot_translation.name: Omniglot Translation
mystic_omniglot_translation.description: When you converse in or read a foreign language, your communication is flawless, without a trace of an accent. You can turn out translations in your native language in a matter of minutes without needing to roll. If you are translating mystical runes or the handwriting of Gods, you still do so swiftly but must make a…
mystic_omniglot_translation.mechanicalEffects: When you converse in or read a foreign language, your communication is flawless, without a trace of an accent. You can turn out translations in your native language in a matter of minutes without needing to roll. If you are translating mystical runes or the handwriting of Gods, you still do so swiftly but must make a Knack Skill roll.

mystic_presence_of_magic.name: Presence Of Magic
mystic_presence_of_magic.description: You always know when you are near an object or place of true magical or sacred power. How this manifests is up to you. Ask the Storyguide if an object is magical or sacred, and she must tell you honestly “yes” or “no.” This bypasses the need to make any kind of Occult roll to identify a place or object of magical or…
mystic_presence_of_magic.mechanicalEffects: You always know when you are near an object or place of true magical or sacred power. How this manifests is up to you. Ask the Storyguide if an object is magical or sacred, and she must tell you honestly “yes” or “no.” This bypasses the need to make any kind of Occult roll to identify a place or object of magical or sacred power.

mystic_sage_counsel.name: Sage Counsel
mystic_sage_counsel.description: When someone approaches you in need of advice, they gain +1 Enhancement to resolve the problem themselves if you work together on a solution. If they can’t solve it, you gain the same bonus to all rolls to resolve the issue by your - self. These bonuses apply before rolls are made. Spend Mo - mentum to impel a…
mystic_sage_counsel.mechanicalEffects: When someone approaches you in need of advice, they gain +1 Enhancement to resolve the problem themselves if you work together on a solution. If they can’t solve it, you gain the same bonus to all rolls to resolve the issue by your - self. These bonuses apply before rolls are made. Spend Mo - mentum to impel a Storyguide Character to come to seeking your counsel.

nomad_cross_the_distance.name: Cross The Distance
nomad_cross_the_distance.description: When you take a Move action, cross the distance instantly. This movement ignores hazardous and difficult terrain and crosses distance where there may not be a safe place to walk — such as across a chasm. So long as you can see your destination and it is within a distance you can Move, you appear there unharmed. This…
nomad_cross_the_distance.mechanicalEffects: When you take a Move action, cross the distance instantly. This movement ignores hazardous and difficult terrain and crosses distance where there may not be a safe place to walk — such as across a chasm. So long as you can see your destination and it is within a distance you can Move, you appear there unharmed. This may only be used to augment the reflexive Move action and does not apply to Rush or Disengage.

nomad_ever_moving.name: Ever Moving
nomad_ever_moving.description: When you move from place to place and don’t stay in one location for more than a day, targets of lesser Tier cannot follow your trail and cannot find any record of you: no receipts, no stray hairs or fibers, and so on. Enemies of the same Tier or higher make a Clash of Wills in order to track you down.
nomad_ever_moving.mechanicalEffects: When you move from place to place and don’t stay in one location for more than a day, targets of lesser Tier cannot follow your trail and cannot find any record of you: no receipts, no stray hairs or fibers, and so on. Enemies of the same Tier or higher make a Clash of Wills in order to track you down.

nomad_friends_anywhere.name: Friends Anywhere
nomad_friends_anywhere.description: When you arrive in any location, you always have friends and allies you can rely on. You may spend Momen - tum in place of invoking a Path to declare a Contact of your choosing (which does not need to be related to your Path) with a rating equal to your Nomad dots.
nomad_friends_anywhere.mechanicalEffects: When you arrive in any location, you always have friends and allies you can rely on. You may spend Momen - tum in place of invoking a Path to declare a Contact of your choosing (which does not need to be related to your Path) with a rating equal to your Nomad dots.

nomad_internal_compass.name: Internal Compass
nomad_internal_compass.description: You always know your precise direction — whether that be navigating while on foot or driving a car or working your way out of a petty God’s labyrinthine prison. You do not ever have to roll to navigate somewhere, or to find your way out of being lost. If you are entrapped in a magical maze, make a Clash of Wills with…
nomad_internal_compass.mechanicalEffects: You always know your precise direction — whether that be navigating while on foot or driving a car or working your way out of a petty God’s labyrinthine prison. You do not ever have to roll to navigate somewhere, or to find your way out of being lost. If you are entrapped in a magical maze, make a Clash of Wills with +2 Enhancement.

nomad_the_long_road_to_anywhere.name: The Long Road To Anywhere
nomad_the_long_road_to_anywhere.description: You make an extended journey without stopping but must rest upon arrival. When you arrive, you can ask hospi - tality of anyone of a lower Tier than you, and if they refuse you have the option to make the target suffer +2 Difficulty to all actions until you choose to remove the penalty.
nomad_the_long_road_to_anywhere.mechanicalEffects: You make an extended journey without stopping but must rest upon arrival. When you arrive, you can ask hospi - tality of anyone of a lower Tier than you, and if they refuse you have the option to make the target suffer +2 Difficulty to all actions until you choose to remove the penalty.

nomad_traveling_companions.name: Traveling Companions
nomad_traveling_companions.description: You can always find confluences of fellow travelers. You’re always able to encounter traveling bands, biker gangs, a bus full of dragon enthusiasts at any point after your Nomad dots in days of travel. These companions act as temporary Pawns with a rating equal to your Nomad rating which may be purchased as a…
nomad_traveling_companions.mechanicalEffects: You can always find confluences of fellow travelers. You’re always able to encounter traveling bands, biker gangs, a bus full of dragon enthusiasts at any point after your Nomad dots in days of travel. These companions act as temporary Pawns with a rating equal to your Nomad rating which may be purchased as a Birthright at the end of the story.

nomad_unfettered.name: Unfettered
nomad_unfettered.description: Obstacles cannot stop you; locks do not deter you, and a closed door is nothing but an invitation. When facing a mundane obstacle that would prevent you from getting where you want to be or is between you and your goal (an item you intend to steal, a comrade in danger, etc.) you ignore it. You do not need to roll to…
nomad_unfettered.mechanicalEffects: Obstacles cannot stop you; locks do not deter you, and a closed door is nothing but an invitation. When facing a mundane obstacle that would prevent you from getting where you want to be or is between you and your goal (an item you intend to steal, a comrade in danger, etc.) you ignore it. You do not need to roll to bypass any obstacle, pick locks, or get past a closed area. If the area is blocked by supernatural means, you automatically make a Clash of Wills and add your Nomad dots as Enhancement.

predator_apex_predator.name: Apex Predator
predator_apex_predator.description: When a target of lower Tier who you have been pursuing attacks you or otherwise attempts to hunt you in return, increase the Difficulty of all Stunts they apply against you by +1. Spend Momentum to increase it by an additional +1.
predator_apex_predator.mechanicalEffects: When a target of lower Tier who you have been pursuing attacks you or otherwise attempts to hunt you in return, increase the Difficulty of all Stunts they apply against you by +1. Spend Momentum to increase it by an additional +1.

predator_blood_in_the_water.name: Blood In The Water
predator_blood_in_the_water.description: When you pursue, hunt, track, or harm an already in - jured target, you add the value of their current Injury Condition as Enhancement to relevant rolls, including attack rolls.
predator_blood_in_the_water.mechanicalEffects: When you pursue, hunt, track, or harm an already in - jured target, you add the value of their current Injury Condition as Enhancement to relevant rolls, including attack rolls.

predator_implacable_killer.name: Implacable Killer
predator_implacable_killer.description: Pick a target that you are hunting. As long as you hunt, stalk, ambush, or otherwise assault them indirectly, gain your choice of either Hard (1) Armor or +2 Difficulty on the target’s use of the Inflict Damage or Critical Hit Stunts. If you stand and fight your prey head-on and fairly, this effect immediately ends.
predator_implacable_killer.mechanicalEffects: Pick a target that you are hunting. As long as you hunt, stalk, ambush, or otherwise assault them indirectly, gain your choice of either Hard (1) Armor or +2 Difficulty on the target’s use of the Inflict Damage or Critical Hit Stunts. If you stand and fight your prey head-on and fairly, this effect immediately ends.

predator_most_dangerous_prey.name: Most Dangerous Prey
predator_most_dangerous_prey.description: Choose an enemy. While you pursue them, gain +1 Enhancement to all rolls made against the target (including attack rolls) until the end of the session or until you catch them, whichever comes first. You gain access to the follow - ing Stunts, which may be applied to any attack action made against your quarry: Stalk…
predator_most_dangerous_prey.mechanicalEffects: Choose an enemy. While you pursue them, gain +1 Enhancement to all rolls made against the target (including attack rolls) until the end of the session or until you catch them, whichever comes first. You gain access to the follow - ing Stunts, which may be applied to any attack action made against your quarry: Stalk (1s): After resolving your attack, spend a success to take an additional Move action. Entrap (any successes above Defense): You trap the tar - get in place. They may not make Move, Rush, or Disengage actions. To end the effect, the target must make Athletics + Dexterity rolls vs. your Knack Skill until they succeed or until you choose to end it, whichever comes first.

predator_perfect_camouflage.name: Perfect Camouflage
predator_perfect_camouflage.description: You blend in seamlessly with your surroundings, granting +3 Enhancement to avoid notice by the person you are pursuing, which applies before you roll. Targets of a lower Tier simply cannot spot you. Gain access to the following Stunt: Vanish (successes equal to the target’s Composure): After resolving an attack, you…
predator_perfect_camouflage.mechanicalEffects: You blend in seamlessly with your surroundings, granting +3 Enhancement to avoid notice by the person you are pursuing, which applies before you roll. Targets of a lower Tier simply cannot spot you. Gain access to the following Stunt: Vanish (successes equal to the target’s Composure): After resolving an attack, you vanish from the target’s line of sight. They may not target you with any action until the start of your next turn.

predator_quenched_with_blood.name: Quenched With Blood
predator_quenched_with_blood.description: When an enemy is Taken Out by you, spend Momentum and heal 1 Injury, starting with the most severe. This does not heal any Injuries taken to Armor.
predator_quenched_with_blood.mechanicalEffects: When an enemy is Taken Out by you, spend Momentum and heal 1 Injury, starting with the most severe. This does not heal any Injuries taken to Armor.

predator_send_the_pack.name: Send The Pack
predator_send_the_pack.description: Make a Knack Skill roll. On a success, designate a target that you can see with unaided sight. Friendly characters you designate up to your Inheritance can pursue them without ceasing and at no increased Difficulty.
predator_send_the_pack.mechanicalEffects: Make a Knack Skill roll. On a success, designate a target that you can see with unaided sight. Friendly characters you designate up to your Inheritance can pursue them without ceasing and at no increased Difficulty.

primeval_a_dragons_territory.name: A Dragon’S Territory
primeval_a_dragons_territory.description: The Field you are fighting in becomes your territory. When an enemy enters your territory, you have the option to make one attack against them, regardless of which range band they have entered, and which may not be boosted by any Knacks that allow you to make extra attacks. You use this ability even if you have…
primeval_a_dragons_territory.mechanicalEffects: The Field you are fighting in becomes your territory. When an enemy enters your territory, you have the option to make one attack against them, regardless of which range band they have entered, and which may not be boosted by any Knacks that allow you to make extra attacks. You use this ability even if you have already taken your action this round and may do so no matter how many enemies enter your di - vine territory, but you may only make one attack per enemy.

primeval_consuming_embodiment.name: Consuming Embodiment
primeval_consuming_embodiment.description: At the start of any turn, make a Knack Skill roll. satyr_blind_luck.mechanicalEffects: As the Sage Knack, Master of The World, except that you may only use it when you are hindered by a Complication (not including Hooves). While inside a Field, you may define up to three points of Enhancements or Complica - tions (or a combination of each) that are readily apparent to your perceptions (which may be enhanced by other abilities) but not obvious to other observers. They must conform to the Features of the Field, however — it makes sense for a shotgun to be behind the bar, but not a rock - et launcher. The hardwood floors of a burning building could be expected to be weak, but the flames can’t be cold. Only three total Enhancements or Complications can be applied to a Field at a time, regardless of how many Scions possess this ability.

satyr_cup_of_wisdom.name: Cup Of Wisdom
satyr_cup_of_wisdom.description: You drink heavily to obtain knowledge. When you try to solve a complex problem, take the Drunk Condition for the rest of the scene to gain a +1 Enhancement on your rolls to solve it.
satyr_cup_of_wisdom.mechanicalEffects: You drink heavily to obtain knowledge. When you try to solve a complex problem, take the Drunk Condition for the rest of the scene to gain a +1 Enhancement on your rolls to solve it.

satyr_fruit_of_passion.name: Fruit Of Passion
satyr_fruit_of_passion.description: Choose a form of art as your driving passion. For the rest of the session, add an extra Success on rolls involving the creation of that art. After producing a work that you deem satisfactory, you can switch to another art form.
satyr_fruit_of_passion.mechanicalEffects: Choose a form of art as your driving passion. For the rest of the session, add an extra Success on rolls involving the creation of that art. After producing a work that you deem satisfactory, you can switch to another art form.

satyr_give_me_another.name: Give Me Another
satyr_give_me_another.description: It’s easy to convince others to keep doing something that they enjoy. Roll Subterfuge + Manipulation to make a target repeat their current willing activity for another iteration. Spend a point of Momentum if doing so would put the target at risk of harm.
satyr_give_me_another.mechanicalEffects: It’s easy to convince others to keep doing something that they enjoy. Roll Subterfuge + Manipulation to make a target repeat their current willing activity for another iteration. Spend a point of Momentum if doing so would put the target at risk of harm.

satyr_party_animal.name: Party Animal
satyr_party_animal.description: While you pursue a passion, you can stave off the need for food, drink, or sleep for a number of days equal to your Resilience without suffering any negative effects. At the end of that period, or when you have satisfied your need, you fall into an undisturbable slumber for an equal amount of time.
satyr_party_animal.mechanicalEffects: While you pursue a passion, you can stave off the need for food, drink, or sleep for a number of days equal to your Resilience without suffering any negative effects. At the end of that period, or when you have satisfied your need, you fall into an undisturbable slumber for an equal amount of time.

satyr_revels.name: Revels
satyr_revels.description: While you take part in any performance, celebration, or friendly gathering, the Scale of social actions for ev - eryone involved is reduced by 1. You must remain present and participate actively for this ability to work.
satyr_revels.mechanicalEffects: While you take part in any performance, celebration, or friendly gathering, the Scale of social actions for ev - eryone involved is reduced by 1. You must remain present and participate actively for this ability to work.

satyr_wild_at_heart.name: Wild At Heart
satyr_wild_at_heart.description: When you intimidate someone with your ferocity, spend Momentum to double the number of successes on the Knack Skill roll.
satyr_wild_at_heart.mechanicalEffects: When you intimidate someone with your ferocity, spend Momentum to double the number of successes on the Knack Skill roll.

satyr_hair_of_the_goat.name: Hair Of The Goat
satyr_hair_of_the_goat.description: You are immune to all forms of poison and venom. If you spend a point of Momentum, you can mix whatever available liquids you have to make one dose of an antidote to any poison you know of.
satyr_hair_of_the_goat.mechanicalEffects: You are immune to all forms of poison and venom. If you spend a point of Momentum, you can mix whatever available liquids you have to make one dose of an antidote to any poison you know of.

satyr_panic.name: Panic
satyr_panic.description: Spend Momentum to make the Field that you occupy terrifying to lower-Tier beings. The power is indiscrimi - nate, and causes all those affected, anyone lacking a Legend score, to flee out of the Field as quickly as possible. Once outside, they will not return for the remainder of the scene.
satyr_panic.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to make the Field that you occupy terrifying to lower-Tier beings. The power is indiscrimi - nate, and causes all those affected, anyone lacking a Legend score, to flee out of the Field as quickly as possible. Once outside, they will not return for the remainder of the scene.

satyr_too_clever.name: Too Clever
satyr_too_clever.description: When engaging in a nonviolent contest with another being for defined stakes, spend Momentum to make your die pool for the contest equal to hers. Modifiers from other factors apply after the pools are equalized.
satyr_too_clever.mechanicalEffects: When engaging in a nonviolent contest with another being for defined stakes, spend Momentum to make your die pool for the contest equal to hers. Modifiers from other factors apply after the pools are equalized.

therianthrope_bloody_minded.name: Bloody-Minded
therianthrope_bloody_minded.description: You gain an additional Injured slot. If your Stamina is 5, you also gain an additional Maimed slot. This bonus is cumulative with the Bruised slots from having Stamina 3+.
therianthrope_bloody_minded.mechanicalEffects: You gain an additional Injured slot. If your Stamina is 5, you also gain an additional Maimed slot. This bonus is cumulative with the Bruised slots from having Stamina 3+.

therianthrope_feral_grace.name: Feral Grace
therianthrope_feral_grace.description: You gain +1 Enhancement to all Athletics rolls that do not involve using tools or weapons.
therianthrope_feral_grace.mechanicalEffects: You gain +1 Enhancement to all Athletics rolls that do not involve using tools or weapons.

therianthrope_howl.name: Howl
therianthrope_howl.description: When you display your bestial side to intimidate an - other person, you gain a +1 Enhancement.
therianthrope_howl.mechanicalEffects: When you display your bestial side to intimidate an - other person, you gain a +1 Enhancement.

therianthrope_keen_eyed_predator.name: Keen-Eyed Predator
therianthrope_keen_eyed_predator.description: As the Hunter Knack of the same name
therianthrope_keen_eyed_predator.mechanicalEffects: As the Hunter Knack of the same name

therianthrope_predators_bond.name: Predator’S Bond
therianthrope_predators_bond.description: As the Kitsune Knack, Tongue of the Fox, except that you can only use it on predatory animals (which may be of any genus or species).
therianthrope_predators_bond.mechanicalEffects: As the Kitsune Knack, Tongue of the Fox, except that you can only use it on predatory animals (which may be of any genus or species).

therianthrope_scent_of_blood.name: Scent Of Blood
therianthrope_scent_of_blood.description: You automatically know when you are in the pres - ence of someone with a Bruised or greater injury and the level of her injury. You have +1 Enhancement to follow the trail of that person until she either washes away the scent or covers it with something stronger.
therianthrope_scent_of_blood.mechanicalEffects: You automatically know when you are in the pres - ence of someone with a Bruised or greater injury and the level of her injury. You have +1 Enhancement to follow the trail of that person until she either washes away the scent or covers it with something stronger.

therianthrope_unleash_the_beast.name: Unleash The Beast
therianthrope_unleash_the_beast.description: When you fight unarmed, spend Momentum to add the Lethal tag to your attacks for the remainder of combat.
therianthrope_unleash_the_beast.mechanicalEffects: When you fight unarmed, spend Momentum to add the Lethal tag to your attacks for the remainder of combat.

therianthrope_wary_beasts.name: Wary Beasts
therianthrope_wary_beasts.description: Unless compelled by supernatural means, ordinary animals will not approach or harm you. An observer can make an Occult skill roll with Difficulty 2 to recognize your true nature if he sees animals react.
therianthrope_wary_beasts.mechanicalEffects: Unless compelled by supernatural means, ordinary animals will not approach or harm you. An observer can make an Occult skill roll with Difficulty 2 to recognize your true nature if he sees animals react.

therianthrope_feral_hunter.name: Feral Hunter
therianthrope_feral_hunter.description: Choose a Heroic or Immortal Hunter Knack.
therianthrope_feral_hunter.mechanicalEffects: Choose a Heroic or Immortal Hunter Knack.

wolf_warrior_favored_weapon.name: Favored Weapon
wolf_warrior_favored_weapon.description: As the Warrior Knack Master of Weapons, except that you may only add one tag. At the beginning of the session, choose one of your weapons to be your favored weapon. When you use your favored weapon, add a single additional tag point. This does not have to fit the weapon’s existing profile: A sword can be made to…
wolf_warrior_favored_weapon.mechanicalEffects: As the Warrior Knack Master of Weapons, except that you may only add one tag. At the beginning of the session, choose one of your weapons to be your favored weapon. When you use your favored weapon, add a single additional tag point. This does not have to fit the weapon’s existing profile: A sword can be made to strike at far range, for example (but good luck running over to pick it up). Spend Momentum to switch the benefit to another weapon. Negative cost tags cannot be purchased with this Knack.

wolf_warrior_helping_hands_make_idle_wor.name: Helping Hands Make Idle Work
wolf_warrior_helping_hands_make_idle_wor.description: When you look for help among people who support your cause, you can always find someone willing to offer it. Their aid is humble and limited, but can include pro - viding shelter, sharing supplies, gathering information, or providing a distraction for your actions. Where applica - ble, treat this help as a +1…
wolf_warrior_helping_hands_make_idle_wor.mechanicalEffects: When you look for help among people who support your cause, you can always find someone willing to offer it. Their aid is humble and limited, but can include pro - viding shelter, sharing supplies, gathering information, or providing a distraction for your actions. Where applica - ble, treat this help as a +1 Enhancement.

wolf_warrior_i_love_it_when_a_plan_comes.name: I Love It When A Plan Comes

wolf_warrior_together.name: Together
wolf_warrior_together.description: When you formulate a plan for a complex action that furthers your cause and involves your allies, roll the ap - propriate Knack skill. Your number of successes on that roll become a pool of Enhancement bonuses for anyone taking part in the plan to draw from when playing their part in it.
wolf_warrior_together.mechanicalEffects: When you formulate a plan for a complex action that furthers your cause and involves your allies, roll the ap - propriate Knack skill. Your number of successes on that roll become a pool of Enhancement bonuses for anyone taking part in the plan to draw from when playing their part in it.

wolf_warrior_inspiring_act.name: Inspiring Act
wolf_warrior_inspiring_act.description: When you demonstrate how to perform a task by doing it yourself, you can give an ally a +1 Enhancement to do the same action.
wolf_warrior_inspiring_act.mechanicalEffects: When you demonstrate how to perform a task by doing it yourself, you can give an ally a +1 Enhancement to do the same action.

wolf_warrior_one_of_the_crowd.name: One Of The Crowd
wolf_warrior_one_of_the_crowd.description: When you hide in a group of people, anyone trying to locate you must roll at +1 Difficulty to identify you through any means (direct observation, record searches, divinations, etc.).
wolf_warrior_one_of_the_crowd.mechanicalEffects: When you hide in a group of people, anyone trying to locate you must roll at +1 Difficulty to identify you through any means (direct observation, record searches, divinations, etc.).

wolf_warrior_rallying_presence.name: Rallying Presence
wolf_warrior_rallying_presence.description: When you lead a group in combat, spend Momentum to give every member of the group an additional Bruised damage slot for the duration of the battle. The bonus does not apply to you, and goes away if you are Taken Out or otherwise defeated.
wolf_warrior_rallying_presence.mechanicalEffects: When you lead a group in combat, spend Momentum to give every member of the group an additional Bruised damage slot for the duration of the battle. The bonus does not apply to you, and goes away if you are Taken Out or otherwise defeated.

wolf_warrior_still_kicking.name: Still Kicking
wolf_warrior_still_kicking.description: Once per scene, when you would normally be Taken Out by damage, you may spend Momentum to ignore all effects of the attack that did so, including suffering an Injury Condition.
wolf_warrior_still_kicking.mechanicalEffects: Once per scene, when you would normally be Taken Out by damage, you may spend Momentum to ignore all effects of the attack that did so, including suffering an Injury Condition.

wolf_warrior_strength_in_numbers.name: Strength In Numbers
wolf_warrior_strength_in_numbers.description: When using Teamwork, you increase the maximum number of successes you can add from 3 to 5 and can have multiple people rolling to assist you. To get the benefit of more than 3 successes, you must have a number of help - ers at least equal to the number of successes rolled.
wolf_warrior_strength_in_numbers.mechanicalEffects: When using Teamwork, you increase the maximum number of successes you can add from 3 to 5 and can have multiple people rolling to assist you. To get the benefit of more than 3 successes, you must have a number of help - ers at least equal to the number of successes rolled.

wolf_warrior_champion_of_the_cause.name: Champion Of The Cause
wolf_warrior_champion_of_the_cause.description: Choose one Heroic or Immortal Knack from the Guardian, Leader, or Warrior Knacks. You may select this Knack more than once to take multiple Knacks.
wolf_warrior_champion_of_the_cause.mechanicalEffects: Choose one Heroic or Immortal Knack from the Guardian, Leader, or Warrior Knacks. You may select this Knack more than once to take multiple Knacks.

wolf_warrior_exemplary_deed.name: Exemplary Deed
wolf_warrior_exemplary_deed.description: Spend Momentum to allow an ordinary mortal who supports your cause to use your dice pool for one action. Any given person can only receive this benefit once in her life, but gains a 1 Enhancement on that action.
wolf_warrior_exemplary_deed.mechanicalEffects: Spend Momentum to allow an ordinary mortal who supports your cause to use your dice pool for one action. Any given person can only receive this benefit once in her life, but gains a 1 Enhancement on that action.
